name: Before the Gates
description:
You find yourself in the middle of a field of golden wheat ready for the
harvest.  Far off in the distance large mountains ripple along the horizon.
The sky is clear and there is a chill in the air.  As you run your hand along
the tops of the wheat, the grains slip between your fingers.  You are suddenly
aware that a massive doorway stands before you. The door looks like the last
remaining ruins of a palace reduced to rubble aeons ago.  As you approach the
door, a chill runs up your spine, yet there is something very familiar about
this place.

name: A Muddy Clearing
description:
This muddy clearing is one of the few accessible points to the massive river
that snakes through the land.  The rapids look tough and the water is
literally  rippled with hundreds of fish and another aquatic life.   The heat
rolls of the water and the humidity is almost crushing.

name: The River Tampaqui
description:
This massive river stretches out farther than you can see.  The distance
between each bank is breath taking.  If not for the small grey strands of land
on each side and the massive trees with branches that dip into the water, you
could swear you were sailing the ocean.  The broiling heat makes the humidity
all the more oppressive.

name: A Fork In The River
description:
The river splits off into two distinct branches.  The the north, the river
continues to make its way to the ocean while the western branch seems to split
into a deeper part of the jungle.   The water is moving slightly faster as the
two currents colide to create some slight rapids.

name: The Dark Heart River
description:
The jungle around the river is dark and thick.  The sound of insects and
predators drowns out the sound of the river slowly moving northwest. The water
is thick with mud and the farther you look down the river, the more it seems
to turn into a swamp.

name: The Heart Of Darkness
description:
The river ends as a large quagmire of mud, quick sand, and rot fills the area.
This massive swampland is vicious and ugly.  The smell of water and vegetation
bleeds into the smell of rot and tar.  It seems best to brave the river back
and flee from this place, it holds nothing worth the risk to your life.

description:

will not take you out to the doldrums.

name: Under The White Water
description:
The river is deep enough to dive under the rushing white water, avoiding the
crushing force of water against water.  The current tags at you but you are
able to maintain your own course, avoiding the large rocks and jagged
riverbed. Their seems to be quite a bit of fish that enjoy the flow of the
river under the rapids.

name: The Foot Of A Massive Waterfall
description:
A small lagoon is formed at the foot of this massive waterfall.  The top of
the cliff must be several hundred feet up and the fall would be fatal.  There
seems to be a pathway through the rocks that would lead to the top of these
cliffs, although the climb would not be easy.

name: The Temple of Thunder
description:
As you enter from the marble staircase you are amazed by the colossal scale of
the room you have just entered.  The room is filled with massive pillars of
white marble that tower into the dark clouds above.  The floor is made of
tiles of the same white marble that reflect the arcs of lightning which
cascade through the clouds high above.  It is a very warm damp environment
with several vines of ivy beginning to creep up the pillars.  The sheer size
of this place is overwhelming, yet you are over come with the feeling all is
right and in balance here.

name: On The Road To Dreams
description:
The air has grown thin and the lights you carry have started to flicker,
flare, and some begin to sing soft tunes.  You are reminded of the songs that
mother's sing to their children, gentle notes to guard against bad dreams and
wandering nightmares.

name: On The Road To Dreams
description:
The air has grown thin and the lights you carry have started to flicker,
flare, and some begin to sing soft tunes.  You are reminded of the songs that
mother's sing to their children, gentle notes to guard against bad dreams and
wandering nightmares.

name: Dreaming While Awake
description:
You are sure that you are dreaming.  The air is made of butterflies and each
word you speak becomes a dancing piece of metal that flutters in a breeze you
cannot feel.  There are small spirits at your feet and they all seem to wink
and smile before laughing at a fate you cannot see. The only way you can go is
deeper inside, but as look further down the staircase that wasn't there when
you came in, you feel as if it would be best to stay here.

name: Dreaming While Awake
description:
There is a small door, no bigger than most and certainly no where near as
grand as most. The doorknob is made of wood and the frame is made of silk.
The door seems to pulsate, hands push through the thin cloth and beckon you to
enter. Faces appear as well, screaming and crying. They are pulled away by
other hands and you can hear the familiar sound of flesh being torn.

name: In The Void
description:
There is nothing.  No cold. No warmth. No sound of your voice. No sound of
your heart. No sound of your thoughts.  You are alone. Yet you see so many
others around you. The only thing you barely make out through the emptiness is
a small sign and a small tear in the ceiling.

name: In A Garden Of Broken Teeth
description:
The sky is blanket of skin, stitched together with fish scales and dragon's
teeth. The sun is broken and spins around a square moon.  The ground is made
of crushed teeth, odd flowers in the shape of stomachs grow and shake with the
sound of a heartbeat.  The air smells of acid and roses.

name: In A Sea Of Bile
description:
As if from walking from one room to another, you are engulfed in a  sea of
bile. The foulness is thick and even with the ability or spell to breathe in
liquid, you don't want too.  There is no bottom to the thick gel nor is there
anything above. Yet, if you look the way you came you can it is dry and only a
few steps away.

name: Walking In A Cemetery Of Prayers
description:
The ground is surprise soft.  The bright red and orange moss that covers the
sugar headstones of the graves is warm and soothing to the touch.  The air
smells of rain and salt water.  The sky is a reflection of a corpse and you
can feel small drops of blood fall.  At each grave there is a low murmur, the
last desperate prayers of faith.

name: A Hallway Of Broken Silence
description:
This thin hallway appears from nothing. One moment there is earth and the next
you are walking among a wall full of flowing tapestries.  The floor is made of
solid snakes while the walls whisper to each other and watch you with granite
eyes.  There is no ceiling, only an engulfing void. The sound of metal on
stone moves past you and back again.

name: The Deathbed Of The Ageless
description:
All you can see in a desert of stars.  Burning orbs imbedded in green lava rock
that is cool to the touch.  The sky is a ballet of dancing suns that collide
into each other only to shatter into a thousand more.  The scent of smoke
lingers and the stench of burning hair is everywhere.

name: A Staircase Of Daggers
description:
You make your way up a staircase made completely of daggers and razors. Each
step cuts through your feet, the hand rails are serpents with seven heads and
seven fangs.  There is nothing else but the staircase, occasionally a mirror
will float by, showing a thousand dead eyes watching you.

name: A Room Of Whispering Mirrors
description:
This room is made entirely of glass.  It is almost impossible to see anything
as the floor, the walls, the ceiling, and even the air is a reflective
surface.  The entire place is whispering into your ear, each of them distinct
and clear yet only a garble of words and taunts.  You hear your own voice
begging you to bury your weapon into your eye, and at the same time another
voice warning you that death is near.  The very air that is breathed is glass.

name: A Room Of Burning Children
description:
The smell of the room is sickening. The entire area is engulfed in flame,
rivers of sulfur and bile flow below it, the fire lightly dancing on the blue
black waters.  The flames make the faces of children, some mocking, some
dancing, others crying, other's dying. Among the black smoke, red ash, and
hellfire stands a figure, engulfed by spinning masses of teeth and tentacles.

name: Entering The Mist
description:
The water of the open sea continues to rock back and forth. Yet
to the south you can see what appears to be a huge fogbank.
You wonder if it would be safe to venture in, the mist seems
to be thick and ominous.

name: Wandering In The Mist
description:
The mist is thick and heavy, even breathing is beginning to become difficult.
The only light you can see is from your own and the water seems to be black as
ebony.  You can see pieces of wreckage floating in the water. You hope you
don't run into a large rock or coastal reef.

name: Approaching A Black Sand Beach
description:
The mist begins to yield as you can barely make out the shape of land dead
south of you! The beach looks covered in some kind of substance that resembles
tar or liquid darkness.  You see the skeletons of a few wrecked ships dotting
the otherwise clear shoreline.

name: Wandering A Black Sand Beach
description:

warm and shimmers like a blanket of night.  In the distance you can see some

you continue away from the water.

sort of hills to the south.  The various pieces of wreckage begin to thin as
you continue away from the water.

name: The Edge Of The Foothills
description:
The nightsky beach to the north fades from view, the ocean now hidden beyond
the horizon.  The moss covered path seems to have not been used in centuries,
only a faint marking of carved stone underneath gives the impression that
someone once made this area their home.

name: A Trail In The Foothills
description:
The ancient roadway leads further to the south.  The hills around you are
small with gentle slopes.  It seems an ideal place for children to play games.
 Beautiful flowers of green and purple dot several of the hills along with
various varieties of shrubs and other plants.

name: Deep In The Foothills
description:
The trail is almost unrecognizable from the rest of the thin wheat colored
grass. The foothills cast huge shadows along the path and your paranoia
reminds you that this would provide an excellent place for an attack.  You
have seen no sign of life other than wandering rabbits and the few lynx's
you've run across.

name: A Fork In The Road
description:
The path splits off towards the east into the shadow of a very large hill. To
the south you can barely make out signs of a road going deeper into the
Highlands.  You're not sure which path is safer.

name: A Blocked Path
description:
The path through the dense hills was once cut off. You can see where magical
shields have cut through everything but now they have vanished. The land is
scarred but what ever magical force had protected this area has faded.

name: An Ancient Road
description:
The road is now very much apparent.  The ancient stones are worn and faded but
you can still make out a series of symbols. They appear to be a crest of some
kind.  The road continues towards the large hill and back to the fork in the
road.

name: In The Shadow Of The Hill
description:
As your eyes adjust to the shadows you begin to make out buildings at the very
foot of the hill.  Slanted Roofs and one exceedingly large tower of some sort
seem to almost perfectly meld into the hillside. It would be impossible to see
from anywhere else.

name: The Edge Of A Deserted Village
description:
The buildings are clear now.  It seems to be a village, or what was once a
village. The fences around some of the farms have long since fell and decayed.
The buildings are ravaged by time and ill weather.  It does not seem that the
village died out by violence, there is no sign that anyone has lived or died
here in quite awhile.

name: Inside A Deserted Village
description:
The village is empty save the ghosts of the buildings and the memories of
their inhabitants.  The small homes along the street are barely standing.  The
tile of the hat shaped roofs are mostly scattered to the ground.  You cannot
see signs of a battle or a plague, it is as if the people of the village
simply left and never looked back.  The large tower shaped building to the
north seems to be the only building that does not look dangerous to enter.

name: Inside A Deserted Home
description:
The home is tidy and sparsely decorated. A few old scrolls of an odd paper lay
shattered on the floor from age.  A parchment of some kind hangs on the wall,
encased in glass.  The symbols are odd, more like a series of drawings rather
than a language.  You have never seen such writing in your lifetime and wonder
even if the oldest of the Ghoul Mages could read it.

name: Inside A Deserted Home
description:
The home is almost completely empty. Only a few torn mats remain, neatly
tucked into the corner of the home.  An incredibly low table with several long
pillows dominate the center of the small house.  A tea pot and several small
glasses are placed in the center of the table. You wonder if perhaps the
gnomes or pixies once inhabited this village.

name: In Front Of The Pagoda
description:
The odd tower seems to be made of six or seven of the houses stacked on top of
each other. The large iron gate has since fell off its hinges and is covered
in rust and time.  The building looks safe enough to explore.  More symbols
decorate the walls and the few remaining banners that are motionless despite
the breeze.

name: The Entrance To The Pagoda
description:
The Pagoda seems much larger than you thought. The courtyard is beautiful,
with flowers of all different colors and sizes growing unchecked.  Several
fountains are now quiet with different flowers and plants.  An odd statue
guards the main entrance, a faceless creature with the body of a lion and tail
of snakes.

name: Inside The Pagoda
description:
The central room is the most luxiourus of any of the places you've seen so far
on this island. Numerous paintings of strange, mist like creatures adorn the
walls, carpets of silk and wool cover the floors, and several large black iron
Statues guard the entrance. You can still smell the lingering scent of incense
from all over.  The candles that light the Pagoda seem well tended.

name: A Meditation Room
description:
The room is empty save a single flickering candle. The walls are a muted white
 and the floor a dull gray.  There is nothing here to distract your eye from
the lone candle.  There is no dust or dirt, somebody has been keeping this
area clean.

name: A Prayer Room
description:
The room is lined with different parchments of symbols. Each gray parchment
contains a single symbol, written in a bold ink with a delicate hand.  A
statue of a multi-armed creature stands at the center, all six arms folded in
prayer. Several strands of beads rest at the feet of the statue.

name: A Meditation Room
description:
The room is empty save a single painting. The painting shows a single dot of
black against a white background.  The walls are a muted white and the floor a
dull Gray. There is nothing here to distract your eye from the lone dot of
black ink. There is no dust or dirt, somebody has been keeping this area
clean.

name: A Training Room
description:
Several racks of weapons line the walls. An Ogre sized dummy of sand and
leather stands in the center of the room. The floor is covered in a soft
padding.  There are several charts that have detailed maps of the mortal body
on the ceiling. You cannot read the symbols bit it seems they explain weak
points in the anatomy of all creatures.

name: A Sparring Dojo
description:
This room is barren except for the padded white floor. The walls are bare and
it seems as if it has one sole purpose.  The slight indentations on the floor
and old bloodstains on the floor seem to hint at just what that purpose is.

name: Inside The Pagoda
description:
The hear the faint sound of chanting in the area, some sort of prayer in a
language you have never heard before. The walls are covered in an odd tapestry
of a some God. Six armed with purple skin and wielding two beautiful scimitars
and other weapons you have never seen before. Your senses tell you that
somebody is moving around here. You hope that they are friendly, or rich, or
both.

description:

name: Inside The Pagoda
description:
The incense is heavy in the air and the room is wildly decorated with
different flowers, banners and a few statues of creatures that seem to
resemble the different races yet seem incredibly alien as well.  The smell of
food cooking is coming from the east. This must be these monks living
quarters.

name: A Simple Kitchen
description:
This kitchen is amazingly simple. A small iron fireplace with a large black
pot is about the extent of equipment.  You see no oven and the only utensils
are several knives and an odd wooden hammer. There are no spices to be seen
save a brownish paste that smells of ginger.

name: A Barren Dining Hall
description:
A long wooden table stretches down the room.  The chairs are incredibly simple
but they look sturdy enough. The bowls and spoons are already laid out, made
of wood as well.  The few monks that are eating are quiet. They take slow
mouthfuls of food and seem to be focused on the single candle in the middle of
the table.

name: The Common Room
description:
This room seems to be the only one that is dedicated to leisure. Several
bookshelves hold numerous tomes and on a simple wooden table an odd game made
of wooden pieces with symbols stands untouched. There are several large
couches that are padded with bird feathers and rabbit skin.

name: The Monks Quarters
description:
The room is filled with several cots that are made of animal skins and a
strong black wood.  The pillows are simply animal skins over several layers of
cotton. A rack is next to each cot that seems to hold the robes of the monk as
they sleep.

name: The Monks Quarters
description:
The room is filled with several cots that are made of animal skins and a
strong black wood.  The pillows are simply animal skins over several layers of
cotton. A rack is next to each cot that seems to hold the robes of the monk as
they sleep.

name: Inside The Pagoda
description:
The statues and the paintings of the room have a much darker tone than before.
The statues show creatures of horrible faces and bodies. Winged Crabs and
multi-tentacled and multi-mouthed demons. The paintings show a group of
familiar yet alien creatures being hunted down and slaughtered by a huge
creature wielding a massive hammer.

name: A Memorial
description:
This room seems to be a dedication to someone or something.  The same
six-armed God is present yet his arms are tied and bound, his eyes removed.
The candles that burn are black and the flowers are long since wilted and dry.
 You can hear the whispered sobs of someone.

name: A Private Study
description:
The room is filled with scrolls and texts of all types. You even recognize
some of the scrolls as a very ancient form of Ghoulish. The books all have
sketches of horrible creatures and horrible battles. It is becoming clear that
whoever this Six-Armed God was, he was defeated.

name: A Room Of Attrition
description:
The walls of this room are covered in various devices of torture and pain.
Several posts with shackles attached dominate the center of the room. It seems
that pain is a part of these monk's philosophy. You shudder at some of the
tools as your mind imagines what they are used for.

name: An Odd Gallery
description:
This room is dedicated to paintings of ancient things. They seem to be in some
sort of order. The first depicts the great Six-Armed God and his followers.
Each creature by his side resembles something you know but at the same time
are obviously not what you think. The next shows the emergence of the horrible
creatures. The rest depict great battles that raged between the two sides.
The final painting depicts the large Daemon creature with the massive hammer
sealing away the Six-Armed God and the last survivors of his kind.

name: An Odd Gallery
description:
This room is dedicated to the numerous statues that have adorned the Pagoda.
One looks almost human yet his forehead is heavily sloped and ridged and much
larger than the average human. You thought you saw a Ghoul yet the creature
has 3 eyes and teeth of knives. One statue is well over fifteen feet tall,
what appears to be a type of Orc you have never seen.  It's tusks are at least
two feet long and its arms are as broad a man's stomach.

name: Closer To The Top
description:
The room is smaller than the others and from the simple window you can see you
are quite high into the air. The room ahead seems to be the only way to go.
You swear you thought you heard somebody call out your name from above you.

name: The Sensei's Quarters
description:
The head of the monks must live here.  The room is filled with various books
and scrolls that seem dedicated to unlocking magic.  Some of these scrolls are
even in common! You recognize some of the others. Vash's theories on magical
destabilization, Vilutu's recounts of the ancient days, and even some of the
newest theories you have just heard about! This Sensei must have access to the
outside world.

name: A Guarded Steel Gate
description:
A Huge Gate leads up higher into the temple but it seems that the guards here
aren't very happy.  The room is adorned with numerous symbols and runes and
you know you recognize several of them as protection spells.  A BANG erupts as
something pounds against the gate. You wonder if keeping it closed really is
the best idea.

name: A Vortex Of Colors
description:
The room houses a beautiful whirlpool of energies. There seems to be some kind
of barrier between you and the vortex. It's beauty is unmatched, so much so
that you forgot about the huge creature with the head of a lion, the body of a
lizard, and a tail of living snakes that is hungrily staring at you.

name: Inside A Ruined Temple
description:
The Vortex releases you into a strange place. You are underground for sure as
the slime covered walls are cold and naturally carved from pure granite. You
smell nothing but can hear the sounds of rage and an ancient curse. The
skeletons of odd creatures, demon and otherwise are scattered everywhere. You
see a strange writing that is burned onto the stone. It suddenly shifts itself
to read in your native tongue! THE UN-NAMED LIE DEFEATED. ALL THAT REMAIN IS
THEIR RAGE.

name: The Catacombs Of The Un-Named
description:
These tunnels seem to meld into each other. What is solid rock one minute
begins to shift into a pathway while another pathway seems to simple disappear
into stone. You can hear creatures running through these tunnels shouting
war-cries you cannot understand. You hope you can avoid them while you try to
figure out how to get out of here.

name: The Dark Gate Of Synot
description:
You find yourself at a huge gate,  covered in protection glyphs and not unlike
the gate that resides deep within the Ghoul homecity.  The lock looks rusted
shut and it seems from the battered frame that these creatures have tried to
open it on many different occasions to no luck.  To the west the tunnels
continue further down, hopefully it is a way out!

name: The Catacombs Of The Un-Named
description:

begins to shift into a pathway while another pathway seems to simple disappear
into stone. You can hear creatures running through these tunnels shouting
war-cries you cannot understand. You hope you can avoid them while you try to
figure out how to get out of here.

name: The Throne Of Synot Lodhal
description:
The Cave is empty save for a make-shift throne of bones. You can see no way
out of the cave save through the gate you took to get in. A huge creature with
six arms stands as you enter, a look of surprise written on the scarred face.
It is clear that nobody has seen this creature in a time to long to remember.

name: Dont Change (:
description: Dont Change (:

name: A Dirt Packed Tunnel
description:
This tunnel has been made by simply digging out the earth and then
painstakingly pushing the remaining dirt into the walls to reinforce it. The
ground is quite stable and it seems as if this tunnel could withstand any
force.  By the amount of traffic of all the ants going by, it is obvious it is
meant to be sturdy.

against the sides.  Judging by the add designs and tracks on the walls and

even rusted equipment.

name: The Worker's Haven
description:
This large cavern has been fashioned to give the thousand of worker ants a
place to eat their small meals and rest before they ordered out to do their
unending service to their liege.  The ground is caked in mucus, stomach acid,
and even the dried out husks of worker ants that have long since passed away.

name: The Royal Tunnels
description:
This system of tunnels is actually smaller than the others.  The traffic is
much slower as only the royal guardians, egg carriers, and royalty inhabit the
space.  The walls are carefully constructed and even small twigs and leaves
have been used to reinforce the walls.  It is clear by the way the
egg-carriers avoid you and the guardians eye you that this area is off limits
to everyone.

description:
This large chamber has been painstakingly built to protect the eggs of the
colony. Numerous egg carriers and ant matrons crawl all over, taking hatched
larvae up to the higher levels of the colony or making sure the unhatched eggs
are safe. There is a constant stream of egg carriers moving from somewhere
else, bringing eggs inside.

description:

bodies. They live a life of luxury, a steady supply of food and royal jelly is
brought to them.  They lounge about, waiting for the time they are called into
service.

name: A Secret Tunnel
description:
This large tunnel is designed as a quick escape if the Queen herself is
threatened. It is hastily built and seems rather unsafe, it is clear that she
has never had to use it.  You can continue to climb up, the air is warmer and
the walls barely contain just a hint of sunlight.

name: The Queen's Chamber
description:
This large chamber is dozens of times larger than any of the other chambers in
the colony.  The ground is sticky with jelly and goo and the shells of hatched
eggs and discarded food stuff litter the area.  It is obvious something
massive and important lives here.

name: The Imperial Gate
description:
This massive iron gate is one of the most amazing things you have ever seen.
The gate itself must be over 100 feet tall, and at least five feet of pure
iron. The walls of this great city must be twice that width in mortar. Whoever
built this city must have spent generations perfecting such an awesome display
of engineering.

name: The Trader's Way
description:
This cobblestone street connects to the Imperial Gate and also enters into the
trader's district of Bazabel. You can hear the many calls of merchants and
traders hawking their wares as well as numerous people bartering over prices.

name: A Spice Trader's Stall
description:
This stall is just a simple canvas put up to block out the sun and wind. The
air is sweet and you can see several spices you have never even heard of
before. The  man standing by his goods smiles and offers you to try a small
taste of the  many spices he has available.

name: A Trinket Vendor's Stall
description:
This stall is filled with numerous trinkets and baubles that you can't imagine
have any use other than looking rather attractive. The woman tending to the
stall smiles and bows and offers you a wild story about how each trinket was
found.

name: A Book Vendor's Stall
description:
This stall is filled with numerous books and scrolls.  You see some that
detail the history of the city while others have accounts of amazing heros and
tales of horrible monsters.  Some of it may be worth a read if you have a
spare coin and the spare time.

name: A Fruit Vendor's Stall
description:
Numerous fruits and vegetables lie in several carts here. You see watermelon,
honeydew, grapes, apricots, apples, and even some hard to find kiwi's and
cherries.  The woman tending the cart asks you to sample some odd thing called
a date.

name: A Meat Vendor's Stall
description:
This stall is filled with the hanging corpses of numerous animals. They have
all been cured and dried to last for months.  The small man running the stall
invites you try a tender lamb shank that he just prepared this morning.

name: A Drink Vendor's Stall
description:
This stall is filled with numerous bottles of wine, ale, mead, and juices of
all sorts.  You see some rather nice looking bottles that must cost quite a
pretty gold coin.  Perhaps you could pick up a bottle for the road or as a
present to a loved one when you return back home.

description:
This building has been converted into a gathering place for all sorts of
people to sell or trade their old or outdated items.  Maybe you'll find a
nice weapon or armor for cheap.  There is no real system of set up, people are
wandering around and presenting the few items they have to one another.

description:

south is not paved but rather hard packed dirt. It does not seem to be
travelled as often.

community.

name: The Sentinel District
description:
This part of the city is dedicated to the housing and training of the local
police force.  This city's police force is in itself an army. You see numerous
barracks and training facilities for these men. Apparently women are not
allowed to serve in the imperial services.

relaxing.

name: The Common District
description:
This part of the city is where the servants and other unrecognized workers of
the city must live. The streets are poorly cared for and if anyone here owned
a carriage or cart the wheels would quickly be torn apart from the shoddy
roads.  The streets are filled with beggars and dirty children who should
probably be in school, if there is one here.

name: Inside The Royal Palace
description:
This Palace is amazing.  The halls are twice the size of anything you've
ever seen.  The entire floor is carpeted with fur and a soft wool. You see
paintings of all sorts, beautiful armors and rarities from around the world.
There are trophies of horrible animals and even a few fountains! Yet
you also notice the high number of guards that are wandering through
the halls and you also notice the large scroll that is has been
nailed to the wall.

name: The Throne Room
description:
The beauty and lavishness of the Palace can only be surpassed by this room.
The walls are covered in amazing murals, tapestries, and paintings that
exhibit a fine taste in art from around the continent.  There are several
large couches filled with soft cotton and several servants seem to be
constantly bringing in silver platters of food and chalices of wine. The man
on the throne looks to be quite young, yet by his battle armor and the wicked
looking crossbow next to him you can only assume this is the son of Warlord
Zanzen, Yu-Hin.

name: Bazabel Transportal
description:
This small room contains a small ticket booth, and a spiral staircase that
leads upward into the transport booth.  Bazabel Transportal guarantees
safety during the magical portal process, and as far as anyone knows, noone
has "disappeared" during a transportal.

name: Transportal Chamber
description:
This small room sits at the top of the spiral stairs.  No decorations are
placed here, to ensure that there are no disruptions with the transportal
process.  One just needs to stand in the room, have a valid magic portal
ticket, and soon they will be sent to the proper location.

name: Placeholder
description: Placeholder Room

name: The Mouth Of The Cave
description:
You have just taken your first step into a bear cave.  Many man eating bears
live in this cave and can get to be pretty big.  You should be sure to know
where you are at at all times.  Find some way to mark your path, beware of the
bears don't anger them.  It is said that a rare white bear lives in the heart
of the cave.

name: A Dark Corridor
description:
The walls of the corridor are dark and identical. Figuring out your exact
location within them is nearly impossible. The ground is damp and there is a
musty scent looming within the air. You feel your feet brush past a pile of
bones as you continue to make your way onward. Spiderwebs are all around you
and you can feel their eerie tickling as you walk.

name: A Dark Corridor
description:
You find yourself standing within a large cavern. A few dim beams of light
shine in from the world above through some nearly obsolete crack in the great
ceiling that lies above. The smell of fresh meat lingers here.

name: A Large Ice Cavern
description:
You stand within a massive cavern. The ground is stained red with blood, and
bones lay strewn about the great cavern. Vines grow up the walls of the cavern
fighting each other for the small amount of light that makes it into this
cavern. A loud growl can be heard here.

name: A Humming Dirt Path
description:
This small path has not been travelled often by halfling feet.  Only a thin
outline of dirt leads the way further north.  The sound of a faint humming is
everywhere, and more than just a few bees fly past, busy in their routine.

name: Before A Great Oak
description:
This massive oak trees appears to be hundreds of years old.  It reaches at
least a hundred feet into the air, the branches spreading out, creating a cool
canopy.  The dirt around is soft and a deep brown, this would be an ideal spot
to rest and relax. Even the numerous bees seem relaxed and content in the
presence of such beauty.

name: Amongst The Branches
description:
The branches provide an amazing amount of support, despite your weapons and
armor, they do not moan or crack, even the slightest bit.  The leaves are an
ever-green and the smell of honey is heavy in the air.

name: Inside The Hive
description:
The smell of honey is overpowering and the entire place feels sticky and
humid. Bees of all sizes move back and forth, mostly oblivious to your
presence.  Everything is a muted yellow or golden, the honeycomb walls are so
uniform and distracting. It is hard to identify any clear paths.

there is always a small amount of give which makes walking uneasy.

This tunnel is small and cramped, you feel covered in an odd mixture of honey
and wax.  There is less traffic in this tunnel as the deeper workings of the
hive seem reserved for specific tasks.  While the floor and walls feel firm,
there is always a small amount of give which makes walking uneasy.

name: The Pollen Storage
description:
This large patchwork of half finished honeycomb provides an excellent storage
facility for the hive.  Layers and layers of pollen are stored here until they
are consumed in order to make honey in order to make stronger bees.  The smell
of flowers is almost too strong to handle.

name: A Forgotten Space
description:
This small section of honeycomb has been covered over in wax and forgotten.
For whatever reason, the bees no longer seemed interested in this room, the
wax and honey is dried and stiff.  There is nothing in the room, save a few
odd pieces of bone and long dead bees.

name: The Inner Hive
description:
This tunnel through the honeycomb is a bit wider, despite being even deeper
inside the hive.  There are few very bees in this area, the workers seem to
shun this area for the most part.  Only a few very large bees and the youngest
seem to dawdle in this part.

name: The Honey Pot
description:
This cross section of various honeycomb appears to be the main storage space
for the precious honey the hive produces.  It is hard to move as it is just
sits on the floor, the occasional bee coming in to gather some to transport
out or to come in and create more.

name: The Queen's Lair
description:
This massive alcove is created at the very center of the hive.  The room is
filled with freshly laid eggs, honey, and the rarest royal honey.  This is the
biggest space in the hive, from the sounds above and below, whomever resides
in this alcove can hear and feel the entire goings on of the hive.

name: A Shortcut Through The Hive
description:
This small and cramped tunnel appears to be a quick short cut through the
entire hive.  It is sticky and the sweet smell of honey permeates everything,
but this does appear to be the fastest way out of the hive.

name: Entrance to an unkept cemetery
description:
Beyond the archway in which you are now under rests an old, overgrown
cemetary. Only a small path is visible inside the cemetery, as the rest
are covered with tall grass and the pieces of fallen apart headstones.

name: Inside the Cemetery Gate
description:
Not even five steps into the holy burial grounds of old, the dead oak trees
begin to talk amongst themselves. The creeking and groaning might make one
truly believe that these old oak trees are alive. Suddenly the grass moves
around your feet.

name: A small path
description:
The path in which you travel lies straight. Just a few pieces of granite,
from fallen apart headstones, rest upon the ground where grass use to be
plush. The trees begin to moan louder with each step, almost as if they
are warning the inhabitants of the cemetery...or you.

name: Before a Large Mausoleum
description:
Standing before you, inside this small cemetary, is a rather large, and
luxurious mausoleum. This tomb has withstood the test of time and seems
as if it has been taken care of. By who or what remains unknown. However,
some inscriptions have been made on the wall.

name: Inside the Mausoleum
description:
Silence envelopes you while the darkness comsumes you. The inside of this
resting place is much larger than its outside appearance lets one assume.
Some shrieking can be heard, coming from somewhere inside the grave.

name: The Resting Place
description:
A clean, unweathered cherry wood coffin rests upon a large stone platform
in the middle of this giant tomb. The lid is pushed off to the side, yet
no dirt or dust rests upon the red velvet material within it. Once again,
some Drow markings appear upon the lid. A breeze can be felt coming from
where the platform meets the floor.

name: A spiraling staircase
description:
Lanterns incased in red glass are hung on the walls beside the staircase.
The shrieking is coming from beneath you. And with the lanterns around you,
lighting is not a concern, as nothing can be seen that will attack you.

name: Bottom of the Staircase
description:

name: In a large cavern
description:
You are now inside one of the largest cavern systems within the realm.
Bats can be heard shrieking about as they chase the moths in which they
feed upon. A slight howl can also be heard.

name: Inside the Cavern
description:
A small puddle on the cavern floor reflects the red light coming from the
numerous lanterns placed throughout this vast place. Fluttering wings
can be heard around you, and off in the distance. What sounds like an egg
cracking open is among the many noises glancing off of the rock cave walls.

name: Deep within the Cavern
description:
The shells of cuccoons lie upon the ground, covering it completely. With
each step comes a soft crunch. Red lanterns still continue to light your
surroundings. The shrieks of the baby vampires are nearly deafening, but
most adventurers are able to keep a sound mind and continue their journey.

name: A Small Rockfall
description:
A small crevasse, surrounded by many rocks, works its way north, into the
mountain itself.  You see evidence of other traffic travelling to and from the
small pass, although it looks like a tough road.  The road north up the
mountain twists and turns, and at times, seems to be almost vertical.  Huge
white clouds occasionally mask the top of the peak.

name: A Small Rockfall
description:
A small crevasse, surrounded by many rocks, works its way north, into the
mountain itself.  You see evidence of other traffic travelling to and from the
small pass, although it looks like a tough road.  The road north up the
mountain twists and turns, and at times, seems to be almost vertical.  Huge
white clouds occasionally mask the top of the peak.

name: Bottom Of The Glacier
description:
You stand at the bottom of the huge glacier that makes up the north face of
Axenose, the tallest peak of the Ironkores.  Many famous climbers have met
their match at this peak.  At times the path upwards seems almost vertical,
although not entirely impossible.  The ice is cleared below you, and you see
the main trail of Ironkore pass to the south.

name: Bottom Of The Glacier
description:
You stand at the bottom of the huge glacier that makes up the north face of
Axenose, the tallest peak of the Ironkores.  Many famous climbers have met
their match at this peak.  At times the path upwards seems almost vertical,
although not entirely impossible.

name: Climbing The Glacier
description:
You climb precariously along an icy glacier.  From here you can see back down
into the pass, and see the mighty entrance to IronHolde to the southeast.  The
dark valley leading into Tyrybblyn can be seen down and to the southwest.
It doesn't seem to far down from here.

name: Climbing The Glacier
description:
You climb precariously along an icy glacier.  Off on a peak to the west, you
can see the tops of a huge castle.  It is a long distance off, but you swear
you can still see the inhabitants, walking the walls...they must be huge!  The
sparkly black rock that marks the caves of the orcs can be seen further west
down the pass.  It's quite a view!

name: Climbing The Glacier
description:
You climb precariously along an icy glacier.  The huge oaks of the Elder
Forest can be seen in the haze along the western border, and you swear you can
still make out the bright colors of the pendants, flying in the breeze above
Alden.  From where you stand now, it would be dangerous to fall all the
way down!

name: Climbing The Glacier
description:
You climb precariously along an icy glacier.  At this point, anything below
you is lost in a frozen haze.  The wind whips about, threatening to throw you
from the mountain.  You barely hang on to the small hand and foot holds that
make up this path.

name: Top Of The Glacier
description:
You stand at the top of huge glacier, stuck to the north face of Axenose, the
highest peak of the Ironkores.  The path heads off north here, skirting the
edge of some steeper terrain.  Over the edge to the south begins the long
climb back down the mountain, towards IronHolde.

name: A Narrow Icy Pass
description:
You walk, climb and crawl amongst the icy rocks that make up this pass.  North
of here is the peak of Axenose, the halfway point of the pass.  The icy wind
blows sharply through the pass, chilling your through your clothes and armor.

name: A Rocky Forest
description:
You walk along a dirt track, that zigs and zags its way through several large
stones, evidence of rockfalls from the mountains above.  Slowly the path heads
north and down, towards the green of a forest.  Above you, you hear the sound
of the icy winds ripping through Bitter Pass.

description:

north and down, towards the green of a forest.

name: A Rocky Forest
description:
You walk along a dirt track, that zigs and zags its way through several large
stones, evidence of rockfalls from the mountains above.  Slowly the path heads
north and down, towards the green of a forest.  You drop down into a small
valley, with a stream running down the middle.

name: Standing In The Stream
description:
You splash about in a shallow stream.  The water moves swiftly, but it is not
deep enough to cause you any harm.  Small silver fish swim by you.  The path
heads back up either side of the little valley.

name: Standing In The Stream
description:

deep enough to cause you any harm.  Small silver fish swim by you.  The path
heads back up either side of the little valley.

name: In The Elder Woods
description:
You walk along a dirt track that wander amongst the oaks of the Elder Forest.
The sound of rustling leaves on the forest floor, and the occasionally squawk
of a raven in the distance is the only thing that breaks the lonely silence of
this dark place.

name: Dont Change This Room
description: You stumble into a newly created room.

name: The Southern Plains
description:
You leave the small road and walk into the grass of the plains.  The wind
blowing it about gently causes the grass to ripple, and creates an effect not
much unlike that of flowing water.  The smell of the fresh air invigorates
you, and you feel like adventuring forward.

name: The Southern Plains
description:

blowing it about gently causes the grass to ripple, and creates an effect not
much unlike that of flowing water.  The smell of the fresh air invigorates
you, and you feel like adventuring forward.  The grass seems to have grown a
bit higher here, and covers your boots.

name: The Southern Plains
description:

blowing it about gently causes the grass to ripple, and creates an effect not

name: Amongst The Blades
description:
You stop suddenly at look about you.  You gasp as you realize that the grass
has grown to a point high over your head, and yet each blade seems as thick as
a tree trunk.  Looking about, you realize that somehow, without noticing the
change, you have been shrunk!  Hopefully there will be some kind of way to fix
this!  Realizing there was no way to get back through the grass behind you,
you move on.

name: Amongst The Blades
description:
You move about the blades of grass, much liked you used to move about the
great forests.  You hear the clicks and hum's of various insects and other
creatures that make their home in the grass.  Somewhere there must be a way
out of here.

Large rocks litter the surface of this large clearing.  You find it difficult
to pick a path amongst the boulders.  The smell of death is strong in this
area, probably coming from the decaying flesh still stuck on the bones
scattered about carelessly.

name: A Narrow Canyon
description:
A narrow canyon leads north through the rocky pass.  The air is cool and
moist...perhaps there is a water source somewhere in the canyon.  Green vines
crawl up the rocks, and creep out of the cracks and crevices of the canyon
wall.

name: A Small Spring
description:
The narrow canyon ends abruptly at a small spring.  A clear pool of water has
formed at the bottom of a small crack.  Water drips slowly from the crack.
You realize that there are no signs of creatures here, save the footprints of
smaller wildlife.  Perhaps this is a safe place to rest.

name: A Small Plateau
description:
A small plateau looks out over the land.  From this vantage point, you can see
down into the Ironkore Valley to the south and below you.  Further south
stretches the southern plains, and you can just barely make out the white
sands of the Talon Desert beyond them.  The winds are quite strong up here, so
be careful where you tread.

name: The Boulder Gate
description:
A huge gate, carved from the rock of the mountain, stands before you.
Whatever creature crafted such a thing must be mighty indeed, for it is much
too heavy for you to lift or move.  Lucky for you, the bars are also spaced
far enough apart, that you can just barely squeeze through the opening.

name: A Wall Of Boulders
description:
You tread along the castle wall, which is crafted out of huge boulders.  Far
below you, you can see the Ironkore Valley, and the road you traveled to
reach this point.

name: A Rocky Courtyard
description:
The castle courtyard is made up of large, crude statues of giants, carved out
of the rock of the mountain.  Set in various warlike poses, the statues state
evilly back at you, and threaten you with huge weapons held at the ready.

name: The Main Hall
description:
The main hall of this stone castle stretches out to the east, and the ceiling
towers high above you.  Not much care has been taken to keep this castle
clean, as rocks and dirt lie all about the floor.  No trophies line the wall,
and the usual tapestries are also absent.

name: The Throne Room
description:
A gigantic stone throne takes up nearly the entire eastern side of this room.
A few trophies of war hang from the walls, mostly the skeletons of what
appears to be dwarves, their tattered clothing still hanging from the bones.
Unlike the other rooms of the castle, this one is lit by many torches placed
around the walls.

name: Wandering The Stone Castle
description:
You wander about the halls of the stone castle.  This mighty fortress was
obviously designed with the needs of the giants in mind, for everything you
encounter is built in a scale quite a bit larger than yourself.

name: A Lookout Tower
description:
This lookout tower stands high above the castle grounds.  From here you have a
good vantage point of the valley around the castle, including the road leading
up the the main gate.  It is built quite tough, and seems like a good place to
repel invaders from.

name: A Suspended Walkway
description:
You stand on a suspended walkway, high above the bubbling mud of the swamp.
Hanging from the branches of several of the larger trees, the walkway gives
the lizardmen a place to attach their homes and huts out of the muck and wet
of the bog.  A rope ladder heads down towards the bog.

name: The Wartrainers Hut
description:
This small hut has a hammock on one side, but the rest of the room is bare.  A
leather pad covers most of the floor.  Training weapons rest on racks against
the far wall.  This looks like a good place to practice your skills.

name: The Royal Hut
description:
This hut is larger than the others, and more care has been taken with its
construction.  Interesting looking lizardman art hangs on the walls, and a
collection of skulls is set in a ring around the room.  A large wooden throne
sits against the far wall.

name: The Huntresses Hut
description:
This hut has a strange smell about it, like a cross between rotting meat and
preserving chemicals.  Small corpses of muskrats and other swamp animals lie
in a pile in one corner, and a large water container sits in the middle of the
room.

name: The Scribes Hut
description:
Small scraps of paper lie strewn about this messy hut.  The bulk of the space
is taken up by a large desk and chair.  The smell of foul inks floats through
the air.

name: A Skull-Covered Hut
description:
The smell of death is strong in this hut.  Bits and pieces of various woodland
creatures sit in various places around the room.  Strange relics, probably
used for some sort of lizardman ritual are placed carefully on a large wooden
shelf.

name: The Armorers Hut
description:
The smell of tanning fluid hits you as you enter this hut.  Large pieces of
deerskin hang from ropes ran across the top of the hut, most in various stages
of the tanning process.  A box with bits of metal stands close by.

name: Wandering The Bog
description:
The sound of bubbling is all around you as you explore this strange bog.
While only ankle deep, the mud and water pulls at you, making walking
difficult.  Above you, a makeshift walkway connects several suspended huts.
The sound of insects is all about you.

name: An Overgrown Trail
description:
You travel down a very overgrown trail.  At times, you can barely make out the
path, due to all the vines and bushes.  The trees are covered in a strange,
dangling moss.  The sounds of insects and other wildlife are all about you.
The trail appears to open up into some sort of swamp to the north.

name: A Sturdy Dock
description:
A sturdy dock juts out into the bay, with several small skiffs tied up
alongside.  Through the mists to the west, a large, green island can be seen.
North of the beach here is the southern edge of the Spearfang Forest, while
south of you is a huge spread of thick jungle.  The graded dirt of a road
heads off to the east.

name: On Bullhorn Road
description:
The wide dirt track of Bullhorn Road twists and turns through the golden sands
of a pristine beach.  The sounds of crashing waves can be heard to the west.
Off to the north, the edge of the Spearfang Forest can be seen.  South of the
road, the beginnings of a thick jungle rise into the sky.

name: On Bullhorn Road
description:

name: On Bullhorn Road
description:
The wide dirt track of Bullhorn Road twists and turns through the foothills of
the rocky mountains rising up to the east.  You can see the tops of the pines
of Spearfang Forest off to the northwest.  From the peaks of the foothills,
you catch a glimpse of a large, sparkling lake to the southwest, and a large
expanse of green jungle beyond it.

name: On Bullhorn Road
description:
The wide dirt track of Bullhorn Road twists and turns through rocky mountains.
On either side of the road, the towering rock cliffs rise up, blocking any
chance of leaving the road easily.  The road climbs higher into the mountains
as it heads east.

name: A Large Cave
description:
Squeaks of bats can be heard echoing about the high ceiling of this large
cave.  Even louder, strange sounds, perhaps mining work, can be heard coming
from deeper into the large cavern.  Many small footprints can be found in the
dirt...looks like goblin tracks.

name: Room name
description: You stumble into a newly created room.

name: On A Busy Trail
description:
The yelling and shouting is almost deafening now.  Hundreds of Imperial
soldiers are running all sorts of errands.  Some seem to be preparing for
combat while others are attending to the wounded or gathering supplies. Others
are simply waiting around, trying not to be noticed.

name: The Sortie Camp
description:
The Imperial camp is spread out all along the outskirts of the village.  To
the  very far south you can see a high ridgeline of mountains and thick
forest. It seems that there is no way out except through this camp.  The
village itself is  burning and the symphony of war is heavy in the air.

name: The Village Barricade
description:
This defensive measure seems a bit hurried.  This used to be the walls of a
once great ogre village, judging by the language burned into the wood, but the
Imperials have turned this gate into a choke point.  No one can enter or exit
the city except through this gate which is heavily guarded. The cries of
battle come beyond the door.  Judging by the way the veterans are pushing the
newest soldiers through the gate, a fierce one at that.

name: The Burning Village
description:
The smell of burning wood, rotting bodies, and fresh blood is everywhere.
Most of the buildings have fallen into piles of burning ash and stone ruins.
At every corner there is a crouched figure firing arrows into the fray or
rebel soldiers jumping onto the backs of the Imperial soldiers that are
desperately trying to maintain formation.  You can smell the blood-lust in the
air.

name: The Burning Village
description:
The smell of burning wood, rotting bodies, and fresh blood is everywhere.
Most of the buildings have fallen into piles of burning ash and stone ruins.
You make your way through the different skeletons of once great buildings,
homes, and the bodies of the dead.  The black smoke make it hard to see, and
travelling through the graveyard of wood and bone makes it difficult to tell
where the path is.

homes, and the bodies of the dead.  The black smoke make it hard to see, and
travelling through the graveyard of wood and bone makes it difficult to tell
where the path is.

name: The Rebel Barricade
description:
This hastily built barricade is a collection of broken homes and freshly
chopped trees.  It is held together with a thick glue like goo and whatever
nails could be found.  There are few soldiers left on this side of the
barricade, the rest of the village deserted and empty.  Only a few people are
left, most of them trying to find their children or some dear lost possession.

name: The Deserted Village
description:
It seems most of the civilians have already fled or died in defense of this
village. You see very little left anywhere. Empty houses and empty streets.
It is an eerie calm as just a few steps away you know that the earth is
stained red.

name: The Commander's Quarters
description:
The room is barren save a few maps, a few pieces of old rusty armor, and a
large bottle of fire-breather.  Most of the information and intelligence the
rebels had must have been burned or taken out of the village by now.  A few
messengers run in and drop their reports or talk to the tall woman standing in
the back before running back through the barricade.

name: The Deserted Village
description:
It seems most of the civilians have already fled or died in defense of this
village. You see very little left anywhere. Empty houses and empty streets.
It is an eerie calm as just a few steps away you know that the earth is
stained red.

name: The Escape Route
description:
The last of the villagers and civilians are streaming through this small
tunnel. It must lead out into the forest or perhaps back around behind the
Imperial forces.  There are no rebel soldiers anywhere to be found, they must
all be trying to hold the barricade for just a few more moments.

name: Inside A Ray Of Light
description:
The room suddenly grows bright as if the sun itself is focusing it's gaze on
you. You feel warm and at peace as the room slowly glows brighter and
brighter. The only way to go now is to follow this beautiful light to where it
may take you.

name: The Gate Of The Celestials
description:
This magnificent gate is made of gold, pearl, and ice.  It reaches higher into
the bright blue sky and you can see no sign of it ending.  The floor itself
seems to made of light, below you can see the shapes of the continents and the
blue oceans.  There are numerous winged creatures flying about, many of them
shaking your hand or offering you something to drink.

name: The Celestial Walk
description:
The massive gate behind you fades into a transparent shawl as you continue
deeper inside this place.  The feeling of warmth and compassion is almost
overwhelming.  You swear you can see the faces of those you once knew but have
lost, a friend, a lover, a child.  The celestials all bow to you and make no
effort to scare or threaten.

name: The Gates Of Sanctuary
description:
You come across another magnificent gate of ice and light.  It has no keyhole
and several of the greater celestials seem to pass through with no effort yet
your attempts are blocked.  You can beyond the gate to a land of grass and
green trees that bear a delicious looking fruit.

name: The Sanctuary Of The Celestials
description:
The ground is now a soft green grass that feels like silk to the touch. The
sky is magnificent red and soft blue that looks more like a madman's painting
that anything you could see naturally.  You can no longer make out the shapes
of those you thought you once knew, the area is filled with only Celestials as
they lounge and enjoy the beauty.

name: The Gates Of All
description:
This wondrous gate is made of nothing yet you cannot see through it. It is as
if reality simply stops at the point.  You can see nothing beyond it yet you
cannot make out any features.  Whatever is beyond this barrier must be
something of amazing power or amazing wealth.

name: The Gate Of Elisium
description:
This gate is made of living trees and vines.  The fruit that bears from these
plants tastes like the sweetest honey.  You cannot see what is beyond it but
the faintest hint of running water and soft grain floats in on the breeze.

name: The Fields Of Elisium
description:
This ground is soft earth that cradles your steps yet allows you a solid
foothold. The Celestials that reside here relax in the soft earth, forming an
odd bed that gently rocks them to sleep.  The air is warm and the breeze a
refreshing moment of autumn nights.  Trees of every kind dot the land and it
seems to continue to beyond all hope of measurement.

name: The Gates Of Silence
description:
The soft grass gives way to a gate made of silence and awe.  You produce no
sound when you knock against the heavy frame of air and light.  Other
celestials bow and smile as they seem to melt into the gate before emerging on
the other side.

name: The Womb Of Silence
description:
This place is silent as a starless sky.  Above you is nothing but a gray mix
of cloud and darkness.  The Celestials here are simply meditating or sleeping,
making no sounds and no movements.  The only thing you can feel is a gentle
heartbeat that rises up from the floor of mist.

name: The Throne Of All
description:
This room is a chaotic mix of everything you can imagine.  To the west you see
a mountain range of infinite heights, to the east an ocean of crystal green
and blue waves.  To the north is a forest with trees that seem to touch the
stars.  It is as if all creation started in this wondrous place.

name: A Broken Tower
description:
You enter the base of a huge tower, that looks as if it has been ruined for
centuries.  Large chunks of stony wall lie about on the floor.  Rats and
spiders have made nests in the many cracks in the rock.  A spiral staircase
leads upwards around the southern wall of the tower.  As you look up, you are
nearly blinded by a golden light shining down.

name: Cahel's Throne
description:
You find yourself inside the Throne room and home of the great Celestial and
Blade-Lord Cahel.  The room is filled with poems of hundreds of races and
instruments of a thousand geniuses.  Cahel's former weapons, the twin silver
katanas rest on the wall along his battle armor.

name: A Short Dirt Path
description:
You're on a short dirt path that pretty much ends here, but you can
go west toward a very run down shack and a pier jutting into a
body of water.

name: A Short Dirt Path
description:
To the north is Capt'n Cluckys Chicken Shack. The building looks
as though it would be much more comfortable if it would just fall
over and give up trying to stand. There is a little window on this
particular part of the building but it looks as though it has never
ever been cleaned so you cant see inside at all. The entrance
appears to be down the road a bit more west, that is if you want to
risk going inside this deathtrap.

name: A Short Dirt Path Before A Shack
description:
You can tell that this is Capt'n Cluckys Chicken Shack because there
is a sign over the door that says just that.. well, Capt'n Clucky
spelled Chicken "Chiggin" but thats confusing and the sound of all
the clucking coming from the other side of this shack makes it
clear that a Chiggin is a Chicken. The Shack is in a terrible state,
and what once passed for a door is a plank that is actually behind
you, across the dirt path, as you stand in awe of this woefully
dilapidated abode.

name: Inside The Chicken Shack
description:
As your eyes adjust to the light, you see a number of people at
various tables around the room enjoying various forms of chicken.
And it appears that the food here is superb! This place is packed
day and night with people from all over who have travelled her just
for a taste of the Capt'n's recipe of 12 herbs and spices. Capt'n
Clucky probably never leaves because he's so busy.

name: Inside The Chicken Shack
description:
You maneuver between the table, chairs, and patrons to this corner of
the room. The ceiling is partially collapsed here so you have to
watch that you don't hit your head on the beams. On the wall are
various drawings and scribbles, some kind of horrible machinery.
You look away quickly to stop thinking about the drawings and try
to decide what kind of chicken you might like to try.

name: Inside The Chicken Shack
description:
This part of the shack looks to be in slightly better condition than
the rest, probably due to all the seafaring memorabilia which is
stored here. There's a compass and a logbook, some oars and harpoons,
even some charts and paintings. Maybe Capt'n Clucky painted them?
The patrons don't even seem to notice the "decor" they only seem
interested in the food.

name: Inside The Chicken Shack
description:
Being this close to the kitchen you can really smell the delicious
chicken cooking. Theres a heavy door with only a small hole in which
orders are placed and chicken is served. I guess Capt'n Clucky isn't
taking any chances with people snooping around his kitchen. Someone
might steal his recipe! You try to catch a glimpse inside the
kitchen, but are jostled and bumped out of the way by the servers
placing orders and picking up plates of hot food.

name: Captain Clucky's Kitchen
description:
Well, you managed to find a way into the kitchen.. but unfortunately
the plucking machine appears to mistake you for a chicken. Good Luck.

name: Cluckys Room
description:
This is where the Captain sleeps.. if he sleeps. There is a bedroll
here but it doesn't appear to have been used in months at least..
maybe a year or two? Dust and cobwebs everywhere. The captain does
not look to have many possessions at all. For someone with a wildly
popular business you would think he would have some money stashed
somewhere around here.

name: The Chicken Pen
description:
CHICKENS EVERYWHERE!!!
You've never seen so many chickens in your whole life, you trudge
through them as if you were wading in the surf. The chickens are
busy eating grain and clucking and doing important chicken stuff.

name: The Chicken Coop
description:
You thought there were a lot of chickens outside.. till you came in
here! And the smell! You consider cutting off your nose for a moment.
Eyes watering from the stench, you really cant see much. There are
so many chickens in here, even if there were hill giants in here
you would probably miss them. If you wish to not lose your sense of
smell.. Get Out!

name: The Chicken Pen
description:
CHICKENS EVERYWHERE!!!
You've never seen so many chickens in your whole life, you trudge
through them as if you were wading in the surf. The chickens seem
none too happy to see someone else here.. adding to their crowded
conditions. There appears to be a huge chicken coop to the west
the multiple ramps leading inside are veritable poultry highways.

name: The Chicken Pen
description:
CHICKENS EVERYWHERE!!!
You've never seen so many chickens in your whole life, you trudge
through them as if you were wading in the surf. If this pen wasn't
as incredibly strong as it is.. what with the barbed wire and
metal bar reinforcement, the chickens might actually overpower this
jail and break out of here.

name: The Chicken Pen
description:
CHICKENS EVERYWHERE!!!
You've never seen so many chickens in your whole life, you trudge
through them as if you were wading in the surf. It's as though you've
discovered the source of all the chickens in the whole world, right
here in this gigantic pen. Hens and roosters and chicks and eggs
everywhere. Grain dispensing silos which you can visibly see being
consumed by this ravenous throng. Nests in every stage of
construction. You can't decide if this is chicken heaven.. or hell.

name: Just Outside The Chicken Pen
description:
The ravine ends here next to the north fence of Capt'n Cluckys
pen. There really isn't anywhere to go from here, although this
part of the path has opened up a bit, the thorny brambles are no
less thick or menacing. You should probably Go back to the beach
and relax. All this crawling on all fours to get here has made you
hot and a cool beverage would really hit the spot.

name: A Thorny Trail
description:
The ravine turns and continues here. It's a good thing you have some
armor on to protect you from the thorns and brambles, they are very
sharp and numerous. You could hack at them with your weapon if only
there was a little more room to swing at them.

name: A Thorny Trail
description:
You are in a shallow ravine which continues for quite a distance.
You cannot stand upright here.. crawling on all fours is the only
way to avoid the sharp and pointy thorns. If someone planted these
on purpose, it is clear that they wanted noone and no thing to get
through here.

name: A Short Dirt Path
description:
The path slopes down toward the beach, somewhat cutting into the
side of a cliff which the Chicken shack sits upon north of here.
You see at large white sandy beach and a pier to the west while the
dirt path leads up to the shack to the east.

name: A Short Dirt Path
description:
The dirt path here is more wooden logs than actual dirt, The logs
undoubtedly allow cart traffic to and from the pier. The beach opens
up here and you see sand dunes to the north and south of you.

name: A Wooden Path
description:
The southern ocean is beautiful from this vantage. Jetties off to the
north and south create a small harbor for the pier to the west.
This pier is quite substantial and could probably berth a very
large ship in a pinch. There is a ramp to the west which leads to
the pier, and the wooden path leads east to a shack on the cliff.

name: A Gangplank From Shore To The Pier
description:
This gangplank is large enough for 2 carts to pass one another,
probably for hauling fish, or goods off of a ship. It is pretty
deserted at the moment though.

name: On The Pier
description:
This concourse is an intersection of the inner berths and the main
thoroughfare. This main thoroughfare is high over the water,
supported by very large timbers. The berths off to each side descend
to the water and actually float on the surface. South of here,
you can walk down to berth one, to the north is berth two.

name: On The Pier
description:
The water is calm and you only hear small waves lap against this
floating berth.

name: On The Pier
description:
The water is calm and you only hear small waves lap against this
floating berth.

name: On The Pier
description:
The main thoroughfare here is the only place that anyone seems to
come, and mostly fisherman. Birds pick at the planks for morsels
that the fishermen have left behind. A "No Diving" sign is about
the only other feature in this part of the pier.

name: On The Pier
description:
Off to the west and south the Southern Ocean extends off
beyond the horizon. Mount Olympus far off to the east
rises majestically out of the sea and high up into the clouds.
The thoroughfare ends here, Gangplanks lead down on either side,
berth three to the south, and four to the north.

name: On The Pier
description:
The water is calm and you only hear small waves lap against this
floating berth. There might be something down there under the water
but it looks kinda murky in this area.

name: On The Pier
description:
Only a small dinghy is tied up here. Probably only used to scrape
barnacles off the pier. The water is calm and you only hear small
waves lap against this floating berth.

name: Sand Dunes
description:
The deep sand and dunes are difficult to traverse without all the
junk you brought with you. A large pile of boulders support the cliff
face to the east.

name: On The Beach
description: The warm sand and cool breeze make this an ideal spot for relaxing.

name: In The Waves
description:
Waves wash up and down the beach here, making walking much easier
on this wet sand. Small sea birds race up and down, following the
receding waves, checking for morsels stranded up on the shore.
Only the occasional piece of driftwood or stone breaks the surface
of the surf.

name: On The Beach
description:
The warm sand and cool breeze make this an ideal spot for relaxing.
There is a jetty here, sheltering the pier from the large waves.

name: On A Jetty
description:
This jetty, built of rather large boulders creates a harbor here
for the pier. You feel the ocean spray as the waves break against
these boulders. Small crabs fence one another between the crevasses
and the perimeter of the jetty is girdled with some particularly
large mussels.

name: On A Jetty
description:
A bit further out on the jetty the water is deeper and a deeper blue
color. You look back at the shore and notice that these jetties do a
superb job of sheltering the pier from the ocean waves. The harbor
is quite calm and safe in contrast to the waves breaking against
the outside of the jetty.

What's to stop you from just building a small hut right here and

name: On A Jetty
description:
Out here towards the end of the jetty, you feel quite isolated. Gone
are the sounds of the beach, the birds, the waves on the shoreline.
All you hear are the rhythmic crash of waves against the jetty which
turns southwest from here toward the other jetty. Continuing that
direction would be unwise, the waves are just too violent.

name: The Chicken Pen
description:
You've never seen so many chickens in your whole life, you trudge
through them as if you were wading in the surf. There appears to be
a small flap on the side of the shack in which some chickens seem to
reluctantly find relief from the cramped living conditions.

name: Under The Pier Ramp
description:
Under the ramp leading up the the pier, there is a little shade from
the hot sun afforded by the ramp and the pier. You stop for a moment
to watch the waves break on the pier posts as they come ashore.

name: Riding The Thermal
description:
A tall thermal wind allows you to circle higher and higher into the sky.  Just
below you, you see the Plains Road stretch off east and west.  Above you, you
come closer to the strange clouds.

name: Riding The Thermal
description:
A tall thermal wind allows you to circle higher and higher into the sky.
Below you, you see the Plains Road stretch off east and west.  Above you, you
come closer to the strange clouds.

name: Riding The Thermal
description:
A tall thermal wind allows you to circle higher and higher into the sky.
Below you, you see the Plains Road stretch off east and west.  Above you, you
come closer to the strange clouds.

name: Riding The Thermal
description:
A tall thermal wind allows you to circle higher and higher into the sky.
Below you, you see the Plains Road stretch off east and west.  You rise up
high enough here to be amongst the clouds.  You see the land far below you.
The thermal seems be blowing the birds around you to the east.

name: Floating Amongst The Clouds
description:
Ahh, you ride the cool breezes of the atmosphere, floating amongst the soft,
fluffy clouds that you saw from below.  Many different birds seem to
congregate up here, larger than the ones you've seen closer to the ground.
Perhaps this is where all birds come from!

name: An Underwater Canyon
description:
You swim down a narrow canyon, deep under the surface of the sea.  Small fish
dart back and forth amongst the rocks, searching for food and hiding from
predators.  Green seaweed sways back and forth in the current.  Small growths
of coral are scattered about the sandy bottom.  The canyon enters the open sea
to the west.

name: The Coral Reef
description:
The canyon opens up here and before you spreads a large coral reef.  Strangely
shaped growths of coral, every color of the rainbow, stretch out as far as you
can see.  Many undersea creatures can be seen moving about, their homes
located amongst the living rocks.

name: The Coral Reef

name: A Matted Down Clearing
description:
A pit of  smoldering coals  warms the immediate  clearing before the entrance to
Cracked Skull Cave, and looks as if it is in need of attention. A large oak tree
watches over the cave, which seems to have been cut out of the rocks that pierce
through the realm's skin like a worn ogre's tooth through the meat of  a chicken
that has been overcooked. A large black kettle, half full of vegetable and  herb
stew, sits near the fire, but not on it. A large canvas sack rests near the open
mouth of the cavern. Some dirt seems to be out of place near the cave entrance.

name: Cracked Skull Cave
description:
Mold covers the stone walls  of the corridor, casting  a green tinted reflection
throughout. Loose rocks form the cavern floor, declining into the cave. A  light
flickers further into the corridor, likely caused by a torch light. A  muttering
can be heard echoing off of the rock walls, but are muffled by the mold so  well
that the origin can not be made out. The smoldering coals of a fire can  be seen
to the south.

name: Cracked Skull Cave
description:
The roof of the corridor is no longer solid rock, and  shows signs of dirt  that
is packed tightly enough to support the cave's large walkway. Mold is dense upon
the rock walls, but lessens toward deeper into the cavern  as the rock turns  to
dirt. A warm light flickers to the north as the loose rock floor becomes steady.

name: Cracked Skull Cave
description:
The corridor now splits  into three directions, with dirt floor walkways  to the
and to the east. A torch hsa been inserted into a  crack in the western wall  to
provide light for each of the directions. Tightly packed dirt serves the purpose
of both floor and wall, giving a sturdy place to walk for any who try. Roots can
be seen hanging from the ceiling of the corridor.

name: Cracked Skull Cave
description:
Shadows dance upon the walls of Cracked Skull Cave, enough to  turn the stomachs
of unseasoned adventurers. A light muttering can be heard echoing throughout the
corridors, echoing off of the dense walls, but muffled  by the surrounding mold.

of unseasoned adventurers. A light muttering can be heard echoing throughout the
corridors, echoing off of the dense walls, but muffled  by the surrounding mold.

name: Cracked Skull Cave
description:
The corridor twists and turns, losing the light from the torch near the entrance
to Cracked Skull Cave. A skeleton lies on the floor of the cave, its back rested
against the wall as if it knew its own death was coming. Muffling grunts can  be
heard deeper into the cave.

name: Cracked Skull Cave
description:

to Cracked Skull Cave. A skeleton lies on the floor of the cave, its back rested
against the wall as if it knew its own death was coming. Muffling grunts can  be
heard deeper into the cave.

name: Cracked Skull Cave
description:
The cave has grown dark, even  with the help of  a light source, except for  one
small crack of light toward the east. The surroundings  of the crack can not  be
made out at this time, but the usual dirt and rock continue to make up the walls
and floor of the corridor.

name: Cracked Skull Cave
description:
Rotted wood  is nestled into the hole in  the cave wall, preventing anyone  from
venturing deeper into the cavern. The wall around the door is a solid mixture of
rock and dirt, and seems to  be there naturally. A light can  be seen flickering
from beneath the door.

name: Cracked Skull Cave Main Cavern
description:
A small number of lanterns illuminate the main cavern of Cracked Skull Cave, and
showcase some recently used bedrolls upon the floor. Also visible are  a pair of
unkept chairs  that would surly break if  a large creature were to use it.  They
are nestled beneath  a table crafted of rotted planks  of wood that would better
serve as food for a camp fire.
