name: An Opening in the Trees
description:
The trees break here, opening into a huge clearing covered in a lush
blanket of thick green grass.  The occasional butterflies and birds pay
their visits, adding color and flair to the already vivid picture.  One
could stay here all day simply to relax in the comforts of nature, or
perhaps stay into the night to gaze up at the clear, starry-filled sky.

name: The Edge of the Lake
description:
The grass ends here abruptly at the edge of a huge lake.  The water
ripples slightly from the breath of the wind grazing over its surface, its
color as blue as the sky above, reflecting mirror images of the
immediate surroundings.  Even in the winter, this lake somehow
remains unfrozen, as if protected by some sort of spell.

name: Lake D'Aira
description:
The air is cooler here on the lake, the breeze caressing your skin
softly.  The surface of the lake gleams brilliantly, sparkling as the sun
plays over the top of it.  The soothing water might be just what you need to
ease the ache in your bones caused by your long travels.  Perhaps it
wouldn't hurt to stay for a while, just to relax.

name: Astyn Island
description:
A small piece of land rests in the middle of Lake D'Aira here.  Thick
trees cover the surface of the island, blocking out most all of the
sunlight from overhead, and making it appear larger than it really is.
Plant life rustles softly in the breeze, the only sound breaking the
quietness.

name: The Dark Heart Swamp
description:
The ground is half water and half mud.  It is hard to walk as each step makes
you sink even deeper.  It smells horrific, you can taste the rotting life in
your mouth.  The heat is oppressive and the humidity is just as bas as the
river that feeds this pit.

description:

ruins.  There are nests made on the floor, tightly woven reed beds and moss
covered pillows.  Judging by the broken weapons on the floor, the size of the
nests, and their neat ordering on the floor,  it is clear that this place was
once the housing of soldiers.

name: An Underwater Market
description:
This incredible natural cavern had been converted into an underwater bazaar.
Neat stalls have been carved into the walls of the cavern and even now it
clear where the trinket vendor had been, where the clothing and weapons
vendors were.  It is amazing how complex this bazaar is even though it looks
as if it has always been underwater.

name: A Large Ruined Hallway
description:
This hallway is much larger than the others you have found so far.  The water
is still seeping in and stone roof seems to be caving in, but it looks safe
enough.  Pottery, rusted jewelry, and all sorts of fine items line the floor,
although it is clear they are not worth the mud they are covered in.

name: The Fallen Throne
description:
This throne room was once beautiful, as all things are once beautiful, but now
it is rotted and threadbare.  The walls are crumbling, the tapestries have
been eaten away by the sea life that has infested this former seat of power.
The throne itself has long since rotted down to its metal frame, a large
lizardwoman rests on it.

name: Deep In The Jungle
description:
You push your way through the heavy jungle growth.  Many strange
animal cries echo about you.  The trees above you block out most of the light,
and you catch glimpses of exotic creatures as they dash away under the brush.
You spy a small path through the undergrowth to the east.

name: A Path Through The Tents
description:
This simple dirt path makes it's way through the numerous tents that dot this
open expanse of field.  To the west and north are a series of hills that block
 any view from the ocean. To the east and south are a series of tall trees
that  would make this camp hard to spot from the  walls of Sahardin.  You see
numerous soldiers wandering around or tending to the sick. You recognize the
armor as that of the Imperial Army.

name: The Fatigue Tent
description:
This tent is dedicated to treating and housing soldiers with battle fatigue.
Some are constantly shaking, others are merely frozen as they stare lifelessly
at you.  A few soldiers are even tied down as they rant and rave in some
episode, probably reliving the horror of the battlefield.

description:

wound removed.  You hear the screams of soldiers as a bonesaw begins it's
joyless work.  The smell of rotten cheese and almonds is heavy in the air.
This is not a tent that a soldier ever wants to visit.

wound removed.  You hear the screams of soldiers as a bonesaw begins it's
joyless work.  The smell of rotten cheese and almonds is heavy in the air.
This is not a tent that a soldier ever wants to visit.

name: A Larger Medical Tent
description:
This is a basic field medical tent.  The heavy canvas coverings keep the sun,
wind, and rain away from the soldiers but not much else. Numerous wounded
soldiers are here. It seems that they would prefer to desert and receive
medical attention than be put back on the front lines. Several healers run
back and forth, trying to ease the pain of the wounded men.

description:
This tent is used to house wounded soldiers.  None of them look fatally
injured or in need of a bonesaw but still need time and rest to recover from
their wounds. They all carry a down prodded look on their face, disgraced but
happy to be alive.  Some are visibility angry at those that ordered them and
their friend's to such a horrible end.

name: The Rebel Headquarters
description:
This tent seems to serve a dual purpose.  You can see medical supplies
stacked to the top as well as wounded soldiers that the other tents could not
house.  Yet you also see other people that are not dressed in standard
Imperial army equipment.  They are consoling the soldiers and you can hear
them whisper to them about things that should be whispered.  You can tell
these people are not deserters but dissenters.

name: A Lookout Tower
description:
This hastily built lookout tower is not much more than four heavy pieces of
lumber with another sheet on top.  Yet it seems sturdy enough to hold a lookout
or two.

name: A Lookout Tower
description:
>From here you can see the entire camp.  You also catch a glimpse of a large
stone highway leaving Sahardin from the east. You strain your eyes over the
trees to see what looks like a few smaller villages to the southeast and a
very distant spec seems to be another walled city.

name: The Officer's Tent
description:
This long tent must be where the leader of deserters is.  There are other
soldiers here, talking of the war and of the something called "The Hunt".
They all eye you suspiciously as you walk past.  Broken weapons, food
supplies, and anything else they could salvage before the flight here is
strewn everywhere.

name: The Temple Altar
description:
This Alden Temple is packed with hundreds of survivors and refugees.
The walls are stained with blood and ash, the smell of infected wounds and
poisoned barbs make the air heavy.  The groans of the injure drown out most of
the constant orders being yelled out between the survivors and those brave
militia that have formed to defend against the Elder Spawn.  This is one of
the only parts of the city still controlled by the citizens.

name: The Temple Of Drazuk
description:
A large barricade of broken furniture, tapestries, and even statues is all
that keep the hordes of the elder spawn from punching through.  Dozens of
exhausted soldiers and militia guard the barricade, waiting for the moment the
creatures break through.  You can hear the low murmurs and piercing wails of
the creatures outside and the few brave souls that ventured out to retake the
city.

name: The Temple Of Drazuk -- Meeting Room
description:
The meeting room has been turned into a triage facility.  There is only half a
dozen healers, mostly cleric adepts that have not yet fully reached
priesthood.  There are at least a hundred bodies in the room, bandaged and
some dying, some waiting to die.  Occasionally a soldier or militia will enter
and pick one of the healthiest wounded to be put back on barricade duty.

name: The Temple Of Drazuk
description:

that keep the hordes of the elder spawn from punching through.  Dozens of
exhausted soldiers and militia guard the barricade, waiting for the moment the

the creatures outside and the few brave souls that ventured out to retake the

name: The Temple Of Drazuk -- Judgement Room
description:
The sound of soldiers and defenders fill this room, it has been turned into an
enlistment room, citizens too young to know love and those so old they have
buried grandchildren.  The too wounded to fight but healthy enough to sign
papers are recording the names of soldiers going off to fight and crossing off
the names of those that have not returned.

name: The Temple Of Drazuk -- Donation Room
description:
The massive pit of the donation room has been converted into a makeshift
armory  for the defenders of the Alden.  The weapons are caked in blood
and gore, reused over and over again and collected by soldiers as they retreat
back into the barricaded temple.  The newly drafted defenders are lining up,
waiting to receive what ever armor or weapons are available.

name: The Temple Of Drazuk -- Resting Room
description:
The pillows and refreshing drinks of the resting room are gone.  There are a
few blankets laid out on the ground as soldiers sleep against each other for
only a few moments before going back out to retake the city.  A simple rope
ladder leads up through a large hole in the ceiling.

name: Homer Street
description:
The great city of Alden is engulfed in ash and venomous clouds of bile.
Elder spawn stalk through city freely while handfuls of loyal defenders still
struggle to kill every spawn they see.  To the south of here is the barricaded
Temple of Drazuk. To the west, what was once the Outdoor Outfitters shop, and
to the east there is a smouldering storefront that was once a Real Estate
Office.

name: Questmasters Inc.
description:
The defenders of Alden have used the powerful magiks surrounding this
building to stage a safe haven and rallying point for the war.  Many soldiers
stream in and out, some getting bandaged while others take rare herbs and
powerful potions to grant them strength and courage.  Joey is still, willing
to give quests, despite what is going on outside of his shop.

name: The First (And Only) Bank Of Alden.
description:
This small bank is completely untouched by the war outside.  The spell that
Carlye set up seems to be keeping the elder spawn passive when they enter.
Some soldiers or citizens hide in here as well, waiting for the cost to clear
before they make the short but dangerous run back to the barricades.

name: Khent's Weapon Shack
description:
The many fine weapons of Khent's shop have been taken for the war effort.  The
floor is stained with blood, black and red.  It looks as if Khent has taken it
upon himself to do his part by defending his shop as best he can.

name: The Sneaky Shadow
description:
This small shop has been burned and ravaged by the elder spawn.  The various
tools and implements of the thief are strewn across the floor, along with the
bodies of citizens and defenders.  A few fires still burn but somehow they
have not yet managed to destroy the entire shop.

name: Garth's Armor Emporium
description:
Garth's fine collection of armor has been ransacked by the badly under
supplied militias that have formed to protect the city.  The bodies of elder
spawn and defenders are everywhere as it seems fierce fighting has broken out
even in the relatively cramped space of the shop.  Large pieces of the roof
are missing, and the northern wall is cracked and weak.

name: The Sorcerer Store
description:
The magical items of this shop seemed to have little avail against the horde
of elder spawn that have swept through the city.  Wands and staves are broken
on the floor and scrolls burn in the smouldering ruins of this once beautiful
shop.  It seems the owner left this place to its fate.

name: Mistress Leah's Fashions
description:
The silk and satin clothing of this shop have been looted to make bandages for
the injured.  The walls are barren and caked in blood as many citizens of
Alden died to retrieve them.  By the condition of the shop, it does not
seem that the owner made it out alive.

name: The Refined Warrior
description:
The fine cloth and leather goods of this shop are gone, used to make bandages,
make shift armor, and even bedding for the displaced citizens, hiding out  in
the barricaded temple.  The walls are barely standing and most of the roof is
gone as the smell of elder spawn and dead citizens fill the air.

name: Outdoor Outfitters
description:
The various armors and weapons of Richard's shop have long since been looted
to bolster the dwindling supplies of the Alden militia.  The shop is
crowded with the amount of bodies, human and otherwise, as the shop lies in a
crucial position to defend the north most barricade of the Temple.  It seems
the defenders have fought long and hard for this small piece of land.

name: Alden Real Estate Brokers
description:
This shop is empty, large pools of blood replacing the counter and several
bodies are crushed under the weight of the eastern wall collapsing.  There is
nothing left in this shop of the affluent, as the last thing anyone wants is
to buy land in Alden at the moment.

name: Warriors Guild
description:
You stand in the Guild Hall of Warriors.  This is where you come to
practice your skills of combat.  Battered trophies and exotic weapons hang
along the walls.  Training dummies stand, beaten and torn, about the room.

name: Rangers Guild
description:
You stand in the Guild Hall of Rangers.  This is where you come to
practice your skills of combat and nature.  Battered trophies and exotic
weapons hang along the walls.  Training dummies stand, beaten and torn, about
the room.  Various samples of the local fauna are set about for you to study.

name: Mages Guild
description:
You stand in the Guild Hall of Mages.  This is where you come to
practice your skills of magic.  Various magical trophies and ancient artifacts
and relics hang along the walls.  The smell of bubbling potions and magical
scroll-inks fills the air.

name: Clerics Guild
description:
You stand in the Guild Hall of Clerics.  This is where you come to
practice your skills of prayer.  Holy relics and books describing the various
deities sit in various places in the room.  The sound of chanting fills the
air.

name: Thieves Guild
description:
You stand in the Guild Hall of Thieves.  This is where you come to
practice your skills of stealth.  Stolen tapestries and implements of thievery
hang along the walls.  Practice locks are set among one wall and a special
area to practice sneaking is set against another.

name: Druids Guild
description:
You stand in the Guild Hall of Druids.  This is where you come to
practice your skills of nature.  Various samples of the local flora and fauna
are placed about the room for you to study.  The sound of various critters
echoes faintly about the room.

name: Above The Temple
description:
You find yourself in a small room.  Looking through the windows about you, it
appears that you are floating above the Temple of Drazuk!  You can't recall
seeing any flying buildings while you stood on the streets of
Alden...there must be some powerful magic about this place.  A small
door leads south from here.

name: A Brightly Lit Hallway
description:
This hallway is brightly lit with free-floating candles.  A feeling of warmth
and safety encompasses you.  Pictures of the Ghoul Royals hang on the
dark-wood walls.

name: A Brightly Lit Hallway
description:
This hallway is brightly lit with free-floating candles.  A feeling of warmth
and safety encompasses you.  Pictures of the Ghoul Royals hang on the
dark-wood walls.

name: The Ghoul Hideaway
description:
This room is lit by the soft glow of a few floating candles.  The plush
pillows that ghouls love so much take up most of the room.  Silken coverlets
lay about within arms reach, and a large fire burns in a fireplace on the east
wall, providing a very comfortable warmth.

name: The Kitchen
description:
A small stove sits in the corner of this room, and ample counterspace lines
the walls.  This must be where the visiting Royals can prepare a small meal if
they feel hungry.

name: The Nightgaunt's Tickler
description:
This tavern must have been a nice place to rest and relax, but now it is
simply a graveyard.  The battles fought in here must have been fierce as the
second story has fallen completely and several large holes are in each wall.
The floor is slick with blood and judging by the fire damage, the defenders
must have resorted to lighting the stronger spirits on fire.

name: The Portal Room
description:
This room houses a large magical portal, which Thalen uses to send you to your
specific hometown.  The rest of the room is quite bare.

name: Thugs Guild
description:
You stand in the Thugs Guild.  Dark and dingy, you'd be afraid to run into any
of the occupants, if you weren't already one of them.  In one corner, a class
in intimidation is taking place.  In another, recruits are picking on some
unfortunate soul.

name: Monks Guild
description:
You stand in the Monks Guild.  The colors are calm and pleasing to the eye.  A
feeling of tranquility sets over you as you rest in this guildhall.  Exotic
weapons hang from the western wall.  You watch a group of students practice
their combat styles with the Master.

name: Samuels Repairshop
description:
This small shop's forge is cold and the necessary tools for repairing armor
have been abandoned on the floor.  The building is barely standing, it looks
as if the walls had been coated in a heavy acid.  You see no sign of Samuel
anywhere.

name: Samuels Repairshop
description:
This small shop looks like the home to a repairsmith.  Lots of small bits of
metal used to patch up armor, and the tools and gear used to repair ripped and
torn leathers, is set about the small store.

name: Lilyans Recharging
description:
This quaint little shop is little more than a charnal house.  There is no sign
of life, the magics used to recharge wands and staves is gone as it Lilyan.
Judging by the blood and several limbs, they did not leave peacefully.

name: Hero's Hideout -- Lobby
description:
You stand in the newly remodeled lobby of the Hero's Hideout.  You aren't
getting in here unless you are level 50 or higher, so congratulations (;

Its not too shabby of a place.  The entranceway is a shiny hardwood floor, and
most of the walls and furniture are made of a dark shiny wood.  Several trophy
heads of creatures you recognize from your travels are up on the wall.  There
are some comfortable couches you can rest on, but of more interest are the
places you can go from here.  Back up is the Temple of Drazuk.  North is a
non-safe room, good for testing those skills on each other (;  East is a
special Hero shop.  West is a nice place to rest.

name: Hero's Hideout -- Arena
description:
This room is large and barren of any furniture.  The hardwood floor is rough
and scuffed, and has several large stains in various places.

name: Hero's Hideout -- The Stash
description:
Welcome to The Stash.  You will be able to buy special items here.  Yes, they
will be strong.  Yes, they will be powerful (:  Coming soon...

name: Hero's Hideout -- Resting Room
description: This room will double regen rate soon...but it doesn't right now (;

name: The Den
description:
The first thing that is noticeable as you enter Vash's house is that the floor
is sunk into the ground almost to your waist, the ground is layered in lavish
piles of silken pillows, and sweet smelling smoke drifts throughout the
entirety of the oriental room. The colored paper lanterns which hang in
clusters around each corner of the room cast it into parchment tinged yellows,
reds, and greens. A dark black wooden kneeling table inlaid with jade takes up
most of the center of the room. The table is laden with ornately carved pipes,
some of them even filled with water. In the corner the scabbard for the
legendary sword "Cuddly Death" rests on a pedestal, catching the muted
multihued light on each grain of it's dark honeyed wood. The large pillows
with scrolled characters are massive enough for a person to recline upon if
they were inclined to smoke one of the pipes.
A long corkscrew staircase leads up into the Library.
A stunted staircase leads from the den to the museum.

name: The Museum
description:
Vash's museum is an entirely different affair than the opium den.
While still done in the styles of far off lands, the walls of the museum are
dark and minimalist, so as not to detract from the beauty of the objects of
art which he has collected and stored here under great risk. More than that,
each piece of curios is contained in a box of the clearest glass the realm has
ever seen. There is not a bubble to be seen on any pane in this room. The
framed pictures are dark and emotional, and the statue in the corner with it's
arms upraised as if in a last desperate attempt to fend of an attacker, is
rumored to have been an individual who attempted to remove a piece of art from
this room.

The huge bastard sword which used to belong to Zanzen has been thrust into the
middle of the hardwood floor by Vash as a trophy.

name: The Library
description:
Behind a door at the top of the staircase is Vash's living space. This room
also has dark wooden walls, and the room can be divided in half with the slide
of a cream colored paper screen. The red wooden floor is smooth and polished,
throwing everything upon it back in blurred red relief. One side of the room
is dominated by huge bookshelves which reach to the vaults of the ceiling, the
alien lettering of the books draws the eye with a riot of colors and designs.
Scrolls are hung upon the wall with watercolor calligraphy. a window opposite
the door looks down upon the busy streets of Alden, another screened
window somehow looks down upon the flickering red landscape of another realm
which wavers and distorts constantly. The hundreds of leather wrapped books
make the room smell vaguely of paper, ink, and spices. A massive oak desk is
pushed against the wall near the infernal window.

name: Diabolists Guild
description:
You stand in the Diabolists Guild.  It is dark and damp in this dungeon-like
room.  The monotone chanting of studying demonologists can be heard echoing
about the chamber.  The sharp smell of burning sulfur is all about you, and a
smoky haze obscures the ceiling above.

name: The Grand Artificer
description:
This artificer shop is completely empty, the chest of gold gone and the heavy
wooden counter smashed into nothing.  Nothing is left except for a few dead
Mi-gos and perhaps a few deep ones.

name: A Candlelit Lounge
description:
The first thing you take note of as you reach the top of the long, spiral
staircase leading up from the altar room below, is the massive, black room you
just walked into.  On the northern wall hangs a large portrait of the Lord and
Lady that reside in this sanctuary, the eastern and western walls holding two
large windows, draped in long black curtains.  Below it is a crackling fire,
assisting in lighting up the large area.  It is complimented with a few thick,
red candles set on the mantle, much similar to the ones on stands placed about
the room.  Two long, black couches, arranged so that they sit a short distance
on either side of the fireplace and separated by a small marble table, lead to
two chairs, made of dark brown leather and comfortable looking.  A beautiful,
pale skinned woman walks past the southern exit, a haunting yet soothing, soft
melody resonating from her as she greets you and offers you something to
drink.

name: A Dark Music Hall
description:
The haunting music grows louder as you enter this room.  You notice the only
item in it, besides the stairs leading to the room above, is a large,
web-covered pipe organ made of bones collected from various beings.  The tune
heard is somewhat relaxing, it being relentlessly played by keys on the
instrument that do not move at all, the organ itself enchanted by some magic.

Small red candles adorn this eerie contraption, resting on individual skulls
placed randomly about the pipes themselves. To the north, a faint light is
noticeable; the opposite can be said about the top of the stairs, a
pitch-black aura obscuring it.

name: A Dim Bedchamber
description:
The only light in this room emanates from racks of small red candles
surrounding a large, four-post bed.  The frame of the bed is made of wood, cut
from the nearby forest.  Long black drapes are tied neatly to the posts,
leaving the bed itself exposed.  Black silk sheets cover the bed and large
pillows, covered in matching cloth, rest at the head of it.   All are
embroidered with small white roses stitched along the edges.  Large drapes,
matching those in the other rooms, cover the windows of doors that appear to
lead out to a balcony.  On closer inspection of the windows you notice small
boards nailed into the edge of the walls, blocking out any light that would
pass in from the outside.  A faint tune can be heard coming from the stairs
leading down into the lower room.

name: Jesters Guild
description:
You stand in the Guild Hall of Jesters.  This is where you come to
hang out, have a few drinks and just learn to live life.  Battered trophies
and exotic weapons hang along the walls.  Let noone say Jesters don't know how
to get things done!

name: The Lucky Corpse
description:
This dark and dingy room has the smell of old, musty death about it. The
bodies of too many creatures and citizens litter the floor, it is impossible
to count how many have died in this place.  The large wooden cart is missing,
as is the strange man that once inhabited this place.

name: Shamans Guild
description:
You stand in the Guild Hall of Shaman.  Many magical fetishes, used for
calling and controlling the spirits hang from the walls and sit on shelves.  A
huge alchemical set sits on a table that stands along the west wall.  The
smell of burnt components fills the air.

name: Conjurers Guild
description:
You stand in the Guild Hall of Conjurers.  Many pieces of dismantled golems
are stacked along the wall, with studying conjurers looking at and inside
them, trying to decipher the hidden workings.  A huge shelf for storing
components stands against the east wall, but is only for the use of the
Guildmasters themselves...adventuring conjurers will need to find their
components elsewhere!

name: Alden Transportal
description:
This small room contains a small ticket booth, and a spiral staircase that
leads upward into the transport booth.  The portal is still open and active,
despite the war that goes inside.  Occasionally, a few dwarves, gnomes, and
ghouls appear from above, armed and ready to do battle with their newly formed
alliance with Alden.

name: Transportal  Chamber
description:
This small room sits at the top of the spiral stairs.  No decorations are
placed here, to ensure that there are no disruptions with the transportal
process.  One just needs to stand in the room, have a valid magic portal
ticket, and soon they will be sent to the proper location.

name: Lair Of The Fur(r)y Dragon
description:
A voice says "Naw, just kiddin"...

Welcome to the House of Fury. As soon as you enter this "humble" residence,
you are overwhelmed by the sound of the Eagles playing in the background. He
really did love his 70s rock. Very plain in design, but this place seems to
be filled with a Mystical power. After all, it WAS made by the Creator, Drazuk
himself. There are a few paintings on the wall, those might be fun to LOOK at
later.

You notice there are many papers cast about, detailing maps on how to kill
dragons, the effects of staffs, wands and other magical information. Stuff
that would make the Great Abatha say his "Achiever" within was showing.  In
the corner you see a finely finished wooden desk that seems to be crammed with
junk he has collected on his journeys into the unknown. He has plenty of
mismatched chairs, every kind from the pelted leather ones to the ones that
fold out with a place for your beer. His bed, a comfy looking hammock, seems
to be untouched and dusty.  He was known for his late nights, adventuring into
the Elders realm or diving into books by some other realm Author named
"Stephen King". Just as you bend over to grab one of these highly prized
novels, a voice from the behind you says, "Hey Pally, wanna Drink? Blood beers
are Furys recommended choice".

name: A Dark Living Room
description:
Very minimal light exists within this room, the obsidian walls lined with
torches, but not allowing the lambency to stretch very far.  The floor is
the color of blood red, a HUGE, overstuffed, black leather sofa centered
upon it, housing a myriad of cushy pillows.  Directly across from this, a
giant magical viewscreen hangs on the far wall, numerous black and silver
boxes connected to the screen by what one could only assume to be some sort
of exotic black ropes.  The remainder of the room is sparsely decorated,
save for the occasional painting or framed picture.  A spiral staircase winds
upward to the second floor.

name: The Study
description:
This is where Vra researches new Diabolist spells and checks his e-mail.
A magical white box sits humming on a desk right beside a small viewscreen.
The walls are lined with shelves full of books of all shapes and sizes, many
bearing runes you've never seen before.  The spiral staircase continues upward
to a third floor.

name: The Bedroom
description:
Vra rarely ever sleeps here, so he uses this room mostly for storage.
Several large chests sit around the room, filled with souveniers and
trinkets from his journeys around the world.

name: Heirlooms of a Warrior
description:
The walls of this spacious room are completely covered in various weaponry
and armor, torches seemingly added afterwards, wherever there was a place
to fit.  These artifacts are not those of a simple warrior's...dulled, beaten
and thrown about as if there were no time to care for them.  They seem more
like antiques, worthy of much more attention and care, and obviously given it,
for there is not one piece in this room that doesn't shine with brilliance.
Directly across from the entrance is a wooden door leading elsewhere.

name: Spoils of War
description:
This emmense room is decorated with a vast amount of "trophies" from hideous
creatures throughout the realm.  Synot, Azathoth and the Nightmare Magnet are
but a few of the slays the owner of this home has apparently made.  Only a
Champion could have this many prizes to brag about.  The floor is a smooth
sable color of wood, more weaponry stashed in neat holders in every corner
of the room, making it a very fit place for sparring.  Another wooden door
leads west into yet a different room.

name: The Resting Chamber
description:
The floor to this room is made of etched stone slab, magnificent carpets
laid down over it to keep the chill off of one's feet while walking.  A huge
bed takes up a big part of these chambers, velvet canopied drapes hanging from
the tops of all four corner posts.  Red and ebony seem to be the favored
colors of the one who sleeps here.  At least that is what the bedding and
other decorations portray.  A fireplace is set into one wall across from the
bed, its flames casting a soft glow and allowing the shadows to play amongst
the light.  Lush pillows lay on the floor in front of the hearth, inviting
those who visit to bask in their comfort.  Against the opposite wall is a
large tapestry depicting a victory scene of a young ghoul who has defeated
one of the mighty masked hunters.

name: The Locker Room
description:
This room is bare and dull, the only thing occupying it being rows
and rows of lockers against the walls.

name: An Old Attic
description:
After fearing for your life while climbing the old rickety ladder, you
notice hey this really is an old attic. There are cobwebs everywhere
and you wonder if Lardar ever comes in here. There are a few crates
of old junk piled along the North wall and piles of rags along the south
wall. The east wall is bare and looks as if it is ready to crumble. The
old rafters look heavy and you realize that they may fall on your head,
in fact it looks as if one already has as you notice a skeleton on the
floor beside it. The west wall does seem curious, though. It is the only
wall that looks as if it has been tended to since half of it has been
painted in a grayish color, even if it has not been finished yet.

name: A Bright Sitting Room
description:
You clever soul you! Ever thought of being a thief? Your mind seems
well suited for it since you found the entrance to my living room. Upon
reaching the top of my rafter the first thing you notice is how bright my
sitting room is. As well it should be since the walls are set with gold.  In
the center of the ceiling rests a bright circular ball with several large
diamonds inset around the top of it. The diamonds seem to be making
the ceiling glow in the many colors of the rainbow and the gold reflects
the light well throughout the rest of the room. On the West wall, you see
many wicked looking daggers ceremoniously hung on the wall. Realizing
that these are probably Lardars former weapons, you cannot help but
wonder what he uses these days. The north has a small kitchen area with
many fancy dishes lying about. The table appears to be made of solid crystal.
Glancing to the south, you see the entrance to the bedroom.

name: A Majestic Bedroom
description:
Walking into the room you see the giant 4 poster bed covered in rich
luxuriant blankets and several down pillows. The bed looks quite cozy
and roomy enough for several people at once. Looking around you
notice the 4 poles of the bed are solid gold Gold Dragons. They almost
seem real. Did that tongue just flick? It does seem a bit warm in here.

name: A Small Trailer
description:
This trailer is small and cluttered.  It would remind one of what an actor
or actress would use while they were on location shooting a movie.  Its
inhabitant is obviously male and not a very tidy person, as men's clothing
is scattered everywhere throughout the tiny living quarters.  It's a wonder
he could even live in this small abode, as there is very little furniture to
speak of and it would seem like he was trapped.  His only saving grace
is perhaps the tiny magical viewscreen placed upon the counter.

name: A Pathway Through Towering Trees
description:
A small path cuts South from the lake, weaving it's way around
the towering trees that hide the sun and many other things from
view.  Different types of foilage cover the ground as well as a
thin veil of fog.  There is nothing to be heard but complete silence.

name: A Pathway Through Towering Trees
description:
A small path cuts South from the lake, weaving it's way around
the towering trees that hide the sun and many other things from
view.  Different types of foilage cover the ground as well as a
thin veil of fog.  There is nothing to be heard but complete silence.

name: A Shrouded Doorway
description:
The path here ends to the South, as a large home now stands there.
The doorway to this house is covered with some sort of black mist
that moves and swirls over the closed wooden surface.  Tendrils of
fog creep over the ground as if they are looking for something...or
someone to suffocate.  Any visitors would dare not step beyond here
unless, perhaps, they made a deal with the Devil.

name: An Entrance Way
description:
Entering this house would overcome someone with a desire to flee.
A vampire's  house is not normally welcome to intruders. During the
daytime hours, black shrouds are carefully placed over both of the
windows that rest upon the southern wall, holding the darkness inside.
A couple of staves and wands fill a bucket to the right of the doorway,
obviously discarded. Fine rugs, made from an unknown beast, line the
hardwood floor. An open closet next to the door  holds various cloaks
and other assorted garments. Black candles line the room, inviting you
deeper within this house.

name: A Living Room
description:
What a spacious room!  The ceiling here is made up of black tiles,
painted to look like the night sky.  Bookshelves line all four walls,
overflowing with scrolls and parchments of every color.  From the
center of the room above hangs a sparkling chandelier of nothing
but  pure  crystal.  Atop the endless array of bookcases,  carefully
placed  upon  the  dark walls,  are paintings of magnificent quality.
On the south wall, however, two pictures stand out from the rest, a
picture of the Goddess Ashlyn on the left and a picture of the God
Sainrith on the right. A  table set into the hardwood floor, centered
in the room, is obviously a  work space for creating many magical
items. What strange things go on here? Only the owner would be
able to tell you.

name: A Luxurious Chamber
description:
A bedroom of a truly rich vampire is a sight to see. The largest bed
known  to  man  or  beast rests against the wall.  The heavy oaken
frame is covered by a silk canopy. Plush rugs of bear fur cover the
hard floor and the smell of exotic oils and colognes reach the nose
in a pleasent waft. No windows mark the black walls and various
trophies, collected from around the realm, stand proudly upon the
dresser beside the bed.  Golden lights crafted from magic float near
the ceiling, allowing you to see what little of the room that the owner
wishes you to see. A door leads to a bathroom made completely of
marble, mined by the goblins of Unki.  Music creeps in from seemingly
nowhere to please the ears and relax the visitors.  Perhaps the owner
isn't that bad after all.

name: Aboard The Raptor
description:
You stand on the deck of the only Alden war zepplin that still flies, a
ship that had servered in the Ogre and Orc wars.  This is the legendary vessal
of Cahel's Blade-Knights, his batallion of soldiers in his mortal life.  The
deck is made from now extinct ironwood, the railings are antique brass,
turning green in some parts. The entire ship is tethered to a patchwork and
large balloon full of air that keeps the ship afloat. The faded emblem of two
crossed swords can be seen on the side of the ship.

name: The Prow
description:
This is the front of the Raptor, where the figurehead of a nude sea-elf plows
through the forming clouds of smoke and ash.  The helm of the ship is here,
made of ancient swords tied together in the center by a small iron shield.  It
seems to also serve as a memorial to many Blade-Knights that did not return
from the Ironkores. The darkness of the Elder Forest can be seen, a huge
harpoon buried into treeline and a large but rusted chain providing a way down
and out of Alden.

name: The Starboard Cannon Platform
description:
This is the primary gun platform of the Raptor, given some upgrades by the
Kinterownt engineers that have been in Cahel's service for some time.  These
long brass tubes use magical explosions to hurl large chunks of debree at
their targets. This kind of technology can only be found on ethernauts in the
modern era, and those cannons were never so large. The light of the upper
atmosphere glints cruelly off of these objects, as if to foreshadow the
destruction of which they are capable. The cannons explode often, raining
death upon the elder spawn. These devices seem to be keeping the western path
out of the city relatively clear, if you jump now you can make it out of the
city.

name: The Port Ethernaught Bay
description:
The eastern side of the Raptor is devoted to the deployment of the giant suits
of magical armor known as Ethernaughts. The entire side of the ship is covered
with the hulking suits of steam and magick driven battle vehicles. The suits
still in their docking alcoves pour fire and magick into their target landing
zone, so that the soldiers dropping down to the ground have a clear area to
land in. The small eastern road leading into Alden appears to be a safe
place for you to land.

name: The Escape Hatch
description:
The Stern of the raptor serves as its escape bay and transfer area. The deck
is lined with teleportation runes that will bounce anything placed upon them
down onto the earth. The Southern road leading out of Alden can be seen,
 and it appears to be clear of invading elder spawn. This might be the only
way to the areas south of Alden without having to bunch through
Azathoth's lines.

name: Lex's Lair
description:
The room is dark, Very dark. The only source of light comes from the black
candle that sits on the table. Along the south wall stands the resting place
of the Legendary mace, Osires the Dragon Tamer.

name: Lardar's Shack
description:
This is a cozy little cottage. There may be a treasure or two to be found in
a corner, but don't let me catch you looking fer it.  There is a small ladder
leading to what appears to be an old dusty attic off in the North Corner.

name: Drazuk's Office
description:
You stand in the stately office of Lord Drazuk.  Dark wooden walls surround a
thick red carpet.  Oil paintings of horrible beasts are placed on the walls,
and the room is lit by small candles, held by live gargoyles.  A large fire
roars in the fireplace on the south wall, and a massive wooden desk sits on
the western side of the room.

name: Placeholder
description: Placeholder

name: The Temple Altar
description:
This is the altar room of the Temple of Drazuk.  Adventurer's usually come
here from the result of death or a recall spell.  Hopefully you walked here or
used the spell, because if you died, your corpse has not traveled with you!
There is a healer here, and a sign on the wall lets you know the prices for
that healing.

name: The Temple Of Drazuk
description:
You wander about the hallways of the Temple of Drazuk.  It looks as if
numerous tapestries once decorated the stone but now they are mostly barren.
A few statues still stand and the occassional painting, yet they are not
decoration but rather blocking the large holes and tears in the Temple.

name: The Temple Of Drazuk -- Meeting Room
description:
You stand in the grand meeting room of the Temple of Drazuk.  A few throw
pillows are set out for the few adventurers that need to rest before making
their way out of the Temple.  This is a good place to wait for friends and
meet others.  A staircase is in the corner, leading up towards the demi-god's
temples.

name: The Temple Of Drazuk
description:
You wander about the hallways of the Temple of Drazuk.  It looks as if
numerous tapestries once decorated the stone but now they are mostly barren.
A few statues still stand and the occassional painting, yet they are not
decoration but rather blocking the large holes and tears in the Temple.

name: The Temple Of Drazuk -- Judgement Room
description:
This dark hall still smells of smouldering fires, several large pieces of the
roof missing.  The large desk that was once the seat of judgement is gone,
used for a barricade.  But you can still use the large book here to sign your
name into becoming a deadly killer here.

name: The Temple Of Drazuk
description:
You wander about the hallways of the Temple of Drazuk.  It looks as if
numerous tapestries once decorated the stone but now they are mostly barren.
A few statues still stand and the occassional painting, yet they are not
decoration but rather blocking the large holes and tears in the Temple.  A
single tapestry, singed but still in one piece, still hangs from the walls.

name: The Temple Of Drazuk -- Donation Room
description:
This portion of the temple houses a large pit, used for storing items donated
by other adventurers.  It's worth a look to see if there is anything helpful
located within.

name: The Temple Of Drazuk
description:
You wander about the hallways of the Temple of Drazuk.  It looks as if
numerous tapestries once decorated the stone but now they are mostly barren.
A few statues still stand and the occassional painting, yet they are not
decoration but rather blocking the large holes and tears in the Temple.

name: The Temple Of Drazuk -- Resting Room
description:
This room is mostly barren, save a few chairs and heavy cotton blankets.   The
stone floor looks stained with blood as if this was a charnel house. A large
hole in the ceiling is empty now, a perfectly cut circle in the center rather
than the large gaping wounds in the other parts of the Temple.

name: Homer Street
description:
The city of Alden has seen better times.   Most of the buildings are
little more than collections of rubble, the decimated population still sift
through burnt stone and wood to find the bodies of their family, the remains
of their savings, the last bit of their life before  the war.  South of here
leads back to the Temple of Drazuk.  To the west is a relatively intact shop,
and to the east there is the Alden Real Estate office.

name: Homer Street
description:
The city of Alden has seen better times.  Most of the buildings are
little more than collections of rubble, the decimated population still sift
through burnt stone and wood to find the bodies of their family, the remains
of their savings, the last bit of their life before  the war. East of here is
the Rangers Guild, and west is the Warriors Guild.

name: Intersection Of Homer And Sturm
description:
The people of Alden are working their best to repair their city.
Numerous frames are being razed so that new foundations can be built, new
homes, and new stores.  Those still alive in the city and those that have come
back fill the streets, more doing their part to restore the city to what it
once was.

name: North Of Drazukville
description:
You stand at the northern entrance to Alden.  Guards stand by to make
sure no undesirables enter the city.  They check you over, identify you as
adventurers, and continue on with the difficult job of being a guard. The
large gate to the south has been torn off its hinges and the walls of the city
nearly eaten away.

is the Temple of Drazuk.  West lies the Mages Guild, and east is the Clerics
Guild.
