name: Questmasters Inc.
description:
The Questmaster of Alden inhabits this shop.  You can ask him for a
quest by using the "AQUEST" command.  Good luck in your adventures! This is
one of the few buildings in Alden that seems untouched by the war. The
powerful magiks that Drazuk installed to protect Joey long ago seem to have
paid off.

name: The First (And Only) Bank Of Alden.
description:
This small bank holds only one teller, but Carlyle has a knack with cash.  He
can handle all your banking needs, helping with 'deposit's, 'withdraw'als, and
checking your 'balance'.  "Don't worry about accessing your money," he tells
you.  "Any bank in the Realm will be able to help you out."

name: Khent's Weapon Shack
description:
Many fine weapons hang from the walls of Khent's, known throughout the Realm.
The greatness of these implements are only exceeded by the stupidity of their
owner.  The shop is badly damaged, the roof has been completely removed.  The
wooden timbers are stained with the blood of defenders and elder spawn.

name: The Sneaky Shadow
description:
This small shop is burned and it seems a small miracle it is still standing.
What is not burned or slowly rotting away is painted over with slurs and
insults. Apparently whomever ran this shop before the war did not stay to lend
a hand.

name: Garth's Armor Emporium
description:
This small shop is little more than a well organized pile of rubble and debris
with pieces of armor leaning against stone and a few trophies of elder spawn.
The smell of blood and ash is thick, each step kicks up a large cloud of dust.
The armor does look useful, although most of it seems to have seen some
action.

name: The Sorcerer Store
description:
This store is much larger inside than it appears from the street, partly from
magic but also since the eastern wall no longer stands.  All over the small
patches of the building that are not already destroyed, graffiti and slurs are
painted to protest the magician who spent the war hiding inside the Temple.

name: Mistress Shilea's Fashions
description:
This small boutique was once filled with the most beautiful dresses in the
realm.  But now it is more or less empty with some of the finer things
displayed on what clean and sound parts of the store are left.  There is a
large wreath of flowers and tokens of grief from the many citizens that heard
of the previous owner's misfortune.

name: The Refined Warrior
description:
This store is in relatively decent shape.  There are only a few minor holes in
the ceiling and the walls are still standing.  However, the entire place,
including what is left of the fine clothes, are ruined with paint and hateful
messages.  It is obvious that the citizens of Alden are not too happy
with this establishment.

name: Outdoor Outfitters
description:
Richard's chain of outdoor shops continues its trend of fine gear for the
ranger-types with its Alden branch. This store used to be the flagship
of Richard's chain but now it is more or less a grim testament to his
dedication to his trade.  The walls are charred and bloodied, the floor is
weak and somewhat unsafe, but the store is open for business.

name: Alden Real Estate Brokers
description:
This small room houses the Alden Real Estate office.  Although the price
is quite high due to low space and great demand, you can purchase a deed from
the brokers here to have your own residence constructed.  Fargo smiles at you
and says, "Greetings friend.  Let me show you the lots we have available."

name: Warriors Guild
description:
You stand in the Guild Hall of Warriors.  This is where you come to
practice your skills of combat.  Battered trophies and exotic weapons hang
along the walls.  Training dummies stand, beaten and torn, about the room.

name: Rangers Guild
description:
You stand in the Guild Hall of Rangers.  This is where you come to
practice your skills of combat and nature.  Battered trophies and exotic
weapons hang along the walls.  Training dummies stand, beaten and torn, about
the room.  Various samples of the local fauna are set about for you to study.

name: Mages Guild
description:
You stand in the Guild Hall of Mages.  This is where you come to
practice your skills of magic.  Various magical trophies and ancient artifacts
and relics hang along the walls.  The smell of bubbling potions and magical
scroll-inks fills the air.

name: Clerics Guild
description:
You stand in the Guild Hall of Clerics.  This is where you come to
practice your skills of prayer.  Holy relics and books describing the various
deities sit in various places in the room.  The sound of chanting fills the
air.

name: Thieves Guild
description:
You stand in the Guild Hall of Thieves.  This is where you come to
practice your skills of stealth.  Stolen tapestries and implements of thievery
hang along the walls.  Practice locks are set among one wall and a special
area to practice sneaking is set against another.

name: Druids Guild
description:
You stand in the Guild Hall of Druids.  This is where you come to
practice your skills of nature.  Various samples of the local flora and fauna
are placed about the room for you to study.  The sound of various critters
echoes faintly about the room.

name: Above The Temple
description:
You find yourself in a small room.  Looking through the windows about you, it
appears that you are floating above the Temple of Drazuk!  You can't recall
seeing any flying buildings while you stood on the streets of
Alden...there must be some powerful magic about this place.  A small
door leads south from here.

name: A Brightly Lit Hallway
description:
This hallway is brightly lit with free-floating candles.  A feeling of warmth
and safety encompasses you.  Pictures of the Ghoul Royals hang on the
dark-wood walls.

name: A Brightly Lit Hallway
description:
This hallway is brightly lit with free-floating candles.  A feeling of warmth
and safety encompasses you.  Pictures of the Ghoul Royals hang on the
dark-wood walls.

name: The Ghoul Hideaway
description:
This room is lit by the soft glow of a few floating candles.  The plush
pillows that ghouls love so much take up most of the room.  Silken coverlets
lay about within arms reach, and a large fire burns in a fireplace on the east
wall, providing a very comfortable warmth.

name: The Kitchen
description:
A small stove sits in the corner of this room, and ample counterspace lines
the walls.  This must be where the visiting Royals can prepare a small meal if
they feel hungry.

name: The Nightgaunt's Tickler
description:
This tavern seems like a nice place to take a break, grab some food, maybe a
drink or two.  A large fire roars in the fireplace on the southern wall,
warming and lighting the room.  Various tables and chairs are placed about,
and a stand-up bar runs the length of the west wall.  Despite the fact the
floor boards are standing up in some places and that the roof lets a chill
breeze into the tavern, it seems to have survived the war in a state of grace.

name: The Portal Room
description:
This room houses a large magical portal, which Thalen uses to send you to your
specific hometown.  The rest of the room is quite bare.

name: Thugs Guild
description:
You stand in the Thugs Guild.  Dark and dingy, you'd be afraid to run into any
of the occupants, if you weren't already one of them.  In one corner, a class
in intimidation is taking place.  In another, recruits are picking on some
unfortunate soul.

name: Monks Guild
description:
You stand in the Monks Guild.  The colors are calm and pleasing to the eye.  A
feeling of tranquility sets over you as you rest in this guildhall.  Exotic
weapons hang from the western wall.  You watch a group of students practice
their combat styles with the Master.

name: Samuels Repairshop
description:
This small shop looks like the home to a repairsmith.  Lots of small bits of
metal used to patch up armor, and the tools and gear used to recharge magical
items, is set about the small store. The walls are covered in slander and the
store has seen much better days, but none the less the sound of a hammer
against steel ring out through the store.

name: Rillian's Recharging
description:
This quaint little shop is almost just a booth on the side of the street. It
has survived the war with all four walls and most of the roof, but by the
large amount of flowers, candles, and prayer beads laid out at the threshold
of the store, the previous owner met a gruesome fate.

name: Hero's Hideout -- Lobby
description:
You stand in the newly remodeled lobby of the Hero's Hideout.  You aren't
getting in here unless you are level 50 or higher, so congratulations (;

Its not too shabby of a place.  The entranceway is a shiny hardwood floor, and
most of the walls and furniture are made of a dark shiny wood.  Several trophy
heads of creatures you recognize from your travels are up on the wall.  There
are some comfortable couches you can rest on, but of more interest are the
places you can go from here.  Back up is the Temple of Drazuk.  North is a
non-safe room, good for testing those skills on each other (;  East is a
special Hero shop.  West is a nice place to rest.

name: Hero's Hideout -- Arena
description:
This room is large and barren of any furniture.  The hardwood floor is rough
and scuffed, and has several large stains in various places.

name: Hero's Hideout -- The Stash
description:
Welcome to The Stash.  This small store is more akin to a table with strange
items displayed than a true store. An ancient ghoul seems to levitate behind
the table, waiting for you to step forward.

name: Hero's Hideout -- Resting Room
description: This room will double regen rate soon...but it doesn't right now (;

name: The Den
description:
The first thing that is noticeable as you enter Vash's house is that the floor
is sunk into the ground almost to your waist, the ground is layered in lavish
piles of silken pillows, and sweet smelling smoke drifts throughout the
entirety of the oriental room. The colored paper lanterns which hang in
clusters around each corner of the room cast it into parchment tinged yellows,
reds, and greens. A dark black wooden kneeling table inlaid with jade takes up
most of the center of the room. The table is laden with ornately carved pipes,
some of them even filled with water. In the corner the scabbard for the
legendary sword "Cuddly Death" rests on a pedestal, catching the muted
multihued light on each grain of it's dark honeyed wood. The large pillows
with scrolled characters are massive enough for a person to recline upon if
they were inclined to smoke one of the pipes.
A long corkscrew staircase leads up into the Library.
A stunted staircase leads from the den to the museum.

name: The Museum
description:
Vash's museum is an entirely different affair than the opium den.
While still done in the styles of far off lands, the walls of the museum are
dark and minimalist, so as not to detract from the beauty of the objects of
art which he has collected and stored here under great risk. More than that,
each piece of curios is contained in a box of the clearest glass the realm has
ever seen. There is not a bubble to be seen on any pane in this room. The
framed pictures are dark and emotional, and the statue in the corner with it's
arms upraised as if in a last desperate attempt to fend of an attacker, is
rumored to have been an individual who attempted to remove a piece of art from
this room.

The huge bastard sword which used to belong to Zanzen has been thrust into the
middle of the hardwood floor by Vash as a trophy.

name: The Library
description:
Behind a door at the top of the staircase is Vash's living space. This room
also has dark wooden walls, and the room can be divided in half with the slide
of a cream colored paper screen. The red wooden floor is smooth and polished,
throwing everything upon it back in blurred red relief. One side of the room
is dominated by huge bookshelves which reach to the vaults of the ceiling, the
alien lettering of the books draws the eye with a riot of colors and designs.
Scrolls are hung upon the wall with watercolor calligraphy. a window opposite
the door looks down upon the busy streets of Alden, another screened
window somehow looks down upon the flickering red landscape of another realm
which wavers and distorts constantly. The hundreds of leather wrapped books
make the room smell vaguely of paper, ink, and spices. A massive oak desk is
pushed against the wall near the infernal window.

name: Diabolists Guild
description:
You stand in the Diabolists Guild.  It is dark and damp in this dungeon-like
room.  The monotone chanting of studying demonologists can be heard echoing
about the chamber.  The sharp smell of burning sulfur is all about you, and a
smoky haze obscures the ceiling above.

name: The Grand Artificer
description:
This is a pretty bare room when compared to the other shops of Alden. A
long wooden counter separates the main lobby from a small workshop.  A large
chest of gold, used to pay for the various artifacts brought in, sits securely
in the very back of the store.

name: A Candlelit Lounge
description:
The first thing you take note of as you reach the top of the long, spiral
staircase leading up from the altar room below, is the massive, black room you
just walked into.  On the northern wall hangs a large portrait of the Lord and
Lady that reside in this sanctuary, the eastern and western walls holding two
large windows, draped in long black curtains.  Below it is a crackling fire,
assisting in lighting up the large area.  It is complimented with a few thick,
red candles set on the mantle, much similar to the ones on stands placed about
the room.  Two long, black couches, arranged so that they sit a short distance
on either side of the fireplace and separated by a small marble table, lead to
two chairs, made of dark brown leather and comfortable looking.  A beautiful,
pale skinned woman walks past the southern exit, a haunting yet soothing, soft
melody resonating from her as she greets you and offers you something to
drink.

name: A Dark Music Hall
description:
The haunting music grows louder as you enter this room.  You notice the only
item in it, besides the stairs leading to the room above, is a large,
web-covered pipe organ made of bones collected from various beings.  The tune
heard is somewhat relaxing, it being relentlessly played by keys on the
instrument that do not move at all, the organ itself enchanted by some magic.

Small red candles adorn this eerie contraption, resting on individual skulls
placed randomly about the pipes themselves. To the north, a faint light is
noticeable; the opposite can be said about the top of the stairs, a
pitch-black aura obscuring it.

name: A Dim Bedchamber
description:
The only light in this room emanates from racks of small red candles
surrounding a large, four-post bed.  The frame of the bed is made of wood, cut
from the nearby forest.  Long black drapes are tied neatly to the posts,
leaving the bed itself exposed.  Black silk sheets cover the bed and large
pillows, covered in matching cloth, rest at the head of it.   All are
embroidered with small white roses stitched along the edges.  Large drapes,
matching those in the other rooms, cover the windows of doors that appear to
lead out to a balcony.  On closer inspection of the windows you notice small
boards nailed into the edge of the walls, blocking out any light that would
pass in from the outside.  A faint tune can be heard coming from the stairs
leading down into the lower room.

name: Jesters Guild
description:
You stand in the Guild Hall of Jesters.  This is where you come to
hang out, have a few drinks and just learn to live life.  Battered trophies
and exotic weapons hang along the walls.  Let noone say Jesters don't know how
to get things done!

name: The Lucky Corpse
description:
This dark and dingy room has the smell of old, musty death about it.  Cobwebs
hang from the ceiling, and are especially think in the corners of the room.  A
solitary torch lights the room with its flickering flame.  An old wooden cart
sits against the far wall.  Strange, rust-colored stains cover the bottom of
the cart.

name: Shamans Guild
description:
You stand in the Guild Hall of Shaman.  Many magical fetishes, used for
calling and controlling the spirits hang from the walls and sit on shelves.  A
huge alchemical set sits on a table that stands along the west wall.  The
smell of burnt components fills the air.

name: Conjurers Guild
description:
You stand in the Guild Hall of Conjurers.  Many pieces of dismantled golems
are stacked along the wall, with studying conjurers looking at and inside
them, trying to decipher the hidden workings.  A huge shelf for storing
components stands against the east wall, but is only for the use of the
Guildmasters themselves...adventuring conjurers will need to find their
components elsewhere!

name: Alden Transportal
description:
This small room contains a small ticket booth, and a spiral staircase that
leads upward into the transport booth.  Alden Transportal guarantees
safety during the magical portal process, and as far as anyone knows, noone
has "disappeared" during a transportal.

name: Transportal  Chamber
description:
This small room sits at the top of the spiral stairs.  No decorations are
placed here, to ensure that there are no disruptions with the transportal
process.  One just needs to stand in the room, have a valid magic portal
ticket, and soon they will be sent to the proper location.

name: Lair Of The Fur(r)y Dragon
description:
A voice says "Naw, just kiddin"...

Welcome to the House of Fury. As soon as you enter this "humble" residence,
you are overwhelmed by the sound of the Eagles playing in the background. He
really did love his 70s rock. Very plain in design, but this place seems to
be filled with a Mystical power. After all, it WAS made by the Creator, Drazuk
himself. There are a few paintings on the wall, those might be fun to LOOK at
later.

You notice there are many papers cast about, detailing maps on how to kill
dragons, the effects of staffs, wands and other magical information. Stuff
that would make the Great Abatha say his "Achiever" within was showing.  In
the corner you see a finely finished wooden desk that seems to be crammed with
junk he has collected on his journeys into the unknown. He has plenty of
mismatched chairs, every kind from the pelted leather ones to the ones that
fold out with a place for your beer. His bed, a comfy looking hammock, seems
to be untouched and dusty.  He was known for his late nights, adventuring into
the Elders realm or diving into books by some other realm Author named
"Stephen King". Just as you bend over to grab one of these highly prized
novels, a voice from the behind you says, "Hey Pally, wanna Drink? Blood beers
are Furys recommended choice".

name: A Dark Living Room
description:
Very minimal light exists within this room, the obsidian walls lined with
torches, but not allowing the lambency to stretch very far.  The floor is
the color of blood red, a HUGE, overstuffed, black leather sofa centered
upon it, housing a myriad of cushy pillows.  Directly across from this, a
giant magical viewscreen hangs on the far wall, numerous black and silver
boxes connected to the screen by what one could only assume to be some sort
of exotic black ropes.  The remainder of the room is sparsely decorated,
save for the occasional painting or framed picture.  A spiral staircase winds
upward to the second floor.

name: The Study
description:
This is where Vra researches new Diabolist spells and checks his e-mail.
A magical white box sits humming on a desk right beside a small viewscreen.
The walls are lined with shelves full of books of all shapes and sizes, many
bearing runes you've never seen before.  The spiral staircase continues upward
to a third floor.

name: The Bedroom
description:
Vra rarely ever sleeps here, so he uses this room mostly for storage.
Several large chests sit around the room, filled with souveniers and
trinkets from his journeys around the world.

name: Heirlooms of a Warrior
description:
The walls of this spacious room are completely covered in various weaponry
and armor, torches seemingly added afterwards, wherever there was a place
to fit.  These artifacts are not those of a simple warrior's...dulled, beaten
and thrown about as if there were no time to care for them.  They seem more
like antiques, worthy of much more attention and care, and obviously given it,
for there is not one piece in this room that doesn't shine with brilliance.
Directly across from the entrance is a wooden door leading elsewhere.

name: Spoils of War
description:
This emmense room is decorated with a vast amount of "trophies" from hideous
creatures throughout the realm.  Synot, Azathoth and the Nightmare Magnet are
but a few of the slays the owner of this home has apparently made.  Only a
Champion could have this many prizes to brag about.  The floor is a smooth
sable color of wood, more weaponry stashed in neat holders in every corner
of the room, making it a very fit place for sparring.  Another wooden door
leads west into yet a different room.

name: The Resting Chamber
description:
The floor to this room is made of etched stone slab, magnificent carpets
laid down over it to keep the chill off of one's feet while walking.  A huge
bed takes up a big part of these chambers, velvet canopied drapes hanging from
the tops of all four corner posts.  Red and ebony seem to be the favored
colors of the one who sleeps here.  At least that is what the bedding and
other decorations portray.  A fireplace is set into one wall across from the
bed, its flames casting a soft glow and allowing the shadows to play amongst
the light.  Lush pillows lay on the floor in front of the hearth, inviting
those who visit to bask in their comfort.  Against the opposite wall is a
large tapestry depicting a victory scene of a young ghoul who has defeated
one of the mighty masked hunters.

name: The Locker Room
description:
This room is bare and dull, the only thing occupying it being rows
and rows of lockers against the walls.

name: An Old Attic
description:
After fearing for your life while climbing the old rickety ladder, you
notice hey this really is an old attic. There are cobwebs everywhere
and you wonder if Lardar ever comes in here. There are a few crates
of old junk piled along the North wall and piles of rags along the south
wall. The east wall is bare and looks as if it is ready to crumble. The
old rafters look heavy and you realize that they may fall on your head,
in fact it looks as if one already has as you notice a skeleton on the
floor beside it. The west wall does seem curious, though. It is the only
wall that looks as if it has been tended to since half of it has been
painted in a grayish color, even if it has not been finished yet.

name: A Bright Sitting Room
description:
You clever soul you! Ever thought of being a thief? Your mind seems
well suited for it since you found the entrance to my living room. Upon
reaching the top of my rafter the first thing you notice is how bright my
sitting room is. As well it should be since the walls are set with gold.  In
the center of the ceiling rests a bright circular ball with several large
diamonds inset around the top of it. The diamonds seem to be making
the ceiling glow in the many colors of the rainbow and the gold reflects
the light well throughout the rest of the room. On the West wall, you see
many wicked looking daggers ceremoniously hung on the wall. Realizing
that these are probably Lardars former weapons, you cannot help but
wonder what he uses these days. The north has a small kitchen area with
many fancy dishes lying about. The table appears to be made of solid crystal.
Glancing to the south, you see the entrance to the bedroom.

name: A Majestic Bedroom
description:
Walking into the room you see the giant 4 poster bed covered in rich
luxuriant blankets and several down pillows. The bed looks quite cozy
and roomy enough for several people at once. Looking around you
notice the 4 poles of the bed are solid gold Gold Dragons. They almost
seem real. Did that tongue just flick? It does seem a bit warm in here.

name: A Small Trailer
description:
This trailer is small and cluttered.  It would remind one of what an actor
or actress would use while they were on location shooting a movie.  Its
inhabitant is obviously male and not a very tidy person, as men's clothing
is scattered everywhere throughout the tiny living quarters.  It's a wonder
he could even live in this small abode, as there is very little furniture to
speak of and it would seem like he was trapped.  His only saving grace
is perhaps the tiny magical viewscreen placed upon the counter.

name: A Pathway Through Towering Trees
description:
A small path cuts South from the lake, weaving it's way around
the towering trees that hide the sun and many other things from
view.  Different types of foilage cover the ground as well as a
thin veil of fog.  There is nothing to be heard but complete silence.

name: A Pathway Through Towering Trees
description:
A small path cuts South from the lake, weaving it's way around
the towering trees that hide the sun and many other things from
view.  Different types of foilage cover the ground as well as a
thin veil of fog.  There is nothing to be heard but complete silence.

name: A Shrouded Doorway
description:
The path here ends to the South, as a large home now stands there.
The doorway to this house is covered with some sort of black mist
that moves and swirls over the closed wooden surface.  Tendrils of
fog creep over the ground as if they are looking for something...or
someone to suffocate.  Any visitors would dare not step beyond here
unless, perhaps, they made a deal with the Devil.

name: An Entrance Way
description:
Entering this house would overcome someone with a desire to flee.
A vampire's  house is not normally welcome to intruders. During the
daytime hours, black shrouds are carefully placed over both of the
windows that rest upon the southern wall, holding the darkness inside.
A couple of staves and wands fill a bucket to the right of the doorway,
obviously discarded. Fine rugs, made from an unknown beast, line the
hardwood floor. An open closet next to the door  holds various cloaks
and other assorted garments. Black candles line the room, inviting you
deeper within this house.

name: A Living Room
description:
What a spacious room!  The ceiling here is made up of black tiles,
painted to look like the night sky.  Bookshelves line all four walls,
overflowing with scrolls and parchments of every color.  From the
center of the room above hangs a sparkling chandelier of nothing
but  pure  crystal.  Atop the endless array of bookcases,  carefully
placed  upon  the  dark walls,  are paintings of magnificent quality.
On the south wall, however, two pictures stand out from the rest, a
picture of the Goddess Ashlyn on the left and a picture of the God
Sainrith on the right. A  table set into the hardwood floor, centered
in the room, is obviously a  work space for creating many magical
items. What strange things go on here? Only the owner would be
able to tell you.

name: A Luxurious Chamber
description:
A bedroom of a truly rich vampire is a sight to see. The largest bed
known  to  man  or  beast rests against the wall.  The heavy oaken
frame is covered by a silk canopy. Plush rugs of bear fur cover the
hard floor and the smell of exotic oils and colognes reach the nose
in a pleasent waft. No windows mark the black walls and various
trophies, collected from around the realm, stand proudly upon the
dresser beside the bed.  Golden lights crafted from magic float near
the ceiling, allowing you to see what little of the room that the owner
wishes you to see. A door leads to a bathroom made completely of
marble, mined by the goblins of Unki.  Music creeps in from seemingly
nowhere to please the ears and relax the visitors.  Perhaps the owner
isn't that bad after all.

name: Lex's Lair
description:
The room is dark, Very dark. The only source of light comes from the black
candle that sits on the table. Along the south wall stands the resting place
of the Legendary mace, Osires the Dragon Tamer.

name: Lardar's Shack
description:
This is a cozy little cottage. There may be a treasure or two to be found in
a corner, but don't let me catch you looking fer it.  There is a small ladder
leading to what appears to be an old dusty attic off in the North Corner.

name: Drazuk's Office
description:
You stand in the stately office of Lord Drazuk.  Dark wooden walls surround a
thick red carpet.  Oil paintings of horrible beasts are placed on the walls,
and the room is lit by small candles, held by live gargoyles.  A large fire
roars in the fireplace on the south wall, and a massive wooden desk sits on
the western side of the room.

name: Placeholder
description: Placeholder

name: University Entrance
description:
You stand inside the entrance to the University of Alden, an
establishment designed to teach the basics of play inside this game.  Each
room has a specific purpose and contains information on the various commands
to maneuver around and interact with the players.  We recommend you explore
the University in full, taking the time to read the instructions in each room.

Type N to move north to the next room in the University.  If you have already
completed the rigors of the University and wish to test your combat mettle in
the battlegrounds, type OPEN S or OPEN DOOR, then S to enter the arena.

name: A Stone Corridor
description:
To the west is the language lessons room. Lady Celine is there
to assist you in learning the languages of the land.  To the east
is where Agape will assist you in practicing your weapons, skills
and spells.  When you are finished with your lessons, come back
here and continue north through the University.

name: Somewhere
description:
You did it! You are an excellent student! To continue your education,
please leave north. That will return you to the Reading room.

name: The Laboratory of Skills and Spells
description:
This is where you will practice your arsenal of weapons, spells and skills.
Type PRACTICE to get a list of these currently available to you.  Everyone
will have sections listing skills, weapons and languages.  Spells casters
will have an additional section for spells.  To practice a spell, skill or
weapons style, type PRACTICE <full name of spell, skill or weapon style>.

For instance, to practice dispel magic, you would type PRAC DISPEL MAGIC.
When practicing, you start at 0% and one practice will earn you between
15% and 20% proficiency.  Additional knowledge is gained through usage of
the skill or spell until adept, which is a maximum of 30% - 95%.

To get see information using spells, skills or weapons, type HELP CAST or
HELP <spell, skill or weapon style>.  For general questions on practicing,
type HELP PRACTICE.  The number of practice sessions you may gain at each
level is determined by the amount of wisdom you have when you level.

name: The Reading Room
description:
This is a silent room, which means while here you will not see any of the
channels. In fact, you can only use socials, emotes and group tell here.
The room was created to give you a quiet place to read our help files.
You can reduce your own screen scroll by reducing the number of channels
you receive. You can get a full list of channels by typing CHAN. You may
turn off a channel by type CHAN -<channel> and reactive a channel by
typing CHAN +<channel>. For example, you can turn off auction channel by
type CHAN -AUCTION and you can turn it back on by typing CHAN +AUCTION.
You can also turn off ALL your channels by typing CHAN -ALL and turn them
all on again by typing CHAN +ALL. Once you have finished reading, you are
ready to test your ability to negotiate your way around.
Going west will take you into another part of the University. The test is to
follow all the room descriptions until you can find your way back to this
point. If at any time you become lost, type U to return to this room. Once
you have successfully returned here, please continue to the north to
explore the rest of the University.

name: Chamber of Trials for Rangers
description:
Here you will experience your first full combat against MOBILES, also known
as MOBS. Mobile is the name used for monsters and the like in the game.
All exits, except down, lead to a CAGE mob. Some of these cage mobs may be
aggressive and will attack you upon entering their room. As you kill them,
you will gain experience, as well as university equipment and gold. Once you
have defeated a mob, type GET ALL CORPSE to loot the coins and equipment.
You may also type CONFIG +AUTOLOOT or CONFIG +AUTOGOLD. AUTOLOOT will take
everything from the corpse when you kill it. AUTOGOLD will take only the
gold from the corpse. When you loot a corpse of equipment, the items are
transferred to your inventory. You may suffer injury during the battle, so
return here and type REST or SLEEP. This will speed your healing process.
When you are finished healing, type WAKE or STAND to continue.

name: Celine's Language Lessons
description:
This is where you LEARN your LANGUAGES.  Languages are learned differently
than spells, skills and weapons, as you must be adept at language before
you may use it.  To see a list of the languages available to you, simply
type PRACTICE.  You do not need to learn the TONGUE of your race nor the
common language, as they both come naturally to you.  To learn a language,
type LANGUAGE LEARN <language type>.

For more information on how to learn a language, type HELP LANGUAGES.  To
learn how to use languages, type HELP SPEAK and HELP TONGUE.  It will cost
a few practice sessions each time you wish to increase your fluency in a
language.  Those who are intelligent, wise and lucky will find it takes
fewer practice sessions to become adept at a language.

name: Wandering the University
description:
Each player has a menu of items that the game controls automatically once
it has been configured. To get a list of this menu, type CONFIG. For this
part of your schooling, it is suggested you type CONFIG +AUTOEXIT. This
will have the mud show you all obvious exits available to you. When you
are moving around the game, EXIT is a very important command. When you
type EXIT, it shows you the room names each exit shown under obvious exits.
You can use this command to get hints of dangers and death traps that might
be close by. You may also try to LOOK in adjoining rooms. You do this by
typing LOOK <direction>. Your next move is to the west, to see what you
are walking into, try typing EXIT and L W.

name: A Dank Pit
description:
Here stands a Automaton.  He was created by the Mages Guild and the
Instructors decided to use him as a teaching aid.  With him you can practice
attacking and fleeing, but hopefully not dying.  You will also want to make
use of the 'consider' command.  This command compares your level and hitpoints
to that of the creature.  To use here, type 'con automaton'.

To use the consider command elsewhere, type CON <MOBNAME>.  It is wise to
ALWAYS consider a mob before fighting it the first time.  This will many
times save your life, as mobs are often a lot more difficult then they
outwardly appear.  Be careful and enjoy your fight.

name: Wandering the University
description:
This is where you will start learning about exits not listed under "Exits".
Doors are not seen on the game. You must read room description and LOOK
<direction> to find them. Another method of finding a door is to "bump" into
the walls. Type N. OUCH! You ran into the door. You want to be careful not
to be affected with the pass door spell while using the bump method, as you
may end up in a room you would rather not visit. Now, type OPEN N or OPEN
DOOR. Next type EXIT, you will now see the north exit listed under "Exits".
Type HELP OPEN to find out more information on doors.

name: An Enclosed Room
description:
You did it! Well done. You will find many rooms such as this all over the
game. Some are easy to find because of hints in the room descriptions.
Some are very hard to find, as the clues could be rooms away. However, you
are now armed with the tools to locate them. You know how to use "look",
bump, and "exit". Many classes also get a spell called "scry". This spell
will allow the person affected by it to see the into the adjoining rooms.
It is used like "look", but gives you more detailed information. To see if
you gain the scry spell at a later level, type SLIST. This will give you a
list of all spells, skills and weapon types you may practice. SLIST also
gives you information on what level you may practice each, to what percent
you are currently practiced in each, and what the maximum percent that you
may practice each.

name: Lost in the University
description:
There are several special exit types that you may encounter in your travels.
You have experienced open exits and closed doors to this point. There are
also hidden doors. The hidden door can not be found with the "bump" method.
Often they will not show up with the "look" method either. These exits are
found by reading room descriptions, mobiles descriptions and looking at
objects. You are looking for words that stand out, those words will be the
door name. You will also find doors that are locked. You may get past some
locked doors with the pass door spell, the pick door skill or bash door skill.
Some doors may only be passed by using the matching key. Other exits you
may find require you to be skilled in climb or affected by the fly spell.
All exits are in real directions that can be abbreviated to the following:
N, E, W, S, NE, NW, SE, SW, U, or D. There are also SOMEWHERE exits that
use "leave", "climb", "enter", or just a word to use. To the north you
will experience a hidden exit, use the room description to find the door name.

name: Lost in the University
description:
You are standing in a richly decorated room. A large oak table surrounded
by twelve chairs dominates a large portion of the area. Crystal globes with
continual light spells cast on them hover about the room, providing a soft
comfortable light. The walls are adorned with tapestries of the finest
quality. The tapestry on the west wall draws your attention more so than
the others. Now, you have many clues on the possible exit. Try to find the
right word by typing LOOK <word>. For example, try LOOK GLOBES. Sometimes
looking at other things in the rooms description will lead you to the word
that will open the exit.

name: A Secret Alcove
description:
Well Done! You have found this secret room. Sometimes these secret rooms
will contain valuable items or will lead to other parts of the area you
are exploring. Always pay close attention to room descriptions, mobiles
descriptions and items, this will many times bring profitable results.
This is a where you will experience a Somewhere exit. To find your way
out, try looking at the picture on the wall. If you can not figure it out,
you may leave by the up exit. Good luck!

name: A Marble Corridor
description:
This room will teach you several commands to check your statistics and
character health. These commands are SCORE, EQUIPMENT, INVENTORY, and
LEVEL. Score is used by typing SC, it tells you all the basic statistics
about your character. Equipment is used by typing EQ, this shows you all
the items you are currently wearing. Inventory is used by typing I, and
shows you all items you are carrying other than your worn equipment.
Level is used by typing LEVEL, it show your current level, your current
experience points, and the experience needed for the next few levels.
Use the help menu to get more information on the topics covered here,
type HELP <subject>.

name: Preparing for Combat
description:
The time is drawing near to experience combat.  Directly below you now is
the Chadoyn Pit, the home of a creature which will assist you in learning
how to initiate combat.  The Chadoyn is not aggressive, which means you
must begin the fight.  There are many ways to start a fight, the quickest
way is to type KILL <mob>.  As you gain skills and spells, you may find
many of them are also capable of initiating combat.

Some of the more popular spells used to start an attack are DISPEL MAGIC,
SLEEP, CHARM PERSON, BLINDNESS, WEAKEN, CURSE, and FAERIE FIRE.  Some of
the most popular skills used to begin an attack are STEAL and BACKSTAB.
  ** These skills and spells WILL also begin an attack on a player **

Wands, staves and scrolls may also be used to start fights.

name: A Dank Pit
description:
This room explains about WIMPY, FLEE, and RECALL as a way to leave from
combat. Wimpy is an automatic withdrawal from a fight when your hitpoints
reach a set minimum. To set your wimpy, type WIMPY or WIMPY <number>. The
number being the amount of hitpoints you want remaining when you leave the
battle. You will lose experience for wimpying out of a fight, but the amount
of experience lost will generally be less then the amount lost from death.
You may also manually withdraw from a fight with flee. To use flee, just
type FLEE. You may flee out of the fight at any amount of hitpoints. Fleeing
will cost you loss of experience. You may also "recall" from a fight. This
is done with the spell "word of recall" or reciting a recall scroll. You
lose more experience when you recall from a fight then when you use wimpy
or flee. Recall should be used as a last resort.

name: A Marble Corridor
description:
Congratulations! You have come far in your training. Your next step is
getting your equipment from the cage mobs for your chosen class. North
of here is the University Healer, Lord Kell.  He will cast spells on you,
to help with your fights. Sit with him until you are ready to proceed in
your training.

name: Hall of the Warrior
description:
You see shields of every make and shape mounted on the walls here. Donated
by the warriors who have passed through these hallowed halls before you. The
clash and ring of steel can be heard coming from the floor beneath you.

name: The University Healer
description:
This is a healer. You will find many of them throughout the game. Their
purpose is to cast spells of armor, bless, cure blindness, cure poison,
cure light, and refresh. The healer casts these spells randomly to the
characters in the room. Some healers have programs that will allow you
to purchase certain spells for coins. Others have programs that will give
you a spell when you say a certain word or phrase, or do a certain social
to them. It is important to look at mobiles to read their descriptions.
Many will have hints in their descriptions that will tell you what to
say or do to get their favor.  A passage leads up towards the Battleground.

name: Hall of the Druid
description:
Walking along this hall is strangely reminiscent of a stroll through a
lush forest. A light breeze touches your cheek and you look twice to make
sure you are indeed in the University. You see a soft glow coming from
the floor.

name: Hall of the Thug
description:
The hall is so dimly lit here that details are hard to discern. The rustle
of dead leaves, blowing in the wind, fills your ears. As you grow to realize
they are more whispers than leaves, you find yourself compelled. Willingly,
you proceed to their source.

name: Hall of the Thief
description:
You have the distinct feeling that you are not the only person here.
Every now and then you catch glimpses of shadows dancing across the wall.
You can feel a slight breeze, as if someone has passed close by you. Upon
searching the area, you confirm you are the only person in sight.

name: Hall of the Mage
description:
The pungent odor of sulfur is dominant here. Fine mists cover the floor,
and a harsh chanting seems to be coming from all around you. Thunder claps
and bursts of light can be seen and heard coming from below you.

name: Hall of the Cleric
description:
A feeling of utter peace and tranquility fills your spirit, ahead you
see the horrors of your nightmares come to life, not giving them a second
glance you pass right through them to fulfill your destiny.

name: Chamber of Trials for Warriors
description:
Here you will experience your first full combat against MOBILES, also known
as MOBS. Mobile is the name used for monsters and the like in the game.
All exits, except down, lead to a CAGE mob. Some of these cage mobs may be
aggressive and will attack you upon entering their room. As you kill them,
you will gain experience, as well as university equipment and gold. Once you
have defeated a mob, type GET ALL CORPSE to loot the coins and equipment.
You may also type CONFIG +AUTOLOOT or CONFIG +AUTOGOLD. AUTOLOOT will take
everything from the corpse when you kill it. AUTOGOLD will take only the
gold from the corpse. When you loot a corpse of equipment, the items are
transferred to your inventory. You may suffer injury during the battle, so
return here and type REST or SLEEP. This will speed your healing process.
When you are finished healing, type WAKE or STAND to continue.

name: Clerics West Cage
description:
Kill this "cage" mob, remove the "university" equipment from the corpse, and
then sacrifice the corpse. Sacrifice is as the name states, you sacrifice
the corpse to the gods and they reward you for it. To use, type SAC CORPSE.
You may also sacrifice unwanted items, by first dropping them on the ground,
then typing SAC <item>. For more information on sacrifice, see the help.

name: Clerics North Cage
description:
As you loot the corpses you will be collecting your equipment, you need to
learn the commands for using your equipment. The commands are: GET, DROP,
WEAR, WIELD, HOLD, REMOVE, REPAIR, and EXAMINE. To get a piece of equipment
from a corpse you type GET <item> CORPSE. To get an item from the ground
you type GET <item>. To drop a piece of equipment from your inventory, type
DROP <item>. To wear an item, type WEAR <item> or WEAR ALL. To wield a
weapon, type WIELD <item>. You may not wield a weapon if you are already
wielding one, you must first remove the weapon you are using. To remove a
weapon or item, type REMOVE <item>. Many pieces of equipment may be damaged
and repaired. To see the condition of a piece of equipment, type EXAM <item>.
If is it in need of repair, you need to find a blacksmith. Once in the room
with the blacksmith, remove item to inventory and type REPAIR <item>.

name: Clerics South Cage
description:
The stench of rotting corpses assaults your senses. Bits of bone and pieces
of rusted armor are strewn about the cage. Remember, kill, loot the corpse,
then sacrifice the corpse. You may type CONFIG +AUTOSAC to have all corpse
sacrificed automatically at the mobiles death. You must use caution when
using AUTOSAC as items still inside the corpse are also sacrificed. Even
if you have CONFIG +AUTOLOOT, there are times when your hands are full or
you have reached maximum weight and will be unable to get everything from
the corpse.

name: Clerics East Cage
description:
The cage mobs are all named "cage" in addition to their actual name. This
mob can be killed using KILL CAGE or KILL KOBOLD. All the other cage mobs
are similarly named. The mobs in the battlegrounds will all be referred to
as "arena" in addition to their name. Also, all equipment available in the
University is named "university". You can WEAR UNIVERSITY or REMOVE UNIVERSITY
in addition to the actual name of the item.

description:

name: The Room Of Portals
description:
This is the portal room which leads to the training hall for each of the
classes.  Prepare to be transferred once your presence is noticed.  It may
take a few moments, so please be patient.  Should you decide you are not
ready to face the Chamber of Trials, you can return to the south.  You
notice a large certificate on the wall; at least you have something
to read while you wait.

name: A Stone Corridor
description:
This is the stage of your training where you may begin to feel pangs of
hunger and a parched throat. In other words, you need food and drink.
To the east is the University Supply Store. You may purchase water and
some meat. Once you have eaten and drunk, you will be ready to proceed
north.

name: University Supply Store
description:
This is a regular shop, you type LIST to see what you can purchase and
BUY <item> to make the purchase. Like many other places in the game,
you may bribe the storekeeper to give you an item. There are many mobs
in this world that will sell you keys, items or information in exchange
for a few gold coins. Be sure to look at the mobiles for hints on these
types of programs.

name: A Stone Corridor
description:
In this part of the university you will learn about the Death Trap, more
commonly known as a DT. A death trap is exactly as its name states, a
room that causes your death. Unlike a regular death, you do not lose
your hitpoints and you do not leave a corpse behind. All the items you
were wearing and carrying are destroyed. You do not leave a corpse behind.
You are then transported back to the Temple in Alden. Going west will
give you more information about death traps.

name: Slow Death
description:
This is what you will see if you stumble into a death trap.  As previously
stated, a DT kills instantaneously and destroys any and all equipment you
have at the time.  Hints as to the placement of a death trap are sometimes
given in the room that precedes them.  Also remember to use "exit" and
"look" to find these deadly rooms.  Note:  no DTs should exist in the Realm,
but it's best to be aware of such things.

name: A Stone Corridor
description:
One final challenge remains for you. Then you may enter the battlegrounds
to further hone your combat skills. To the west is a creature that holds
the an important prize. Kill him and it is yours.

name: A Final Test
description:
You can hear the clash of steel and chanting coming from somewhere above
you. This room smells of decay. The walls are dripping with some sort of
green ichor. It looks as if it is burning right through. You see a flash
of light from the above, then it is gone.

name: In The Middle Of The Eastern Wall
description:
This is the University entrance to the Battleground. Below here is the lower
level of the University. The battleground were supplied to allow you to further
hone the combat skills learned in your schooling. Kill the beasts that wander
here. If you wish to leave, exiting up will take you to Lord Kell.

name: Along The Eastern Wall
description:
You hear the howl of some unnatural beast echo off the walls. The ground
is stained with dried blood, looking closer you see tracks of some sort
of creature ... but what?

name: Rangers North Cage
description:
As you loot the corpses you will be collecting your equipment, you need to
learn the commands for using your equipment. The commands are: GET, DROP,
WEAR, WIELD, HOLD, REMOVE, REPAIR, and EXAMINE. To get a piece of equipment
from a corpse you type GET <item> CORPSE. To get an item from the ground
you type GET <item>. To drop a piece of equipment from your inventory, type
DROP <item>. To wear an item, type WEAR <item> or WEAR ALL. To wield a
weapon, type WIELD <item>. You may not wield a weapon if you are already
wielding one, you must first remove the weapon you are using. To remove a
weapon or item, type REMOVE <item>. Many pieces of equipment may be damaged
and repaired. To see the condition of a piece of equipment, type EXAM <item>.
If is it in need of repair, you need to find a blacksmith. Once in the room
with the blacksmith, remove item to inventory and type REPAIR <item>.

description:

then sacrifice the corpse. Sacrifice is as the name states, you sacrifice

You may also sacrifice unwanted items, by first dropping them on the ground,
then typing SAC <item>. For more information on sacrifice, see the help.

name: Hall Of The Ranger
description:
The freedom of the wild, always has it fascinated you. To be free in the
land, independent of cities and civilizations. These thoughts flood your
mind as you walk this hallway.

name: In A Humid Cavern
description:
You are standing in an underground cavern, moss is prevalent along the ceiling
and walls. A steady dripping is echoing through the area and seems to be coming
from everywhere.

name: In The Cavern
description:
The steady sound of hissing can be heard in the distance.  The air here
is extremely humid, you are finding it very difficult to breathe.

name: In The Cavern
description:
You feel as if you are being pulled into the mire, the constant dampness
of the cavern has caused the ground to be turned into a mud bog.

name: Deeper In The Cavern
description:
The steady sound of hissing can be heard in the distance, closer actually
than you would like. The air here is humid and breathing is difficult.

name: In The Cavern
description:
You feel you are being pulled into the mire, the constant dampness and
humidity have caused the ground to be transformed into a mud bog.

name: Cove Of The Queen
description:
You have inadvertently stumbled upon the cove of the Queen of the Nagas.
This room is littered with bloated corpses of adventurers who have been
reported lost in the past few days.

name: Hall Of The Diabolist
description:
This dark chamber is barely lit by a few large candles, placed along the walls
in tiny alcoves.  Strange circles are drawn around the floor, used to channel
the power of the nether realms.  The odd chanting of other Diabolists can be
heard echoing around the room.

name: Drazuk's Office
description:
This chamber is covered with runes of warding and power a ball of scrying
hovers in front of Drazuk's throne. The throne is made from the bones of
his mortal self before he passed onto the realm of immortality. Looking
you discover a T.V. and DVD player behind the throne for use when the Realms
are not in need of the King of Ghouls.

name: Hall Of The Monk
description:
This chamber is filled with an aura of utter calmness and peace.  The
walls are painted a soft hue, adding to the affect.  Here is were the
Monks come to meditate and reflect upon their activities of the
day.  Small, spartan cots line the walls, each well-padded to make a
comfortable resting place for an exhausted adventurer.

name: Chamber Of Trials For Monks
description:
Here you will experience your first full combat against MOBILES, also known
as MOBS. Mobile is the name used for monsters and the like in the game.
All exits, except down, lead to a CAGE mob. Some of these cage mobs may be
aggressive and will attack you upon entering their room. As you kill them,
you will gain experience, as well as university equipment and gold. Once you
have defeated a mob, type GET ALL CORPSE to loot the coins and equipment.
You may also type CONFIG +AUTOLOOT or CONFIG +AUTOGOLD. AUTOLOOT will take
everything from the corpse when you kill it. AUTOGOLD will take only the
gold from the corpse. When you loot a corpse of equipment, the items are
transferred to your inventory. You may suffer injury during the battle, so
return here and type REST or SLEEP. This will speed your healing process.
When you are finished healing, type WAKE or STAND to continue.

name: Monks North Cage
description:
As you loot the corpses you will collect basic University equipment.  The
commands for using your new belongings are:  GET, DROP, WEAR, WIELD, HOLD,
REMOVE, REPAIR, and EXAMINE.  "Get <item>" or "get <item> corpse" takes an
object from the ground or from a corpse and places it into your inventory.
To wear an item from your inventory type "wear item", and to remove it and
return it to your inventory type "remove <item>".  To drop an item in your
inventory, type "drop <item>".  To wield a weapon, type "wield <weapon>".
Many items may be damaged and repaired.  To see an item's condition, type
"exam <item>".  To repair an item type "repair <item>" at a blacksmith.

name: Monks East Cage
description:
Kill this "cage" mob, remove the "university" equipment from its corpse, and
then sacrifice the corpse.  Sacrifice is as the name states, you sacrifice
the corpse to the gods and they reward you for it (albeit small).  To use,
type 'sac corpse'.  You may also sacrifice unwanted items by first dropping
them and then typing 'sac <item>'.  See 'help sacrifice' for information.

name: Monks South Cage
description:
The stench of rotting corpses assaults your nostrils, while bits of bone
and pieces of rusted armor are strewn about the cage.  Remember - kill,
loot the corpse, then sacrifice the corpse.  You may type 'CONFIG +AUTOSAC'
to have all corpse sacrificed automatically when you kill the creature.
You must use caution when using AUTOSAC, as items still inside the corpse
are also sacrificed.  Even if you have 'CONFIG +outplot', there are times
when your hands are full or you have reached maximum weight and will be
unable to get everything from the corpse automatically.

name: Monks West Cage
description:
The cage mobs are all named "cage" in addition to their actual name, thus
these creatures can be killed using 'kill cage' or 'kill kobold'.  All the
other cage mobs are similarly named.  The mobs in the battlegrounds will all
be referred to as "arena" in addition to their name.  Also, all equipment
available in the University is named "university".  You can 'wear university'
or 'remove university' in addition to the actual name of the item.

name: A Dark Tunnel Below The Battlegrounds
description:
You have left the relative safety of the battlegrounds above.  A thick
stench of death, moisture, and heat mix to assault your every breath.
The walls of this tunnel are covered with a slimy layer of a liquid
similar to sweat.  Below your feet, the ground seems to sink slightly,
barely handling your weight.  Crudely carved tunnels lead deeper into
this underground chamber to the southwest and southeast.

name: A Dark Tunnel Below The Battlegrounds
description:
The walls of this tunnel are close, barely allowing you passage.
The earth under your feet is damp and sticking to your boots.  A
squeal can be heard coming from the south.  You may want to return
back to the safety of the Battlegrounds.

name: A Dark Tunnel Below The Battlegrounds
description:
Darkness engulfs this tunnel, making it impossible to see without a
light source.  Water drips slowly down the tunnel walls, adding to
the moisture in the soil and humidity in the air.  This place does
appear to be very welcoming.

name: A Dark Tunnel Below The Battlegrounds
description:
The walls of this tunnel are close, barely allowing you passage.
The earth under your feet is damp and sticking to your boots.  A
squeal can be heard coming from the south.  You may want to return
back to the safety of the Battlegrounds far towards the north.

name: A Dark Tunnel Below The Battlegrounds
description:
Darkness engulfs this tunnel, making it impossible to see without a
light source.  Water drips slowly down the tunnel walls, adding to
the moisture in the soil and humidity in the air.  This place does
appear to be very welcoming.

name: A Dark Tunnel Below The Battlegrounds
description:
You have entered a opening in the rock, and can see a large cavern
to the east.  Sounds echo around you, coming from everywhere and
nowhere. This place gives you a sick feeling in the pit of your
stomach.

name: A Dark Tunnel Below The Battlegrounds
description:
The tunnel stops abruptly at the southern wall.  There are several
openings leading away from the tunnel, into a large cavern.  You can
hear a lot of noise in the area, and none of it sounds pleasant.

name: A Hollow Cavern Deep Underground
description:
Booming echoes overwhelm your senses.  Loud dripping, sounding like
many large hammers crashing against the stone walls, assault your every
moment. Cries of death surround and torment you.  You get a distinct
urge to move away from here as quickly, and unnoticed, as possible.

name: A Hollow Cavern Deep Underground
description:
The sounds seem to coalesces here, making one noise indistinguishable
from the next.  The cavern wall to the south seems to be sweating,
drips of water roll down its face, collecting in a puddle at your feet.
You have a desire to leave this place, and venture somewhere less
deafening.

name: A Hollow Cavern Deep Underground
description:
Booming echoes overwhelm your senses.  Loud dripping, sounding like
many large hammers crashing against the stone walls, assault your every
moment. Cries of death surround and torment you.  You get a distinct
urge to move away from here as quickly, and unnoticed, as possible.

name: A Hollow Cavern Deep Underground
description:
You sink a few inches into the mud that makes up the floor of this
cavern. Darkness and noise punctuate the devastating nothingness
that fills this space.  If there is life to be found in this place,
you are sure you do not want to run across it.

name: A Hollow Cavern Deep Underground
description:
As you wander through the muggy darkness, your nose detects the musty
scents of fungus and decay as your passing stirs the still air.  The
sounds of battle echo around you as you continue your journey through
the gloom, loud enough to make you believe that around the next
corner you may find two combatants struggling for life. You continue
onwards through the gloom, your senses screaming for you to flee before
it's too late.

name: A Hollow Cavern Deep Underground
description:
Hollow and barren of color and light, this place is overwhelming with
sounds and moisture.  The sound of water dripping and wails of pain and
death can be heard all around you.  Whatever resides in this awful place
does not welcome strangers.

name: A Dark Tunnel Below The Battlegrounds
description:

openings leading away from the tunnel, into a large cavern.  You can
hear a lot of noise in the area, and none of it sounds pleasant.

name: A Hollow Cavern Deep Underground
description:

name: A Hollow Cavern Deep Underground
description:
To the north is a craggy rock wall of the cavern, covered in a slimy
film of an unknown source.  From all directions you are assaulted by
howls of pain, and cries of death.  Moisture clings to your skin,
making you feel much hotter then you should for the air temperature.

name: A Hollow Cavern Deep Underground
description:

cavern. Darkness and noise punctuate the devastating nothingness
that fills this space.  If there is life to be found in this place,

by the warriors who have passed through these hallowed halls before you. The
clash and ring of steel can be heard coming from the floor beneath you.

name: Jesters East Cage
description:
Kill this "cage" mob, remove the "university" equipment from its corpse, and
then sacrifice the corpse.  Sacrifice is as the name states, you sacrifice
the corpse to the gods and they reward you for it (albeit small).  To use,
type 'sac corpse'.  You may also sacrifice unwanted items by first dropping
them and then typing 'sac <item>'.  See 'help sacrifice' for information.

name: Jesters South Cage
description:
The stench of rotting corpses assaults your nostrils, while bits of bone
and pieces of rusted armor are strewn about the cage.  Remember - kill,
loot the corpse, then sacrifice the corpse.  You may type 'CONFIG +AUTOSAC'
to have all corpse sacrificed automatically when you kill the creature.
You must use caution when using AUTOSAC, as items still inside the corpse
are also sacrificed.  Even if you have 'CONFIG +outplot', there are times
when your hands are full or you have reached maximum weight and will be
unable to get everything from the corpse automatically.

name: Jesters West Cage
description:
The cage mobs are all named "cage" in addition to their actual name, thus
these creatures can be killed using 'kill cage' or 'kill kobold'.  All the
other cage mobs are similarly named.  The mobs in the battlegrounds will all
be referred to as "arena" in addition to their name.  Also, all equipment
available in the University is named "university".  You can 'wear university'
or 'remove university' in addition to the actual name of the item.

name: Hall Of The Shaman
description:
This chamber is filled with an aura of utter calmness and peace.  The
walls are painted a soft hue, adding to the affect.  Here is were the
Monks come to meditate and reflect upon their activities of the
day.  Small, spartan cots line the walls, each well-padded to make a
comfortable resting place for an exhausted adventurer.

name: Chamber Of Trials For Shamans
description:
Here you will experience your first full combat against MOBILES, also known
as MOBS. Mobile is the name used for monsters and the like in the game.
All exits, except down, lead to a CAGE mob. Some of these cage mobs may be
aggressive and will attack you upon entering their room. As you kill them,
you will gain experience, as well as university equipment and gold. Once you
have defeated a mob, type GET ALL CORPSE to loot the coins and equipment.
You may also type CONFIG +AUTOLOOT or CONFIG +AUTOGOLD. AUTOLOOT will take
everything from the corpse when you kill it. AUTOGOLD will take only the
gold from the corpse. When you loot a corpse of equipment, the items are
transferred to your inventory. You may suffer injury during the battle, so
return here and type REST or SLEEP. This will speed your healing process.
When you are finished healing, type WAKE or STAND to continue.

name: Shamans North Cage
description:
As you loot the corpses you will collect basic University equipment.  The
commands for using your new belongings are:  GET, DROP, WEAR, WIELD, HOLD,
REMOVE, REPAIR, and EXAMINE.  "Get <item>" or "get <item> corpse" takes an
object from the ground or from a corpse and places it into your inventory.
To wear an item from your inventory type "wear item", and to remove it and
return it to your inventory type "remove <item>".  To drop an item in your
inventory, type "drop <item>".  To wield a weapon, type "wield <weapon>".
Many items may be damaged and repaired.  To see an item's condition, type
"exam <item>".  To repair an item type "repair <item>" at a blacksmith.

name: Hall Of The Conjurer
description:
This small chamber is cluttered with small pieces of magical paraphenalia.
Many new conjurers stand about, practicing their art of pulling the energy
from these items and causing new items to manifest.  A big scorch mark is on
the west wall...obviously a failed experiment.  A huge golem stands in the
corner.

name: Chamber of the Watch
description:
Here reside the watchers of the gateway between the Realms and the
outside world, and from here all new adventurers are observed and
noted by the inhabitants herein.

** This room should *not* be used for any activities of any kind
other than those of the two mobs residing here.  Do not ever move
or purge either of these mobiles if the pre-auth system is used. **

name: The Temple Altar
description:
This is the altar room of the Temple of Drazuk.  Adventurer's usually come
here from the result of death or a recall spell.  Hopefully you walked here or
used the spell, because if you died, your corpse has not traveled with you!
There is a healer here, and a sign on the wall lets you know the prices for
that healing.

name: The Temple Of Drazuk
description:
You wander about the hallways of the Temple of Drazuk.  Many tapestries and
pictures hang on the walls, showing the life and times of Drazuk, the Ghoul
King.  You hope that perhaps your picture and tales may be seen and told
within these halls!

name: The Temple Of Drazuk -- Meeting Room
description:
You stand in the grand meeting room of the Temple of Drazuk.  Comfortable
chairs are placed around tables in groups, for the purpose of adventurers
meeting and planning out their next trip.  This is a good place to wait for
friends and meet others.  A staircase is in the corner, leading up towards the
demi-god's temples.

name: The Temple Of Drazuk
description:

King.  You hope that perhaps your picture and tales may be seen and told
within these halls!

name: The Temple Of Drazuk -- Judgement Room
description:
This dark hall has a huge desk on the south side, and many small chairs set
facing it.  The Gods come here to deal punishment to those mortals who cross
certain lines.  You hope you never have to come here to be sentenced!  You can
also use the large book here to sign your name into becoming a deadly killer
here.

name: The Temple Of Drazuk
description:
You wander about the hallways of the Temple of Drazuk.  Many tapestries and
pictures hang on the walls, showing the life and times of Drazuk, the Ghoul
King.  In addition to the usual decorations, a large portion of this wall is
taken up by a tall oil painting of a battle between a horrible creature and
several adventurers.  You hope that perhaps your picture and tales may be seen
and told within these halls!

name: The Temple Of Drazuk -- Donation Room
description:
This portion of the temple houses a large pit, used for storing items donated
by other adventurers.  It's worth a look to see if there is anything helpful
located within.

name: The Temple Of Drazuk -- Resting Room
description:
This room is set with every comfort that can be found in the realms.  The soft
floor is covered with huge pillows.  Servants bearing food and drink come and
go, bringing all sorts of delights.

name: Homer Street
description:
You travel about the busy city of Alden.  The central hub of the Realm,
all travelers come through here at some point to buy goods or sell their
wares.  Many people make their home here.  South of here is the Temple of
Drazuk.  West of you is the Outdoor Outfitters shop, and east there is the
Alden Real Estate office.
