name: Questmasters Inc.
description:
The Questmaster of Alden inhabits this shop.  You can ask him for a
quest by using the "AQUEST" command.  Good luck in your adventures!

name: The First (And Only) Bank Of Alden.
description:
This small bank holds only one teller, but Carlyle has a knack with cash.  He
can handle all your banking needs, helping with 'deposit's, 'withdraw'als, and
checking your 'balance'.  "Don't worry about accessing your money," he tells
you.  "Any bank in the Realm will be able to help you out."

name: Khent's Weapon Shack
description:
Many fine weapons hang from the walls of Khent's, known throughout the Realm.
The greatness of these implements are only exceeded by the stupidity of their
owner.

name: The Sneaky Shadow
description:
This shop caters to the needs of the more shady individuals in town.  Tools of
the thieves trade hang on hooks and rest on the counters set all about you.
If the item you want isn't here, you don't need it.

name: Garth's Armor Emporium
description:
Many suits of various types of armor are set about this small shop, placed on
stands or just plain lying in heaps.  From helms to shields, gauntlets to
boots, items that provide protection in combat are found in all corners of the
room.

name: The Sorcerer Store
description:
This store is much larger inside than it appears from the street.  Many items
of magical nature, including spell components and arcane artifacts, are set
about.  Bubbling potions and rune-covered scrolls are placed on shelves, and
staves and wands lean against a special section of wall.

name: Mistress Leah's Fashions
description:
This small boutique is filled with fine clothes for the discerning female
adventurer.  While the silks and satins provided here don't provide much
protection in battle, these garments are sure to be more acceptable at King
Drazuk's annual Royal Ball.

name: The Refined Warrior
description:
Fine clothes for the male adventurer line the walls of this small shop.  While
you won't find much in the way of armor to stop that next swing of the axe,
you will surely find some fine clothing to keep you looking good at that next
award ceremony you must attend.

name: Outdoor Outfitters
description:
Richard's chain of outdoor shops continues its trend of fine gear for the
ranger-types with its Alden branch.  Everything from weapons to armor to
special gear can be found here.

name: Alden Real Estate Brokers
description:
This small room houses the Alden Real Estate office.  Although the price
is quite high due to low space and great demand, you can purchase a deed from
the brokers here to have your own residence constructed.  Fargo smiles at you
and says, "Greetings friend.  Let me show you the lots we have available."

name: Warriors Guild
description:
You stand in the Guild Hall of Warriors.  This is where you come to
practice your skills of combat.  Battered trophies and exotic weapons hang
along the walls.  Training dummies stand, beaten and torn, about the room.

name: Rangers Guild
description:
You stand in the Guild Hall of Rangers.  This is where you come to
practice your skills of combat and nature.  Battered trophies and exotic
weapons hang along the walls.  Training dummies stand, beaten and torn, about
the room.  Various samples of the local fauna are set about for you to study.

name: Mages Guild
description:
You stand in the Guild Hall of Mages.  This is where you come to
practice your skills of magic.  Various magical trophies and ancient artifacts
and relics hang along the walls.  The smell of bubbling potions and magical
scroll-inks fills the air.

name: Clerics Guild
description:
You stand in the Guild Hall of Clerics.  This is where you come to
practice your skills of prayer.  Holy relics and books describing the various
deities sit in various places in the room.  The sound of chanting fills the
air.

name: Thieves Guild
description:
You stand in the Guild Hall of Thieves.  This is where you come to
practice your skills of stealth.  Stolen tapestries and implements of thievery
hang along the walls.  Practice locks are set among one wall and a special
area to practice sneaking is set against another.

name: Druids Guild
description:
You stand in the Guild Hall of Druids.  This is where you come to
practice your skills of nature.  Various samples of the local flora and fauna
are placed about the room for you to study.  The sound of various critters
echoes faintly about the room.

name: Above The Temple
description:
You find yourself in a small room.  Looking through the windows about you, it
appears that you are floating above the Temple of Drazuk!  You can't recall
seeing any flying buildings while you stood on the streets of
Alden...there must be some powerful magic about this place.  A small
door leads south from here.

name: A Brightly Lit Hallway
description:
This hallway is brightly lit with free-floating candles.  A feeling of warmth
and safety encompasses you.  Pictures of the Ghoul Royals hang on the
dark-wood walls.

name: A Brightly Lit Hallway
description:
This hallway is brightly lit with free-floating candles.  A feeling of warmth
and safety encompasses you.  Pictures of the Ghoul Royals hang on the
dark-wood walls.

name: The Ghoul Hideaway
description:
This room is lit by the soft glow of a few floating candles.  The plush
pillows that ghouls love so much take up most of the room.  Silken coverlets
lay about within arms reach, and a large fire burns in a fireplace on the east
wall, providing a very comfortable warmth.

name: The Kitchen
description:
A small stove sits in the corner of this room, and ample counterspace lines
the walls.  This must be where the visiting Royals can prepare a small meal if
they feel hungry.

name: The Nightgaunt's Tickler
description:
This tavern seems like a nice place to take a break, grab some food, maybe a
drink or two.  A large fire roars in the fireplace on the southern wall,
warming and lighting the room.  Various tables and chairs are placed about,
and a stand-up bar runs the length of the west wall.

name: The Portal Room
description:
This room houses a large magical portal, which Thalen uses to send you to your
specific hometown.  The rest of the room is quite bare.

name: Thugs Guild
description:
You stand in the Thugs Guild.  Dark and dingy, you'd be afraid to run into any
of the occupants, if you weren't already one of them.  In one corner, a class
in intimidation is taking place.  In another, recruits are picking on some
unfortunate soul.

name: Monks Guild
description:
You stand in the Monks Guild.  The colors are calm and pleasing to the eye.  A
feeling of tranquility sets over you as you rest in this guildhall.  Exotic
weapons hang from the western wall.  You watch a group of students practice
their combat styles with the Master.

name: Samuels Repairshop
description:
This small shop looks like the home to a repairsmith.  Lots of small bits of
metal used to patch up armor, and the tools and gear used to recharge magical
items, is set about the small store.

name: Samuels Repairshop
description:
This small shop looks like the home to a repairsmith.  Lots of small bits of
metal used to patch up armor, and the tools and gear used to repair ripped and
torn leathers, is set about the small store.

name: Lilyans Recharging
description:
This quaint little shop is almost just a booth on the side of the street.
Wands and staves sit around the small shop, some glowing, some humming, and
all appearing magical.

name: Hero's Hideout -- Lobby
description:
You stand in the newly remodeled lobby of the Hero's Hideout.  You aren't
getting in here unless you are level 50 or higher, so congratulations (;

Its not too shabby of a place.  The entranceway is a shiny hardwood floor, and
most of the walls and furniture are made of a dark shiny wood.  Several trophy
heads of creatures you recognize from your travels are up on the wall.  There
are some comfortable couches you can rest on, but of more interest are the
places you can go from here.  Back up is the Temple of Drazuk.  North is a
non-safe room, good for testing those skills on each other (;  East is a
special Hero shop.  West is a nice place to rest.

name: Hero's Hideout -- Arena
description:
This room is large and barren of any furniture.  The hardwood floor is rough
and scuffed, and has several large stains in various places.

name: Hero's Hideout -- The Stash
description:
Welcome to The Stash.  You will be able to buy special items here.  Yes, they
will be strong.  Yes, they will be powerful (:  Coming soon...

name: Hero's Hideout -- Resting Room
description: This room will double regen rate soon...but it doesn't right now (;

name: The Den
description:
The first thing that is noticeable as you enter Vash's house is that the floor
is sunk into the ground almost to your waist, the ground is layered in lavish
piles of silken pillows, and sweet smelling smoke drifts throughout the
entirety of the oriental room. The colored paper lanterns which hang in
clusters around each corner of the room cast it into parchment tinged yellows,
reds, and greens. A dark black wooden kneeling table inlaid with jade takes up
most of the center of the room. The table is laden with ornately carved pipes,
some of them even filled with water. In the corner the scabbard for the
legendary sword "Cuddly Death" rests on a pedestal, catching the muted
multihued light on each grain of it's dark honeyed wood. The large pillows
with scrolled characters are massive enough for a person to recline upon if
they were inclined to smoke one of the pipes.
A long corkscrew staircase leads up into the Library.
A stunted staircase leads from the den to the museum.

name: The Museum
description:
Vash's museum is an entirely different affair than the opium den.
While still done in the styles of far off lands, the walls of the museum are
dark and minimalist, so as not to detract from the beauty of the objects of
art which he has collected and stored here under great risk. More than that,
each piece of curios is contained in a box of the clearest glass the realm has
ever seen. There is not a bubble to be seen on any pane in this room. The
framed pictures are dark and emotional, and the statue in the corner with it's
arms upraised as if in a last desperate attempt to fend of an attacker, is
rumored to have been an individual who attempted to remove a piece of art from
this room.

The huge bastard sword which used to belong to Zanzen has been thrust into the
middle of the hardwood floor by Vash as a trophy.

name: The Library
description:
Behind a door at the top of the staircase is Vash's living space. This room
also has dark wooden walls, and the room can be divided in half with the slide
of a cream colored paper screen. The red wooden floor is smooth and polished,
throwing everything upon it back in blurred red relief. One side of the room
is dominated by huge bookshelves which reach to the vaults of the ceiling, the
alien lettering of the books draws the eye with a riot of colors and designs.
Scrolls are hung upon the wall with watercolor calligraphy. a window opposite
the door looks down upon the busy streets of Alden, another screened
window somehow looks down upon the flickering red landscape of another realm
which wavers and distorts constantly. The hundreds of leather wrapped books
make the room smell vaguely of paper, ink, and spices. A massive oak desk is
pushed against the wall near the infernal window.

name: Diabolists Guild
description:
You stand in the Diabolists Guild.  It is dark and damp in this dungeon-like
room.  The monotone chanting of studying demonologists can be heard echoing
about the chamber.  The sharp smell of burning sulfur is all about you, and a
smoky haze obscures the ceiling above.

name: The Grand Artificer
description:
This is a pretty bare room when compared to the other shops of Alden. A
long wooden counter separates the main lobby from a small workshop.  A large
chest of gold, used to pay for the various artifacts brought in, sits securely
in the very back of the store.

name: A Candlelit Lounge
description:
The first thing you take note of as you reach the top of the long, spiral
staircase leading up from the altar room below, is the massive, black room you
just walked into.  On the northern wall hangs a large portrait of the Lord and
Lady that reside in this sanctuary, the eastern and western walls holding two
large windows, draped in long black curtains.  Below it is a crackling fire,
assisting in lighting up the large area.  It is complimented with a few thick,
red candles set on the mantle, much similar to the ones on stands placed about
the room.  Two long, black couches, arranged so that they sit a short distance
on either side of the fireplace and separated by a small marble table, lead to
two chairs, made of dark brown leather and comfortable looking.  A beautiful,
pale skinned woman walks past the southern exit, a haunting yet soothing, soft
melody resonating from her as she greets you and offers you something to
drink.

name: A Dark Music Hall
description:
The haunting music grows louder as you enter this room.  You notice the only
item in it, besides the stairs leading to the room above, is a large,
web-covered pipe organ made of bones collected from various beings.  The tune
heard is somewhat relaxing, it being relentlessly played by keys on the
instrument that do not move at all, the organ itself enchanted by some magic.

Small red candles adorn this eerie contraption, resting on individual skulls
placed randomly about the pipes themselves. To the north, a faint light is
noticeable; the opposite can be said about the top of the stairs, a
pitch-black aura obscuring it.

name: A Dim Bedchamber
description:
The only light in this room emanates from racks of small red candles
surrounding a large, four-post bed.  The frame of the bed is made of wood, cut
from the nearby forest.  Long black drapes are tied neatly to the posts,
leaving the bed itself exposed.  Black silk sheets cover the bed and large
pillows, covered in matching cloth, rest at the head of it.   All are
embroidered with small white roses stitched along the edges.  Large drapes,
matching those in the other rooms, cover the windows of doors that appear to
lead out to a balcony.  On closer inspection of the windows you notice small
boards nailed into the edge of the walls, blocking out any light that would
pass in from the outside.  A faint tune can be heard coming from the stairs
leading down into the lower room.

name: Jesters Guild
description:
You stand in the Guild Hall of Jesters.  This is where you come to
hang out, have a few drinks and just learn to live life.  Battered trophies
and exotic weapons hang along the walls.  Let noone say Jesters don't know how
to get things done!

name: The Lucky Corpse
description:
This dark and dingy room has the smell of old, musty death about it.  Cobwebs
hang from the ceiling, and are especially think in the corners of the room.  A
solitary torch lights the room with its flickering flame.  An old wooden cart
sits against the far wall.  Strange, rust-colored stains cover the bottom of
the cart.

name: Shamans Guild
description:
You stand in the Guild Hall of Shaman.  Many magical fetishes, used for
calling and controlling the spirits hang from the walls and sit on shelves.  A
huge alchemical set sits on a table that stands along the west wall.  The
smell of burnt components fills the air.

name: Conjurers Guild
description:
You stand in the Guild Hall of Conjurers.  Many pieces of dismantled golems
are stacked along the wall, with studying conjurers looking at and inside
them, trying to decipher the hidden workings.  A huge shelf for storing
components stands against the east wall, but is only for the use of the
Guildmasters themselves...adventuring conjurers will need to find their
components elsewhere!

name: Alden Transportal
description:
This small room contains a small ticket booth, and a spiral staircase that
leads upward into the transport booth.  Alden Transportal guarantees
safety during the magical portal process, and as far as anyone knows, noone
has "disappeared" during a transportal.

name: Transportal  Chamber
description:
This small room sits at the top of the spiral stairs.  No decorations are
placed here, to ensure that there are no disruptions with the transportal
process.  One just needs to stand in the room, have a valid magic portal
ticket, and soon they will be sent to the proper location.

name: Lair Of The Fur(r)y Dragon
description:
A voice says "Naw, just kiddin"...

Welcome to the House of Fury. As soon as you enter this "humble" residence,
you are overwhelmed by the sound of the Eagles playing in the background. He
really did love his 70s rock. Very plain in design, but this place seems to
be filled with a Mystical power. After all, it WAS made by the Creator, Drazuk
himself. There are a few paintings on the wall, those might be fun to LOOK at
later.

You notice there are many papers cast about, detailing maps on how to kill
dragons, the effects of staffs, wands and other magical information. Stuff
that would make the Great Abatha say his "Achiever" within was showing.  In
the corner you see a finely finished wooden desk that seems to be crammed with
junk he has collected on his journeys into the unknown. He has plenty of
mismatched chairs, every kind from the pelted leather ones to the ones that
fold out with a place for your beer. His bed, a comfy looking hammock, seems
to be untouched and dusty.  He was known for his late nights, adventuring into
the Elders realm or diving into books by some other realm Author named
"Stephen King". Just as you bend over to grab one of these highly prized
novels, a voice from the behind you says, "Hey Pally, wanna Drink? Blood beers
are Furys recommended choice".

name: Lex's Lair
description:
The room is dark, Very dark. The only source of light comes from the black
candle that sits on the table. Along the south wall stands the resting place
of the Legendary mace, Osires the Dragon Tamer.

name: Lardar's Shack
description:
This is a cozy little cottage. There may be a treasure or two to be found in a
corner, but don't let me catch you looking fer it.

name: Drazuk's Office
description:
You stand in the stately office of Lord Drazuk.  Dark wooden walls surround a
thick red carpet.  Oil paintings of horrible beasts are placed on the walls,
and the room is lit by small candles, held by live gargoyles.  A large fire
roars in the fireplace on the south wall, and a massive wooden desk sits on
the western side of the room.

name: Placeholder
description: Placeholder

name: The Temple Altar
description:
This is the altar room of the Temple of Drazuk.  Adventurer's usually come
here from the result of death or a recall spell.  Hopefully you walked here or
used the spell, because if you died, your corpse has not traveled with you!
There is a healer here, and a sign on the wall lets you know the prices for
that healing.

name: The Temple Of Drazuk
description:
You wander about the hallways of the Temple of Drazuk.  Many tapestries and
pictures hang on the walls, showing the life and times of Drazuk, the Ghoul
King.  You hope that perhaps your picture and tales may be seen and told
within these halls!

name: The Temple Of Drazuk -- Meeting Room
description:
You stand in the grand meeting room of the Temple of Drazuk.  Comfortable
chairs are placed around tables in groups, for the purpose of adventurers
meeting and planning out their next trip.  This is a good place to wait for
friends and meet others.  A staircase is in the corner, leading up towards the
demi-god's temples.

name: The Temple Of Drazuk
description:
You wander about the hallways of the Temple of Drazuk.  Many tapestries and
pictures hang on the walls, showing the life and times of Drazuk, the Ghoul
King.  You hope that perhaps your picture and tales may be seen and told
within these halls!

name: The Temple Of Drazuk -- Judgement Room
description:
This dark hall has a huge desk on the south side, and many small chairs set
facing it.  The Gods come here to deal punishment to those mortals who cross
certain lines.  You hope you never have to come here to be sentenced!  You can
also use the large book here to sign your name into becoming a deadly killer
here.

name: The Temple Of Drazuk
description:
You wander about the hallways of the Temple of Drazuk.  Many tapestries and
pictures hang on the walls, showing the life and times of Drazuk, the Ghoul
King.  In addition to the usual decorations, a large portion of this wall is
taken up by a tall oil painting of a battle between a horrible creature and
several adventurers.  You hope that perhaps your picture and tales may be seen
and told within these halls!
extra_desc_keywords: oil painting picture fury blight nameless daemon decoration

name: The Temple Of Drazuk -- Donation Room
description:
This portion of the temple houses a large pit, used for storing items donated
by other adventurers.  It's worth a look to see if there is anything helpful
located within.

name: The Temple Of Drazuk
description:
You wander about the hallways of the Temple of Drazuk.  Many tapestries and
pictures hang on the walls, showing the life and times of Drazuk, the Ghoul
King.  You hope that perhaps your picture and tales may be seen and told
within these halls!

name: The Temple Of Drazuk -- Resting Room
description:
This room is set with every comfort that can be found in the realms.  The soft
floor is covered with huge pillows.  Servants bearing food and drink come and
go, bringing all sorts of delights.

name: Homer Street
description:
You travel about the busy city of Alden.  The central hub of the Realm,
all travelers come through here at some point to buy goods or sell their
wares.  Many people make their home here.  South of here is the Temple of
Drazuk.  West of you is the Outdoor Outfitters shop, and east there is the
Alden Real Estate office.

name: Questmasters Inc.
description:
The Questmaster of Alden inhabits this shop.  You can ask him for a
quest by using the "AQUEST" command.  Good luck in your adventures!

name: The First (And Only) Bank Of Alden.
description:
This small bank holds only one teller, but Carlyle has a knack with cash.  He
can handle all your banking needs, helping with 'deposit's, 'withdraw'als, and
checking your 'balance'.  "Don't worry about accessing your money," he tells
you.  "Any bank in the Realm will be able to help you out."

name: Khent's Weapon Shack
description:
Many fine weapons hang from the walls of Khent's, known throughout the Realm.
The greatness of these implements are only exceeded by the stupidity of their
owner.

name: The Sneaky Shadow
description:
This shop caters to the needs of the more shady individuals in town.  Tools of
the thieves trade hang on hooks and rest on the counters set all about you.
If the item you want isn't here, you don't need it.

name: Garth's Armor Emporium
description:
Many suits of various types of armor are set about this small shop, placed on
stands or just plain lying in heaps.  From helms to shields, gauntlets to
boots, items that provide protection in combat are found in all corners of the
room.

name: The Sorcerer Store
description:
This store is much larger inside than it appears from the street.  Many items
of magical nature, including spell components and arcane artifacts, are set
about.  Bubbling potions and rune-covered scrolls are placed on shelves, and
staves and wands lean against a special section of wall.

name: Mistress Leah's Fashions
description:
This small boutique is filled with fine clothes for the discerning female
adventurer.  While the silks and satins provided here don't provide much
protection in battle, these garments are sure to be more acceptable at King
Drazuk's annual Royal Ball.

name: The Refined Warrior
description:
Fine clothes for the male adventurer line the walls of this small shop.  While
you won't find much in the way of armor to stop that next swing of the axe,
you will surely find some fine clothing to keep you looking good at that next
award ceremony you must attend.

name: Outdoor Outfitters
description:
Richard's chain of outdoor shops continues its trend of fine gear for the
ranger-types with its Alden branch.  Everything from weapons to armor to
special gear can be found here.

name: Alden Real Estate Brokers
description:
This small room houses the Alden Real Estate office.  Although the price
is quite high due to low space and great demand, you can purchase a deed from
the brokers here to have your own residence constructed.  Fargo smiles at you
and says, "Greetings friend.  Let me show you the lots we have available."

name: Warriors Guild
description:
You stand in the Guild Hall of Warriors.  This is where you come to
practice your skills of combat.  Battered trophies and exotic weapons hang
along the walls.  Training dummies stand, beaten and torn, about the room.

name: Rangers Guild
description:
You stand in the Guild Hall of Rangers.  This is where you come to
practice your skills of combat and nature.  Battered trophies and exotic
weapons hang along the walls.  Training dummies stand, beaten and torn, about
the room.  Various samples of the local fauna are set about for you to study.

name: Mages Guild
description:
You stand in the Guild Hall of Mages.  This is where you come to
practice your skills of magic.  Various magical trophies and ancient artifacts
and relics hang along the walls.  The smell of bubbling potions and magical
scroll-inks fills the air.

name: Clerics Guild
description:
You stand in the Guild Hall of Clerics.  This is where you come to
practice your skills of prayer.  Holy relics and books describing the various
deities sit in various places in the room.  The sound of chanting fills the
air.

name: Thieves Guild
description:
You stand in the Guild Hall of Thieves.  This is where you come to
practice your skills of stealth.  Stolen tapestries and implements of thievery
hang along the walls.  Practice locks are set among one wall and a special
area to practice sneaking is set against another.

name: Druids Guild
description:
You stand in the Guild Hall of Druids.  This is where you come to
practice your skills of nature.  Various samples of the local flora and fauna
are placed about the room for you to study.  The sound of various critters
echoes faintly about the room.

name: Above The Temple
description:
You find yourself in a small room.  Looking through the windows about you, it
appears that you are floating above the Temple of Drazuk!  You can't recall
seeing any flying buildings while you stood on the streets of
Alden...there must be some powerful magic about this place.  A small
door leads south from here.

name: A Brightly Lit Hallway
description:
This hallway is brightly lit with free-floating candles.  A feeling of warmth
and safety encompasses you.  Pictures of the Ghoul Royals hang on the
dark-wood walls.

name: A Brightly Lit Hallway
description:
This hallway is brightly lit with free-floating candles.  A feeling of warmth
and safety encompasses you.  Pictures of the Ghoul Royals hang on the
dark-wood walls.

name: The Ghoul Hideaway
description:
This room is lit by the soft glow of a few floating candles.  The plush
pillows that ghouls love so much take up most of the room.  Silken coverlets
lay about within arms reach, and a large fire burns in a fireplace on the east
wall, providing a very comfortable warmth.

name: The Kitchen
description:
A small stove sits in the corner of this room, and ample counterspace lines
the walls.  This must be where the visiting Royals can prepare a small meal if
they feel hungry.

name: The Nightgaunt's Tickler
description:
This tavern seems like a nice place to take a break, grab some food, maybe a
drink or two.  A large fire roars in the fireplace on the southern wall,
warming and lighting the room.  Various tables and chairs are placed about,
and a stand-up bar runs the length of the west wall.

name: The Portal Room
description:
This room houses a large magical portal, which Thalen uses to send you to your
specific hometown.  The rest of the room is quite bare.

name: Thugs Guild
description:
You stand in the Thugs Guild.  Dark and dingy, you'd be afraid to run into any
of the occupants, if you weren't already one of them.  In one corner, a class
in intimidation is taking place.  In another, recruits are picking on some
unfortunate soul.

name: Monks Guild
description:
You stand in the Monks Guild.  The colors are calm and pleasing to the eye.  A
feeling of tranquility sets over you as you rest in this guildhall.  Exotic
weapons hang from the western wall.  You watch a group of students practice
their combat styles with the Master.

name: Samuels Repairshop
description:
This small shop looks like the home to a repairsmith.  Lots of small bits of
metal used to patch up armor, and the tools and gear used to recharge magical
items, is set about the small store.

name: Samuels Repairshop
description:
This small shop looks like the home to a repairsmith.  Lots of small bits of
metal used to patch up armor, and the tools and gear used to repair ripped and
torn leathers, is set about the small store.

name: Lilyans Recharging
description:
This quaint little shop is almost just a booth on the side of the street.
Wands and staves sit around the small shop, some glowing, some humming, and
all appearing magical.

name: Hero's Hideout -- Lobby
description:
You stand in the newly remodeled lobby of the Hero's Hideout.  You aren't
getting in here unless you are level 50 or higher, so congratulations (;

Its not too shabby of a place.  The entranceway is a shiny hardwood floor, and
most of the walls and furniture are made of a dark shiny wood.  Several trophy
heads of creatures you recognize from your travels are up on the wall.  There
are some comfortable couches you can rest on, but of more interest are the
places you can go from here.  Back up is the Temple of Drazuk.  North is a
non-safe room, good for testing those skills on each other (;  East is a
special Hero shop.  West is a nice place to rest.

name: Hero's Hideout -- Arena
description:
This room is large and barren of any furniture.  The hardwood floor is rough
and scuffed, and has several large stains in various places.

name: Hero's Hideout -- The Stash
description:
Welcome to The Stash.  You will be able to buy special items here.  Yes, they
will be strong.  Yes, they will be powerful (:  Coming soon...

name: Hero's Hideout -- Resting Room
description: This room will double regen rate soon...but it doesn't right now (;

name: The Den
description:
The first thing that is noticeable as you enter Vash's house is that the floor
is sunk into the ground almost to your waist, the ground is layered in lavish
piles of silken pillows, and sweet smelling smoke drifts throughout the
entirety of the oriental room. The colored paper lanterns which hang in
clusters around each corner of the room cast it into parchment tinged yellows,
reds, and greens. A dark black wooden kneeling table inlaid with jade takes up
most of the center of the room. The table is laden with ornately carved pipes,
some of them even filled with water. In the corner the scabbard for the
legendary sword "Cuddly Death" rests on a pedestal, catching the muted
multihued light on each grain of it's dark honeyed wood. The large pillows
with scrolled characters are massive enough for a person to recline upon if
they were inclined to smoke one of the pipes.
A long corkscrew staircase leads up into the Library.
A stunted staircase leads from the den to the museum.

name: The Museum
description:
Vash's museum is an entirely different affair than the opium den.
While still done in the styles of far off lands, the walls of the museum are
dark and minimalist, so as not to detract from the beauty of the objects of
art which he has collected and stored here under great risk. More than that,
each piece of curios is contained in a box of the clearest glass the realm has
ever seen. There is not a bubble to be seen on any pane in this room. The
framed pictures are dark and emotional, and the statue in the corner with it's
arms upraised as if in a last desperate attempt to fend of an attacker, is
rumored to have been an individual who attempted to remove a piece of art from
this room.

The huge bastard sword which used to belong to Zanzen has been thrust into the
middle of the hardwood floor by Vash as a trophy.

name: The Library
description:
Behind a door at the top of the staircase is Vash's living space. This room
also has dark wooden walls, and the room can be divided in half with the slide
of a cream colored paper screen. The red wooden floor is smooth and polished,
throwing everything upon it back in blurred red relief. One side of the room
is dominated by huge bookshelves which reach to the vaults of the ceiling, the
alien lettering of the books draws the eye with a riot of colors and designs.
Scrolls are hung upon the wall with watercolor calligraphy. a window opposite
the door looks down upon the busy streets of Alden, another screened
window somehow looks down upon the flickering red landscape of another realm
which wavers and distorts constantly. The hundreds of leather wrapped books
make the room smell vaguely of paper, ink, and spices. A massive oak desk is
pushed against the wall near the infernal window.

name: Diabolists Guild
description:
You stand in the Diabolists Guild.  It is dark and damp in this dungeon-like
room.  The monotone chanting of studying demonologists can be heard echoing
about the chamber.  The sharp smell of burning sulfur is all about you, and a
smoky haze obscures the ceiling above.

name: The Grand Artificer
description:
This is a pretty bare room when compared to the other shops of Alden. A
long wooden counter separates the main lobby from a small workshop.  A large
chest of gold, used to pay for the various artifacts brought in, sits securely
in the very back of the store.

name: A Candlelit Lounge
description:
The first thing you take note of as you reach the top of the long, spiral
staircase leading up from the altar room below, is the massive, black room you
just walked into.  On the northern wall hangs a large portrait of the Lord and
Lady that reside in this sanctuary, the eastern and western walls holding two
large windows, draped in long black curtains.  Below it is a crackling fire,
assisting in lighting up the large area.  It is complimented with a few thick,
red candles set on the mantle, much similar to the ones on stands placed about
the room.  Two long, black couches, arranged so that they sit a short distance
on either side of the fireplace and separated by a small marble table, lead to
two chairs, made of dark brown leather and comfortable looking.  A beautiful,
pale skinned woman walks past the southern exit, a haunting yet soothing, soft
melody resonating from her as she greets you and offers you something to
drink.

name: A Dark Music Hall
description:
The haunting music grows louder as you enter this room.  You notice the only
item in it, besides the stairs leading to the room above, is a large,
web-covered pipe organ made of bones collected from various beings.  The tune
heard is somewhat relaxing, it being relentlessly played by keys on the
instrument that do not move at all, the organ itself enchanted by some magic.

Small red candles adorn this eerie contraption, resting on individual skulls
placed randomly about the pipes themselves. To the north, a faint light is
noticeable; the opposite can be said about the top of the stairs, a
pitch-black aura obscuring it.

name: A Dim Bedchamber
description:
The only light in this room emanates from racks of small red candles
surrounding a large, four-post bed.  The frame of the bed is made of wood, cut
from the nearby forest.  Long black drapes are tied neatly to the posts,
leaving the bed itself exposed.  Black silk sheets cover the bed and large
pillows, covered in matching cloth, rest at the head of it.   All are
embroidered with small white roses stitched along the edges.  Large drapes,
matching those in the other rooms, cover the windows of doors that appear to
lead out to a balcony.  On closer inspection of the windows you notice small
boards nailed into the edge of the walls, blocking out any light that would
pass in from the outside.  A faint tune can be heard coming from the stairs
leading down into the lower room.

name: Jesters Guild
description:
You stand in the Guild Hall of Jesters.  This is where you come to
hang out, have a few drinks and just learn to live life.  Battered trophies
and exotic weapons hang along the walls.  Let noone say Jesters don't know how
to get things done!

name: The Lucky Corpse
description:
This dark and dingy room has the smell of old, musty death about it.  Cobwebs
hang from the ceiling, and are especially think in the corners of the room.  A
solitary torch lights the room with its flickering flame.  An old wooden cart
sits against the far wall.  Strange, rust-colored stains cover the bottom of
the cart.

name: Shamans Guild
description:
You stand in the Guild Hall of Shaman.  Many magical fetishes, used for
calling and controlling the spirits hang from the walls and sit on shelves.  A
huge alchemical set sits on a table that stands along the west wall.  The
smell of burnt components fills the air.

name: Conjurers Guild
description:
You stand in the Guild Hall of Conjurers.  Many pieces of dismantled golems
are stacked along the wall, with studying conjurers looking at and inside
them, trying to decipher the hidden workings.  A huge shelf for storing
components stands against the east wall, but is only for the use of the
Guildmasters themselves...adventuring conjurers will need to find their
components elsewhere!

name: Alden Transportal
description:
This small room contains a small ticket booth, and a spiral staircase that
leads upward into the transport booth.  Alden Transportal guarantees
safety during the magical portal process, and as far as anyone knows, noone
has "disappeared" during a transportal.

name: Transportal  Chamber
description:
This small room sits at the top of the spiral stairs.  No decorations are
placed here, to ensure that there are no disruptions with the transportal
process.  One just needs to stand in the room, have a valid magic portal
ticket, and soon they will be sent to the proper location.

name: Lair Of The Fur(r)y Dragon
description:
A voice says "Naw, just kiddin"...

Welcome to the House of Fury. As soon as you enter this "humble" residence,
you are overwhelmed by the sound of the Eagles playing in the background. He
really did love his 70s rock. Very plain in design, but this place seems to
be filled with a Mystical power. After all, it WAS made by the Creator, Drazuk
himself. There are a few paintings on the wall, those might be fun to LOOK at
later.

You notice there are many papers cast about, detailing maps on how to kill
dragons, the effects of staffs, wands and other magical information. Stuff
that would make the Great Abatha say his "Achiever" within was showing.  In
the corner you see a finely finished wooden desk that seems to be crammed with
junk he has collected on his journeys into the unknown. He has plenty of
mismatched chairs, every kind from the pelted leather ones to the ones that
fold out with a place for your beer. His bed, a comfy looking hammock, seems
to be untouched and dusty.  He was known for his late nights, adventuring into
the Elders realm or diving into books by some other realm Author named
"Stephen King". Just as you bend over to grab one of these highly prized
novels, a voice from the behind you says, "Hey Pally, wanna Drink? Blood beers
are Furys recommended choice".

name: Lex's Lair
description:
The room is dark, Very dark. The only source of light comes from the black
candle that sits on the table. Along the south wall stands the resting place
of the Legendary mace, Osires the Dragon Tamer.

name: Lardar's Shack
description:
This is a cozy little cottage. There may be a treasure or two to be found in a
corner, but don't let me catch you looking fer it.

name: Drazuk's Office
description:
You stand in the stately office of Lord Drazuk.  Dark wooden walls surround a
thick red carpet.  Oil paintings of horrible beasts are placed on the walls,
and the room is lit by small candles, held by live gargoyles.  A large fire
roars in the fireplace on the south wall, and a massive wooden desk sits on
the western side of the room.

all travelers come through here at some point to buy goods or sell their
wares.  Many people make their home here.

name: Questmasters Inc.
description:
The Questmaster of Alden inhabits this shop.  You can ask him for a
quest by using the "AQUEST" command.  Good luck in your adventures!

name: The First (And Only) Bank Of Alden.
description:
This small bank holds only one teller, but Carlyle has a knack with cash.  He
can handle all your banking needs, helping with 'deposit's, 'withdraw'als, and
checking your 'balance'.  "Don't worry about accessing your money," he tells
you.  "Any bank in the Realm will be able to help you out."

name: Khent's Weapon Shack
description:
Many fine weapons hang from the walls of Khent's, known throughout the Realm.
The greatness of these implements are only exceeded by the stupidity of their
owner.

name: The Sneaky Shadow
description:
This shop caters to the needs of the more shady individuals in town.  Tools of
the thieves trade hang on hooks and rest on the counters set all about you.
If the item you want isn't here, you don't need it.

name: Garth's Armor Emporium
description:
Many suits of various types of armor are set about this small shop, placed on
stands or just plain lying in heaps.  From helms to shields, gauntlets to
boots, items that provide protection in combat are found in all corners of the
room.

name: The Sorcerer Store
description:
This store is much larger inside than it appears from the street.  Many items
of magical nature, including spell components and arcane artifacts, are set
about.  Bubbling potions and rune-covered scrolls are placed on shelves, and
staves and wands lean against a special section of wall.

name: Mistress Leah's Fashions
description:
This small boutique is filled with fine clothes for the discerning female
adventurer.  While the silks and satins provided here don't provide much
protection in battle, these garments are sure to be more acceptable at King
Drazuk's annual Royal Ball.

name: The Refined Warrior
description:
Fine clothes for the male adventurer line the walls of this small shop.  While
you won't find much in the way of armor to stop that next swing of the axe,
you will surely find some fine clothing to keep you looking good at that next
award ceremony you must attend.

name: Outdoor Outfitters
description:
Richard's chain of outdoor shops continues its trend of fine gear for the
ranger-types with its Alden branch.  Everything from weapons to armor to
special gear can be found here.

name: Alden Real Estate Brokers
description:
This small room houses the Alden Real Estate office.  Although the price
is quite high due to low space and great demand, you can purchase a deed from
the brokers here to have your own residence constructed.  Fargo smiles at you
and says, "Greetings friend.  Let me show you the lots we have available."

name: Warriors Guild
description:
You stand in the Guild Hall of Warriors.  This is where you come to
practice your skills of combat.  Battered trophies and exotic weapons hang
along the walls.  Training dummies stand, beaten and torn, about the room.

name: Rangers Guild
description:
You stand in the Guild Hall of Rangers.  This is where you come to
practice your skills of combat and nature.  Battered trophies and exotic
weapons hang along the walls.  Training dummies stand, beaten and torn, about
the room.  Various samples of the local fauna are set about for you to study.

name: Mages Guild
description:
You stand in the Guild Hall of Mages.  This is where you come to
practice your skills of magic.  Various magical trophies and ancient artifacts
and relics hang along the walls.  The smell of bubbling potions and magical
scroll-inks fills the air.

name: Clerics Guild
description:
You stand in the Guild Hall of Clerics.  This is where you come to
practice your skills of prayer.  Holy relics and books describing the various
deities sit in various places in the room.  The sound of chanting fills the
air.

name: Thieves Guild
description:
You stand in the Guild Hall of Thieves.  This is where you come to
practice your skills of stealth.  Stolen tapestries and implements of thievery
hang along the walls.  Practice locks are set among one wall and a special
area to practice sneaking is set against another.

name: Druids Guild
description:
You stand in the Guild Hall of Druids.  This is where you come to
practice your skills of nature.  Various samples of the local flora and fauna
are placed about the room for you to study.  The sound of various critters
echoes faintly about the room.

name: Above The Temple
description:
You find yourself in a small room.  Looking through the windows about you, it
appears that you are floating above the Temple of Drazuk!  You can't recall
seeing any flying buildings while you stood on the streets of
Alden...there must be some powerful magic about this place.  A small
door leads south from here.

name: A Brightly Lit Hallway
description:
This hallway is brightly lit with free-floating candles.  A feeling of warmth
and safety encompasses you.  Pictures of the Ghoul Royals hang on the
dark-wood walls.

name: A Brightly Lit Hallway
description:
This hallway is brightly lit with free-floating candles.  A feeling of warmth
and safety encompasses you.  Pictures of the Ghoul Royals hang on the
dark-wood walls.

name: The Ghoul Hideaway
description:
This room is lit by the soft glow of a few floating candles.  The plush
pillows that ghouls love so much take up most of the room.  Silken coverlets
lay about within arms reach, and a large fire burns in a fireplace on the east
wall, providing a very comfortable warmth.

name: The Kitchen
description:
A small stove sits in the corner of this room, and ample counterspace lines
the walls.  This must be where the visiting Royals can prepare a small meal if
they feel hungry.

name: The Nightgaunt's Tickler
description:
This tavern seems like a nice place to take a break, grab some food, maybe a
drink or two.  A large fire roars in the fireplace on the southern wall,
warming and lighting the room.  Various tables and chairs are placed about,
and a stand-up bar runs the length of the west wall.

name: The Portal Room
description:
This room houses a large magical portal, which Thalen uses to send you to your
specific hometown.  The rest of the room is quite bare.

name: Thugs Guild
description:
You stand in the Thugs Guild.  Dark and dingy, you'd be afraid to run into any
of the occupants, if you weren't already one of them.  In one corner, a class
in intimidation is taking place.  In another, recruits are picking on some
unfortunate soul.

name: Monks Guild
description:
You stand in the Monks Guild.  The colors are calm and pleasing to the eye.  A
feeling of tranquility sets over you as you rest in this guildhall.  Exotic
weapons hang from the western wall.  You watch a group of students practice
their combat styles with the Master.

name: Samuels Repairshop
description:
This small shop looks like the home to a repairsmith.  Lots of small bits of
metal used to patch up armor, and the tools and gear used to recharge magical
items, is set about the small store.

name: Samuels Repairshop
description:
This small shop looks like the home to a repairsmith.  Lots of small bits of
metal used to patch up armor, and the tools and gear used to repair ripped and
torn leathers, is set about the small store.

name: Lilyans Recharging
description:
This quaint little shop is almost just a booth on the side of the street.
Wands and staves sit around the small shop, some glowing, some humming, and
all appearing magical.

name: Hero's Hideout -- Lobby
description:
You stand in the newly remodeled lobby of the Hero's Hideout.  You aren't
getting in here unless you are level 50 or higher, so congratulations (;

Its not too shabby of a place.  The entranceway is a shiny hardwood floor, and
most of the walls and furniture are made of a dark shiny wood.  Several trophy
heads of creatures you recognize from your travels are up on the wall.  There
are some comfortable couches you can rest on, but of more interest are the
places you can go from here.  Back up is the Temple of Drazuk.  North is a
non-safe room, good for testing those skills on each other (;  East is a
special Hero shop.  West is a nice place to rest.

name: Hero's Hideout -- Arena
description:
This room is large and barren of any furniture.  The hardwood floor is rough
and scuffed, and has several large stains in various places.

name: Hero's Hideout -- The Stash
description:
Welcome to The Stash.  You will be able to buy special items here.  Yes, they
will be strong.  Yes, they will be powerful (:  Coming soon...

name: Hero's Hideout -- Resting Room
description: This room will double regen rate soon...but it doesn't right now (;

name: Diabolists Guild
description:
You stand in the Diabolists Guild.  It is dark and damp in this dungeon-like
room.  The monotone chanting of studying demonologists can be heard echoing
about the chamber.  The sharp smell of burning sulfur is all about you, and a
smoky haze obscures the ceiling above.

name: The Grand Artificer
description:
This is a pretty bare room when compared to the other shops of Alden. A
long wooden counter separates the main lobby from a small workshop.  A large
chest of gold, used to pay for the various artifacts brought in, sits securely
in the very back of the store.

name: A Candlelit Lounge
description:
The first thing you take note of as you reach the top of the long, spiral
staircase leading up from the altar room below, is the massive, black room you
just walked into.  On the northern wall hangs a large portrait of the Lord and
Lady that reside in this sanctuary, the eastern and western walls holding two
large windows, draped in long black curtains.  Below it is a crackling fire,
assisting in lighting up the large area.  It is complimented with a few thick,
red candles set on the mantle, much similar to the ones on stands placed about
the room.  Two long, black couches, arranged so that they sit a short distance
on either side of the fireplace and separated by a small marble table, lead to
two chairs, made of dark brown leather and comfortable looking.  A beautiful,
pale skinned woman walks past the southern exit, a haunting yet soothing, soft
melody resonating from her as she greets you and offers you something to
drink.

name: A Dark Music Hall
description:
The haunting music grows louder as you enter this room.  You notice the only
item in it, besides the stairs leading to the room above, is a large,
web-covered pipe organ made of bones collected from various beings.  The tune
heard is somewhat relaxing, it being relentlessly played by keys on the
instrument that do not move at all, the organ itself enchanted by some magic.

Small red candles adorn this eerie contraption, resting on individual skulls
placed randomly about the pipes themselves. To the north, a faint light is
noticeable; the opposite can be said about the top of the stairs, a
pitch-black aura obscuring it.

name: A Dim Bedchamber
description:
The only light in this room emanates from racks of small red candles
surrounding a large, four-post bed.  The frame of the bed is made of wood, cut
from the nearby forest.  Long black drapes are tied neatly to the posts,
leaving the bed itself exposed.  Black silk sheets cover the bed and large
pillows, covered in matching cloth, rest at the head of it.   All are
embroidered with small white roses stitched along the edges.  Large drapes,
matching those in the other rooms, cover the windows of doors that appear to
lead out to a balcony.  On closer inspection of the windows you notice small
boards nailed into the edge of the walls, blocking out any light that would
pass in from the outside.  A faint tune can be heard coming from the stairs
leading down into the lower room.

name: Jesters Guild
description:
You stand in the Guild Hall of Jesters.  This is where you come to
hang out, have a few drinks and just learn to live life.  Battered trophies
and exotic weapons hang along the walls.  Let noone say Jesters don't know how
to get things done!

name: The Lucky Corpse
description:
This dark and dingy room has the smell of old, musty death about it.  Cobwebs
hang from the ceiling, and are especially thick in the corners of the room.  A
solitary torch lights the room with its flickering flame.  An old wooden cart
sits against the far wall.  Strange, rust-colored stains cover the bottom of
the cart.

name: Shamans Guild
description:
You stand in the Guild Hall of Shaman.  Many magical fetishes, used for
calling and controlling the spirits hang from the walls and sit on shelves.  A
huge alchemical set sits on a table that stands along the west wall.  The
smell of burnt components fills the air.

name: Conjurers Guild
description:
You stand in the Guild Hall of Conjurers.  Many pieces of dismantled golems
are stacked along the wall, with studying conjurers looking at and inside
them, trying to decipher the hidden workings.  A huge shelf for storing
components stands against the east wall, but is only for the use of the
Guildmasters themselves...adventuring conjurers will need to find their
components elsewhere!

name: Alden Transportal
description:
This small room contains a small ticket booth, and a spiral staircase that
leads upward into the transport booth.  Alden Transportal guarantees
safety during the magical portal process, and as far as anyone knows, noone
has "disappeared" during a transportal.

name: Transportal  Chamber
description:
This small room sits at the top of the spiral stairs.  No decorations are
placed here, to ensure that there are no disruptions with the transportal
process.  One just needs to stand in the room, have a valid magic portal
ticket, and soon they will be sent to the proper location.

name: Lair Of The Fur(r)y Dragon
description:
A voice says "Naw, just kiddin"...

Welcome to the House of Fury. As soon as you enter this "humble" residence,
you are overwhelmed by the sound of the Eagles playing in the background. He
really did love his 70s rock. Very plain in design, but this place seems to
be filled with a Mystical power. After all, it WAS made by the Creator, Drazuk
himself. There are a few paintings on the wall, those might be fun to LOOK at
later.

You notice there are many papers cast about, detailing maps on how to kill
dragons, the effects of staffs, wands and other magical information. Stuff
that would make the Great Abatha say his "Achiever" within was showing.  In
the corner you see a finely finished wooden desk that seems to be crammed with
junk he has collected on his journeys into the unknown. He has plenty of
mismatched chairs, every kind from the pelted leather ones to the ones that
fold out with a place for your beer. His bed, a comfy looking hammock, seems
to be untouched and dusty.  He was known for his late nights, adventuring into
the Elders realm or diving into books by some other realm Author named
"Stephen King". Just as you bend over to grab one of these highly prized
novels, a voice from the behind you says, "Hey Pally, wanna Drink? Blood beers
are Furys recommended choice".

name: A Dark Living Room
description:
Very minimal light exists within this room, the obsidian walls lined with
torches, but not allowing the lambency to stretch very far.  The floor is
the color of blood red, a HUGE, overstuffed, black leather sofa centered
upon it, housing a myriad of cushy pillows.  Directly across from this, a
giant magical viewscreen hangs on the far wall, numerous black and silver
boxes connected to the screen by what one could only assume to be some sort
of exotic black ropes.  The remainder of the room is sparsely decorated,
save for the occasional painting or framed picture.  A spiral staircase winds
upward to the second floor.

name: The Study
description:
This is where Vra researches new Diabolist spells and checks his e-mail.
A magical white box sits humming on a desk right beside a small viewscreen.
The walls are lined with shelves full of books of all shapes and sizes, many
bearing runes you've never seen before.  The spiral staircase continues upward
to a third floor.

name: The Bedroom
description:
Vra rarely ever sleeps here, so he uses this room mostly for storage.
Several large chests sit around the room, filled with souveniers and
trinkets from his journeys around the world.

name: Heirlooms of a Warrior
description:
The walls of this spacious room are completely covered in various weaponry
and armor, torches seemingly added afterwards, wherever there was a place
to fit.  These artifacts are not those of a simple warrior's...dulled, beaten
and thrown about as if there were no time to care for them.  They seem more
like antiques, worthy of much more attention and care, and obviously given it,
for there is not one piece in this room that doesn't shine with brilliance.
Directly across from the entrance is a wooden door leading elsewhere.

name: Spoils of War
description:
This immense room is decorated with a vast amount of "trophies" from hideous
creatures throughout the realm.  Synot, Azathoth and the Nightmare Magnet are
but a few of the slays the owner of this home has apparently made.  Only a
Champion could have this many prizes to brag about.  The floor is a smooth
sable color of wood, more weaponry stashed in neat holders in every corner
of the room, making it a very fit place for sparring.  Another wooden door
leads west into yet a different room.

name: The Resting Chamber
description:
The floor to this room is made of etched stone slab, magnificent carpets
laid down over it to keep the chill off of one's feet while walking.  A huge
bed takes up a big part of these chambers, velvet canopied drapes hanging from
the tops of all four corner posts.  Red and ebony seem to be the favored
colors of the one who sleeps here.  At least that is what the bedding and
other decorations portray.  A fireplace is set into one wall across from the
bed, its flames casting a soft glow and allowing the shadows to play amongst
the light.  Lush pillows lay on the floor in front of the hearth, inviting
those who visit to bask in their comfort.  Against the opposite wall is a
large tapestry depicting a victory scene of a young ghoul who has defeated
one of the mighty masked hunters.

name: The Locker Room
description:
This room is bare and dull, the only thing occupying it being rows
and rows of lockers against the walls.

name: A Small Trailer
description:
This trailer is small and cluttered.  It would remind one of what an actor
or actress would use while they were on location shooting a movie.  Its
inhabitant is obviously male and not a very tidy person, as men's clothing
is scattered everywhere throughout the tiny living quarters.  It's a wonder
he could even live in this small abode, as there is very little furniture to
speak of and it would seem like he was trapped.  His only saving grace
is perhaps the tiny magical view screen placed upon the counter.

name: A Pathway Through Towering Trees
description:
A small path cuts South from the lake, weaving it's way around
the towering trees that hide the sun and many other things from
view.  Different types of foilage cover the ground as well as a
thin veil of fog.  There is nothing to be heard but complete silence.

name: A Pathway Through Towering Trees
description:
A small path cuts South from the lake, weaving it's way around
the towering trees that hide the sun and many other things from
view.  Different types of foilage cover the ground as well as a
thin veil of fog.  There is nothing to be heard but complete silence.

name: A Shrouded Doorway
description:
The path here ends to the South, as a large home now stands there.
The doorway to this house is covered with some sort of black mist
that moves and swirls over the closed wooden surface.  Tendrils of
fog creep over the ground as if they are looking for something...or
someone to suffocate.  Any visitors would dare not step beyond here
unless, perhaps, they made a deal with the Devil.

name: An Entrance Way
description:
Entering this house may overcome some with a desire to flee.
A demon's house is not normally welcome to visitors or intruders.
The architect designed this residence with no south facing
windows which holds the darkness inside. A couple of discarded
staves and wands fill a bucket to the right of the doorway.
Fine rugs, made from an unknown beast, line the hardwood floor.
An open closet next to the door holds various cloaks and other
assorted garments. Black candles line the room in elaborate
candelabras, adding a warm but eerie glow.

name: A Living Room
description:
What a spacious room!  The ceiling here is lined with
black marble tiles, painted to look like the night sky.
Bookshelves line all four walls, overflowing with scrolls
and parchments of every color.  From the center of the
ceiling hangs a sparkling chandelier of pure crystal.
Atop the endless array of bookcases, carefully placed
upon the dark walls, are paintings of magnificent quality.
A mahogany table is centered in the room, is obviously
a work space for creating many magical items. Beneath the
beautiful work table is a hand-made rug spun of human hair.

name: A Luxurious Chamber
description:
A bedroom of a truly rich demon is a sight to see. The largest bed
known  to  man  or  beast rests against the wall.  The heavy oaken
frame is covered by a blood red silk canopy. Plush rugs of bear fur
cover the hard floor and the smell of exotic oils and colognes give
a sensual air to the room. No visible windows mark the demonic 
shadowed walls. Various trophies, collected from around the realm are
displayed in elaborate cases on the south wall. Golden magical
lights, crafted from magic, float near the ceiling. A door leads to
a bathroom made completely of marble, mined by the goblins of Unki.
Music slithers softly through the air to please the ears and relax
the visitors.

name: Raistlin's Resting Place
description:
Spell books are splayed out across a table with a bright light floating above
them. Small vials of various colors and shapes are scattered around this
residence. Larger concoctions are slowly boiling upon several small burners.
There is a large painting on the back wall of a Mage in battle with a demon. A
small fire burns in the stone fireplace which heats the room. Robes are hung
nearby while they dry.

name: Kynn's Haven House
description:
This cozy home is filled with the delicious scent of incense. A feeling of
home comforts the most weary of travelers A warm fire dances cheerily in the
hearth. A large leather couch is against the south wall.

name: The Pet Shop
description:
The air is a bit musty, smelling of animal dung and urine. Petro, the
caretaker, is busy in the back cleaning up another one of his animals'
messes. There are various pet supplies placed upon shelves and stacked
up in crates around the small shop.

name: The Pet Room
description:
Various animals are gathered here awaiting for a kind adventurer to take
them home.

name: Drazuk's Office
description:
You stand in the stately office of Lord Drazuk.  Dark wooden walls surround a
thick red carpet.  Oil paintings of horrible beasts are placed on the walls,
and the room is lit by small candles, held by live gargoyles.  A large fire
roars in the fireplace on the south wall, and a massive wooden desk sits on
the western side of the room.

name: Placeholder
description: Placeholder

name: A Ruined Temple
description:
Crumbled columns of an old ruined temple lay in a pile.  Ocean grasses grow
all around them obscuring most of the rubble from view.  Poking around, you
notice that there is a cave entrance underneath the stone.

name: An Old Tunnel
description:
This tunnel has definitely been created by some type of intelligent creature.
Strange art, mostly of the ocean and its various denizens, graces the walls.
The water is a little warmer than that found in the open ocean.

name: The Halls Of Eareska
description:
You stand in the halls of Eareska, the home of the sea-elves.  Hallways are
carved from the rock, most likely form some sort of magic, as opposed to
manual work, such as that of the dwarves.  The walls are lit with some sort of
strange phosphorescent algae.  You occasionally pass by the small homecave of
one of the sea-elves who lives here.

soaring columns shaped like various seashells soar up above you.  You tread
upon a path created by the creative growth of different colored algae, which
create hypnotic designs on the floor.  The walls are lit with the same glowing
algae found outside.

name: Hall Of The Sea King
description:
A huge throne takes up most of the southern side of this grand hall.  Crafted
from several different types of coral, the throne stands tall, and it appears
to have several small sea creatures making their home in it.  The ceiling here
is high above you and is covered in the glowing algae, giving the hall an
eerie blue glow.

name: Weaponsmiths Cave
description:
The materials and gear used to craft weapons can be seen lying about this
cave.  Long shafts of treated wood stand in one corner and a bucket of
obsidian shards sits nearby.  Large chunks of obsidian line the far wall.

name: The Storemaid
description:
Different types of containers, most designed to allow a swimmer maximum
movement, hang on the walls and sit on small pedestals placed around the cave.
 A large countertop runs along the back, and strange materials sit upon it.

name: The Potionmaster
description:
This room must have some magical spell placed on it to keep the water out,
probably so the salt water won't interfere with whatever concoction is being
made in the large alchemist still in the back.  The air has a strange smell to
it.

name: The Armorers Cave
description:
You stand in a large cave.  Sheets of a strange scaly skin hang along one
wall.  In various places about the room, you see where these scales are being
formed into some sort of armor.  Cutting tools and sewing implements sit on
small tables placed about.

name: A Deep Cavern
description:
You swim about in a large dark cavern, that seems to head deep into the earth.
Strangely enough, you don't sight any sea creatures hanging out in this area.
The cave is clear of any vegetation, and the water seems a bit colder here.

name: A Huge Cavern
description:
This cavern is huge!  You can barely see the back of it...which might have
something to do with the body of a large beast blocking your vision!

name: Entrance
description:
Upon passing through the doors the first this you see after the door closes is
that the water is ebbing  out of this small entrance room. This room has no
real furniture and nothing hanging on the walls. After the water has receded
to beneath floor you hear a hiss and then feel the room becoming pressurized.
A pair of doors opens by withdrawing into the walls to the east making it the
only exit now. The floor is tiled with exquisite marble. you proceed to the
door to the next room.

name: Atrium
description:
The marble tile continues into this room surrounding a pool that looks to be
eighty feet by forty feet. Between you and the pool you see a stairway that
leads down. When you look up you are taken aback a tic noticing that the
ceiling ,which begins where the walls end approximately twenty feet from the
ground, is clear and one can see the sky. You can see all the fish swimming by
above you doing what they do and not taking notice of anything in this room.
The pool is crystal clear and on the bottom you see a mural of the Seadragon.
you see a few chairs placed on each side of the pool. Tapestries hang from the
walls from the ceiling to the floor. You look down the stairs but with the way
they curve on the way down you can not see the bottom.

name: Living Room
description:
You descend the stairway and enter the living room.  This room is huge,
stretching out in the cardinal directions and the ceiling must be fifty foot
high. The northern wall is a gigantic fishtank stocked with a very diverse
collection of different species There is a round beverage area in the center
of the room with a 4 armed daemon working. There are seating of all kinds in
this room with no real arrangement. A few tables are placed throughout the
room also some with ashtrays others with arrangements of flowers on them.
Along the eastern wall is a stage that rises a few feet above the rest of the
room . Along the south and west walls are paintings.

name: Placeholder
description: Placeholder

name: Through The Foothills
description:
You move past the odd spot of charred grass and flowers. The hills are
beginning to thin and you smell the slight hint of running water nearby.
Animals are moving along the hills and the sound of a some kind of animal
echoes against the hillside.

name: Through The Foothills
description:

to thin and you smell the slight hint of running water nearby.  Animals are
moving along the hills and the sound of a some kind of animal echoes against
the hillside.

name: Approaching A River
description:
The smell of water is heavy in the air. You can hear the rumbling of a river
somewhere to the south.  The grass is thinning and now you can see signs of
coyotes wandering back and forth. Hopefully the river will have a quiet place
to relax after such a long journey.

name: The Banks Of A Swift River
description:
This river is magnificent.  It must flow from some source deeper east inside
the hills.  The current looks heavy and it doesn't seem smart to try and cross
it. Looking down river you can see that it runs through all of the hill sides.
This might be the fastest way to cross the land.

name: Cruising On A Swift River
description:
The current is indeed fast but you are making more than good time moving
through the land.  You see numerous fish and several birds that are diving
into the water after them. You wonder if anybody has ever seen this place
before, it would provide an excellent spot for a Mill.

name: Riding The Rapids
description:
Oh Great Drazuk! The river has turned rough and you've entered a huge set of
rapids. The jagged rocks seem to be smiling as you try maneuver past them.
The white-water is almost five feet high! You pray that you can make it
through.

name: A Rather Steep Drop
description:
The day just get's better and better.  You've managed to survive the rapids
and now you have a nice 200 foot drop into a pool of ragged rocks and shallow
water. It is just that kinda day isn't it?

name: Under A Waterfall
description:
You survived!! You think. The water is warm and clear, the bottom is nowhere
to be seen, and...yes...after careful inspection you are in one piece. Let's
do it again! The current is too swift to swim back up, better try to swim past
the waterfall.

name: Under The River
description:
You continue to swim past the waterfall.  The current is much lighter here and
you think you can make it back up to the surface. The water is amazingly warm,
at least you got a path after traveling through the hills.

name: Floating Through The Bay
description:
You emerge to find yourself in a large bay.  The hills are fading and you can
see the expanse of the ocean ahead of you. It looks as if the hills were just
steeply cut if by magic. Far to the north you can make out the shape of
several island and to the east, more water.

name: In Open Water
description:
Back to the Ocean. To the north you can see the outline of several small
islands and to the east, lots of water. Perhaps it would be best to rest and
dry off on one of the islands. Then again, who knows what lies beyond the
ocean?

description:

description:

flat. You can see several types of flightless birds running around that look
just mouth watering. You wonder how a bird like this got onto this island?

description:
This small island is made of nothing but prime farm land! It is smooth and
flat.  You can see another island that actually has a few odd buildings on it.
It would just be a short swim across the water.

name: Island-Hopping
description:
The next island is only a bit away.  The outline of an odd stone building is
coming into view. You can hear the calls of those delicious flightless birds
coming from the island as well.

name: Island-Hopping
description:
The next island is only a bit away.  The outline of an odd stone building is
coming into view. You can hear the calls of those delicious flightless birds
coming from the island as well.

name: Among A Ruined Farm
description:
The stone building appears to be an old granary of some kind. Whatever food it
once held is long since been eaten by rodents. Or maybe those little birds.
You cannot see any reason why this farm was abandoned but it seems that it has
been deserted for a good deal of time.

name: Inside The Granary
description:
The floor has been picked clean of any of the grain or wheat that was stored.
You can see several very rusted scythes and an odd contraption that looks like
a hand-pushed cart with blades on the side. The proportions of the machine and
the tools make its clear it was a family of dwarves or gnomes. In the corner
you can see evidence of a large clan of rats that are probably the descendents
of those that gluttoned themselves here.

name: Among A Ruined Farm
description:
The stone building appears to be an old granary of some kind. Whatever food it
once held is long since been eaten by rodents. Or maybe those little birds.
You cannot see any reason why this farm was abandoned but it seems that it has
been deserted for a good deal of time.

name: Among A Ruined Farm
description:
A stone house that has mostly broken apart lies to the north. The wooden roof
has caved in and you can see the wind has taken some of the rotting clothing
and scattered it all over. Despite the damage, it looks safe enough to
explore.

name: Inside A Ruined House
description:
The house is old and seems to make a groan with each step you take. You search
for signs of valuables but find nothing. No silverware, no family treasures,
barely any sign of clothing. You can't find a reason why anyone would just let
this place run down.

name: A Humble Graveyard
description:
You are at a tiny graveyard, overlooking the water. You can see the shape of
another island to the west but it would be quite a drop to the water below.
The language is obscure but you notice the first portion of each name is the
same.  It seems a family did once live here. Four of the ten gravestones have
the same markings, you imagine its the date.  Perhaps some horrible fate
befell the family and they decided to leave this place. That's a very cheery
thought indeed.

name: A Larger Island
description:
This island is quite large compared to the others. It seems to have several
types of large trees and plants.  Yet walking is easy and the undergrowth
doesn't seem to be an issue.  The larger plantlife seems to have made an ample
food source for the large turtles that are slowly making their way about.

steep, it would be hard to climb. Yet you spot a small landing a bit away.
The water looks calm and inviting. It would be an easy swim.

name: Island-Hopping
description:
The smoking island is not that far. Just keep moving. The water is almost
uncomfortably warm.  You notice the turtles have stopped coming near the
water.  Their is a definite halo of haze around the island.

description:
The ground itself is warm and the plant life is amazingly lush. The air is
humid from the constantly burning dew and ocean spray. You can feel a very
warm wind blowing in from the south.

description:
The source of the light is definitely coming from below the cave. You can see
jets of steam and smoke rising from small holes all around the crevice. The
heat is starting to get very uncomfortable. You wonder just what is down there.

name: Inside A Fire-Rat's Nest
description:
This place reeks of natural gases and old bones. You can see several large
shells of the turtles that wander here. It seems a large family of rats that
are more than at home in the heat have made their home here.  A flow of old
lava has solidified below, blocking this area from the direct blasts of heat
but also keeping it at oven like temperatures.

name: In Open Water
description:
The ocean current is light and the fish are plentiful. The bottom is nowhere
to be seen and the waves small and playful. The ocean just keeps going on and
on but in the far distance you can see the outline of what may be seagulls.

dying. You doubt that many birds are dying at once.

name: Closing In On A Break Wall
description:
This large break wall is definitely man made. It seems to be made of numerous
rocks and cement yet bolstered by beams of steel. A magnificent example of
masonry to be sure.  You can see what seems to be signs of a port city! This
must be the far east you have heard about!

name: Walking The Dune Ridge
description:

side of the dune, you catch sight of a small oasis, with several small tents

description:

floats about this small oasis.  Tents are gathered to the east, situated
around the water.  The nomads of the area must of put up a little camp here.

Standing amidst desert bushes and tall palm trees, you enjoy the cool air that
floats about this small oasis.  Tents are gathered about the area, situated
around the water.  The nomads of the area must of put up a little camp here.

name: Amongst The Rocks
description:
An large outcrop of rocks sticks out in the middle of the sand dunes.  The
rocks form a natural passageway to the north, offering a dark place to hide
from the hot daytime sun.  The cavern entrance lies to the north.

name: A Rocky Cavern
description:
You instantly feel the cool of the shade as you enter the cavern.  It is quite
rocky, with long stalactites hanging down from the ceiling, small puddles of
dirty water sitting underneath them.

name: A Rocky Cavern
description:
You stand further back in the cool, dark cavern.  A small path seems formed
amongst the debris.  It is quite rocky, with long stalactites hanging down
from the ceiling, small puddles of dirty water sitting underneath them.

name: The Edge Of The Elder Forest
description:
At the end of the road is a small field.  The field slowly narrows into what
appears to be an opening in the forest, perhaps the beginning of a path.
Though the trees of the Elder Forest look foreboding, the clearing itself is
bright and the songs of the birds on the closest branches give the place a
cheery feel.

name: Safe Passage Through The Elder Forest
description:
The forest itself darkens as you proceed down the path, but still, despite the
weather, the air around you is warm, the bird's songs are happy, and you feel
as safe as you've ever felt.

name: A Dark Path Through The Trees
description:
The elder oaks are so thick here that barely no light comes through.  There is
a strong feeling of sadness about this area, and as you look to the sides of
the path, you notice many shallow graves.  You aren't sure, but it seems as if
the tree's have moved to block the passage to the east.
