name: Behind The Huge Oak
description:
You stand behind the Huge Oak, which has been converted by the bandits into a
gate for their hideout.  You hear it click shut behind you, and after a quick
search, you can find no way back through.  The forest ahead is normal, but
quiet.  A path picks it's way through the brambles surrounding
the trees.

name: The Briar Patch
description:
The bandits were very clever to place their hideout in such a place.  The
towering elder oaks keep the path dark, and the thick thorns on the bushes
makes it difficult to find your way through.

the decaying corpses of various large creatures lie about.  The sound of flies

name: The Briar Patch
description:
The bandits were very clever to place their hideout in such a place.  The
towering elder oaks keep the path dark, and the thick thorns on the bushes

increases and you begin to itch under your armor.  You're not sure where this
path is going, but you have a bad feeling.

name: The Briar Patch
description:
The bandits were very clever to place their hideout in such a place.  The
towering elder oaks keep the path dark, and the thick thorns on the bushes
makes it difficult to find your way through.  You are gagging due to the lack
of clean air, and the ground itself sizzles about you.  South of stands a
large cave leading down into the ground.  The glow of fires come from within,
and with them a wind of fear.

name: The Scorched Cave
description:

young.  You see where it has slowly had to dig out more and as he grew.  The
crunch of bones are underneath your feet.  The stench of death is everywhere.

makes it difficult to find your way through.  Tents are set about in alcoves
cut into the brambles.  The scraps of raids and other crimes lie tossed about.
 A large cook fire burns in the middle of this clearing.

name: A Bright Clearing
description:
You stand in a bright clearing, surrounded by elder oaks.  You aren't sure how
exactly you got here...all you can remember is the sweet smell of roses and
then....this.  You look around and see that the only path available to you is
to the west.

name: A Bright Path
description:
Although this path is bright and warm, you don't feel very welcome.  Even as
you see the weather shift above you, it stays the same between these trees,
and that means strong magic.

you see the weather shift above you, it stays the same between these trees,
and that means strong magic.  To the west, a pile of rocks has tumbled from
the mountain above, and from the sounds, some creature has taken up residence
within.

name: A Small Cave
description:
This cave doesn't head too far down into the earth.  Small animal bones are
scattered about the floor, and there is a strong smell of dog within.

and that means strong magic.  A cookfire burns here, and a small platform has
been created, probably for the purpose of dancing.

name: A Bright Path
description:
Although this path is bright and warm, you don't feel very welcome.  Even as
you see the weather shift above you, it stays the same between these trees,
and that means strong magic.  A large gypsy wagon stands to east.

name: A Large Gypsy Wagon
description:
The occupant of this wagon is obviously a mystic of some sorts.  Exotic
reagents and mystical powders stand about in odd-shaped jars, books and tomes
lie about, several small daemons flutter about in birdcages.  A large chair
faces the center of the room, and a comfortable bed sits along the wall.

name: A Sinister Trail
description:
You stumble through the small opening, and gasp as you see the trees shut
behind you.  Far away in the distance, you hear what could be the sounds of
screaming.

name: A Sinister Trail
description:
The trees close in about you, and the branches move in the breeze as if
grasping at you for help...or straining to attack you.  Far away in the
distance, you hear what could be the sounds of screaming.

description:
The trees close in about you, and the branches move in the breeze as if
grasping at you for help...or straining to attack you.  Far away in the
distance, you hear what could be the sounds of screaming.  The corpses of what
appear to be recent kills lie about here, and the runes of demonic rituals are
carved into them.  The sight makes you very ill.

name: A Sinister Trail
description:
The trees close in about you, and the branches move in the breeze as if
grasping at you for help...or straining to attack you.  Far away in the
distance, you hear what could be the sounds of screaming.  Hanging to the
north between two ragged oaks is a golden ring, large enough to step through.
It glows an evil red, and only gray can be seen beyond it.

name: In The Dark Void
description:
You float in the dark void, the personal domain of an old demon prince.  The
sounds of insanity echo in your ears, and you feel extremely dizzy.  It seems
the only path available to you now is to the north.

name: A Manicured Trail
description:
This path is obviously well kept.  Small rocks line the sides of a gravel
road, and flowers and other attractive plants grow in select places.  The
owner of the keep must be fairly rich.

name: A Manicured Trail
description:
This path is obviously well kept.  Small rocks line the sides of a gravel
road, and flowers and other attractive plants grow in select places.  The
owner of the keep must be fairly rich.  To the west stands the large gate of a
keep.  It is closed and looks pretty strong.

name: The Keep Gate
description:
You stand now within the main gatehouse of the keep.  Paths along the walls
lead off north and south, and you can see what appears to be a magnificent
courtyard ahead to the west.  Somehow, the gate to the east has closed and you
can't find any way to open it again.

name: A Magnificent Courtyard
description:
The courtyard of this keep is glorious.  A huge beautiful marble fountain sits
in the middle, and a green, well-tended lawn and garden stretches off to the
south.  North stands a small side-house, and west is the large door that forms
the entrance of the keep.

name: An Elaborate Foyer
description:
Wow!  The foyer of this keep is quite nice indeed.  Dark wood panels the walls
and crystal chandeliers hang from the vaulted ceiling.  This entry room is
definitely made to impress any visitors.

name: Hallway Of The Keep
description:
You stand in the main hallway of the keep.  A thick carpet is underfoot, and
pictures of various lords and ladies, doing various lord-and-lady things hang
about.

name: Hallway Of The Keep
description:
You stand in the main hallway of the keep.  A thick carpet is underfoot, and
pictures of various lords and ladies, doing various lord-and-lady things hang
about.

name: Hallway Of The Keep
description:
You stand in the main hallway of the keep.  A thick carpet is underfoot, and
pictures of various lords and ladies, doing various lord-and-lady things hang
about.

name: The Library
description:
You step into a spacious room, with a tall ceiling.  Bookshelves line the
walls, and each is overflowing with various books and tomes.  Comfortable
chairs and small tables sit about randomly.  This looks like a nice place to
just sit down and read a book...what a nice change from adventuring!

name: The Kitchen
description:
This kitchen is quite spacious, and has a lot of space for preparing meals.
Large counters run along the walls, and a huge wood-burning stove sits in one
corner.  Various pot and pans hang from hooks on the ceiling.  Dried foods
hang along one wall, and a large icebox sits opposite the stove.

name: Hallway Of The Keep
description:
You stand in the main hallway of the keep.  A thick carpet is underfoot, and
pictures of various lords and ladies, doing various lord-and-lady things hang
about.

name: Hallway Of The Keep
description:
You stand in the main hallway of the keep.  A thick carpet is underfoot, and
pictures of various lords and ladies, doing various lord-and-lady things hang
about.

name: Hallway Of The Keep
description:
You stand in the main hallway of the keep.  A thick carpet is underfoot, and
pictures of various lords and ladies, doing various lord-and-lady things hang
about.

name: The Throne Room
description:
A large wooden throne sits at the far end of this room.  An ornate red carpet
runs up the middle of the room to the throne.  Torches burn on golden stands,
one of which looks like its worth more than you've ever seen in your
adventuring career.  A large metal door is placed in the west wall of this
room.

name: Barracks
description:
This room appears to be a simple barracks for the soldiers of the keep.
Decent bunks line the walls, and small chests for the belongings of the guards
sit at the foot of each.  Plain weapons hang in racks along one wall.

name: Barracks
description:
This room appears to be a simple barracks for the soldiers of the keep.
Decent bunks line the walls, and small chests for the belongings of the guards
sit at the foot of each.  Plain weapons hang in racks along one wall.

name: The Storage Closet
description:
You walk into what appears to be a storage closet.  Not much in here but
cleaning supplies.  Brooms and mops lean in one corner, and lots of buckets
are piled up against one wall.

name: Slave Quarters
description:
This plain room must be the slaves quarters.  While not quite a prison, there
are chains and manacles attached to the walls, to ensure the occupants don't
try to go anywhere without permission.

name: The Fancy Bedroom
description:
This must be the bedroom of the lord of the keep, because it is the fanciest
one you have ever seen.  A huge bed dominates the room, and ornate wooden
furniture stands against the walls.  No inn that you've ever stayed in had
something like this!

name: Training Arena
description:
This large room is pretty empty, except for what appears to be a rack of
practice weapons along the southern wall.  Some battered weapon-practice
dummies lean against the northern wall.  The rest of the room looks like some
sort of training arena.

name: The Walls Of The Keep
description:
You stand on the walls of the keep itself.  This large wall circles the entire
grounds of the keep and looks to be fairly impenetrable, unless you had some
large siege weapons handy.  There is a walkway all around, so the patrolling
guards can watch all sides easily.

A Well-kept Garden
description:
You walk down a little path through a scenic garden.  Colorful flowers and
various trees are placed about in a particularly aesthetic way, giving you a
sense of calm and safety.  This would be an ideal place for a picnic, if it
wasn't for the strange animal noises you hear.

name: A Treacherous Mountain Pass
description:
You work your way through a small mountain pass, littered with boulders and
other large rocks.  High above you, more rocks are precariously perched on top
of each other, and it looks like they could fall at any moment.  All of a
sudden, with a roar, some boulders come cascading down behind you, blocking
the path!

name: A Thorny Path
description:
You head down a narrow trail, bordered with thorny bushes.  As you push your
way through, you notice the bushes closing in behind you, barring any way of
returning, at least from here.

name: Under The Wagon
description:
You stand in a small tunnel dug underneath the gypsy queen's wagon.  She must
of had this created so there was an option for a quick getaway, as long as she
had enough warning to make it through the tunnel.

name: The Swirling Mist
description:
A large vortex made up of a swirling grey mist hangs in the air above
you.  It tugs at your belongings.  You aren't sure where it leads, but it must
be better than this evil place.

name: The Vault
description:
You stand in a large vault.  This has to be where the Boss keeps his
valuables.  One of the things here is a large painting.  The scene is of a
path through a forest.  As you study it closer, you realize that the painting
looks exactly like the clearing you went through when you entered the grounds
of the keep.  It looks so real, you feel you could just walk right into it!

name: The Hall Of Flames
description:
This house stands directly in a small square within the Elder Forest.  Its
sturdy stone and wood walls are planted into the sandy gray soil with a look
of permanence.  As you enter this home, you feel the icy grip of panic and
fear around your heart when you find yourself standing in the middle of a
roaring fire.  Strangely enough, the hungry flames wrapping themselves around
you do not seem to do physical harm, yet their tremendous heat feels more than
real, making you writhe in agony.

name: Placeholder
description: Placeholder

name: Path To Elenolos
description:
The small dirt roads begins to twist and turn through the trees at the edge of
the forest, headed west towards Elenolos, the home of the elves.  The slight
breeze carries what sounds like music past your ears, and the temperature is
comfortable.

name: Path To Elenolos
description:
The small dirt roads begins to twist and turn through the trees at the edge of
the forest, headed west towards Elenolos, the home of the elves.  The slight
breeze carries what sounds like music past your ears, and the temperature is
comfortable.  A larger than normal tree lays west of you.

name: Entrance Tree
description:
You stand at the bottom of the entrance tree to Elenolos.  Built high up in
the branches of this ancient forest, staircases have been built into the
larger tree's to assist your climb.

name: Entrance Tree
description:
You stand at the top of the entrance tree to Elenolos.  Built high up in
the branches of this ancient forest, staircases have been built into the
larger tree's to assist your climb.

name: Wandering Elenolos
description:
You wander about Elenolos, the home of the elves.  You stand high above the
forest floor, and move about the city by delicate-looking, but sturdy,
rope-and-wood bridges.  You pass by small dwellings built into the trees.
They look quite cozy and comfortable.

name: Library
description:

them changing magically as different thoughts move through your head.  A small
table is in the middle of the room, for comfortable reading.

rope-and-wood bridges.  An ornate staircase heads up into the living quarters

name: Throne Room
description:
You enter a large throne room, carved directly in the center of this gigantic
tree.  The wood has been polished to the point of shining, and rare artifacts
are placed on exhibit around the room.  A pair of thrones, carved from a
warm-colored wood sit against the east wall.

name: Before The Ruins
description:
You stand in a large cavern.  To the north stands the remains of what appears
to be some sort of church or temple.  While the buildings retain their
general shape, most of the decorations and symbols have been damaged beyond
recognition.  A fresh passageway is dug into the wet dirt heading east.

name: Wandering The Ruined Temple
description:
You walk amongst the stones that lie fallen about this ruined temple.  At some
places, strong rock walls have been destroyed by the roots of the trees above.
This part of the temple was probably the entrance.

name: A Stall in the Farmer's Market
description:
This stall in the Farmer's Market sells and trades goods that are indigenous
and imported from all over the continent. This market has a wide variety of
fresh foods; from apples, tomatoes, and cabbage to onions, pumpkins, and
lettuce.

farmers. Rain or shine, this market is always open.

name: Market Road
description:
The upkeep of this road is provided by the profitable merchants. There are
hardly any ruts, pot holes, or puddles to be found. Both sides of the road are
lined with sparsely placed trees and thousands of wildflowers that all seem to
be crowding up to the edge of this well travelled lane.

name: A Narrow Pathway
description:
The pathway leads deeper underground.  You can smell sulfur burning far off
but also the faint hints of evergreen and jasmine.  The walls are a smooth
marble, they also appear to be polished but the formation of the cave seems
too natural. It is too cramped for a large party to continue.

name: Inside The Trial Of Fellowship
description:
The door you came through is gone.  Where it once stood is now just a mere
shadow.  You try to touch the knob but your hands moves right through it.  You
are in some kind of cavern, it is cramped and tight.  To the north is another
massive door that is the color of the darkest coal. To the east you can smell
the strong odor of sulfur but to the east you smell evergreen and cold
mountain air.

name: A Cavern Of Flame
description:
This cavern is not much bigger than anything else you've seen.  The walls and
pillars are made of metal, burning bright red with the extreme heat in the
room.  Rivers of lava and jets of flame erupt in all directions.  You better
watch your step.   Hopefully if anything lives in here, it won't notice you.

description:

within this cavern.  The ceiling is a soft turquoise that mimics a clear blue
sky, snow and great trees line the cavern and it even seems to be snowing!
This is truly a marvel.

gray as even the moss and fungus is an ashen color.  The walls seem solid yet
they easily bend under the simplest pressure.

name: A Cavern Of Shadow
description:
This cavern is covered in a thick mist.  It is not a fog, but rather merely a
darkness so thick that your breathing becomes labored just walking.  The
shadows around you seem to leap and glide about.  The shuffling sounds that
come from all around you do not bode well.

description:
This cavern, if you called it that, is beautiful.  The entire place is bathed
in light.  You smell jasmine and honey everywhere.  Numerous statues have been
built into the walls of the cavern, most of them of kindly creatures with
dove's wings and smiling faces.  You hope that your prescience in this holy
place is not taken as an insult.

description:
This simple gate is made of pure light.  Simply touching the thin strips that
bar your movement north sends a great shock through your system.  There is a
small entry place for a key.

name: A Twisted Cavern
description:
This cavern smells of rot and decay.  The floor is littered with the bodies of
hundreds of soldiers, human and otherwise.  Some of them are slowly crawling
their way up, disregarding their wounds and the fact they are dead to continue
their war with anyone left.  It would be best to move quickly.

description:
This gate is a twisted mass of swords, shields, and bodies.  There is a simple
iron lock in the middle of what appears to be a bent broadsword and several
bodies that look to have been sowed back together.

name: The Grey Walk
description:
This cannon is small and tight.  The same grey walls line it.  Yet the smell
of blood and death are even heavier here as you can see the entire area has
been stained with war.  The deep claw marks all over the walls seem to have
been made by the creature standing by a door of mirror.

name: A Room Of Waterfalls
description:
This room is filled with hundreds of different waterfalls.  You can see and
feel the mist as they crash with the stone floor yet you see no other water.
Surely this small cavern would have flooded long ago.  The small amounts of
light are reflected a hundred times over through all the various waterfalls.

name: Walking To The Fields
description:
You continue down the heavily travelled dirt roads towards the fields. You can
see numerous silk worms busy working on their masterpieces and different opium
plants lined in neat rows. Numerous workers, officials, and merchants stream
through here, trying to get a sample of the goods.

are battling each other to harvest as much as they can.

name: Inside The Opium Smoke
description:
You feel warm and a bit clumsy as the smoke of the opium fills your lungs. Your
eyes grow heavy and you start to sway silently for no reason.  You swear you
can see the birds singing and hear the plants move back and forth in a strange
dance.  Numerous creatures move by you, all of them rainbow colored and
smiling. It's all just a bad trip, just a bad trip.

name: Inside The Opium Smoke
description:
The smoke is starting to clear and the breathe of fresh air is welcomed.  This
seems like a safe place to sit and rest.  The hallucinations don't seem to
come in here, or maybe they are real and just avoid this place.  For whatever
reason, you feel you can relax here.

name: A Narrow Crack
description:
You barely have enough room to fit through this narrow crack in the rock.
The walls are worn smooth from the centuries of slowly draining water
polishing their sides. From here you can see the faint light coming from the
cave above the crack.  The small passage heads down, into darkness.

name: A Rocky Cave System
description:
You find yourself in dark cave system.  Sharp Stalactites hang from the rocky
roof above you, and small pools of water sit underneath the bigger ones.  All
about you is the steady dripping sound of water echoing throughout the
caverns.

name: Flayer Homecaves
description:
These lighted caves are much different than the natural formations of the main
passage.  The ways are smooth and dark.  Upon closer inspection, strange runes
and figures are carved into the rock.  Amongst these designs, small openings
head into the homecaves of the Flayers.

name: An Etched and Scorched Cave
description:
All of a sudden out of the dark, the passage has opened up into a huge cavern.
 The walls are dark and smooth, and looks almost as if the solid rock has been
melted numerous times.  The stink of acidic corrosion fills the air.

name: A Rock-Lined Path
description:
A pretty little rock-lined path leads into a well-tended flower garden to the
north.  The hum of bees and the sweet scent of flowers comes to you on a warm
breeze.  To the south lies the main road to Underhill.

name: Wandering The Flower Garden
description:
You wander amongst a well-tended flower garden.  The hum of bees floating
lazily in the warm breeze is all about you, as the busy creatures fly from
flower to flower, collecting pollen.  The bright colors of the flowers give
the whole area a cheery feeling.

name: Medea's Sanctuary
description:
Once the air that overlooked this flower garden was clear. Now the air has
formed into a quiet sanctuary of misty blue. The lighted walls shine in a
spiral of rainbow colored twists that ascend to the heavens. Against one
"wall" is a tapestry that is suspended. Woven into the colorful picture is the
birth of the Goddess Medea. It shows how the light begot Medea. Beneath this
chapter is a banner that reads: Quod polus erant laetabilis! Which translates
into "And the heaven's were joyous!"

name: Inside The Gate Of Sorrow
description:
This massive gate has seen better days. It seems to have been completely torn
off it's hinges at one point and hastily put back on.  It is battered and
beaten from years of war and from a very recent defeat.  The walls around it
are pure stone and from the dulled red floor, was fiercely defended.

name: The Parade Grounds
description:
You are standing inside the parade grounds of the great Fortress.  There are
numerous temporary defensive positions all around, some decayed with age while
others looked to have been in constant repair.  There are numerous soldiers
patrolling, cadets drilling, and the usual sights and sounds of an active
military base.

name: Inside The Fort
description:
The inside of this Fort is massive, for a dwarf.  You can comfortably walk
without having to duck but it is much more cramped than you would expect from
the masters of stonework.  The walls are scarred and stained from battle.
Some soldiers are napping in the hallway, the bunk rooms too small for the
average human.

name: On The Fort Walls
description:
From here you can see far into the mountain paths of Sorrow.  You can spot a
few smaller trails that wind throughout the crag, and the main passage that
leads deep into the mountain.  You notice a steady flow of steam coming from
far in the mountain, from below it would appear like clouds but from here it
is obvious that there is some great iron works or forge.  The walls are well
protected from enemy fire and with this vantage point, it would be easy to
spot an attack.

leads deep into the mountain.  You notice a steady flow of steam coming from
far in the mountain, from below it would appear like clouds but from here it
is obvious that there is some great iron works or forge.  The walls are well
protected from enemy fire and with this vantage point, it would be easy to
spot an attack.

these heavy bolt throwers, rock throwers, and other forms of heavy siege
weapon can rain death upon any force that comes within eye shot.  It must have
truly been a bloody battle if these awesome machines were constantly throwing
death upon the attackers.

name: A Ruined Shrine
description:
The last part of the battle for this Fort was fought here.  From the size of
the room you can tell that there were only half a dozen defenders left.  The
shrine is to a great dwarf carrying a mug of ale and a hammer.  The
inscription is faded and unreadable.  The room has not been touched, perhaps
out of fear of further angering some great god or maybe out of respect for
those last brave souls that fought to the very last man.

description:

the middle of the room. A sleeping bag resides alongside the fire. Someone's
been living here!?

name: A Simple Door
description:
A door stands alone.  Utterly alone.  The frame is connected to nothing.  It
hovers just out of reach of the jungle floor.  It is a simple door with no
recognizable features other than that it is made of wood, the handle is brass,
and it does not appear to be locked.  It does not seem wise to enter so
lightly.

name: A Marble Hallway
description:
This hallway is simple yet elegant.  The ceiling is covered in an odd fresco
of faded  colors and the walls are made of smooth marble.  There is no
furniture or decorations anywhere save for the few frescos painted along the
white ceiling.  The tile on the floor resembles a chess board with marble tile
against ebony.

name: A Marble Hallway
description:

of faded  colors and the walls are made of smooth marble.  There is no
furniture or decorations anywhere save for the few frescos painted along the
white ceiling.  The tile on the floor resembles a chess board with marble tile
against ebony.   A large gold door is to the east.  A small inscription is
written on it.

name: The Gallery
description:
The Hallway stretches out far to the east.  The floor is the same tile as
before but the ceiling is now blank.  Huge portraits of creatures you have
never seen adorn the walls.  The statues of ancient gods and demons seem to
look you over and you can almost hear them debate your artistic merit.

name: The Gallery
description:
The Hallway stretches out far to the east.  The floor is the same tile as
before but the ceiling is now blank.  Huge portraits of creatures you have
never seen adorn the walls.  The statues of ancient gods and demons seem to
look you over and you can almost hear them debate your artistic merit.  To the
south, a portrait of a man that appears to be a dwarf of orc height watches a
city burn.   He is smiling and cackling at the sight of the slaughter, you can
feel the heat from the painting.

name: The Gallery
description:
The Hallway stretches out far to the east.  The floor is the same tile as
before but the ceiling is now blank.  Huge portraits of creatures you have
never seen adorn the walls.  The statues of ancient gods and demons seem to
look you over and you can almost hear them debate your artistic merit.  To the
north, a portrait of a castle seems to constantly shift.  The castle becomes a
jungle, then a desert, an orgy, and finally the castle again.

name: The Gallery
description:
The Hallway stretches out far to the east.  The floor is the same tile as
before but the ceiling is now blank.  Huge portraits of creatures you have
never seen adorn the walls.  The statues of ancient gods and demons seem to
look you over and you can almost hear them debate your artistic merit.  To the
south, a portrait of a serene garden dominates the wall.  There is nothing
interesting about the garden, it seems the perfect spot for a picnic.  Yet, in
the far corner you notice a figure that oddly resembles yourself.

name: The Gallery
description:
The Hallway stretches out far to the east.  The floor is the same tile as
before but the ceiling is now blank.  Huge portraits of creatures you have
never seen adorn the walls.  The statues of ancient gods and demons seem to
look you over and you can almost hear them debate your artistic merit.  To the
east, a simple door, much like the one that led you inside, it waits to be
opened.  Yet, it is clear the door will not open so easily. Another
inscription is written along the frame.

name: Delight's Garden Party
description:
Beyond the portrait you have found a surreal scene.  The sky is the color of
fresh tea mixed with the brighest dyes in Bazabel.  The ground beneath you is
soft grassland yet the grass is made of sand and the dirt is made of cinnamon.
There are frogs made of sugar and butterflies that cause huge gusts of wind as
they flutter by.  There is a sweet music to the air, rapid and high pitched.

name: Desire's Realm
description:
You suddenly feel as if something is missing from your world.  You want.  You
need. You must have.  But you do not know what.  The sky is sweet red and you
can smell the scent of happier days and better memories.  The floor is a soft
red stone and the walls around you are nothing but rose pedals and perfume.

name: Despair's Descent
description:
There is nothing here.  You have found erebus.  You found the hole in the
world. The sky above you is pitch black.  The floor is soft but with fragments
of bone that seem to pierce through your armor and tear flesh.   There is
nothing left in the world, there is nothing but more pain.

name: Destruction's Celebration
description:
The air is sharp with burning embers and salt water.  The city around you is
burning, drowning, and in a total state of chaos.   The city was once
beautiful, the buildings are taller than you have ever seen and even the gods
themselves would be in awe.  Yet, everywhere there is destruction.  And that
is how it should be.

name: Dream's Castle
description:
You stand before the gate of a magificent castle.  The stones are made of air
and the ground is built from nightmares.  The entire world shifts with each
step you take.  Everytime you move forward, the castle seems to grow smaller.
You can smell the scent of a deep jungle but you are walking on a well
maintained road.  You are not sure what to do or where to go.

name: Destiny's Garden
description:
You are now in a beautiful garden.  The sky is a dazzling blue and the grass
is a spectacular emerald.  There are statues of the greatest gods and
creatures in the world.  You see a beautiful statue that depicts the rise to
power of Darwin over Drazuk, the destruction of a god you have never known,
and of creatures that you cannot say you have ever even conceived of.  Yet,
you have the feeling that you have been here before.  You have the feeling
that you are right where you should be.

name: A Simple Gamble
description:
Life is a gamble.  The reality of pain for the promise of greater meanings.
There is nothing to do but risk what you have won or leave now slightly less.
There is glory down this road, there is rewards.  But what do you offer in
return? Only those that would face delirium may move beyond.

name: Delirium's Dinner Table
description:
A lavish table is laid on the back of a giant turtle.  The wine is as thick as
mud and the ham is made of feathers.  The chairs are swaying to the music.
The turtle is blowing bubbles.  A young girl sits at the head of the table and
laughs.

name: Desire's Realm
description:
You suddenly feel as if something is missing from your world.  You want.  You
need. You must have.  But you do not know what.  The sky is sweet red and you
can smell the scent of happier days and better memories.  The floor is a soft
red stone and the walls around you are nothing but rose pedals and perfume.

description:

need. You must have.  But you do not know what.  This is the heart of desire.

name: Despair's Descent
description:
There is nothing here.  You have found erebus.  You found the hole in the
world. The sky above you is pitch black.  The floor is soft but with fragments
of bone that seem to pierce through your armor and tear flesh.   There is
nothing left in the world, there is nothing but more pain.

There is nothing here.  You have found erebus.  You found the hole in the
world. The sky above you is pitch black.  The floor is soft but with fragments
of bone that seem to pierce through your armor and tear flesh.   There is
nothing left in the world, there is nothing but more pain.

name: Despair's Abyss
description:
There is nothing here.  You have found erebus.  You found the hole in the
world.  This is the eye of the storm.  This is the center of nothing.  This is
where pain is born.  This is where all lost souls are found.  You have found
the center of pain and she is waiting.

name: Destruction's Celebration
description:
The air is sharp with burning embers and salt water.  The city around you is
burning, drowning, and in a total state of chaos.   The city was once
beautiful, the buildings are taller than you have ever seen and even the gods
themselves would be in awe.  Yet, everywhere there is destruction.  And that
is how it should be.

name: Destruction's Throne
description:
The room is both alive and quite dead.  The once magnificent throne room has
been burned, drowned, frozen, and torn apart a hundred different times. Yet,
from the ash comes life.  From the water, life.  The most beautiful roses you
have ever seen grow in the corner among the graveyard.

name: Dream's Castle
description:
You stand before the gate of a magificent castle.  The stones are made of air
and the ground is built from nightmares.  The entire world shifts with each
step you take.  Everytime you move forward, the castle seems to grow smaller.
You can smell the scent of a deep jungle but you are walking on a well
maintained road.  You are not sure what to do or where to go.

You stand before the gate of a magificent castle.  The stones are made of air
and the ground is built from nightmares.  The entire world shifts with each
step you take.  Everytime you move forward, the castle seems to grow smaller.
You can smell the scent of a deep jungle but you are walking on a well
maintained road.  You are not sure what to do or where to go.

name: Dream's Castle
description:
You have made it to the castle.  It no longer bends and warps as you move
forward but it now seems to be stable and in place.  The stone is rather drab
and it sees as if whomever controls this realm has made no attempt to  create
this castle as anything but a simple piece of land.

name: Dream's Castle
description:
The castle is decorated with thousands of paintings, statues, jewels, and
weaponry.  Some of the items you can recall from your dreams as a child and
some seem like they have no place in any world, let alone your own. The air
smells of soft cotton and you can almost taste warm milk in your mouth.

name: Dream's Castle
description:

to the ceiling but rather out of it and into eternity.  The shelves are warped
and twisted and books seem to float back and forth into the different shelves.

name: Dream's Banquet Hall
description:
This massive room has a table that is made of several different trees.  Not
that it is made of finely polished wood but that the entire table are several
trees that have been shaped into a flat surface.  A figure sits at the head of
the table on a giant toadstool.

name: Destiny's Garden
description:
You are now in a beautiful garden.  The sky is a dazzling blue and the grass
is a spectacular emerald.  There are statues of the greatest gods and
creatures in the world.  You see a beautiful statue that depicts the rise to
power of Darwin over Drazuk, the destruction of a god you have never known,
and of creatures that you cannot say you have ever even conceived of.  Yet,
you have the feeling that you have been here before.  You have the feeling
that you are right where you should be.

name: Destiny's Pond
description:
A large pond seems to hover in this place.  There is at least four feet of
space between the bottom of the water and the ground.  The water ripples and
moves as a pond should, yet it is as if two invisible hands contain the water
in the air. You see fish and serpents of all types swimming within.  A robed
man and his two associates advance on you for disturbing their meditations.

name: A Simple Gamble
description:
Life is a gamble.  The reality of pain for the promise of greater meanings.
There is nothing to do but risk what you have won or leave now slightly less.
There is glory down this road, there is rewards.  But what do you offer in
return? One must have the desire to risk all to win all to move deeper.

name: Famine
description:

sea of decay and emptiness.  There is no water in the air.  There is no life
in the dirt. There is nothing here.  The bones of animals and children are the
only tombstones.

description:
This beautiful forest has withered into nothing.  The fires of war have burned
all green away and only the red of bloodshed remains.  The ground is wet with
battle and a thousand bodies litter the field.  The young lay dead as the old
prove their points.

description:
This was once a great and mighty city.  The market stalls are empty now. The
walls are abandoned and nothing has lived in this city for years. The disease
came quickly and few could escape.  Those that did only brought it to other
lands and other cities.

name: Time
description:
You see now all that time has taken.  You can see the proud warrior that fell
to a simple tear in the heart.  You can see the beautiful priestess that met
her faith with arthritis tear drops.  You are walking among the souls that
have perished because time has no master.  There is no battle to face, no
spell to conjurer, time may be delayed, but it is never late.

name: A Lonely Truth
description:
There is but one truth to the world: We all must die. We all must die alone.
The room is barren.  It is neither white nor black.  The color is soft.  There
are no walls, just the color.  You know you are trapped.  You feel the
limitations, you know you are in a room.  But it is endless.  It is eternity.
There is nothing. Except for her.

name: A Narrow Canyon
description:
You walk down a narrow canyon.  At some points in this canyon, you have to
squeeze yourself past fallen rocks.  The canyon walls stretch far above you,
and you don't see an easy way to climb out.  North of you, the canyon seems to
break out into the main pass.

echoes back and forth down the tunnel.  Occasionally, you spot the glimmer of
gemstones, still locked deep within the rock walls.

name: Roughly Carved Tunnels
description:
You stand in a strange tunnel.  To the west of you lies the naturally formed
caverns you came in from.  To the east, it appears as if the tunnel has been
carved out of the rock by amateur hands.  The smell of cookfires also comes
from the east.

name: Roughly Carved Tunnels
description:
You travel about the roughly carved homecaves of the orcs.  You can see places
where the orcs have carved small living quarters out of the rock.  The stink
of orc-flesh and the strong smell of smoke fills the air about you.

name: The Lady's Haven
description:
You pause a moment upon entering, as your eyes adjust to the &Odim
&Ylighting&D.  A &wdouble row of &Wsilvery &Ycandles&D encircles the room,
each stick of pure, sweet smelling beeswax, and each set upon an &ziron
wrought &bpost&D. Directly ahead (and partially underfoot) sprawls a
&Wlengthy, &Csnow&Wwhite&D &zfur&D which has been strewn across the
&Odark oak &zfloors&D, creating an ideal place to recline and ponder the
world's intricacies.

The luxurious fur stops short near a &Olarge &Yfi&rre&Rpl&ra&Yce&D, where
several thick cords of wood burn merrily, warming the entire dwelling.
Directly above you, &ba &Cspiral stair&D suspends in mid-air, leading up to
the rooftop courtyard above. The smallest &Wglimpse&D of &Bs&Ct&War&Cr&By
&Bsky&D is visible from where you stand. To the east and west, each
side of the room is lined with books, floor to ceiling, and
wall to wall.

&OLeather-bound&D, &zmusky volumes&D, ancient tomes, some of &Pmagic&D, some
of &Gmystery&D, all intriguing. Farther ahead stands a &wlarge, four-poster
bed, hung with &pwine coloured netting&D. The &zsilken &pdrapes&D are closed
now, a place of privacy then, the Lady's bedchambers.

name: Bedchambers
description:
As you untie the &zsilken &pribbons&D and slip through her Lady's private
curtains, you feel a sting. &WOuch!&D A &zneedle&D sewn into the ribbon's end
&Rhas &rpricked &Ryou!&D  &RA dr&rop of bl&Rood&D falls from tip of your
finger into a porcelain dish: a toll to enter her personal sanctuary, or
foreshadowing of what is yet to come?

&CLuxuriance &Wembraces your form&D as you settle in upon mounds of &psoft,
silky &zcushions&D piled atop an enormous bed of lush Egyptian cotton. A
marble pedestal stands at the far left of the bed, supporting a porcelain
&Cbowl&D of &Wcrushed ice&D and a &Ccry&Wst&ca&Wll&Cine&D bottle of &Psweet
&Cchampagne&D. On the far right side, a second pedestal bears an eternally
&Rwarm&D, porcelain bowl of &Omelted cho&Ycol&Oate&D, swirling endlessly as if
by magick. Draped across the headboard and encircling the top two bedposts
climb &Gyards of vinery&D, bearing &Wlucious &Psummer&D-&Wripe
&Pstrawberries&D of perfect colour. These vines never wither, nor fade with
season, but are ever fruitful and ever ready to bloom. An enchanted place, and
deigned only to be shared with a select few.

name: Courtyard Sanctuary
description:
When you set foot upon the stairs they begin to flow, moving soundlessly,
pulling &Wonward, &Cupward&D, into the &Glush garden&D that awaits. A light,
sweet &Pscent &Wwafts to you&D upon a breeze and faint rustlings greet your
arrival as &Cpetals &Wun&Ccurl&D and hyacinths, crocuses, bluebells, baby
roses, lilacs, countless others turn to display themselves before you. A
well-kept path divides the &pbloss&Woming &Gfoliage&D into four quarters, each
bearing the fruit and blooming flowers of a particular season. &GSpring&D,
&PSummer&D, &OFall&D and &WWinter&D each equally represented here in cherry
blossoms, ripened berries, sunflowers, mistletoe and more. &zFur&w-draped&D
benches of the same &Odark oak&D rest in each corner of the garden, while a
single &Wwhite gazebo&D graces the center stage, its windows draped with
similar &psilken &zgauze&D, the roof left open &Bs&Wky&bw&War&Bd&D, for
&Wgazing&D. As the &pcurtains&D are drawn now, you can see piles of
comfortable looking pillows swathe the inner benches of this &Cstar&D-&Wgazing
sanctuary&D.

name: A Noisy Tunnel
description:
The cave behind you gives way to a carefully carved tunnel.  The walls have
been exactly cut and measured with torches hanging in neat rows.  A great
amount of noise is coming from deep down, a mixture of goblin songs, forges,
and a few explosions.  A few goblins carrying tools casually walk back.

name: The Tunnels To H'Unki
description:
The tunnel has been precisely crafted by the goblin workers.  They are
numerous now many taking smaller tunnels above and below you.  The floor and
the ceiling are both made of crystal, allowing you to see the dozens of goblin
workers that are expanding their tunnels or perhaps correcting the width and
height.

name: The H'Unki Homecaves
description:
This wider tunnel is both a means of transit throughout the city but also
appears to be the living area of the goblins.  There is little concept of
personal space as numerous goblins sleep in makeshift beds next to one other
and large groups are crowded around cooking pits that seem to heat the food
rather than actually cook it.

name: The Commons Cave
description:
This massive cavern is packed with goblins.  You see collections of tables and
chairs that form small pubs while some goblins have simply laid out their
wares to sell on a blanket before them.   There is no reason to the madness,
the goblins seem content to just set up wherever seems convenient.

description:
This massive cavern is packed with goblins.  You see collections of tables and
chairs that form small pubs while some goblins have simply laid out their
wares to sell on a blanket before them.   There is no reason to the madness,
the goblins seem content to just set up wherever seems convenient.

name: The H'Unki Mines
description:
This tunnel is both a means of getting through the mines but it also is the
mines.  Numerous goblins are busy hacking or drilling into the tunnel walls or
making their way down deep into the earth to the other veins below you.   A
great heat rises from the floor.

name: The H'Unki Mines
description:
The system of caverns is amazing.  The goblins seem to prefer to just blast
throw a piece of rock and continue blasting down rather than slowly move down
level by level.  They use crude rope ladders to lift their treasures and
themselves out of the holes.  You wonder just how far down they go.

name: The H'Unki Homecaves
description:
This wider tunnel is both a means of transit throughout the city but also
appears to be the living area of the goblins.  There is little concept of
personal space as numerous goblins sleep in makeshift beds next to one other
and large groups are crowded around cooking pits that seem to heat the food
rather than actually cook it.

name: The H'Unki Homecaves
description:
This massive cavern is really just one large room where the residents of the
city sleep.  There are hundreds of goblins here, most of them sitting on
makeshift beds or pillows while they play odd games or talk.  Some just sleep,
exhausted after hours working down in the mine or trying to sell their goods
up in the commons cavern.

name: The H'Unki Library
description:
This small room has been carved from the tunnels, offering an interesting
library.  There are no bookshelves or even piles of books but rather small
cubby's have been slashed into the walls for the books and various scrolls.
The collection of books is actually quite amazing, most of them seem to be
hand-written accounts of various goblin's outing into the wider world.

name: A Massive Alcove
description:
This is the only room you have seen that has any measure of privacy. There are
dozens of thick curtains and paper walls that form small rooms and private
parlors.  There is no shortage of fine food or wine and several servants are
making themselves busy preparing more food.  A huge iron throne sits in the
far back, fit for a giant but occupied by a small goblin.

name: A Spooky Path
description:
A dark path can barely be seen through all the undergrowth.  Most of the
vegetation around here is dead and withered.  Although the wind is slight, you
hear a moaning sound in the trees.

description:

hear a moaning sound in the trees.  North of here is a small gate, which

name: Inside The Grounds
description:
You stand amongst the ruins of old grave sites.  No leaves remain on any of
the trees, and the only vegetation living are some thorny weeds.  An old
church stands before you, slowly losing the battle against time.  South of you
is the gate out of here.  North is the old wooden doors of the church.

name: The Foyer
description:
The foyer of the old church is very run down.  Splinters lay where benches
once stood, and shards of colorful glass indicate that once-beautiful
stained-glass windows were once in place here.  Cobwebs fill the corners.  You
feel disturbed when you realize that something has walked through the dust
recently.

name: The Cloak Room
description:
This small room has what looks like several rotting wood pegs set into the
wall.  Some lumps of old cloth are gathered about on the floor under them.
This must of been a place for the worshippers to hang cloaks and robes.

name: The Confessional
description:
This small room only fits one person.  It isn't as dark in here as the rest of
the church seems to be, and a feeling of relief settles into your bones.  You
could probably rest in here without worrying about the other residents
bothering you.

name: Prayer Room
description:
This small room is almost bare, except for a small wooden stand and the few
remaining tatters of some cloth wall hangings.

name: Hallway
description:
Small candles light your way down this hallway.  You feel a little unnerved
when the wind blows one out and it re-lights itself a few seconds later.

name: Church Hall
description:
You stand amongst the rotting pews of the old church hall.  Many small candles
illuminate scary old statues and the remains of broken stained-glass windows.
You see the altar to the north of the hall.

name: Priests Quarters
description:
This small chamber houses the remains of a bed and some other old wooden
furniture.  The priest of this church must of used this room as his living
quarters.

name: The Altar
description:
You stand in front of a large stone altar.  A feeling of safety washes over
your body as you gaze upon the holy symbols carved into the top.  Something
looks strange about a crack around the bottom of the altar however...
A large spiral staircase, blocked by a  black steel gate, leads up into
darkness.  A plain looking wooden door is placed behind the altar to the
north.  A dull, bronze sign is nailed into the center of the northern door.

name: The Store Room
description:
An old store room is now empty, having been looted quite some time ago.  Some
bits of trash still lie in the middle of the floor, however.

name: Under The Altar
description:
You are in a small alcove under the altar.  The stench of long dead creatures
fills the air.  Bones are scattered about the floor, along with equipment used
in embalming.  This must be the catacombs of the small church!  You feel
fairly secure here, but the idea of moving on further into the dark makes you
nervous.

name: Catacomb Hallways
description:
The hallway of the catacomb is dark and cold.  Old bones lie on the floor,
disturbed from their rest in the alcoves on the wall by looters or worse
creatures.  The sounds of moans and shuffling feet come from the darkness.

The hallway of the catacomb is dark and cold.  Old bones lie on the floor,
disturbed from their rest in the alcoves on the wall by looters or worse
creatures.  The sounds of moans and shuffling feet come from the darkness.

litter and bones shows that looters have definitely been here before.

name: Inner Catacomb Hallways
description:
The hallway of the catacomb is dark and cold.  The litter on the floor here
includes bones that are a bit fresher than those in the outer hallways.
Something must be bringing them here, and from what you remember of the church
above, its surely not priests.

name: Inner Catacomb Hallways
description:
The hallway of the catacomb is dark and cold.  A bright light comes from south
of you.  The cold breeze is strongest here; it must be coming from the room to
the south, but how?

name: Guard Room
description:
This room is surprisingly quite bare and clean.  Torches stay lit on the
walls, despite the strong cold breeze that comes from around the edges of what
appears to be a huge steel trapdoor on the floor.

name: The Entrance Cavern
description:
This cavern has some small magical lights placed in the ceiling, and the sand
of the floor is nice and brushed.  This looks like a good place to rest before
venturing into the dark.

name: Dark Caverns
description:
You wander through the cold dark caverns.  Your light doesn't shine as far as
you'd hope here, and there is a breeze blowing past you, despite the fact that
you are underground.  The whole place gives you a sick feeling.

description:
As you enter this shop, a wizened old ghoul steps forward to the counter.

interest you, no matter how powerful you may be."

name: Thayzar's Back Alley Emporium
description:
This darkened room is more of an alcove in the hallway than an actual store.
You can barely make out the form of a drow in the shadows towards the back of
this cave.

name: Old Stone Hallway
description:
You move about through the old stone hallways of the ghoul kingdom.  Strange
runes are carved onto the walls, writings of ages past.  The feel of powerful
magic wards and spells of protection surge throughout the whole kingdom.

name: Dark Sigil-Covered Hallway
description:
You enter a dark hallway, covered in small gold sigils.  The feeling of magic
hits you especially hard in this location.

name: The Black Room
description:
A large black room, filled with the implements of magic.  Against one wall is
a huge potion-distilling setup.  Across the other wall is a huge case of
various books, most with magical lore you've never even heard or thought
about.  In the center is a magical circle, used to confine experiments to that
section of the room, protecting other occupants from the spells of others.

name: Light Sigil-Covered Hallway
description:
You enter a bright hallway, the walls covered in small silver sigils.  The
feeling of protection spells is so strong here, you feel you are very close to
the source.

name: The White Room
description:
You enter a room filled with a collection of many relics, of the various
religions you have heard about, and some that you don't recognize.  Many
priestess's wander about here, praying, studying, and testing new items they
have discovered.

name: Enchanted Hallway
description:
You have a feeling of safety wash over you as you step into this hallway.
Bright colored lights dance about to a wonderful music that floats through the
air.  A smile comes to your face as you realize you have entered a fantastic
place.

name: Throne Room Of The Ghouls
description:
You step into an ornately decorated throne room, home of the King and Queen of
the Ghoul Kingdom.  Decorations and trophies from all over the Realm stand in
places of honor about the room.  Your eye is drawn to two large thrones,
carved of a strange wood, sitting in the back of the room.

name: The Ghoul Suite
description:
This special room is for the King and Queen of the Ghouls, and any special
guests they may let enter.  A large ebony dining table sits at one end,
surrounded by plush, comfortable chairs.  An inviting pile of sleeping
pillows, crafted of the finest of magical materials, lies at the other end of
the room.  Fantastic decorations hang from the walls and stand on small
pedestals.  What a great place to either have a party or just relax!

name: The Dark Library
description:
You enter a dark room, which obviously belongs to the Master Mage of the
Ghouls.  Many artifacts of extreme power lie about, covered by their own
special spells of protection.  You get the feeling you don't belong in this
room at all.

name: The Light Temple
description:
You step into what appears to be the temple of the High Priestess of the
Ghouls.  You shiver as you realize you are not worthy to even look upon this
room, let alone set foot in it.  You feel like you have made a bad choice
coming here.

name: Ghoul Home
description:
You step into the home-cave of a ghoul family.  Not many possessions lie
about, nothing you are interested at least.  The cave is comfortable and
clean, and you could see the appeal of living in such a place.

name: The Cavern of the Silver Gate
description:
You walk into a bright room, and are nearly blinded by the silver glare that
springs from every corner.  The south wall of the room is made up of a huge
silver gate, with a strange lock.  There are runes carved all around the
gate...you better read them before doing anything else.

name: Dark Slimy Caverns
description:
You stumble about in the dark, tripping over bones of previous visitors.
Strange noises assault you ears and you swear you see things moving that are
not there on a second glance.  You feel what sanity you had left slowly
slipping away the further you walk into the dark.

Foul smells and hideous noises greet you, the results of many ungodly
experiments.  You feel sick to your stomach.

at the edges won't let you turn back the way you came.  To the south appears
to be a door in the rock of some sort, but how to open it, you have no clue.

Strange noises assault you ears and you swear you see things moving that are
not there on a second glance.  You feel what sanity you had left slowly
slipping away the further you walk into the dark.

description:
This cavern echoes with the croakings of various toad's and their brethren.
The floor is slick with a slime on the ground, which makes walking difficult.
Evil chanting fills the air, but you don't see any source for that particular
noise.

name: A Barrier Gate
description:
You stumble about in the dark, tripping over bones of previous visitors.
Strange noises assault you ears and you swear you see things moving that are
not there on a second glance.  You feel what sanity you had left slowly
slipping away the further you walk into the dark.  South of you is a huge
barrier covered in runes of protection.

name: A Barrier Gate
description:
You stumble about in the dark, tripping over bones of previous visitors.
Strange noises assault you ears and you swear you see things moving that are
not there on a second glance.  You feel what sanity you had left slowly
slipping away the further you walk into the dark.  South of you is an even
large gate, with spells of imprisonment weaved around the locks.

name: The Black Pentagram
description:
A wave of pure evil strikes you as you enter this room.  A huge black
pentagram is carved into the rock of the floor here, obviously used to lock
some potent being inside.  Just entering this room will upset the balance of
magical powers here.

name: Room Of The Hero
description:
You step into a brightly lit room, of the likes you've never seen.  Rich food
and drink sit on a huge table to one side of the room, and comfortable chairs
are placed so you can relax.  You stop a moment and realize that this has been
the most exciting moment of your adventuring career up to this point.  Where
to go next?

name: Old Stone Hallway
description:
You move about through the old stone hallways of the ghoul kingdom.  Strange
runes are carved onto the walls, writings of ages past.  The feel of powerful
magic wards and spells of protection surge throughout the whole kingdom.

name: Shajaans -- Main Foyer
description:
Upon walking into the foyer of this large abode, you see a large, orangish
blood stain in the corner of the room. A fierce warrior hangs his blood
stained armor here. The room is furnished with blood red tapestries upon
the walls and floors, and black pelt furniture. The walls are covered in
skins and scales from the battles of this great warrior. Sitting in the
corner of the room is a large liquor cabinet full of some of the most
expensive and exotic alcohols known to the world. The warriors obvious
favorite, absinthe, fills the majority of the cabinet, with a special candle
and sugar to mix in sitting next to it. Glaring down at you is the
decapitated head of the great golden dragon from the south. To the east
can be seen what looks to be a trophy room, and to the west a storage room.

name: Shajaans -- Storage Room
description:
All kinds of armor and weapons are sorted all along the walls and hanging
on racks in the room. The warrior of this home has completed many a
quest and achievements to gather such a large collection of artifacts
and beautiful armor. Contemplating stealing any of this equipment will
bring certain death to that unfortunate soul. Above this room is a
beautiful stained glass mosaic of the warrior slaying the fierce
black dragon. A large voice bellows from the area around and says,
"Get Out!" A cold shiver runs down your spine and you know; you
shouldn't be here.

name: Shajaans -- Trophy Room
description:
This is a great room. Walls are covered in skulls of dragons, and heads
kept as trophy's from the great escapades of this evil warrior. A large
stone round table sits in the middle of this room. Upon the table sits
a grouping of ceremonial candles with a red stained glass candelas sitting
around each candle. The flames flicker and shine through the stained
glass filling the room with a red glowing light. The red light shines
upon the trophies and skulls decapitated and collected by the warrior.
Back to the west is the foyer.

name: The Misty Graveyard
description:
As you step through the dark gateway, you realize that you have stumbled
into some type of graveyard.  The mist flows like water here, hampering your
vision of the ground.  You can however make out what looks like broken
tombstones, and what appears to be an arm.  To the north you see an enormous
obsidian structure, but you will need to move closer for further inspection.
Suddenly you feel something brush by your leg, and quickly step aside only to
hear the crunching of bones.

name: The Misty Graveyard
description:
You are now standing directly in front of the obsidian keep.  Looking both
east and west, you see the walls of the keep stretch onward into the darkness.
You are also able to see what looks to be a tower streaking toward the heavens
through the ceiling in this cavern.  There are no tombstones here, but piles
of bodies are stacked up against the wall.  It would seem that the caretaker
here has more work then he can handle.  You can hear some demonic noises
coming from within the keep, and if you are not careful, you just might end up
with these poor souls against the wall.

name: Main Hall
description:
Immediately you realize the demonic noises you vaguely heard are actually
many demons chanting a long forgotten hymn.  The melody is somewhat soothing
as it echoes down the long dark corridors.  Looking around, you are almost
caught in a state of awe at the beauty of this place.  In a large display case
you see a set of lacquered bone armor, accompanied by a wicked looking helmet,
and the fabled "Bad Karma" long sword.  The floors, walls and ceiling are made
from same obsidian as the exterior of the keep.  Covering the ceiling
you realize that the obsidian has been painted over with pictures of epic
battles and huge beasts.  In the largest picture in this room, a menacing
looking ghoul stands in victory over his prey with one sword raised in the air
and the other still in his victim.  Below this artwork you notice a small imp
writing the words, "The Impaler vs. The Warlord Zanzen".  To the
north it appears that the hallway expands to a much larger room.  There are
also hallways to the east and west, neither more inviting then the other.

name: Entry Hall
description:
You step through a large, black fang-handled door with symbols and markings
that look to have been chewed into the door by some kind of beast.  As you
step forward into this room the door then slams loudly behind you and proceeds
to latch itself closed.  Once into the room, the first thing that you notice
is that across the room there are two large gargoyle statues on either side of
an enormous fire place with a raging black flamed fire burning hotly inside of
it.  Something appears to be on a spit above the flames...it looks to be the
head of something???  In front of the fireplace there is a rug of human skin
roughly stitched together with what appears to be some sort of vine and two
large arm chairs facing the fire.  Along the wall on the right there is a
large blackened book shelf.  It holds many ancient and dusty books.  Off to
the left you see a large black root coming through the ceiling and across to
the corner, with many bottles and a strange looking Ogre barman standing
behind it.  There is another black root that looks to be a stairway that leads
up and to the left.  The handrails are lined with many of the same markings
and symbols as the door.

name: Top Of The Stairs
description:
You enter past two ogres with their mouths stitched close.  As you step into
the room you notice that it is an enchanted room.  Where the ceiling should be
you see the mid-night sky with stars shooting through the sky and swirling
clouds of color dancing through the cosmos above you.  Straight out from the
door in the middle of the room is a contraption that looks like it is to be
used to look at the stars.  The floor of this room is the softest, greenest
grass that you have even seen.  There are vines climbing the walls all around
you.  Off to the right there is a large steaming pool of water with a small
waterfall that drops into it.  Off to the left there appears to be a passage
between the vines into a dark place.

name: Side Chamber
description:
As you come through the vines, they open into a dark canopy, formed from the
under side of a large tree.  The roots seem to cover the ceiling and grow down
the walls.  The floor appears to be the same grass that you saw in the room
prior.  In the center of the room lies a large pile of different skins of dead
animals and beasts.

name: A Dark Passage
description:
You stand in a dark passage.  A rough-hewn stone staircase heads up into
darkness...you can only see the first few steps.  An aura of fear seems to
almost drip down all around you, like some sort of nightmarish coating.  For
some reason, a tired feeling seems to be seeping right through your skin and
lodging itself deep in your body.  Your eyes begin to droop...

name: A Dark Passage
description:
Climbing the stairs into darkness causes you to feel even sleepier.  This must
be the product of powerful magic, since you felt much more rested just a
little while ago.  It seems as if some sort of light is coming from above you,
but maybe it's just your eyes playing tricks with your mind.

name: A Narrow Grassy Trail
description:
This narrow trail weaves its way through the tall grass of the plains.  To the
north, you see fields stretch out before you.  You spot what appears to be
herds of animals located about the field.  South of you, the Plains Road
stretches for some way.

description:
This narrow trail weaves its way through the tall grass of the plains.  To the
north, you see fields stretch out before you.  You spot what appears to be
herds of animals located about the field.  The trail ends abruptly here, lost
amongst the tall grass.

description:

signs of trampling, probably by the large herds of animals you notice moving
about.  The buzz of insects fills the air about you.

name: An Old Mineshaft
description:
You stand in a narrow mineshaft, dark and cold.  Remnants of old mine-car
tracks can be seen, but they show the signs of great age.  The chirping of
bats echos about the halls.  The breeze passes through here with a low moaning
sound.

name: An Old Mineshaft
description:
You stand at the bottom of a steeply cut mineshaft.  A couple of old minecarts
sit here, left smashed at the bottom of the shaft.  The mine itself heads
east.  The chirping of bats echos about the halls.  The breeze passes through
here with a low moaning sound.

name: Wandering The Mines Of Ironholde
description:
You wander an old mithril mine, left long ago by the dwarves of Ironholde.
Occasionally you see old tools used for mining, but they are all destroyed by
age.  The chirping of bats echos about the halls.  The breeze passes through
here with a low moaning sound.

You wander an old mithril mine, left long ago by the dwarves of Ironholde.
Occasionally you see old tools used for mining, but they are all destroyed by
age.  The chirping of bats echos about the halls.  The breeze passes through
here with a low moaning sound.

name: On A Copper Path
description:
This road is paved in copper that has now faded and cracked.  The trees begin
to thin as to the west you see a collection of ruins.  The air smells of decay
and rot.  The animals seem to avoid this place and you swear you just heard a
slight groan rise into the air.

name: The Road Of Ihra-Desh
description:
You are standing inside what is left of the great ghoul Kingdom of Ihra-Desh.
The massive stone buildings have now crumbled into nothing.  The ground is
littered with the wasted remains of ghouls and humans.  You see the remains of
children and what appear to be unarmed ghouls.  The battle here that place was
a slaughter.

name: A Ruined Building
description:
This building is scarred from the battle and the roof is now mostly gone.
Several birds flutter about as you make your way through.  Judging by the
skeletons on the floor and the numerous arrows and weapons strewn about, a
group of ghouls made their last stand.

name: A Scarred Hallway
description:
This hallway is heavily damaged from the battle that took place.  The
skeletons are numerous and you can recognize both Imperial armor and ghoulish
armor as well.  The numerous bodies suggest that these ghouls fought hard to
hold this hallway.

name: A Destroyed Church
description:
This ancient church is covered in broken statues. The few that remain show a
figure quite similar to Drazuk as well as a six-armed god with three eyes.
The stained glass windows are all shattered, the pews destroyed, and the great
altar of gold melted and partially looted. The bodies of numerous people
litter this once holy place.

name: Inside A Ruined Hallway
description:
This massive hallway leads into the largest of the buildings. This is one of
the few that still looks like it can still be considered habitable.  There are
hundreds upon hundreds of skeletons and pieces of destroyed armor, simply
walking requires crushing numerous skulls and rib cages.  It looks like the
last stage of the battle took place here.

name: A Burned Nursery
description:
You thank everything you can think to thank that this atrocity took place
hundreds of years ago. This was once a nursery, you can see the burned remains
of cradles and toys. The army of Ihra-Desh took great care to defend this
place but in the end they failed.

name: The Last Stand
description:
This massive hall was probably the seat of power for the ghoul rulers. The
massive tables are destroyed, splintered apart after the barricade fell.
There are thousands of bones here, the last of the ghouls to inhabit this
great kingdom died here. They had no hope of victory or escape but judging by
the ratio of broken Imperial armor to ghoulish armor, they put up one hell of
a fight.

massive tables are destroyed, splintered apart after the barricade fell.
There are thousands of bones here, the last of the ghouls to inhabit this
great kingdom died here. They had no hope of victory or escape but judging by
the ratio of broken Imperial armor to ghoulish armor, they put up one hell of
a fight.

name: Inside A Ruined Hallway
description:
This massive hallway leads into the largest of the buildings. This is one of
the few that still looks like it can still be considered habitable.  There are
hundreds upon hundreds of skeletons and pieces of destroyed armor, simply
walking requires crushing numerous skulls and rib cages.  It looks like the
last stage of the battle took place here.

name: An Empty Library
description:
This large hall must have once been a grand library, filled with tomes of this
place's history and its people.  Now it is empty save for ash and bones. A
great fire was set here.  You can see half burned books that are now being
eaten away by time.  So much knowledge destroyed.

name: Standing In A Cave
description:
You stand in a large cave.  The surrounding rock has been worked extensively,
with dwarven runes and art carved into the mountain walls.  This area looks
like it receives heavy traffic, as you can see many different types of
footprints in the dirt.  To the west, the cave opens out into the Ironkore
Pass.  The passageway also continues further east.

name: A Passage Under The Mountain
description:
You journey down a well-lit passageway under the mountain.  Dwarven runes are
carved into the stone walls.  You are occasionally passed by a dwarf heading
somewhere on some errand.  Steps are carved into the rock floor to make it
easy to travel about.

name: Wandering Ironholde
description:
You walk amongst the fantastic stone halls of the city of Ironholde.  Dwarves
move about with purpose paying no attention to your presence.  The sounds of
conversations and machinery echo around, bouncing off of the ceiling high
above you.  The halls are brightly lit with magical lights that float about.

name: Castle Ironholde
description:
You stand in the hallways of the Castle Ironholde.  Important dwarven
officials move about quickly on various types of business.  The castle guards
seem to take a bit of interest in your presence, but not enough to leave their
posts.

name: Throne Room
description:
You stand in the throne room of Castle Ironholde.  A majestic throne, hewn
right from the living rock of the mountain stands tall before you.  Dwarven
runes of protection are carved up and down its surface.  Trophies of battle
can be found about the room...its almost a museum of battle!

name: A Dark Narrow Passage
description:
This small passage isn't as well traveled as the others in Ironholde, and
lacks the magical lights.  Remnants of an old mine-cart track is seen set
along the floor, although it looks like it hasn't been used in ages.  It's
quite cold and dark down here.

name: The Bearded Lady
description:
This noisy room can only be a pub.  Dwarves line the tables, drinking deeply
from large bronze mugs.  Singing and shouting ring out throughout the room.
You even spot some good-natured brawling going on in a back corner.  This
looks like a good place to get some chow and a drink!

name: Mighty Mithril
description:
This shop must be the local weapon forge.  Huge dwarven hammers and axes hang
from the walls, and even swords and other bladed weapons can be bought or sold
here.  A large fire burns in the back corner, heating the metal to make it
easy to work with.  A large anvil takes up most of the room, with lots of room
for several dwarves to work around it.

name: Kragoths Mountain Gear
description:
This small shop seems to contain gear mostly made for mountaineering use.
Paintings of several dwarves on top of famous peaks line one wall.  From the
tales you've heard, Kragoths gear is the best to have when battling the rough
mountains of the realm.

name: Temple Of The Rock
description:
Ahhh, the Temple of the Rock!  Equipping the famous dwarven battleclerics for
centuries, you hope to find something that can help you defeat the creatures
of the realm here.  From magical supplies to weapons, many useful things can
be bought in this shop.

name: Placeholder
description: Placeholder

name: The Waterspout
description:
You float in the middle of a large swirling waterspout, the winds pulling you
in an upward direction.  A bright light shines down from you above, and as far
as you can tell, you are headed upwards towards a large collection of puffy
clouds.

name: Floating Above The Sea
description:
Tumbling amongst the fluffy clouds, you move amongst the wispy remains of
happy, singing jellyfish.  Bright, warm light shines down from the blue skies
above you.  A salty scent is carried about by the warm breeze that gently
swirls about you as you move amongst the heavens.

happy, singing jellyfish.  Bright, warm light shines down from the blue skies
above you.  A salty scent is carried about by the warm breeze that gently
swirls about you as you move amongst the heavens.

name: A Spiral Cloud
description:
This strange, spiraling cloud connects a brightly-lit group of clouds with the
larger cloudmass hovering over the sea.  From here, you can see what appears
to be some sort of gate above you.

name: A Silvery Gate
description:
At the top of the cloud staircase, a large silvery gate stands, closed.
Beyond the gate you can see what appears to be a whispy passageway, that opens
up into chambers carved out of the clouds themselves.  The staircase heads
back down to the large cloudmass that floats above the sea.

name: A Brightly Lit Cloud
description:
This bright passageway tunnels down the heart of a large cloud.  The sun
outside causes the walls to glow warmly.  Back west, you see a large silvery
gate.  The passage continues to the east.

name: A Brightly Lit Cloud
description:
This bright passageway tunnels down the heart of a large cloud.  The sun
outside causes the walls to glow warmly.  The passageway leads back towards
the west, but it opens up here into what appears to be three large chambers.

name: Cloud Chamber
description:
This large chamber appears to be carved directly out of a large cloud.  The
walls glow warmly from the sun outside.  Apparently this is some sort of place
where souls gather when they feel like being social.

name: Cloud Chamber
description:
This large chamber appears to be carved directly out of a large cloud.  The
walls glow warmly from the sun outside.  Apparently this is some sort of place
where souls gather when they feel like being social.

name: Cloud Throne Room
description:
This large chamber appears to be carved directly out of a large cloud.  The
walls glow warmly from the sun outside.  A large, whispy throne rises out of
the cloud on the east side of the chamber.  For being created from cloud, it
is surprisingly detailed with small sculptures of tentacled creatures.

name: Dont Change This Room
description: You stumble into a newly created room.

name: A Twisty Path
description:
A narrow and twisty path works its way through and under the thick growth of
the jungle.  Small insects buzz about, annoying in their own special ways.
From all around, the sounds of various critters shriek, growl, chirp and
snort.  It is difficult to see anything further down the path, due to all the
plant life.  The path opens up to a larger road to the north.

name: Room name
description: You stumble into a newly created room.

name: Past The Cave Gate
description:
This area is far more guarded than outside of the gate. Numerous gnomes and a
few dwarves are constantly running about. Huge machines that resemble golems
are walking about, the gnome or dwarf riders watching you intently.  There are
numerous heavily fortified positions for archers or crossbowmen to take up
should the gate be reached. Judging by the clock like machine at the very top
of the cavern, more than just bolts and sword defend this place.

name: Inside A Grooved Tunnel
description:
This tunnel is large enough for an army to pass through with ease. Numerous
people are making their way to and fro. Some are heading into the city while
others seem to be preparing to make a trek outside. The ceiling is some fifty
feet above you and you can make out a system of cat-walks and smaller
tunnels.

name: At An Intersection Of Tunnels.
description:
This must be one of the main intersections of tunnels inside the city. To the
north is a smaller tunnel with numerous rows of gas-powered torches.  To the
south is another tunnel that is lighted by hundreds of small crystals that
seem to feed off some form of energy. To the east the massive grooved tunnel
continues deeper into the cave.

name: Inside A Smaller Tunnel
description:
This tunnel is significantly tighter than the other.  You can see that the
walls are lined with tubes made of copper that have small candles placed just
above them.  Holes in these tubes then slowly allow some kind of gas to keep
the candle lit.  It all seems shielded for stability with some sort of magik.
The sound of machinery is louder as you go deeper into the tunnel.
