name: Inside A Runed Tunnel
description:
This tunnel is wildly decorated with numerous dwarven ruins. The walls are
covered in crystals that seem to slightly hum.  As you walk past you notice
some grow brighter.  There are many more dwarves wandering about now than
before and for the first time you spot a child or two wandering about.

name: Inside The Arcane Sanctum
description:
This section of the city is wildly adorned with runes: dwarven, gnomish,
ghoulish, and even some elvish ones.  The large crystal filled cables seem to
be the thickest here.  You can feel the amount of energy being produced.

name: A Make-Shift Throne Room
description:
The once mighty queen of the Dwarves now makes her home in this humble room.
The floor is carpeted with a thick layer of moss, the walls adorned with great
weapons and armours. While much more lavishly decorated than anything else
inside the city, it seems drab and humble lodging for a great matriarch. On
the iron throne there are numerous words inscribed.

name: The Seat Of Magi
description:
The walls of this room are simple.  Numerous cables run in and out of it as
several elvish and ghoulish mages rest inside what appear to be chairs. They
twitch and chant but from the cables running into the odd metal chairs to the
wall, it seems that you have found the source of the shielding that keeps the
Eye stable.

name: An Access Portal
description:
This room is heavily guarded and the walls are layered in thick metal and
numerous protection ruins.  Every few minutes a ghoul or elf or a gnome will
materialize inside, overloaded with different supplies from food to medical
supplies. It seems this is one of the few ways to quickly escape or enter the
city.  This room must not be shielded by the same magiks that prevent astral
travel.

name: Entrance To The Dock
description:
The sound of machinery is almost deafening. To the east you can see a huge
dock where the Battle-Wards and Ethernaughts are built, maintained, and
stored. Numerous gnomes and dwarves shuffle about, carrying tools, parts,
crystals, and  anything else they need to get these awesome machines moving.

name: The Dock
description:
This cavern is monstrous.  The ceiling is at least 300 feet above you and the
entire cavern is packed with various machines.  There must be hundreds upon
hundreds of these massive battle machines that are neatly stored in the air on
racks or on the ground being serviced.  This area is extremely busy.

name: The Dwarven Shelter
description:
The Dwarves of Sorrow's Path have long since been without a home. Their great
fortress to the west was taken and their great city destroyed and turned into
a strip mine.  Their gnome kin have not forgotten them and provided them a
place to stay, raise a family, and one day strike back against the Imperial
forces and take what is rightfully theirs.  This large system of caves are not
the most comfortable but by all the paintings, carpets, fireplaces, and other
dwarven decorations, they have settled into their home quite nicely.

description:

their way past you and you even see a few with metal wings on, working
on a complex system of cables. The sound of clockwork is everywhere.

name: The Eye
description:
This monstrous machine is suspended by a dozen floating orbs of pure energy.
It is constantly turning and spinning, judging by the constant bursts of color
and sparks, this machine is what keeps you from being able to astral travel
out of here.  It also seems to be powering the rest of this place. An
impressive feat, but what is powering the orbs that is keeping this thing
contained?

name: An Access Portal
description:
This room is heavily guarded and the walls are layered in thick metal and
numerous protection ruins.  Every few minutes a ghoul or elf or a gnome will
materialize inside, overloaded with different supplies from food to medical
supplies. It seems this is one of the few ways to quickly escape or enter the
city.  This room must not be shielded by the same magiks that prevent astral
travel.

name: The Kinterownt Library
description:
This massive alcove is dedicated to the storage of the city's knowledge. You
see books on magik, on history, on metallurgy and even on blacksmithing. The
amount of knowledge collected here is just amazing. You could spend a lifetime
here.

name: The Nursery
description:
With a city like this, full of huge walking machines, exposed magikal energy
and not to mention the constant threat of attack, it would make sense that the
people of the city have created a large place to keep their children during
the day.

name: The Steel Throne
description:
This is the throne room of the Gnome Lords. Every person to lead these people
in battle and peace has resided inside this great hall.  There are hundreds of
paintings, some on the walls, some on the ceilings, some on the great pillars
that support this room.  All of them depict some great gnome hero or great
gnome victory.  Numerous armours, weapons, and machines line the hall in a
glorious display of might.

name: A Steep Mountain Trail
description:
A small trail seems to lead up into the rocks to the north of the pass.  The
going looks very tough, but you can spy a small cave opening quite a ways up
the mountain.  A short climb to the south lies the main pass.

name: A Steep Mountain Trail
description:
A small trail seems to lead up into the rocks to the north of the pass.  The
going looks very tough, but you can spy a small cave opening quite a ways up
the mountain.  The boulders give you good handholds on your way up.

name: A Steep Mountain Trail
description:

going looks very tough, but you can spy a small cave opening quite a ways up
the mountain.  The boulders give you good handholds on your way up.

name: A Steep Mountain Trail
description:

going looks very tough, but you can spy a small cave opening quite a ways up
the mountain.  The boulders give you good handholds on your way up.

name: A Steep Mountain Trail
description:
A small trail seems to lead up into the rocks to the north of the pass.  The
going looks very tough, but you can spy a small cave opening quite a ways up
the mountain.  A small plateau justs out here, and you can stop and take a
breath.  Above you, you can see the cave opening you spied from below.  Down
and a bit south of you, you can see light traffic on the pass.

name: A Steep Mountain Trail
description:

going looks very tough, but you can spy a small cave opening quite a ways up
the mountain.  The boulders give you good handholds on your way up.

name: A Small Dark Opening
description:
You stand in front of a small opening in the mountain to the north.  It is
quite dark inside, and you can't quite make out anything inside.  The wind is
colder up here, and whips about you, making a whistling sound come from the
cave entrance.

name: A Small Mineshaft
description:
You stand within the remnants of a small mineshaft.  While most of the posts
and rails look unused and rundown, you swear you can still hear the clinking
of miners about you.  Dust floats about the passageway, and the air is quite
cool.

You stand within the remnants of a small mineshaft.  While most of the posts
and rails look unused and rundown, you swear you can still hear the clinking
of miners about you.  Dust floats about the passageway, and the air is quite
cool.

name: A Low Tunnel
description:
This tunnel seems quite different then the mineshaft itself.  It is carved a
bit smaller than the previous passageways, but looks sturdy and clean.  It's
just the right height for the kobolds.

cleanliness of the caverns about you.  The bones that lie about shine white,
they are so clean.

name: The Top Of A Waterfall
description:
The current is incredibly strong here as the water floods down the sharp
cliffs to the lagoon below.  To the south, the river flows from a large lake
surrounded by mountains.  There is no where else to go save for the lake or
back down the cliffs to the river.

name: To The Lake
description:
The current is weakening from the waterfall to the north and the lake spreads
out to the south.  The water is oddly warm, the river water was actually
cooler.  However, the humidity is not so bad at this altitude and the warm
water feels good after the long climb.

name: To The Lake
description:

name: Lake M'otuco
description:
The lake spreads out in a placid scene.  The water is dark, it is hard to see
more than a few feet below the surface.  The water is warm and inviting, it
seems this would be the ideal place to rest and relax.  The lake is cupped by
the odd mountain range, the lake is almost a perfect bowl.   The smooth and
sloped edge of the mountains make it impossible to climb over.

description:
The water is even warmer as you move your way down into the depths of the
lake.  The water is clouded by a fine layer of grit and dirt, blocking out the
light.  The water feels heavy and you wonder how deep this lake goes and if
anything can survive the darkness and the pressure.

name: The Lake Floor
description:
The water is heavy and thick with dust and some kind of tiny animals.   The
floor of the lake is oddly smooth and fine, yet it makes movement harder as
the sand gives way to your slightest pressure.  There is a wide variety of
creatures that seem to live at this depth, immune to the heat, the darkness,
and the pressure.

name: A Burning Cave
description:
This strange cave is hot, incredibly hot.  There is a strange glow, a soft
muted red or orange that seeps from below the sand.  Bubbles of grit, dirt,
and heat are constantly coming up from the sand below, it seems this is the
source of the heat in the lake.  From the fish bones and crude nests, this is
a Plesiosaurs home.

name: Path Through Small Dunes
description:
A small path weaves its way amongst the small dunes.  Far to the north, the
shimmering sands of the Talon desert stretch for miles.  Small growths of
desert shrubs are scattered about the sandy trail.  Many footprints have
traveled this way, and the sand is trampled to a hard, flat surface.

name: A Small Military Camp
description:
The trail opens up into a clearing, where a small military camp has been
built.  Soldiers move about, readying armor and cleaning weapons.  A temporary
guard stand has been set up here, mainly to greet arriving soldiers and direct
them to their posts.

name: A Small Military Camp
description:
You stand in a clearing, where a small military camp has been built.  Soldiers
move about, readying armor and cleaning weapons.  A large tent has been set up
here, a mess tent from the looks of it.  Soldiers stand around a large cook
fire, chatting and eating.

name: A Small Military Camp
description:
You stand in a clearing, where a small military camp has been built.  Soldiers
move about, readying armor and cleaning weapons.  Many soldiers lie on cots
here, and from the screams and the blood, you deduce this must be some sort of
combat surgery.  You note there are more covered bodies than screaming bodies.

name: A Small Military Camp
description:
The trail opens up into a clearing, where a small military camp has been
built.  Soldiers move about, readying armor and cleaning weapons.  A barricade
with a gate headed north stands here, and many soldiers man the hastily built
wall.  The soldiers are quiet and seem quite tense.

name: A Wide Bloody Path
description:
A wide path has been trampled through the small dunes.  Much blood has been
spilt on the sand, and there is much evidence of hard and recent combat here.
Shattered weapons, broken armor, and an occaisonal dead body mark the edges of
the field of war.  The sounds of crashing metal and fighting men echoes
faintly through the dunes east of you.

name: The Field Of Combat

fighting to the death, stretch out as far as the eye can see in all
directions.  Broken weapons and dead and wounded lie about the ground, making

air.

description:
You stand upon a smooth and clear area of beach.  This is where the enemies
from the Eastern lands have put their boats ashore.  Small fires burn where
temporary camps have been setup.  Various pieces of equipment to build seige
machines sit about in piles, waiting to be constructed.

name: The Road to Learei
description:
The forest seems to pull back to reveal a small city of trees and a few
scattered ground level buildings.  You can make out a few very tall trees that
are covered in banners and flags.  The road is well traveled and heavily
patrolled.

name: The Main Road of Learei
description:
This is the main road that goes through all of Learei.  The buildings blend
perfectly into the forest that surrounds the area, offering a great amount of
camoflauge as well as natural defenses.  Numerous pixies float about while you
notice there are also numerous half-orc servants and even a few younger
ones playing games back and forth

name: The Half-orc Ghetto
description:
The rooms of these buildings are little more than huts.  The room and walls
have large holes in them that let rain, snow, and whatever else in.  There are
numerous spiders and snake and a cold draft seems to always be floating by.
The half-orcs that live here are quiet as they rest from a hard day of working
for the pixies, if you could call it working, others would call it slavery.

numerous spiders and snake and a cold draft seems to always be floating by.

for the pixies, if you could call it working, others would call it slavery.

name: A Pixie Home
description:
This pixie residence is built into the very trees of the forest itself. While
it is not large enough for a normal size person to feel comfortable, it is
perfect for a pixie.  The half-orc servant has to duck and constantly be aware
of the vases and other breakables inside the house.  The pixie master watches
with a cold eye.

name: A Run Down Shop
description:
This shop is poorly constructed and mainted with the same zeal. It is merely a
shack constructed with several pieces of thin wood and held together with
rusty nails and twine.  Yet the shop itself seems to do good business and you
notice it is mostly the half-orcs that frequent it.

name: The Imperial Blacksmith
description:
This shop is one of the few that is constucted with metal and stone rather
than wood or fashioned out of a tree. A huge furnace sits in the back along
with all the tools needed for a smart blacksmith to make a good living.  The
smell of burning coal and steel is heavy.

name: A Burnt Tree
description:
This shop shows sign of a fire or other accident.  The bark of the tree is
blackened and the branches that form the floor seem a bit charred.  The smell
of sulfur and smoke is still heavy in the air.  Judging by all the potions and
components sitting on the shelves, the owner of the shop is responisble.

name: The Singing Fae
description:
This beautiful pub is built upon a massive oak tree.  Their is plenty of room
for dozens of half-orcs as well as three times as many pixies.  However, you
see only pixies and a few Imperial soldiers drinking here.  The few half-orcs
that are here are either guards or servants, loading in a new shipment of ale
or wine.

name: A Massive Tree of Emerald
description:
This mighty tree has the color of a precious gem. It is at least ten times
thicker than oak or sequioa. Numerous important looking pixies and Imperial
officers make their way up the tree. The pixies have an easier time of it but
they politely added several foot holds that make climbing the tree easier.

name: A Massive Tree of Emerald
description:

thicker than oak or sequioa. Numerous important looking pixies and Imperial

they politely added several foot holds that make climbing the tree easier.

name: The Mayor's Branch
description:
This large Branch is dedicated to the office of the mayor of Learei.  The room
is filled with numerous shiny objects, baubles, and other things that seem
more for entertainment that any actual business matter.

name: The Void
description: You are floating in nothing.

name: Limbo
description:
You float in a formless void, detached from all sensation of physical
matter, surrounded by swirling glowing light which fades into the
relative darkness around you without any trace of edge or shadow.

name: Storage
description: This room is reserved for storage of polymorphed players.

name: Storage
description: This room is reserved for future use.

name: Hell
description:
Now you've done it... the gods must have truly forsaken you, to have sent
you straight to hell!
   It is highly advised to wait here to make your appeal to the wrath of the
gods... or face being damned to hell for all eternity!

name: Darwin's study
description:
The room is decorated with various-sized paintings of strange and exotic
creatures from all over the realm. There is a large desk near the center of
the room that is covered with various scraps of paper and notes. A large
"To do" list lies on top of the scattered mess. After taking it all in, you
realize that there isn't much to see in this room. You can't even find the
door. Better make yourself comfy.

name: A dark void
description: It's dark. Very dark.

name: The Arena
description:
You find yourself on the Arena floor.  The roar of the crowd above you
is overwhelming, while around you ... your opponent awaits your coming.

name: The Arena
description:
You stand in the direct center of the Arena.  Blood pools around your
feet, and you almost slip in this morbid mess.  The stench of death
surrounds you, momentarily blocking from your mind the realization
that you could be attacked from any conceivable direction.  Spinning
slowly about, you realize the poor tactical position you hold.

name: The Arena
description:
You find yourself beneath the floor of the great Arena.  The crowd's roar
above is overwhelming, while somewhere ahead ... your opponent awaits.

name: The Arena
description:
You find yourself above the floor of the Arena.  The roar of the crowd
is overwhelming, while somewhere ahead of you ... your opponent awaits.

name: The Arena
description:
You are somewhere above or below the arena floor.  The sound of the crowd
around you is overwhelming, while somewhere ... your opponent awaits.

name: The Halls of Combat
description:
You stand in a massive hallway before the great Arena.  Cheers and jeers
from the assembled throngs rise and fall through the corridors.  Lounging
around the hall with you are several other individuals awaiting their own
chance at glory, honor, and spoils beyond the great doors.  The Arena is
dangerous, though, and battles are often to the death.  Once you leave
this room, there is no turning back.....

name: First Combatant's Chamber
description:
You stand in a long hallway leading out into the Arena proper.  About
you are stacked all manner of weaponry and armor.  Choose your armament
properly, as it will be all that stands between you and death.

name: Second Combatant's Chamber
description:

you are stacked all manner of weaponry and armor.  Choose your armament
properly, as it will be all that stands between you and death.

name: On A Small Road
description:
You stand upon a small road.  To the east rises the mighty Ironkore mountains.
 Many strange creatures make their home in the Ironkores, and the dwarves
claim one of the larger peaks as their home.  A cool breeze blows past you,
and you pull your cloak closer about you.  The eastern entrance of Alden
lies to the west.

name: Climbing The Ironkores
description:
You are following a small road that travels up and through the Ironkore
mountain range.  The going is rather tough, for at some points you find
yourself climbing up and over boulders that have fallen to block the path.
The higher you climb, the colder it gets, and the wind sometimes threatens to
blow you about as it whips through the pass.

name: A Path Through The Dense Jungle
description:
You stumble along this path which has many dense plants growing all over.
Ferns and small trees make it very difficult to navigate.  It slowly get more
hot and humid as you get closer, you can hear the sounds of dragons in the
distance.

An old sign is here in very bad shape, you should look at it.

name: At The Base Of A Massive Canyon
description:
You slowly walk through the base of a massive canyon, the grade of the slope
is taking you down further into the jungle.  You can hear the sounds of
dragons all around you.  You walk in a shallow stream and feel the small
little fish brush past your feet.  You look up to the top of the canyon, it
has a thick canopy from the trees; little places here and there you can see
the sun shine through.

A warm breeze from the south is blowing.

name: In The Dense Jungle
description:
You step into the dense jungle; there is little sign of a path here.  You feel
a mist spraying you as you get closer and closer to what sounds to be a
waterfall.  You try to look ahead but can't see anything special.  You do seem
to notice that it looks like a mountain is forming to the west of you and
there may be something neat there.

name: Mysterria Falls
description:
You stand at the bottom of this large waterfall.  You look to the north of you
and you can see the lake extend outward, it looks to be quite shallow though.
 Behind the waterfall something catches your eye it looks to be ice.  A cool
breeze blows from behind the waterfall.

name: Mysterria Lake
description:
You wade through the lake careful not to step on anything or be too loud.  You
can see many dragons up ahead and they all look quite mean.  One looks over in
your direction, which startles you a bit, but you continue on.  To the west
you can see a small shrine of some sort, and to the north you can see what
appears to be a small castle.

name: The Dragon Shrine
description:
You stand in a small and very badly damaged shrine.  It emits a dim blue light
from within.  You come into the center of the shrine and see an altar with a
badly torn book on it.  Behind the altar there is a crest of the dragon
knights, you think this is where they camped.  This place has very strong
protection spells.

name: The Ice Caverns
description:
You stand in the small ice cavern and feel very cold.  You see many dragons
around you, which scare you quite a bit.  You look all around you at the ice
and see its beauty.

small cave glowing.  It gets hotter as you get closer.  The sky is gray and

description:
You stand in the entrance to the cave.  Many dragons are around you blowing
their fire breath in your direction as a warning.  You look up ahead and see a
small locked gate with a big dragon locked behind it.

name: The Fire Cave
description:
You stand in the middle of the fire beasts now.  You make your way closer to
the gate to see what is behind it.  As you come closer so do the dragons, the
ground is black from the fire.

name: In A Small Cell
description:
You stand before the largest dragon you have ever seen.  He looks straight at
you then attacks.  The room is very small and black from his fire.

name: The Dragon Palace
description:
You stand in small and not very ornate palace.  It is basic, a throne and many
suits of armor on the walls.  The dragon king looks straight at you and
motions to the men on both sides of him towards you.

name: Approaching The Docks
description:
The sea settles and gives way to a massive port.  You can see a series of
docks directly to the south, dozens of ships loading and unloading their
treasures.  You cannot directly identify all of the ships bearing flags you
are not familiar with.   The sound of seagulls and the smell of salt water and
cooking meat fill the air.

name: The Docks Of Niralis
description:
The sturdy wooden docks sway slightly with the soft current of the sea.  The
planks seem to be held together with thick vines that feel like leather.
Dozens of merchants, mercenaries, travellers, and missionaries are wandering
about, trying to get their cargo loaded or unloaded.

name: A Plank
description:
This thick piece of wood is wrapped in strands of steel.  It is large enough
for a cart to be moved up and down and sturdy enough to support the several
people climbing up to the ship or climbing down to the docks.  It is gently
balanced against the side of the ship, secured with only a rope.

name: The Dautlus
description:
This small cruiser looks well prepared for anything.  The sides are covered in
various shields, better to deflect the glancing blows of arrows or bolts.  The
ship looks to be designed for the purpose of exploration and war, several
large minotaurs patrol around, yelling out orders and securing the mast.

name: An Imperial Cruiser
description:
This small battle cruiser looks to be manned by the Imperial forces under
Zanzen. The sails are painted with a bright red Z and the crew all wear the
standard Imperial armor and weaponry.  The ship looks to have taken a beating
in some battle at sea and managed to limp its way here.  A few minotaurs and
goblin engineers are busy trying to fix the damage while ignoring the
rhetoric of the officers.

name: Inside Niralis
description:
The city of Niralis expands out in all directions.  A bazaar has set up among
the stone and clay buildings, merchants hawking their wares and a lucky few
that have managed to set up shop in a permanent location.  You can see no sign
of any race dominating the city, it is clear it is not controlled by any
specific race or organization.  You see mostly wolfen and goblin travellers
with a few minotaurs as well.  The occasional gith can be seen as well.

chairs and tables are all much smaller than even a human could be comfortable
in.  This of course does not stop the goblins from having a good time.  They
drink and feast while singing songs of homes deep within the eastern
mountains.   A few wolfen are taking a seat in the back, sitting on the floor
and enjoying several plates of goblin cuisine.

name: Inside Niralis
description:
The city of Niralis expands out in all directions.  A bazaar has set up among
the stone and clay buildings, merchants hawking their wares and a lucky few
that have managed to set up shop in a permanent location.  You can see no sign
of any race dominating the city, it is clear it is not controlled by any
specific race or organization.  You see mostly wolfen and goblin travellers
with a few minotaurs as well.  The occasional gith can be seen as well.

comfortably enjoy themselves.  The smell of roasting meat and heavy ales fill
the air.  An enchanted group of instruments provide the music and a few quite
seductive wolfen and goblin serving girls wink as they pass by.  You notice
the pale skinned gith working the counter.

south of the great city.

and the sanctity of the altar.  This would be an excellent place to relax
after such a long journey.

sterile and cold.

name: The Niralis Ghettos
description:
Beyond the alleys and the docks of the city, the residents of Niralis make
their life in the humble houses and apartments.  There is no dominant race
here, most are just content to live a quiet life and prosper as much as they
can. The local militia still patrol to ensure the safety of the permanent
residents of the city.

description:

are all very close together and it would be quite easy to simple walk into the
 next house.  Children of all races run about while a few residents are here,
cooking dinner or making trinkets to sell at the bazaar.

name: The Gate Of Niralis
description:
Named after the great founder of the city, Niralis Isis, Paladin of The Grey,
this city promises to provide shelter to all people and to all factions.  All
are welcome but the city itself remains independent of all conflicts,
protecting only their own city.  Many travellers pass through the gate,
looking for supplies or perhaps just trying to catch a boat out to one of the
far off lands beyond the sea.

name: A Militia Post
description:
This small collection of canvas and banners is the home of the local militia.
All people that live within Niralis are ordered to take arms and patrol the
city for one day a week.  The soldiers here relax and play several odd games
with shaped stones while a few inspect travellers for anything dangerous.
Most of them are content to twiddle the day away.

name: A Dank Alley
description:
The heavy torches of the city fade as you make your way through the alley. The
militia avoid this area and for good reason.  It does not feel safe and there
is little room to run if you are attacked.  A few people ask for a spare coin
or if you are interested in making some quick cash while you stay in Niralis.

name: A Drop Of Blood
description:
This shop smells of death and acid.  An older wolfen, cloaked in white and
with a heavy cane tends the shop.  You see a collection of potions, scrolls,
and a few wands. Judging by the look of the supplies, they are not entirely
friendly.

name: The Broken Horn
description:
The shop is made for goblins but the weapons inside are definitely made for
everyone.  You see bladed crossbows that fire barbed darts, massive axes,
twisted swords, and a few daggers that could be very easily hidden.  A heavily
scarred goblin tends the counter, asking if you ever hunted Minotaur before.

name: Bone And Stone
description:
The feel of heat and the smell of burning metal means only one thing, armor is
being made.  You see suits of armor that are obviously meant for one thing,
making anyone landing a blow being in equal pain.  None of these armors seem
very safe for a child to train with as most are spiked, razor tipped, or just
frightening.

name: The Warrior's Inn
description:
This massive inn is probably the largest of any tavern in the city but is
mostly empty.  Only the locals and those that are not afraid of anything stay
here.  The wooden floors are soaked in blood and a few teeth and horns are
everywhere. The patrons all eye you with diabolical eye.  You should probably
leave.

name: Walking On A Muddy Path
description:
You stumble your way through this muddy path.  You sink down in mud to your
knees.  Around you, you can hear the sounds of snakes rattling; they seem to
move away as you get near.  Up ahead you can start to make out what looks to
be a gate made of thorns and wood.  The bubbling of the bog can be heard to
the west.

knees.  Around you, you can hear the sounds of snakes rattling; they seem to

description:

may be savages!

description:
You make your way through the shrubbery very carefully.  You are afraid of
something jumping out at you because you can't see too far in front of your
face.  As you continue on your way you begin to get the feeling you are
getting lost...

ahead is uncertain, you can take your chances or you can try to fight your way
back through the forest.

name: On A Large Staircase
description:
You slowly make your way up the stairs to a huge tower, it rises high into the
sky, before the keep you see a large gate, and after the gate you see a large
iron door.  The sky above glows with a golden brilliance.

name: Walking To The Fields
description:
You continue down the heavily travelled dirt roads towards the fields. You can
see numerous silk worms busy working on their masterpieces and different opium
plants lined in neat rows. Numerous workers, officials, and merchants stream
through here, trying to get a sample of the goods.

of silk all over the leaves of these opium plants.  Whoever decided to  grow
both silk and opium in the same space is obviously a genius.  Numerous workers
are battling each other to harvest as much as they can.

name: Inside The Opium Smoke
description:
You feel warm and a bit clumsy as the smoke of the opium fills your lungs. Your
eyes grow heavy and you start to sway silently for no reason.  You swear you
can see the birds singing and hear the plants move back and forth in a strange
dance.  Numerous creatures move by you, all of them rainbow colored and
smiling. It's all just a bad trip, just a bad trip.

name: The Plains Road
description:
You travel down a narrow road.  The road meanders its way through dunes of
pure white sand.  About you, you hear the sound of birds singing, and the sun
shines warmly down upon you.  There aren't as many flowers here, and what
flowers you see look dried out and sickly.  To the west, the dunes rise up and
the road seems to end.

name: A Hole In The Sand
description:
The Plains Road abruptly ends here, running into a stretch of sand dunes.
Curiously enough, a large hole heads down into the sand here.  A strange
prickly feeling is all about you, and the hairs on your body seem to want to
stand upright.

name: A Sandy Tunnel
description:
You stand in a wide tunnel carved out of sandstone.  The top of the tunnel is
quite far above your head.  The floor is made up of pure white sand.  Pieces
of bone can be seen sticking out of the sand in places, and what appears to be
the tracks of a large clawed beast run down the center.

description:

weeds, brambles, and fallen tree branches. The wild animals that
pass through leave small reminders that civilization is quite distant

name: An odd junction
description:
The thick underbrush has been cleared away, making travel much easier.
The sun can be seen in golden puddles on clear days, while the rain, when
it does precipitate, diffuses into a heavy mist that saturates the earth
rather quickly. Broken blades of grass indicate recent passage of a living
creature.

name: A faint dirt path
description:
Although there is a dirt path here, it is faint. It's as if whatever created
this walkway was more intelligent than wild animals, but not as careful.
This proves the rumors that someone or something is living in hiding here.

name: A faint dirt path
description:
Although there is a dirt path here, it is faint. It's as if whatever created
this walkway was more intelligent than wild animals, but not as careful.
This proves the rumors that someone or something is living in hiding here.

name: A used path
description:
The dirt path becomes more pronounced as if it is used on a regular basis.
A shelter is camouflaged nearby. This does not appear to be created by
an unintelligent creature. A whisper on the breeze is convincing that the
assessment is correct.

hand crafted primitive weapons that, despite their frugal craftsmanship,
appear deadly. The walls have been packed tightly with mud. Small flaps
conceal the holes used for ventilation and observation of intruders.

description:

leaves, and leather tethers to create a functional living space. This room is
the epitome of efficiency. It even has strangely labled shelves that hold a
variety of weapons in preparation for defense.

name: The Longhouse
description:

bit above ground level, appears vaulted. The walls are strong, the ventilation
is good, and the sounds of a household abound. Occasionally the wail of a
prisoner can be faintly heard.

name: A dank, dark cell
description:
This cell is little more than a hole in the ground. The magical forces that
imbue the room with wards of protection against the prisoners, hum in the air
like buzzing bees. The powerful stench of rotting flesh and harbored dream
overwhelms the senses of those who are captured and/or enslaved from this room.

name: Past The Break Wall
description:
You can now see the entire expanse of a huge bay, filled with ships.  To the
east you can see the main port and a bustling city. Many different types of
ships from war-boats to simple merchant vessels fill the area. You hope they
are nice enough to  strangers.

name: In A Huge Bay
description:
The water is still quite warm and there is no sign of the bottom. This must
make an excellent port. Numerous smaller ships buzz by and there are several
wildly painted ships with large harpoons patrolling the water. They seem to be
on the lookout for something.

make an excellent port. Numerous smaller ships buzz by and there are several
wildly painted ships with large harpoons patrolling the water. They seem to be
on the lookout for something.

name: Approaching The Docks
description:
You try to avoid the numerous ships that are both leaving and docking.  You
can hear the hustle and bustle of the city ahead. Numerous workers are on the
ships, unloading boxes or loading them up.  Several huge battle cruisers are
docked as well, keeping an eye on things inside the bay.

description:

name: On The Docks
description:
You've made it into the port.  The docks are busy with all kinds of workers.
You seem ogre laborers unloading and numerous human sailors doing some kind of
work to their ships. Two small vessels are docked right next to you.

name: On A Small Merchant Ship
description:
This ship is small compared to some of the others but it seems sturdy enough.
Several sailors and making rope or repairing the sails.  The deck is wet and
the smell of dried salt is heavy.  The ship looks like it just got in and are
waiting for a group of dock workers to unload it.

name: On A Small Merchant Ship
description:
This must be the bilge of the ship.  It reeks of filth and decay. You can see
several large rats happily swimming by.  You decide to head back up and cut
the tour short.

Several sailors and making rope or repairing the sails.  The deck is wet and
the smell of dried salt is heavy.  The ship looks like it just got in and are
waiting for a group of dock workers to unload it. From here you can get
a great view of the bay.

name: On A Boarding Craft
description:
This small boarding craft is being repaired. Apparently it went through some
sort of battle as several sailors are washing blood off the deck and the
walls.  You can see several swords laying on the ground and the bodies are
being carried and stacked inside a large piece of sail.

name: In The Crow's Nest
description:
Some sailor met a grisly fate up here.  His bow and arrow are by his side.
Several, or rather numerous arrows dot his body.  This lookout must  have
tried to take up a sniper position but from the look of things, he was
outmatched.

name: On The Docks
description:
You've made it into the port.  The docks are busy with all kinds of workers.
You seem ogre laborers unloading and numerous human sailors doing some kind of
work to their ships. Two small vessels are docked right next to you.

name: On The Docks
description:
You've made it into the port.  The docks are busy with all kinds of workers.
You seem ogre laborers unloading and numerous human sailors doing some kind of
 work to their ships. To the east you can see the main marketplace of the
city.

name: Entering The Bazaar
description:
You can see the crowds of people gathered around, some shopping, some
examining items, and other selling them. The town watch is out and about,
stopping random passerbys and examining their goods. You see a heavy mix of
the different races in the crowd.

name: The Intersection Of Shin And Xanis
description:
You are at a busy intersection of two streets.  The road is crowded in each
direction as some are going to the docks to work while others are just busy
sorting through the numerous vendors.  With this many people it would be a
good idea to keep a tight hand on your money.

name: On Shin Avenue
description:
You make your way through the crowd, occasionally bumping into a large ogre on
his way to the docks or feeling a slight tug at your coin pouch.  A street
vendor is hawking her wares and a small crowd is huddled around her.
Occasionally you see an urchin or thief try to snag an item off the table.

name: On Shin Avenue
description:
You make your way through the crowd, occasionally bumping into a large ogre on
his way to the docks or feeling a slight tug at your coin pouch.  A small inn
is just to the north, from inside you can hear a crowd of sailors singing some
song.

name: On Shin Avenue
description:
You make your way through the crowd, occasionally bumping into a large ogre on
his way to the docks or feeling a slight tug at your coin pouch.  The street
stretches a good deal more to the east and you can see the outline of several
more shops.

name: On Shin Avenue
description:
You make your way through the crowd, occasionally bumping into a large ogre on
his way to the docks or feeling a slight tug at your coin pouch.  The street
stretches a good deal more to the east and you can see the outline of several
more shops. To the south is a larger pub and inn.  Music floats in from the
open door and windows.

name: On Shin Avenue
description:

name: The Intersection Of Shin And Dubai
description:
You stand at another busy intersection of streets. To the south you can see a
large gate and several other vendors. The traffic isn't nearly as heavy as
before, but you can see large grooves dug into the stone streets. They seem
wide enough to accommodate wagon-wheels.  To the north is a small shop that
seems to be pretty desolate.

name: On Dubai Way
description:
The street has far less pedestrian traffic than the others but it is filled
with odd wagons with wooden wheels that fit nicely into the two grooves in the
street. You can see a large gate to the south and the source of numerous
wagons coming in and out of the city.

name: On Dubai Way
description:
The street has far less pedestrian traffic than the others but it is filled
with odd wagons with wooden wheels that fit nicely into the two grooves in the
street. The gate to the east seems to be the entrance and exit out of the
city. Numerous guards are inspecting the travellers that are moving in and
out.

name: On Dubai Way
description:
The street has far less pedestrian traffic than the others but it is filled
with odd wagons with wooden wheels that fit nicely into the two grooves in the
street. To the south you see a constant cloud of black smoke from a
building.  Several wagons are packed in front.

name: On Dubai Way
description:
The street has far less pedestrian traffic than the others but it is filled
with odd wagons with wooden wheels that fit nicely into the two grooves in the
street. To the west is what appears to be a blacksmith of some sort but by
the clientele it seems that they specializes in wagons and their repair.

name: On Dubai Way
description:
The street has far less pedestrian traffic than the others but it is filled
with odd wagons with wooden wheels that fit nicely into the two grooves in the
street. A street vendor is here, hawking his wares. He sees you and points
for you to stop on by.

name: On Dubai Way
description:
The street has far less pedestrian traffic than the others but it is filled
with odd wagons with wooden wheels that fit nicely into the two grooves in the
street. A quiet shop lies to the west, you cannot tell what they might sell.
The shutters are closed and the door is draped in a heavy rug to
block out the sun. How odd.

name: On Dubai Way
description:
The street has far less pedestrian traffic than the others but it is filled
with odd wagons with wooden wheels that fit nicely into the two grooves in the
street. To the south you can see that the wagons are being parked
in a large section of dirt and unloaded or loaded.

name: On Dubai Way
description:
The street has far less pedestrian traffic than the others but it is filled
with odd wagons with wooden wheels that fit nicely into the two grooves in the
street. To the south you can see that the wagons are being parked
in a large section of dirt and unloaded or loaded.

name: The Intersection Of Dubai And Jhen
description:
It seems that the track for wagons ends here and the heavy
foot traffic begins again. Most of the people are either sailors, dock workers,
or watchmen. To the west you can see a large building with a large
red and gold Z painted on the side.

name: On Jhen Road
description:
The traffic here is somewhat minimal compared to the other streets.  Most of
those walking are soldiers, guards, sailors, or dock workers.  They all seem
to be heading towards the large building. A few gnome or pixie's are fighting
their way through the crowd, intent on enjoying the scene. They must be
tourists.

name: On Jhen Road
description:
The traffic here is somewhat minimal compared to the other streets.  Most of
those walking are soldiers, guards, sailors, or dock workers.  They all seem
to be heading towards the large building. To the north is a decent sized
shop. The smell of jasmine and rosemary is heavy in the air.

name: On Jhen Road
description:
The traffic here is somewhat minimal compared to the other streets.  Most of
those walking are soldiers, guards, sailors, or dock workers.  They all seem
to be heading towards the large building. A few gnome or pixie's are fighting
their way through the crowd, intent on enjoying the scene. They must be
tourists.

name: On Jhen Road
description:
The traffic here is somewhat minimal compared to the other streets.  Most of
those walking are soldiers, guards, sailors, or dock workers.  The large
building to the north seems to be the administrative offices of the city. It
seems well guarded and is adorned with numerous banners and statues of
emperors and kings you've never heard of. To the west the street stretches on.

name: On Jhen Road
description:

tourists.

name: On Jhen Road
description:
The traffic here is somewhat minimal compared to the other streets.  Most of
those walking are soldiers, guards, sailors, or dock workers.  They all seem
to be heading towards the large building. To the south is a small shack that
is spreading some sort of horrible smell. The ogres in the crowd seem to
loiter around the shop, homesick and hungry.

name: The Intersection Of Jhen And Xanis
description:
The intersection is crowded and the smell of the shack to the east still fills
the air.  To the north you see a street filled with the locals of the city.
It seems to be a bit poorer than the other parts of the bazaar.

name: On Xanis Street
description:
This is definitely the local hangout of the city.  It is filled with people
heckling and hassling the tourists.  The dock workers turn a deaf ear but you
a small group of elves seem quite dismayed. To the north are several shops and
pubs.  The amount of urchins and thieves seems to have doubled here.

have doubled here.  To the east is a dank alleyway that doesn't seem
to be the best place to enjoy the sights.

name: On Xanis Street
description:
This is definitely the local hangout of the city.  It is filled with people
heckling and hassling the tourists.  The dock workers turn a deaf ear.  To the
north are several shops and  pubs.  The amount of urchins and thieves seems to
have doubled here.

name: On Xanis Street
description:
This is definitely the local hangout of the city.  It is filled with people
heckling and hassling the tourists.  The dock workers turn a deaf ear.    The
amount of urchins and thieves seems to  have doubled here.  A small shop that
sells rope and other sailing supplies is to the east.

name: The Golden Lamp
description:
This pub seems to be a favorite of the sailors and dock workers. The ale and
wine is flowing freely as numerous people are cashing in their paychecks with
the new shipments. There are others celebrating before they go out on another
trip. A petite young lady is tending to the bar.

name: The Blue Harp
description:
This must be the tourist trap of Sahardin. You can see many different types of
people ordering drinks or trying to get a room for the night.  A trio of
musicians play on the small stage. Above you is a balcony and several barmaids
scramble among the patrons.

name: The Blue Harp
description:
>From the balcony you can see the entire expanse of the bay as well as get a
good view of the band playing.  The tone is upbeat and it seems that everybody
is having a good time. Perhaps you should get a room here.

name: The Harpie's Dagger
description:
This shop is run down and it would appear that it is about to cave in.  An old
man with a huge scar against his face is tending to a small counter of
weapons, most of them rusted or in pieces. He looks up at you and takes a drag
off his hand rolled cigarette.

name: The Harpie's Dagger
description:
This back room is really more of a back shack.  It has the basic four walls
and a roof but that is about it.  There are no decorations or even extra
inventory.  Apparently all that is in the front is all that there is in the
store. You notice the dirt in the middle of the room is a slightly different
color than the rest.

name: A Hidden Pathway
description:
This pathway seems to go on into the north. You can't make out anything other
that this route was hastily built  and in desperate need of a good mason.
Besides the dirt, the bugs, and the  lack of light, it's really not that bad.

name: A Hidden Pathway
description:
This pathway seems to go on into the north. You can start to make out oddly
scribbled symbols on the walls. They look like directions!   You can't make
out anything other  that this route was hastily built  and in desperate need
of a good mason.   Besides the dirt, the bugs, and the  lack of light, it's
really not that bad.

name: Before The Gate
description:
The town watch and even some military personnel are stationed here. They are
watching everyone with a keen eye and are in full battle gear. Perhaps they
have been attacked recently by bandits?

name: At A Check Point
description:
A large man with a large Z pinned to his cloak is inspecting everyone as they
make their way out of the city.  He takes a look at you and waves his arm to
go on through.  The security here is definitely on edge.

name: The Sahardin Gate
description:
This gate is massive.  The spiked doors must be two feet thick of metal. The
gate guard are watching for anybody who looks suspicious. The doors are open
There is a sign that reads in an odd cursive "OPEN TO THE TRADING PUBLIC!"

name: The Steel Wheel
description:
The smell of smoldering metal and steam fill the air.  A huge man with a
shaved head and no neck is at the counter. Numerous customers are walking
around, taking a look at the latest advances in wagon technology.  Several
very large wheels from a war-wagon are hung from the roof like trophies.
Further inside the store you hear the sound of metalworks.

name: The Steel Wheel
description:
A large half-orc is pounding out the spokes of a large wheel.  Two large
furnaces burn so hot you can feel your armor growing uncomfortably hot.  The
sound of the hammer strikes are deafening and you feel like gagging from the
smell of burning metal.

name: The Sulfur Dream
description:
This shop is almost as dark as an empty sea.  A few candles cast the only
light.  The shop is full of plants, carefully shielded with several panes of
dark glass to prevent what little light that does come in to touch these
delicate items. The shopkeep is a small pixie that is carefully mixing several
drops of liquid together.

name: Strawberry Fields
description:
The shop is filled with the scent of peaceful and soothing incense. Numerous
potions and powders adorn the walls. A cheerful looking Elf greets you and
offers to take your coat.  Numerous customers are looking through the
catalogue of potions this young woman could make. You see love potions, health
potions, fertility potions, but nothing of any real value. Deeper inside you
can see somebody working in the back.

name: Strawberry Fields
description:
The heavy air of the front room is less here.  The room is simple and much
less cluttered with flowers or carpets or paintings.  A drow is hunched over a
workbench, painfully careful to brew potions.  He looks up at you and seems to
have a very spiteful look in his eye. He goes back to work mixing potions.

name: The Imperial Office
description:
A long line of sailors and soldiers stand and wait for their number to be
called. You see that is the office of the Mayor, the Harbor Master, and the
Town Guard.  Several guards are constantly watching the workers with a
suspicious eye.  However, the sheer number of people in here seem to make the
guard an illusion of security.

name: The Imperial Office
description:
The waiting room seems to have been converted into a security checkpoint.
Several guards pat you down and put an odd lock onto your weapons.
They ask you numerous questions but seem unimpressed with your answers.
After several more pat-downs and a few compliments of your physical
shape they waive you forward to a staircase.

name: The Imperial Office
description:
The staircase is beautifully crafted. Each step is carpeted and the hand rail
is a polished oak.  The frame seems to made of a very sturdy metal. Along the
walls you see a painting of a large man wearing an odd suit of armor, wielding
a huge longsword, and flanked by a set of huge attack dogs.  Directly next to
his painting is a smaller but no less grand one of a younger man, dressed in
similar armor and carrying what appears to be a crossbow of some sort with a
bladed guard and several bolts docked at once.

name: The Imperial Office
description:
This room is the makeshift headquarters of the Town Guard.  You imagine it was
once a waiting room of some sort but hasty additions of extra protection on
the doors and a moveable barricade for the stairs suggest that this changed
not too long ago.  The Captain of the Guard is surveying a  handful of maps
and seems uninterested in your approach.  Several wanted posters hang from the
walls, giving sketches and descriptions of a few individuals.

name: The Imperial Office Of The Harbor Master
description:
The Harbor Master is buried in paper work.  Running such a busy port must be a
stressful job.  He scribbles some numbers onto a large book and uses an odd
device with many beads that shift back and forth to calculate something.  He
looks up and motions to a sign that reads: Leave All Cargo Manifests on My
Desk.  The pile on the desk almost reaches the twenty foot ceiling.

name: The Imperial Office Of The Mayor
description:
This portly fellow reaches for a dagger the moment you enter.  After he
studies you for a minute he reclines back in his chair and hastily chews on
his pipe.  He goes back to his work, occasionally lifting his eyes to meet
yours before he goes back to his papers.  You notice they are all upside down.

name: Da Shantay
description:
This shack seems to be the hotspot for the numerous ogre, orc, and troll
workers in the city.  Numerous animals are hung from the ceiling and several
fire pits have animals roasting.  Almost all of the patrons are of the larger
races and the ale is heavy on the floor.  Old bones and left over food are
thrown on the floor but it is odd you don't see any stray animals here...

name: The Aragos
description:
This small inn must be one of the oldest buildings in the city.  Made of  wood
rather than stone and steel it has a nice quaint feel to it.  An older man
smiles at you and offers you a drink.  The crowd is thin here, probably
because most of the tourists and foreign traders don't want to be hassled
every time they  walk by.  This place would be nice to rest for awhile.

name: The Mermaid's Oyster
description:
Another large bouncer nods to you as you walk in.  The lights are dim
and a single piano player is quietly playing a Sonata. Despite the quiet
atmosphere you notice the place is absolutely packed! Then you notice
the barmaids.  Each one is dressed in a VERY revealing outfit.  You see
elves, drow, pixies, orcs, ogres, and every other race here,  drinking
and absorbing the sights.  The bouncers must be pretty tough to keep
this lot quiet.

name: Inside A Dark Alley
description:
The alley is larger than the others and several people seem to be wandering
around.  There are few lights here and you imagine the town watch don't come
down this route often.  Numerous beggars and cut-purses watch you and eye your
bags greedily.

name: Inside A Dark Alley
description:
The alley is larger than the others and several people seem to be wandering
around.  There are few lights here and you imagine the town watch don't come
down this route often.  Numerous beggars and cut-purses watch you and eye your
bags greedily.

name: Inside A Dark Alley
description:
The alley is larger than the others and several people seem to be wandering
around.  There are few lights here and you imagine the town watch don't come
down this route often.  Numerous beggars and cut-purses watch you and eye your
bags greedily. To the south is a small shop that is poorly hidden behind
several potted plants.

name: Inside A Dark Alley
description:
The alley is larger than the others and several people seem to be wandering
around.  There are few lights here and you imagine the town watch don't come
down this route often.  Numerous beggars and cut-purses watch you and eye your
bags greedily. To the north is another shop that seems to be tucked away
in the shadows. To the east the alley continues.

name: The Assassin's Dagger
description:
A very thin Ghoul stands behind a counter full of numerous weapons. You see
poisoned blades, spiked gauntlets, needle thin daggers, and numerous other
weapons you imagine are illegal here.  He grins a smile of broken teeth and
horribly breath and asks if you'd like to see the "imports".

name: Inside A Dark Alley
description:
The alley is larger than the others and several people seem to be wandering
around.  There are few lights here and you imagine the town watch don't come
down this route often.  Numerous beggars and cut-purses watch you and eye your
bags greedily.

name: The Orc's Backside
description:
This shop is dedicated to all sorts of armors.  The small man behind the
counter watches you nervously while trying to hide the fact he has a compact
crossbow aimed right you.  The armor all varies in size and shape, you see a
few "retired" pieces of Imperial armor and several other vambraces or boots
that probably aren't standard issue.

name: Bait N Hook
description:
This tidy little shop has all the bare essentials for the amateur sailor.
Rope, water-resistant clothes, and pills to ease sea sickness are readily
available. An old captain watches and smiles.  He points out how to tie
numerous knots and which would be useful to know if you ever try your hand at
taming the mistress that is the sea.

name: Inside A Dark Alley
description:
The alley is larger than the others and several people seem to be wandering
around.  There are few lights here and you imagine the town watch don't come
down this route often.  Numerous beggars and cut-purses watch you and eye your
bags greedily. To the south is a very raucous tavern.

name: The Jackal's Den
description:
The smell of cheap liquor and dried sweat is heavy in the air. This doesn't
seem to be a collection of the finest of Sahardin but it looks lively enough.
Several worn out looking barmaids try to keep up with the numerous sailors and
you suspect, smugglers.

name: Close To Shore
description:
You are close to a wide beach that spans a lot of the southern edge of the
continent.  The waves are smaller here, and don't have quite as much force.
The water is nice and warm.  This looks like a nice place for a swim.  The
rocks of the break block any movement to the west.

point.  This looks like a nice place for a swim.  The rocks of the break block

name: Out To Sea
description:
You are amidst the rough waters of the Great Sea.   The water is a dark blue,
and waves threaten to pull you down into the deep.  The faint cries of gulls
can be heard in the sky.  All about you, there is nothing but water, as far as
the eye can see.

name: Under The Sea
description:
You swim quietly under the surface of the ocean.  The strange floating
sensation added to the quiet gives you a feeling you are on some other plane,
and not just swimming around the great sea.  Ocean weeds and other strange
plants grow here, and you see the occasional fish come and check you out.

name: The Prow
description:
You stand on the jutting prow of the pirate frigate.  Underneath you, you
catch glimpses of dolphins riding the waves of the ship and flying fish
leaping into the air.  The pleasant sound of a ship cutting through the water
rises up, and the sweet sea air is all around you.

name: A Pirate Ship
description:
You stand on the deck of a large frigate, that rolls easily over the waves of
the ocean.  For a band of pirates, this ship is quite clean.  The ropes are
coiled, the wood is oiled, and every bit of brass shines like the day it was
poured.  The shouts of the pirates can be heard coming from all over the ship.

name: Climbing The Mast
description:
Small handholds and a swinging rope allow you to climb up the mast of the
ship.  Below you is the wide deck.   High above you is the crows nest, a great
place for a lookout to be standing.

name: In The Crows Nest
description:
The salty-sweet wind of the sea rushes around you as you stand high above the
deck of the pirate frigate.  From here you can see quite a ways off into the
distance.  Any ship sailing nearby would be quickly sighted by the lookout,
and the pirates would have plenty of time to depart the area, or attack and
loot the cargo.

name: A Storage Room
description:
The smells of foreign spices and old oak casks fills this small storage room.
Nets hang from the ceiling so the pirates can maximize the space they
have...the better for packing in all the loot they can get!

name: Inside The Pirate Ship
description:
The creak of wood and the sway of the ship are your biggest sensations as you
stand belowdecks.  Occasionally you spy a small rodent, one of the inevitable
stowaways on a large sailing ship.  Otherwise the small spaces under the ship
are quite clean and tidy.

name: The Captains Quarters
description:
For a small room on a ship, these quarters are quite amazing.  Silk tapestries
hang from the walls, a thick, red velvet curtain is set to block the morning
light from the portholes, and a vibrant, cherrywood dining set is set into the
floor, to avoid having it slide about in a storm.  Gold tassels hang from the
edges of a comfortable looking hammock.  A large sea-chest is place in the far
corner.

have...the better for packing in all the loot they can get!

name: The Pirate Galley
description:
This small galley has a thick iron stove, the better to contain the burning
coals inside.  Buckets of water line one of the walls, just in case a fire was
to break out.  Pots and pans hang from hooks in the ceiling, and casks and
boxes take up much of the other space.  Salt pork and stale bread makes up
most of the foodstuffs, but some watered down rum and a small crate of limes
is also available.

name: The Pirate Bunks
description:
This small room is filled with the hanging hammocks that are much more safe
and comfortable on a sailing ship, then the normal bed.  By swinging in the
air, the sleepers have a stable bunk, especially in storms and rough seas.
Small chests are placed about, but seem to only contain old sailing clothes
and worthless personal items.

stand belowdecks.  Occasionally you spy a small rodent, one of the inevitable
stowaways on a large sailing ship.  Otherwise the small spaces under the ship
are quite clean and tidy.  A small ladder leads up to a hatch, which allows
access to the upper deck.

name: The Bow
description:
You stand out on the bow of a large slave galley.  Looking back behind you,
you can see the rows of benches where the slaves sit and man the long oars.
Below you, the bright blue water of the sea stretches out before you.  The
cries of gulls come from far off, a mournful sound on this ship of misery.  A
small rope hangs from the side, probably for disembarking the ship.

name: A Slave Galley
description:
You stand in the aisle of a large slave galley.  On either side of you sit
long wooden benches, where slaves sit and man the oar which propel the mighty
ship.  Dark stains show where slaves may of decided to disobey their captors
and paid the ultimate price.

name: The Stern
description:
You stand high up in the stern of the slave galley.  A large drum is placed
here.  This is where the beater stands to set the pace of the slaves.  Just a
simple increase in the steady pounding can boost the ship to great speeds, at
the cost of the pain and suffering of the slaves.

name: The Slave Benches
description:
A long wooden bench sits here, a fairly uncomfortable place for the slaves to
sit on and row the large ship.  Dark, rust-colored stains spot the bench and
floor, where whipped and beaten slaves slowly bled into the wood.  Towards the
outside of the ship, you see the long oars stretch out into the sea.

name: On The Prow
description:
The jagged prow of the ship juts out far over the sea.  Once shaped like a
mermaid or some sort of angel, time and abuse has changed this once lovely
figurehead to now look like some sort of aged hag.  Colors have faded to ugly
browns and greens, and the eyes look sunken in, as if a corpse has been nailed
to the bow of the ship.

name: A Ghostly Galleon
description:
The smell of rotted wood and unkept rope lies about the deck of this ship like
an evil fog.  While in places it seems as if one might just collapse through
the old planks, so far your feet feel firm on the deck.  Dark blotches on the
wood show the signs of battle and death...although they should of faded some
time ago.

name: Up The Mast
description:
The mast of this old ship is twisted and splintered.  Rusted nails poke out of
the wood, as if trying to catch and tear the flesh of anyone trying to reach
the top.  The wind blowing about carries the sharp lash of small chips of ice,
despite the calm weather surrounding the ship earlier.

name: Hanging On!
description:
The wood of the crows nest is definitely rotted through, enough so that it
cannot support any weight at all.  It is surprising to see that it is even
held together at all.  The old rigging hangs about like a spider web, and in
the wind, there is a danger of becoming tangled up in the mess.  The rolling
deck of the ghost ship can be seen down below, but a fog obscures all around.

name: A Rotted Rope Ladder
description:
You hang on a rotten rope ladder, attached to the side of an old, rotten
sailing frigate.  This ship appears to have been long dead, and it is
surprising to see such a vessel still sailing the seas.  A chill fills the
air, and the moaning of the wind sounds sad and mournful.  You hesitate,
wondering if it is smart to proceed onto the deck.

name: An Empty Hold
description:
The reek of rot and mold fills this large, empty hold.  The walls and supports
have long been gone, eaten by woodworms and the wet of the sea.  The air is
thick and hard to breathe.  The remains of barrels, crates, and piles of
other, once expensive, goods are scattered about.

name: The Bow
description:
The crash of the waves against the bow of the small skiff send a salty spray
up into your face.  The wind whistles past you as the boat cuts through the
seas.  Flying fish jump out of the breaking waves in front, sailing through
the sky before landing back down into the water.

name: A Rebel Skiff
description:
This small craft is used for ferrying rebel soldiers and smuggling the goods
needed to keep up their fight against the Imperial Navy.  Crates and barrels
are set about the ship, and ropes crisscross their way up the masts.  While
definitely seaworthy, the small ship provides no shelter against stormy
weather, and probably isn't safe for a long sea voyage.

name: Dont Change This Room
description: You stumble into a newly created room.

name: Beyond Bazabel
description:
The massive gate behind you seems a lifetime away as you stare down the road.
The hills and small forests seem to swallow everything.  There is considerably
less people here than the other gates, mostly soldiers returning from patrol
or the few random children that wanted to play beyond the city walls.

name: On The Silver Path
description:
The forests of the south swallow the road in each direction.  The roots and
moss of the trees has spread into the road, making it impossible for a cart to
survive for long.  The trees are thin and pale yet so densely packed it seems
no light can come in.  You hear the sounds of small animals and rodents making
their living.  The air from the south is distinctly colder.

name: Before A Great Tundra
description:
The forests are long behind you and now you stand at the edge of a great
Tundra.  All you can see is barren white fields.  The air is harsh and chill.
To the very far south you can make out snow-covered mountains.  You wonder
what lies buried within this forgotten wasteland.

name: A Small Tunnel
description:
This small tunnel appears to have been created with intense heat, as the rock
looks melted instead of carved away.  It is smooth and has an almost glassy
appearance.  Above you, the tunnel seems to enter a large cavern, but in the
dark, it is difficult to tell.

name: A Small Tunnel
description:
This small tunnel appears to have been created with intense heat, as the rock
looks melted instead of carved away.  It is smooth and has an almost glassy
appearance.  Below you, the tunnel seems to get a little larger.

name: A Warm Tunnel
description:
You stand in a round tunnel, the walls about you smooth and glassy, as if
something burned its way right through the rock of the underground.  The smell
of smoke and sulfur is strong down here, and breathing is a little difficult.
The tunnel heads off to the east, and a small opening above you looks
climbable as well.

name: A Warm Cavern
description:

lot.  The smell of smoke and sulfur is very strong here.  Small depressions
are formed into the rock floor, almost like a birds nest, but formed from
melted stone.

name: Outside Of Bazabel
description:
One of the four massive gates of Bazabel is to the west.  The road into the
mountains goes onto the east. From the top of the wall you can see several
sentries taking a break and talking loudly about their jobs and the threat of
a rebel attack on the city.

name: On Sorrow's Path
description:
The road continues east and then north into the mountains.  The air is much
cooler and the top of the peaks are barely visible but clearly covered in
snow. The road looks seldom traveled and you can see no evidence that much
trade comes through here.  The pieces of coal, broken rope, and rusted tools
scattered along side the road suggest that there is some sort of mine inside
the mountain.

name: On Sorrow's Path
description:
The road continues north towards the large Fort. The road is lightly traveled
save for a few soldiers coming off a tour of duty or just starting another.
The road itself has numerous metal spikes interrupting the road to prevent
siege weaponry or wagons to travel close to the base.

name: Before Sorrow's Post
description:
The massive steel and wood doors of the fort are held open by a complex system
of chains and wheels. Numerous sentries patrol the walls and a lookout tower
some four hundred feet in the air must give an amazing view of the entire
area.  This fort would make it difficult for any army to advance on Bazabel.

name: A Dead End In The Mountain
description:

to climb and the massive gusts of wind would make flight dangerous. Among the
sparse bushes and foliage you hear the faint sound of a heartbeat and unless
it is some trick by the light, you could swear you see the faintest sign of a
door hidden in the rock.

name: Before A Great Iron And Stone Door
description:
This door is massive. It is even larger than the gates of Bazabel. It must be
solid iron and rock.  From the huge dents in it, it would seem that a few
battering rams have tried to take it down but by the decayed piles of wood to
the side, they were unsuccessful. The door is covered in numerous markings
gnomish and ghoulish. The door is heavy guarded and it seems ready to be shut
the instant it needs to be.

name: Before The Mine Entrance
description:
The entrance to the mine is well guarded by soldiers and militia alike.
Hundreds of men, half-trolls, half-orcs, half-ogres, and some full blooded
ones are shuffling in or out, bringing pounds of fresh coal, tin, and anything
else valuable. It would seem that this is the source of Bazabel's metal.

name: On The Southern Road
description:
You stand upon the Southern Road.  The road meanders its way through grassy
plains.  About you, you hear the sound of birds singing, and the sun shines
warmly down upon you.  This road is fairly well-traveled, and from the tales
you have heard, is also relatively safe.  North of you lies the southern
entrance to Alden.

You stand upon the Southern Road.  The road meanders its way through grassy
plains.  About you, you hear the sound of birds singing, and the sun shines
warmly down upon you.  This road is fairly well-traveled, and from the tales
you have heard, is also relatively safe.

name: Spearfang Road
description:
To the north sits the sturdy gates of Niralis.  Headed off to the south is a
dirt track, that quickly enters the dark pines of the Spearfang Forest.  The
sounds of forest critters can be heard off in the trees and scuttling through
the undergrowth.  A warm breeze causes the tops of the pines to sway, creating
an eerie windy moan.

name: An Overgrown Path
description:

this was an old game trail.  Weeds and other vines crisscross their way across
the dirt path, making walking difficult.  The trail opens out onto a wider
path to the west.

description:

the branches of these trees.  They are somewhat sticky, but not so much that
it impedes your movement.  It seems something has used these fibers to create
a path through the trees.

name: Deep In The Web
description:
The strong fibers of the web are quite thick here, and the thought of the size
of the spider that could spin them gives you a pause.  Faint light trickles
down through the web stretched throughout the branches.  The web is a bit
stickier here, and it pulls at you as you walk about.

name: The Sticky Web
description:

of the spider that could spin them gives you a pause.  Faint light trickles
down through the web stretched throughout the branches.  The web is very
sticky here, and you find it almost impossible to pull yourself free.

name: A Hole In The Web
description:
The strong fibers of the web are quite thick here, and the thought of the size
of the spider that could spin them gives you a pause.  Faint light trickles
down through the web stretched throughout the branches.  The web is a bit
stickier here, and it pulls at you as you walk about.  What appears to be a
hole leading down is spun in the web here, but it isn't big enough for you to
fit into.

name: The Enclosed Web
description:
The web is so thick here, it actually forms a large chamber.  No light is able
to get through the thick, sticky strands, making this room quite dark.  Many
small bundles are stuck about the walls of this chamber...they look like
spider eggs.

name: A Narrow Forest Trail
description:
A barely discernible trail leads off the Greenpath.  The thick undergrowth
nearly hides the trail entrance.  The trail looks as if it might have been
made by animals.

name: The Trail Continues
description:
The undergrowth is rather thick on this part of the trail and appears even
denser to the north.  Piles of leaves cover the ground, making it easy to slip
and fall.

name: The Trail Turns
description:
As the trail turns, the thick undergrowth makes walking a little difficult and
twigs and branches make a distinctive cracking sound when any one walks by --
unless they're flying or floating that is.  This is not a good place to try
sneaking around silently.

name: The Trail Continues
description:

twigs and branches make a distinctive cracking sound when any one walks by --
unless they're flying or floating that is.  This is not a good place to try
sneaking around silently.

name: A Forest Intersection
description:
The forest thins here, forming a small intersection of paths.  To the west a
trail leads into thick woods, to the south a narrow path has few footprints
and to the north a path seems to widen.

name: The Lesser Used Path
description:
Tall trees loom overhead and the branches have interwined over the years,
forming a rich canopy.  Sinewy tendrils of moss hang down and the air is
filled with the sound of birds and insects.  Needles and leaves cover the
ground, making following the path a challenge.

name: The Lesser Used Path
description:

forming a rich canopy.  Sinewy tendrils of moss hang down and the air is
filled with the sound of birds and insects.  Needles and leaves cover the
ground, making following the path a challenge.

name: Deep In The Forest
description:
There's no sign of a path here and the canopy is so thick that little sunlight
reaches the ground which is full of spongy piles of needles and leaves.  All
directions seem the same.  Once in awhile a soft snickering sound can be heard.

name: Deep In The Forest
description:

name: A Smooth Path
description:
This path is easy to follow as trees have been thinned and the paved stones
are free of any debris.  To the south lies a forest intersection and to the
north the path continues.

description:

proves fruitless for a blue mist obscures what lies beyond.  Solid stone walls
as tall as three giants loom overhead.  There is no way to scale over them as
a crackling sound above reveals the presence of some sort of magic preventing
one from flying over the walls.

plaza without an obvious way to reach it.

name: Inside The Crystalline Gate
description:
A blue mist obscures the view of what lies outside the gate to the west.  An
eastern archway leads to a dim corridor.  As one enters the gate a booming
voice announces: "Welcome to Srilaxa: The Sorcerers' Retreat.  As a reminder,
practitioners of all races are welcome here to further the teaching and
research of all magical arts!"

name: The Plaza Entry
description:
The plaza is paved with what appears to be blocks of crystal.  No natural mine
could have produced any mineral of this size.  Distinct clicking sounds can be
made as one walks across the shimmering blue crystal.  Greenery is provided
from the magically suspended hanging baskets, filled with common and exotic
plants from all over the world.

description:

stone floor is covered by many large tracks and appears to never be swept

Numerous large tracks cover the filthy stone floor.  Unlit sconces hang on the
walls as if whoever comes here has no need for light.  Northward leads to an
open air plaza.

description:

are meticulously clean and various instruments useful for working with
gemstone lie neatly upon them.
