name: Lodge Entrance
description:
The lodge entrance is a circular chamber with a roaring brick fireplace in its
center.  The fire seems real enough yet no smoke rises from it.  The plush
brown carpets that cover the floor show no stains or signs of wear.

name: Gathering Room
description:
This room is probably used as a social gathering place for Srilaxa residents
and guests for it's filled with soft chairs, arranged to allow groups of
people to sit and relax.  Plush rugs cover the floor though one rug looks a
bit askew.

name: Through A Hallway
description:
The hallway is illuminated by hanging orbs of light and a narrow carpet covers
a worn wooden floor.  East leads to the gathering room and north and south are
some shops.

name: Shoppe Of Magical Goods
description:
Various magical items are on display throughout the shop.  The shopkeeper
stands behind a counter, waiting for customers to make their selections.  A
northern doorway leads to another part of the shop.

name: A Back Room
description:
A stone workbench is here along with all the components a wizard would need to
recharge magical items.  The southern doorway leads back to the main portion
of the shop.

name: A Small Stairwell
description:
This stairwell leads up to the lodge's gathering area and at the base of the
stairs is a blank stone wall.  All sound is muffled, including footsteps.
This is apparently a dead end.

name: Srilaxa Council Chambers
description:
Tapestries depicting practitioners of all magical arts cover the walls, no
single tapestry is larger than another.  The room is pleasantly lit though the
source of the light is not obvious.  Beautifully embroidered chairs are neatly
arranged around the meeting table.  A revolving door is in constant motion at
one of the chamber corners.

name: A Well Lit Shoppe
description:
Lights, lights, lights!  This room is exceedingly bright for all sorts of
lights, orbs, and lanterns are hanging almost everywhere. This is where lights
are bought and sold.

name: A Tiny Alcove
description:
The air is musty and thick dust is caked onto the walls of this tiny, sparse
alcove.  Dusty footprints provide the only evidence that anyone has visited
this place at all.

name: The Trail Continues
description:
The undergrowth is rather thick on this part of the trail and appears even
denser to the north.  Piles of leaves cover the ground, making it easy to slip
and fall.

name: Walking Sandy Dunes
description:
You travel across the tops and curves of massive sand dunes, that stretch as
far as the eye can see.  It is warm, but not uncomfortably so, but there is no
water visible in any direction either.  You keep on the most likely paths.

name: Before The Pyramid
description:
You stand in front of a huge pyramid, and can see the large mountain range
that stands behind it, to the north.  The entrance lies wide open, and quite
a few different prints can be identified in the sand around opening.  A
moaning sound comes from deep within the pyramid itself...maybe its a freak
breeze.

name: Pyramid Outer Corridor
description:
You stand in the musty and dusty outer corridor of the huge pyramid.  Your
light doesn't penetrate far into the darkness.  The sounds of shuffling and
moaning can be heard deep within the pyramid.

name: A Small Passageway
description:
This small passageway leads to a path further up into the pyramid.  Many
tracks mar the dust on the floor about you, showing that something is indeed
moving about this old place.

name: The Lower Catacombs
description:
These hallways are stuff with the remains of mummies and corpses, all in poor
condition.  They must of been the commoners and workers, who helped build and
take care of the pyramid and its occupants.

You stand at what appears to be almost the very top of the pyramid.  Great
statues and intricate carvings of religious value cast strange shadows from
your lights.  The sarcophagi you see are more ornate than those lower down.

name: A Small Passageway
description:
This small passageway leads to a path further up into the pyramid.  Many
tracks mar the dust on the floor about you, showing that something is indeed
moving about this old place.

name: The Ancient Pharaohs Chamber
description:
The first thing you notice in this room is how the giant golden throne
glistens so nicely in your light.  Then the piles of jewels and coins draw
your gaze.  Next, your sight is taken by racks and heaps of magical weapons
and armor.  Then the huge mummy in front of you comes into focus...

name: A Red Sandstone Canyon
description:
You walk along a narrow canyon, carved out of a deep red sandstone.  A strange
whistle comes from overhead, as the wind blows thru the narrow opening and
into little holes carved by an ancient water flow.  You have to occasionally
move around large rocks, but the going is not too rough.

name: A Small Cave
description:
You enter a small clean cave.  Shelves and furniture have been carved into the
sandstone itself, and a small bed is placed against the south wall.  The floor
is freshly swept, and everything is in the right place.  The resident of this
cave must be pretty tidy.

name: Stumbling Amongst Rocks
description:
The sand gives way to several large rocks and boulders, most with rough, sharp
edges on them.  You swear you hear some sort of humming sound nearby, but
can't quite place the direction.

name: A Large Passageway
description:
You stand in a large rock passageway.  A crackling hum can be heard further
down the dark passage.  It is quite warm down here, and without a light
source, you'd be stumbling on all the small rocks laying about.

name: A Large Passageway
description:
You stand in a large rock passageway.  The crackling hum has gotten quite
loud, and appears to be coming from the cavern to the west.  It is quite warm
down here, and without a light source, you'd be stumbling on all the small
rocks laying about.

name: A Huge Cavern
description:
The first thing you notice as you enter this chamber is the large lightning
bolts arcing back and forth across the sturdy rock roof.  As each bolt
wriggles its way along the ceiling, it emits a loud, crackling hum.  The bolts
light up the cave with an eerie blue glow.

name: A Private Lair
description:
On one side of this spacious chamber are works of art and other riches are
fully arranged in display cases.  The owner of this chamber evidently has
spent some time collecting treasures found throughout the world.  A powerful
energy field is protecting the valuables and once in awhile a zapping sound
can be heard as an unfortunate insect wanders too close to the field.
Elsewhere, cages and chains of all sizes are stacked up.  Inside one of the
cages is a small daemon who claws furiously to escape.

name: The Gates Of The Academy
description:
The large crest on the gate proudly bears the symbol of the sword and shield,
the crest of the Alden Templars.  Started by Kurian Tis after his wife
founded the Battlesisters, this academy has raised up generations of great
knights that dedicate themselves to Drazuk and the defense of his great city.
You can hear the sound of precision marching and mock combat.

name: The Templar Academy
description:
The Academy stretches out before you. To the east is a large building that
must serve as the barracks and other facilities of the academy.  You can hear
the sounds of drilling and combat to the north and south.  Those must be the
training areas for the cadets.

name: The Training Pit
description:
This large expanse of grass and mud is referred to the Training Pit.  Numerous
cadets are marching around the expanse of the field while older cadets and
instructors scream out orders.  There are also numerous sparring exercises
being done here as cadets wander about in a mock battle, choosing opponents
and learning new ways of being lethal.

name: Inside The Academy
description:
The Academy building is made of steel and stone with an eye for defensive
positions.  The walls seem to be at least two feet thick of solid granite
with numerous steel support beams that also act as great defensive positions.
Judging from the scattered scars in the building, it seems that mock battles
are staged in here as well.

name: The Cadet Barracks
description:
This is where the cadets sleep and live when they are not face down in the mud
and grass.  The bunks are plain and uncomfortable.  They are simple wooden
frames with only a thin mattress of sand atop and a few blankets.  Each cadet
has a small chest at the foot of their bunk to house their few personal items
and maybe a few pieces of contraband as well.

and grass.  The bunks are plain and uncomfortable.  They are simple wooden
frames with only a thin mattress of sand atop and a few blankets.  Each cadet
has a small chest at the foot of their bunk to house their few personal items
and maybe a few pieces of contraband as well.

name: Inside The Academy
description:
The Academy building is made of steel and stone with an eye for defensive
positions.  The walls seem to be at least two feet thick of solid granite
with numerous steel support beams that also act as great defensive positions.
Judging from the scattered scars in the building, it seems that mock battles
are staged in here as well.

name: The Private Corridors
description:
These are the private corridors of the Academy.  They are relatively barren
and empty as most of the Templars are off fighting against the eastern
raiders.  The torches that line the walls are well cared for and the entire
hallway is quite bright, probably to keep cadets or thieves from easily hiding
in the shadows.

name: A Forgotten Tunnel
description:
This small tunnel seems to have been forgotten by most of the residents of the
Academy.  The torch light is low and flickering.  The musk of dirt and  mold
is heavy in the air. Judging by the faint smell of tobacco and a few old piles
of pipe weed, some people do come in here from time to time.

name: A Hidden Corridor
description:
This tiny corridor is well hidden.  There is only the faint glow of low
torches and the slow drip of water.  The floor is slick with mold and slime
but you can see a faint light down the way.  The smell of incense is pretty
heavy here.

name: The Spell-Sword Library
description:
This massive library is the personal collection of the Templar Spell-Swords.
There are numerous books are each of the disciplines of magik.  You see volume
after volume of books that catalogue the different spells of the world as well
as the most effective means of stopping them.  You even see a few newer
additions that might have come from the eastern continent.

name: The Supply Room
description:
This small room houses all sorts of different items that a cadet would need.
You see practice weapons, light armor, and of course some food. You notice in
the corner a small stash of tobacco, a bit of ale and whiskey, and other
things that aren't allowed on the premises.  You imagine the Quartermasters'
sales for those items are good.

name: The Templar Armory
description:
This huge room is filled with numerous weapons, armors, and everything else a
soldier would need.  There is row after row of weapons, each one looks like it
would catch a fair price at the market or make a worthy addition to your
arsenal.  There are a few rarer items here, personal weapons of some of the
great Templars.

name: A Portal Room
description:
This room is completely black and bare.  Nothing was used for decoration,
and there wasn't really much need, as this room is strictly used as a portal
to get from one place to another.

name: A Portal Room
description:
This room is completely black and bare.  Nothing was used for decoration,
and there wasn't really much need, as this room is strictly used as a portal
to get from one place to another.

name: A Sparring Arena
description:
The ceiling and floor in this room are bare.  The walls, however, are
adorned with various weapons, armor and shields of all different sorts
and sizes.  The floor is made of a dark marble, almost black, with narrow
stripes of white going through it.  The walls are, oddly enough, a stained
wooden finish, and the ceiling is a typical bright shade of white.

name: Altar Room
description:
At the exit of the small, dimly-lit tunnel is a larger cavern, with many
holes in the wall of varying length and size. More make shift ladders are
carved into the stone walls, rising all the way up to the ceiling. at the
front of the room is a large, stone altar, splattered with blood, some fresh
and still dripping from the corpse laying on it. Behind the altar is a crude
drawing of a long table, with goblins, orcs, ogres, and trolls seeming to
feast on various creatures flesh. At the center of the room is a large
makeshift wooden table, bloodied and covered in the remains of various
creatures. Between the columns of holes in the wall at one point is a large
doorway, flanked either side by two rather large goblins

name: Treasure Room
description:
Inside of this room lay dozens of chests, overflowing with gold. Piles of
gold litter the floor, along with weapons and armour, some still being worn
by the skeletons of their previous owner. At the very back of the room is a
throne and a finally crafted table, with the skulls of various humanoids
placed upon it.

name: The Garden Of Shadows
description:
The stillness of this place could be part of its healing as much as anything
else. When one steps into this room, they are enfolded by an overwhelming
sense of rightness and umbrage. This is mostly due to the fact that, as they
step from the temple into this area, there is a night sky which has been
absolutely overwhelmed with flickering stars which sprawl over one's head in
an endless fresco. This night sky is the deep purple of reflections in the
depth of night and darkness, it is the melting blue of the slow healing of the
soul through sleepless reflection. Small hills roll into the distance below a
fat orange harvest moon, which bobs up and down on silver lined black midnight
clouds. The smells of running water and sweet hay drift towards around the
garden on eddies of warm breeze, and the grass and short deadwood trees creak
and sway in secret midnight songs.

The forms of recovering friends of the shadows lay out in the dark and dewy
grass of the valley and, although their eyes cannot be seen, it is only
reasonable to think that they are watching the heavens.

name: The Alabaster Courtyard
description:
The alabaster courtyard blooms with the life of spring.  The marble pillars
that surround it are draped in small flowers and the air is the purest of
perfumes.  A gentle pond, slowly bubbling with the beauty of creation takes
the center of the heavenly place.  The entire courtyard is decorated in the
art of geniuses and mad men.  The only theme that ties together the various
weapons, paintings, poetry, and tapestries is that they are all seem to honor
nature.  You see elven weapons made of the purest silver and blended with the
strongest of oak, paintings of three suns setting behind the endless sands of
the eastern desert, and a tapestry that seems to flow with all the grace
of the ocean itself.   The ground is a soft moss over pearl, cool to
the tough and softer than silk.  Within the very center of the pond sits a
humble throne of coral and pearl.

A large easel stands  in the back of the courtyard, sitting among the the
multicolored light of the stained glass windows around it.  The massive canvas
is covered in a half finished mosaic of the great adventurers that once walked
the land, Cahel Mourningstar, Vash the Hellmage, Nameless the Ancient, Jaren
the Wise, and a host of others that have shaped and changed the world, for ill
or grace.

name: The Tree Of Everland
description:
A massive tree stands in the center of this small garden.  The walls are lined
with ivy and roses.  The tree itself seems to reach higher than the stars
themselves, the thick branches providing an excellent place to safely store a
piece of armor or a sword.  The numerous nooks and squirrel holes also provide
a wonderful place to hide smaller treasures.  You swear you can smell fresh
rain in the air, the massive tree gently shaking off the morning dew into the
sweetest of spring showers.  An ancient druid tends to the garden and the to
the tree.

name: The Path To Glory
description:
The sweet smell of spring begins to fade as you make you way down the
corridor.  You are reminded that serenity cannot exist unless their are those
that are ready to fight and die for it.  Peace must be purchased with love as
well as pain.  The sounds of the city come closer and the great temple of
Sebille seems like a dream.

name: Courtyard of Unity
description:
This large courtyard is a bustle of activity with merchants from all over the
world coming to sell their wares.  High walls stationed with soldiers keeping
an eye on the crowds making their way through.  To the north end of the
courtyard lays a magnificent staircase of marble which seem to climb forever. 
Chanting of healers can be heard to the east mending the wounded and curing
the sick.

name: The Barracks
description: Under Construction

name: Halls of Healing
description:
This large candle lit hall echoes with the chanting of healing spells.  Row
after row of cots waiting for the sick lay empty. Priests and their helpers
scurry about taking care of their daily duties.  If you are in need of healing
take a quick rest on one of the cots.

name: Into the Light
description:
The magnitude of brightness here is beyond description.
You can positively feel the light waves pulsing against
your skin.  You find yourself in an immeasurable space.
Infinite and unfathomable, The Lord of Light calls this
place his home.

name: The Hoard
description:
Fires burn on torches hung from braziers on the wall. A single chest sits in
the middle of the room, which is otherwise empty. The room itself is clean if
not spotless. A slight odor of damp is obvious, but not overpowering. A
stairway along the east wall leads up.

name: Ascending from Light
description:
You find yourself in the space between the mortal realm
and the point of all creation.

name: The Medic's Tent
description:
This tent looks like a latrine on the outside, but once within the safety of
it's canvas walls, it is spacious, clean, and well stocked with the latest in
magical medical technology. Behind a sanitary curtain there are shadows moving
in surgical maneuvers that should not be seen by non-professional eyes.

name: Amongst The Heavens
description:
You stand at the top of a staircase that seems to of led you straight up into
the heavens!  Stars glisten overhead, lighting up a translucent glowing path
to the east.  The stairs lead back down to the Temple of Drazuk.

name: Amongst The Heavens
description:
The translucent path splits up here.  A white spiral staircase leads up,
closer to the stars above you.  A black staircase, formed of stone heads down
deeper into the dark.  To the east, a grey, shimmering path heads off into the
distance.  To the west you can sight the top of the staircase that leads back
down to the Temple of Drazuk.

name: The Temple Altar
description:
This is the altar room of the Temple of Drazuk.  Adventurer's usually come
here from the result of death or a recall spell.  Hopefully you walked here or
used the spell, because if you died, your corpse has not traveled with you!
There is a healer here, and a sign on the wall lets you know the prices for
that healing.

name: The Temple Of Drazuk
description:
You wander about the hallways of the Temple of Drazuk.  Many tapestries and
pictures hang on the walls, showing the life and times of Drazuk, the Ghoul
King.  You hope that perhaps your picture and tales may be seen and told
within these halls!

name: The Temple Of Drazuk -- Meeting Room
description:
You stand in the grand meeting room of the Temple of Drazuk.  Comfortable
chairs are placed around tables in groups, for the purpose of adventurers
meeting and planning out their next trip.  This is a good place to wait for
friends and meet others.  A staircase is in the corner, leading up towards the
demi-god's temples.

name: The Temple Of Drazuk
description:

pictures hang on the walls, showing the life and times of Drazuk, the Ghoul
King.  You hope that perhaps your picture and tales may be seen and told
within these halls!

name: The Temple Of Drazuk -- Judgement Room
description:
This dark hall has a huge desk on the south side, and many small chairs set
facing it.  The Gods come here to deal punishment to those mortals who cross
certain lines.  You hope you never have to come here to be sentenced!  You can
also use the large book here to sign your name into becoming a deadly killer
here.

name: The Temple Of Drazuk
description:
You wander about the hallways of the Temple of Drazuk.  Many tapestries and
pictures hang on the walls, showing the life and times of Drazuk, the Ghoul
King.  In addition to the usual decorations, a large portion of this wall is
taken up by a tall oil painting of a battle between a horrible creature and
several adventurers.  You hope that perhaps your picture and tales may be seen
and told within these halls!

name: The Temple Of Drazuk -- Donation Room
description:
This portion of the temple houses a large pit, used for storing items donated
by other adventurers.  It's worth a look to see if there is anything helpful
located within.

name: The Temple Of Drazuk -- Resting Room
description:
This room is set with every comfort that can be found in the realms.  The soft
floor is covered with huge pillows.  Servants bearing food and drink come and
go, bringing all sorts of delights.

name: Crossing A Rope Bridge
description:
The warm jungle air becomes heavy, the crystal blue waters of an ancient river
almost steam with the heat.  The bridge is a simple construction, layer upon
layer of robe and dragonhide with only a few aged planks for footing.  The odd
mist from the river and the thick trees block your view as to where this
bridge might lead.

name: The Shores Of Tenhicoal
description:
A city of stone and gold towers into the sky.  The banks of the river are
carpeted by a soft sand, crystal white and oddly cool.  The massive stone
buildings are covered in overgrowth but the gold statues and roofs shine with
all the intensity of the noonday sun.  The Wolfen guard keep a close eye on
you but make no advances upon you.  They seem content to let you stare in awe.

name: A Dirty Copper Road
description:
The ground beneath you is entirely plated in copper.  There are numerous
scratches, grooves, and pieces missing from what seems like centuries of daily
life.  The street is lined with different stores and stalls, the beating heart
of trade within the city.  You notice a few goblins in the mix, selling their
wares and offering their services.

name: A Worn Silver Road
description:
The road is now plated in the purest of refined silver giving the ancient
stone buildings a pale glow.  There are numerous homes, apartments, and even a
few taverns and pubs along the street.  The guard keep a close eye on the
residents of Tenhicoal, this must be the residential area of the neatly
ordered city.

name: A Simple Iron Road
description:
Your feet make a hard sound on the heavy iron road, the marks of stray weapons
and dragged bodies form odd patterns.  The road is faded and seems to have
little more than a brief bath when the rain comes.  The city guard as well as
what appear to be warriors populate the area.  A few large stacks of smoke and
steam give evidence to the metal works in this part of the city.

name: An Elaborate Gold Road
description:
The world seems to be bathed in the most glorious of lights, the gold beneath
you catching any stray light and reflecting it in every direction.  There
massive stone temples sprawl into a mass of craft and skill.  The priests and
medicine men of the city congregate and talk of life, magik, spirits, and the
mysterious of the world.

name: A Jewelled Hallway
description:
The hallway of the great temple of Tenhicoal is adorned by hundreds of
dazzling gems.  You see rubies, emeralds, pearls, and even diamonds carefully
placed in designs into the walls and the floor.  The royal guard keep a keen
eye on you as you make your way deeper into the massive building.  The air is
perfumed and light.

name: The Muckslab Tavern
description:
This small tavern reeks of sweat and is stained with blood.  There are
numerous Wolfen resting in the tavern, most drinking heavily.  The others are
engaged in measures of strength with each other.  A few travelling goblins
take in the sights and try not to get crushed.  A small door leads into the
back, the sound of cheering barely audible.

name: The Entrance
description:
Several large and scarred Wolfen eye you as you enter.  They nod when they see
you are not with the city guard.  Below you a series of pits with various
warriors pacing, some engaged in combat with others.  The fans watch from
above, shouting and cheering.  A small goblin looks at you and smiles.

name: The First Pit
description:
The sound of cheering is near deafening.  The spectators above throw ale and
half-eaten bones down the steel grating.  The entire pit is stained with blood
and a few missing teeth and bones slowly decaying at your feet.  There is no
way out now except victory.

name: The Second Pit
description:
The sound of cheering is near deafening.  The spectators above throw ale and
half-eaten bones down the steel grating.  The entire pit is stained with blood
and a few missing teeth and bones slowly decaying at your feet.  There is no
way out now except victory.

name: The Sewers
description:
The smell of bile and rot is damn near overpowering.  Your eyes sting and your
throat burns.  You try not to breathe too deeply.  You keep your light high in
the air, hoping to not see exactly what you are making your way through.   You
hear the sounds of all number of disgusting creatures that make this their
home.

name: The Temple Of Quetzeson
description:
The stone courtyard is massive, accented by the forty feet fountain in the
center. The plaza is amazingly decorated with dozens of statues, perfectly
arranged plants, paintings, and even live performers.  A network of
spider-silk thin glass keeps the inside of the plaza cool in the day and warm
at night.   Travellers from all over rest and relax, you feel as safe as a
child in their mother's arms.

name: A Heavy Wooden Ladder
description:
The tall buildings full of Warrens are all built onto of each other.  These
massive ladders provide access to the higher apartments.  The ladders are tied
into the buildings although the odd bladed contraptions around the ropes seem
to be a defensive invention making access into the higher apartments difficult
for invaders.

name: A Wolfen Warren
description:
This small home is modest at best.  Several  beds of soft cotton blankets and
pillows line one wall with a small place is set aside to cook.  The fire pit
leads conveniently into a smoke stack, allowing the residents to cook with
little fear of choking themselves.  There are a few toys and smaller luxuries
but it seems the people here life simple, spending most of them time outside
within the city rather than at home.

name: The Slaughtered Lamb
description:
This large pub is warm and inviting.  Despite the name it seems like a good
place to settle in for the night and enjoy a cup of ale or two and talk to the
many adventurers and travellers that stop through here.  A family of goblins
seem to run the place, the father heads up the bar while what appears to be
his son takes the orders.

name: Wirli's Magical Stockpile
description:
This neat and orderly shop has all the basic essentials a magically inclined
traveller would need.  You see potions of energy, basic healing, and even a few
potions to cure any illness caught by one of the many snakes in the jungles.
A young wolfen boy sits behind the counter and goes over some sort of list.

name: The Dragonhide Boot
description:
This tannery smells just like another places where animals are skinned and
dried, it smells horrible.  The older wolfen woman doesn't seem to mind as she
skins what appears to be a large rabbit.  The clothes do not look half bad,
most of them seem durable and well suited for travelling.  This might be an
excellent place to pick up a spare travelling set.

name: The Guard Station
description:
The walls are barren save for a few rough sketches of wanted criminals within
the city.  A few chairs sit around an empty table.  The city guard don't seem
to mind you poking around, most of them relaxing in the heat or already out
patrolling the city.

name: The Room Of Swords
description:
The warriors of the Wolfen practice relentlessly here.  The walls are full of
different swords, some mere pieces of heavy iron while others seem precisely
crafted.  The senior warriors yell out orders and taunts to the younger
warriors as they train.  They look at you and offer you a chance to prove your
might against them.

name: The Room Of Daggers
description:
The rogues and assassins of the wolfen practice their craft here.  The place
is poorly lit except for several spots where a bright light shines down.  The
wolfen take turns trying to conceal themselves within the shadows, striking at
the dummies in the light.  They watch you closely but watch your bags more
closely.

name: The Tenhicoal Armorer
description:
This small armory has quite an extensive collection.  The room is packed with
different weapons and armors as well.  You see heavy copper breastplates and
tough leather hauberks.  There are swords, axes, polearms, even a few
claw-extenders.  The ground is quite warm and an odd system of pipes leads
below.

name: The Forge
description:
The room smells of sulfur and feels hotter than a dragon's hate.  A heavy set
wolfen man works the forge and bangs out a new shield.  He nods at you and
goes back to work.

name: The Tenhicoal Barracks
description:
The warriors of the city all reside here in these barracks.  The room is
essentially just stacks upon stacks of wooden frames with a few blankets
thrown down to provide a rough mattress.  It is also so warm it is doubtful
they ever use the blankets for more than just padding.

essentially just stacks upon stacks of wooden frames with a few blankets
thrown down to provide a rough mattress.  It is also so warm it is doubtful

name: Staff And Stone
description:
This small shop is the magic supply of the various shamans, priests, magi's
and other magically inclined members of the city.  A pretty young wolfen
priestess runs the shop, a wide variety of scrolls, wands, staves, and herbs
waiting to be sold.

name: The Spirit Lodge
description:
The air is spiced with numerous incense and tobacco.  Numerous shamans sit and
offer praise to the spirits of their forebear as well as create numerous
helpful potions for the city guard or the warriors of the city.  They ignore
your presence, most of them concerned with talking with themselves rather
than you.

name: The Alcove Of The Cloaked
description:
The mages and conjurers of the wolfen relax here, dozens about dozens of great
tomes of magiks spread out across the highly polished floor.  The smell of
numerous mixtures and magical creations is heavy.  There are a few burn marks
on the walls from spells that have gone wrong or perhaps a duel amongst the
residents here.

name: The Priest's Refuge
description:
The air is full with the scent of fresh fruit and fine wine.  The priest's and
priestesses of the Wolfen relax here, some read while others simply discuss
their litanies with others.  The are large soft pillows to lounge on and
numerous servants carrying trays of food and drink.

name: The Greeting Hall
description:
This massive building is both the local pub and meeting hall of the city.  It
is all wolfen here, commoners and off-duty guards.  They seem content to joke
and talk amongst themselves although you notice they don't make any indication
they mind your presence here.  It seems like a place that is dedicated to
fellowship and kinship.

name: The Throne Of Tenhicoal
description:
The entire room is glass, you look out over the land and view its beauty. You
see jungles, rivers, open plains and the great mountains.  You can even catch
a glimmer or two of the sapphire ocean far away.  The room is relatively barren
for a King's domain but the amount of servants and concubines speaks of the
true luxury of leadership.  A massive golden throne rests directly in the
center of the room.

name: Through A Light Forest
description:
A tiny path leads through a lightly forested area.  This now seems like less a
path, and more of just a space with a little less growth then around you.  The
game path lies back to the east.

name: Through A Light Forest
description:
A tiny path leads through a lightly forested area.  This now seems like less a
path, and more of just a space with a little less growth then around you.  The
undergrowth seems to thicken towards the west.

name: Through A Light Forest
description:

path, and more of just a space with a little less growth then around you.  The
undergrowth seems to thicken towards the west.

name: Through A Light Forest
description:

name: In A Thorny Thicket
description:
You push your way through a large thicket, the tough branches covered in sharp
thorns.  Even the toughest armor has a few scratches after forcing your way
past the vines.  The light forest stands around you, just enough scrawny trees
to obscure your view a bit.

name: Through A Light Forest
description:
A tiny path leads through a lightly forested area.  From what you can tell,
this must be some sort of game path, as it doesn't look liked many humanoids
have traveled along it.  The wind is warm, and an almost "happy" feeling is in
the air.  South of here lies the Greenpath.

name: The Toadstool Circle
description:
You stand in a small clearing in the forest.  The major landmark here is a
large circle of toadstools.  All about you see sense movement, and
occasionally hear bits of song and laughter.  Each time you turn to look,
nothing is there!

name: The Hollow Tree
description:
A large, hollowed out tree stands here.  Within is what appears to be a small
shop, as little bottles and other magical items sit about on display.  A large
log is placed as a counter in front of the tree.

name: A Large Toadstool
description:
An extra large toadstool stands here.  The area around the toadstool is
carpeted with a bright green grass, which feels like the softest carpet under
your feet.

name: A Lighted Path
description:
A small path leads away from the toadstool circle, and into a smaller clearing
north of you.  While you can't see any apparent lights, this area seems
brighter than the surrounding forest.  You hear the sound of music and singing
north of here.

name: The Mystic Spring
description:
A sparkling spring of water sits in a circle of trees here.  The sound of the
gurgling spring is calming and makes you feel better just standing here.  A
feeling of safety emanates from the clearing.

name: Circle Of The Court
description:
You enter a brightly lit clearing in the forest.  On the north end of the
clearing lies a tree, whose roots seem to form what looks like a chair, or
perhaps a throne.  Bright green vines intertwine with the roots, and the smell
of mint fills the air.

name: The Toadstool Circle
description:
You stand in a small clearing in the forest.  As you look about, you realize
you stand in the exact center of the ring of toadstools.  All about you see
sense movement, and occasionally here bits of song and laughter.  Each time
you turn to look, nothing is there!

name: Inside Flutterby's Toadstool
description:
The inside is small for human standards, but for a pixie it's nice and roomy.
The room is rounded and the walls are lined with shelves filled with various
types of jars and other containers. The floor is covered with a woven grass
rug. A small firefly floats around the ceiling, providing much needed light
inside the otherwise dark room.

along a smooth saddle in the sand dunes.  Off to the east, you see a large
stone tower poking up out of the sand.

name: A Hallway Of White Stone

both the north and the south from here, are built of a shiny white stone.
What appear to be glowing gemstones are placed in the ceiling at equal
lengths, lighting your way.  A plain brown carpet runs down the middle of the
hallway.

name: Storage Closet
description:
This small room must be a storage closet of some sorts, as all you can see
about you are the various implements and tools used for keeping a tower clean.
 It smells of a flowery soapy smell in here.

name: Greeting Hall
description:
You stand at the western end of a large greeting hall.  Cupboards and cubbies
are placed along the walls, for the purpose of travellers storing their
belongings.  Wooden pegs are placed above, for hanging backpacks and cloaks.
A long table with a few chairs runs the length of the room.

name: Greeting Hall
description:
You stand in the middle of a large greeting hall.  Cupboards and cubbies
are placed along the walls, for the purpose of travellers storing their
belongings.  Wooden pegs are placed above, for hanging backpacks and cloaks.
A long table with a few chairs runs the length of the room.

name: Greeting Hall
description:
You stand at the eastern end of a large greeting hall.  Cupboards and cubbies
are placed along the walls, for the purpose of travellers storing their
belongings.  Wooden pegs are placed above, for hanging backpacks and cloaks.
A long table with a few chairs runs the length of the room.  A large fire
roars in a fireplace in the eastern wall.

name: Guard Booth
description:
This small room is a waiting area for the gate guards.  A small table sits in
the middle of the room, and a wood-burning stove smokes away in the
southeastern corner.

name: Cooling Room
description:
As soon as you enter this room, you feel the drop in temperature.  Lots of
vegetables and preserved meats are placed on wooden planks that run the length
of the eastern wall.

name: A Carved Rock Staircase
description:
You climb a spiral staircase carved of a smooth brown rock.  Down below, you
see the bottom level of the tower, and its hallways of white stone.  Above,
the hallways of the next level are a light brown in color.

description:

rumbling and pounding can be occasionally heard from down the halls.  What
appear to be glowing gemstones are placed in the ceiling at equal lengths,
lighting your way.  The floor is dirt, and in places, grass and plants attempt
to grow.  A small cave can be seen to the east.

name: A Small Cave
description:
You stand in a small cave, bored into the sandstone of the hallway.  Evidence
of a small campfire is left in the middle of the cave, showing that this might
be a safe place to rest and regroup.

name: A Brightly Lit Cave
description:
This small cave has brightly glowing crystals all over the walls.  The light
coming from here seems to have attracted most of the bugs in the hallway to
this cavern.

name: A Sandy Cave
description:
This large sandy cave looks like it was dug out of the sandstone of the
hallway.  Something doesn't feel right about this large cave...you don't
recall seeing anything on the outside of the tower that would indicate this
large cavern would be here.

name: A Crack In The Stone
description:
This small crack in the sandstone barely has enough room for you to squeeze
through.  A small glittering light to the east makes you wonder what lies at
the end of this crevice.

name: A Crack In The Stone
description:
You squeeze your way through the slim crack in the sandstone.  The crack has
slowly narrowed to the point where you can't go any further in this direction.
 You can maybe back out to the west if you are careful.

name: A Dripping Cave
description:
This large cave has a clear pool of water exactly in the center of it.  The
sounds of echoing drips of liquid can be heard all around you, but there are
no corresponding stalactites for water to drip from.

name: A Humid Cave
description:
There is so much vegetation in this small cave, that it is difficult to find a
place to walk.  It is warm and humid in here, and small drops of water hang
from the tips of the jungle foliage.

name: A Lush Passage
description:
This passage has lots of lush plants and bushes growing from the floor and
walls.  Small jungle trees stand on the edge of a little pool of water, with a
tiny stream that leads off to the east.  The buzz of insects is in the air.

name: A Lush Passage
description:
This passage has lots of lush plants and bushes growing from the floor and
walls.  Little fish dart about in the slowly moving stream that cuts through
the middle of this room.  The buzz of insects is in the air.

name: A Lush Passage
description:

name: A Dark Rock Staircase
description:
You climb a spiral staircase carved of a rough black rock.  Down below, you
see another level of the tower, and its hallways of brown stone.  Above,
the hallways of the next level are a black in color.

name: A Hallway Of Rough Lavarock
description:
You stand in a hallway that is built out of a rough lavarock.  Occasional
blasts of heated air blow past you.  What appear to be glowing gemstones are
placed in the ceiling at equal lengths, lighting your way.  The floor is
rocky, and nothing seems to be able to grow.  A spiral staircase made from a
rough black rock heads down.  A crack in the lava heads west.

description:

your way through this fissure in the lava rock.  Its hard not to scrape
yourself on the jutting teeth of stone.

name: A Rough Tunnel
description:
A small tunnel has been created through the rough lava rock, probably by the
flow of molten stone a long time ago.  The walls are quite warm to the touch,
and you feel a strange vibration under your feet.  The main hall lies to the
north.

name: A Hot Cavern
description:
This rocky cavern seems almost hotter than the surrounding halls, if that is
possible.  In places, you see the orange glow of lava trying to melt through
the floor of the cave.

name: A Hot Cavern
description:

possible.  In places, you see the orange glow of lava trying to melt through
the floor of the cave.  The cave deadends here.

name: A Small Alcove
description:
You stand in a small alcove, worn from the rough lava rock ages ago.  There is
a small vent in the rock above you, and the air coming into this small cave is
cooler than the hallways around you.  This looks like a safe place to rest.

name: A Smooth Lava Bore
description:
This wide tunnel is perfectly smooth, and the walls are warm to the touch.  It
seems that lava has passed through this rock much more recently than in the
surrounding hallways.

name: A Smoky Cave
description:
This cave is quite hot, and filled with a dark gray smoke.  Small fires burn
all about the cavern, the rock itself so hot that it ignites into bursts of
flame.

name: A Small Lava Cave
description:
A small cave is dug out of the rough lava rock.  Evidence of creatures living
here is all about...charred bones, old burnt skins, and other bits of debris.

name: A Blue Marble Staircase
description:
You climb a spiral staircase crafted out of a dark blue marble.  Down below,
you see another level of the tower, and its hallways of dark and rough
lavarock.  Above, the hallways of the next level are a turquoise in color.

name: A Hallway Of Smooth Turquoise
description:
You stand in a hallway that is crafted from smooth, flowing turquoise.  Water
comes up to a humans waist, and is clear and cool.  What appear to be glowing
gemstones are placed in the ceiling at equal lengths, lighting your way.  The
floor is sandy, and small patches of seagrass sway in the current.  A dark
blue marble staircase spirals its way down.  A small coral cave is off to the
east.

name: A Coral Filled Cavern
description:
This small side cavern has coral growths covering most of the wall.  The floor
is rocky and uneven, and you can see many small colorful fish dart amongst the
cracks and crevices.  The sound of water splashing against the rocks echos
about the cave.

name: A Cloudlike Staircase
description:
You climb a spiral staircase crafted out of some cloudlike substance.  Down
below, you see another level of the tower, and its hallways of smooth blue
marble.  Above, the hallways of the next level are a misty gray.

name: A Hallway Of Mist
description:
You stand in a hallway that is created from thick mist and fog.  Winds whip
around your body, making it hard to hold onto your smaller items.  What appear
to be glowing gemstones are placed in the ceiling at equal lengths, lighting
your way.  The floor is shrouded in fog, but feels solid under your feet.  A
cloudy gray staircase spirals its way down.

name: A Dark Corridor
description:
A small dark corridor heads off of the misty hallway.  The sounds of your

name: A Black Staircase
description:
You stand about halfway up a spiral staircase, carved from solid obsidian.
The rock is smooth, shiny, and black as the blackest night.  The whole area
around you seems to absorb the light.  The shadow of a small hall is below
you, and above you is only darkness.

name: A Dark Black Hallway
description:
This hallway is dark as night, the black obsidian walls shiny in your own
light.  It is quite silent all around you...you can barely hear your own
movements.  A strange feeling of doom seems to shroud the hallway, but you
don't see anything to explain why.

name: Mirror Room
description:
The only thing you see in this whole room is a large mirror that is attached
to the west wall.  A plain iron frame runs around the outside of the mirror.
Otherwise this room is dark, cold and empty.

name: Dark Study
description:
You stand in what appears to be some sort of office or study.  An elegant
chair stands in front of an ornate obsidian desk.  Papers with mystical runes
are scattered about the desk.  A small cabinet stands next to the desk.

name: The Tainted Surgery
description:
The first thing you notice as you enter this large room is the stench of
decaying flesh.  Looking about you see quite a few hideous tools, covered in
blood.  Three rough iron tables are setup, one with the remnants of a carved
up creature slowly rotting atop it.  Broken chemical bottles and small tools
are strewn about the floor.

name: The Tainted Surgery

up creature slowly rotting atop it.  Broken chemical bottles and small tools
are strewn about the floor.

name: Chemical Storage
description:
The smell of acidic liquids and caustic powders fills the air of this small
room.  Numerous wooden shelves are set into each wall.  Each shelf is
overflowing with small reagent bottles, paper packets of powders, and curious
looking herbs in jars.

name: A Dark Closet
description:
This room must be some sort of storage closet, as its barely big enough for
you to fit inside, and all you see is a tall cupboard sitting against the
eastern wall.

name: The Summoning Chamber
description:
You stand at one end of a large chamber.  Many diagrams of summoning circles
and the runes to activate them hang from the walls, and a small wooden table
is covered in various drawing tools.

name: The Summoning Chamber
description:
You stand in the middle of a large chamber.  Many diagrams of summoning
circles and the runes to activate them hang from the walls, and a small wooden
table is covered in various drawing tools.

name: The Summoning Chamber
description:
You stand at the far end of a large chamber.  Many diagrams of summoning
circles and the runes to activate them hang from the walls, and a small wooden
table is covered in various drawing tools.  A large circle is carved into the
rock floor, with many different designs and permutations carved about it to
ease the work of the summoner.

name: A Narrow Stairway
description:
You stand within the confines of a narrow staircase, crafted from plain gray
stone.  No light shines from above or below...the only source of illumination
being your own lightsource.

name: A Plain Gray Hallway
description:
After the rest of the tower, this level seems pretty unexciting.  The walls
are crafted from simple granite bricks.  It is only after you look closer that
you notice the strange runes carved into each brick.  A narrow staircase leads
back down into the tower from here.

are crafted from simple granite bricks.  It is only after you look closer that

name: Chamber Of Order
description:
Whomever inhabits this chamber must be very orderly.  Everything seems to be
in the right place, and items are sorted by color, size, and other various
systems.  The desk in the middle of the room is placed so that the sides are
exactly parallel with the walls of the chamber.  Every painting is hung
perfectly straight.

description:

Some boxes are piled in the northeast corner, but they are stacked
precariously, as if the owner had no plan in mind when they started storing
things.  Tapestries are hung upside down, or crookedly, and paintings are hung
in places where they are blocked by the columns.

name: Entrance To The Trials
description:
You step into a small antechamber of the old tower.  As soon as you enter, you
feel the unmistakable chill of things long dead.  A small bronze sign hangs on
the wall next to the entrance, proclaiming "Welcome to the Trials.  Be on your
guard adventurer!"

name: Somewhere Underground
description:
After stepping through the threshold, you're overwhelmed by the stench of
death and decay.  An uneasy chill settles over your body as you realize this
place and feeling seems familiar somehow, with the only difference being the
locations of spattered blood and bones.

name: The First Trial
description:
As you step into the first trial room, you can't help but notice the abundance
 of fresh corpses strewn haphazardly about the chambers.  Apparently you
aren't  the first to take these trials.

name: Climbing The Tower
description:
You stand at the top of the staircase.  The stench of the undead below you
drifts up here, and you wonder if you'll ever find fresh air again.  The
passage continues on to the north.

name: Wandering The Tower
description:
You move along, your light barely pushing back the creeping darkness.  The
sound of shuffling and what seem to be groans come from all around you.  You
feel as if something stands right behind you, but when you turn, nothing is
there.

name: The Second Trial
description:
You enter another small room, apparently holding another demonic denizen.
Many ghoulish runes are carved into the floor and walls, probably to contain
the evil forces to this small lair.

name: Climbing The Tower
description:
Some small windows at the top of this stair allows you to get a glimpse of the
world outside, and also a small, refreshing amount of clean air.  You see the
Plains Road stretch out east and west below, while further west the forest
gives way to a thick jungle.  Darkness lies to the north.

name: Wandering The Tower
description:
The silence of this floor is quite unnerving.  After all the noise the other
shambling undead made, you wonder now if you have put all that behind you.
Yet the scattered bones remain on the floor, proof that something does indeed
stalk about.

The silence of this floor is quite unnerving.  After all the noise the other
shambling undead made, you wonder now if you have put all that behind you.
Yet the scattered bones remain on the floor, proof that something does indeed
stalk about.

name: The Third Trial
description:
Blood and deep claw marks cover the stone walls of this chamber.  Even more
eerie is the lack of corpse remains that littered the floors of the other
chambers.

name: Climbing The Tower
description:
You stand once again at the top of a spiral staircase, on another level of
this accursed tower.  The stench of death still exists, but isn't as
strong...or perhaps you are just getting used to it.  Darkness lies to the
north.

name: Wandering The Tower
description:
Faint scratching noises and scuffs in the dust on the floor show that this
level is indeed inhabited, probably by more of the undead.  The bones on the
floor have been reduced to tiny shards, as if something was crunching them up.

description:

name: Wandering The Tower
description:
You are once again shrouded in quiet, except this time it seems as if even the
noises of your own passage are absorbed into the black.  Occasionally you
think you see small lights off in the distance, but they disappear fast enough
that you aren't sure you really saw them.

victims...

name: The Sixth Trial
description:
This chamber is much larger than any of the previous Trial chambers.  Many
runes in silver and mithril are laid into the floor and walls, with a huge
ruby placed into the ceiling.  The room is awash in a reddish glow, coming
from the ruby itself.

name: Climbing The Tower
description:
A solitary window at the top of the stairs shows nothing but dark storm clouds
all around the tower.  Dark birds circle and glide on the strong breezes that
you can feel rushing through the small opening.  The usual darkness to the
north seems colder and somehow, more forbidding.

name: The Darkened Chamber
description:
You stand in a dark and cold chamber.  Your light is absorbed quickly by the
blanket-like black surrounding you.  Cackles and cries can be heard all around
you.  The strange sounds assault your ears and mind, making it hard to
concentrate on your surroundings.  You feel engulfed in chaos.

You stand in a dark and cold chamber.  Your light is absorbed quickly by the
blanket-like black surrounding you.  Cackles and cries can be heard all around
you.  The strange sounds assault your ears and mind, making it hard to
concentrate on your surroundings.  You feel engulfed in chaos.

name: Off The Opium Road
description:
The path is easy to follow and seems to be well maintained. You can see the
deep grooves of numerous carts that seem to be carrying quite heavy loads on
their way back towards the main road.  Down a ways you can make out smoke and
signs of a small settlement.

name: On The Outskirts Of Lgonlilve
description:
The path is well worn and you can see the the half-troll village of Lgonlilve.
There are numerous people about, the citizens of the village as well as a
strong presence of imperial soldiers.  The houses and buildings seem poorly
made save for a few.  To the east is one of them.

name: Along The Main Road
description:
This road is really nothing more than well packed earth and a few stones on
the side to create the sense of a road. Numerous buildings dot the street and
it seems that there isn't much else to this tiny village. The citizens seem to
mind their own business, occasionally a child will look up at you in wonder.

name: The Imperial Outfitters
description:
This small shop is suited to meet the needs of the Imperial soldiers and
citizens that are stationed here. None of the half-trolls have entered here,
only a few off-duty soldiers.  Weapons and armor, all standard issue, line the
walls as well as some basic provisions.

name: The Waterin' Hole
description:
This simple pub is an uneasy mix of Imperials and the local villagers. The bar
top is tarnished and dirty, the stools look unsafe to sit in, and there seems
to be little merriment.  The smell of cheap drinks is heavy in the air.

name: A Closed Down Shop
description:
This building must have been a shop once.  The dust and amount of rodents
would suggest that is has been closed for a good while now. A few pieces of
jewelry and tribal clothing are left to decay on the floor.

name: The Limb And Leaf
description:
This shop caters more to the half-troll population of the village.  The walls
are lined with weapons and armor, all of them made out of wood or bamboo. None
of the Imperials enter the shop, probably due to the large full-blooded troll
busy behind the counter.

name: Inside A Half-Troll Longhouse
description:
The half-troll living quarters are more of huge houses that numerous families
must share.  You see rows of simple beds, a few racks for clothes or
possessions, and precious little else. Children run around playing games while
some of the adults stare out the window.  Judging by the designs on the floor
and roof that separate each section of the house, these were quickly and
poorly built over existing buildings.

name: Inside A Small Hut
description:
The occupants of this hut are quite lucky.  They have their own lodging and it
seems that only one family lives here. There is even a chair or two and a few
other luxuries. The large Z painted on the ceiling must mean that this family
is a public supporter of the Imperial forces.

name: Inside A Half-Troll Longhouse
description:
This longhouse is half finished and still under construction. To the north you
can  see several empty huts that are being tore apart and then simply grafted
onto the longhouse. Even worse, it seems that several families of half-trolls
have already been moved into the half completed home.

name: Before A Large Hut
description:
To the south is a huge hut that must be the seat of authority in the village.
To the east and west are smaller dirt paths that lead to more of the
half-troll longhouses. The presence of the Imperials is much less in this
part of the village.

name: Along A Small Dirt Path
description:
This dirt path is filled with weeds and grass.  The signs of heavy foot
traffic and wagons has disappeared. To the east you can make out a huge
longhouse that looks to have been constantly repaired and maintained.

name: Behind A Hut
description:
This small courtyard behind the hut is completely hidden from the road. The
dense bushes and foliage prevent anyone from seeing in and offers a nice shady
spot to relax. Below a large table with several Imperial symbols painted on is
what appears to be a door.

name: Inside A Hidden Room
description:
This room must be used to give shelter to runaways or rebel escapists. It is
stocked with food, water, warm blankets, and everything else a person would
need to hide out for a few days.  This would be an excellent place to sit and
stay awhile.

name: Inside A Half-Troll Longhouse
description:
This longhouse is beautifully maintained and decorated. The walls are covered
in paintings and poetry made by the citizens of the city. The smell of incense
is heavy in the air and the floor is covered in soft mats of woven reeds and
fur.  You see several of the half-trolls inside working on maintaining the
building or adding more decorations.

creature comforts are all but removed.

name: Inside The Imperial Checkpoint
description:
This stone building is the seat of power for the Imperials in the city. The
walls are solid stone and the floor is well carpeted. Numerous imperial
soldiers and citizens are making their way, checking in with the captains or
trying to get a slaver's permit.

name: Inside The Prefect's office.
description:
This small office is covered in papers and books.  The walls are adorned with
paintings of the great imperial cities as well as images of the Emperor and
his son.  The prefect's desk is a mess of slaver's licenses and the bi-monthly
census of the half-troll population.

name: Inside The Royal Hut
description:
This larger hut is wildly decorated with numerous animal skins and heads.
Judging by the holes in the decorations it seems that all the weapons and
armors were removed.  The floor is a soft fur and the walls are a heavy thatch
of reeds and mud.  To the south is the throne room.

name: The Lgonlilve Throne
description:
The throne is made of wood and nothing else.  The walls are bear and the floor
is carpeted by mats of reeds and not much else.  There are several pictures of
the Imperial Family and cities but the throne has been turned to look away
from them.

name: A Narrow Crevasse
description:
You stand in a narrow crevasse through the mountains.  There is barely enough
room for two people to stand side-by-side on this trail.  It is unusually
quiet here; the normal mountain creatures are nowhere to be found.

name: Within Tyrybblyn
description:
You stand within a large cavern, the ceiling so high you cannot see it.
Slaves of the drow move about, doing their duty to their masters.  High above
you, the sound of a cruel wind can be heard, whistling about the stalactites
on the roof.  It is quite cold here.

name: House Karanthen
description:
This small house is still quite rich, compared to some of the dwellings you've
seen on the surface.  Pictures of a powerful drow female hang along one wall,
probably a matron of the house.  A large table sits in the middle of the room,
probably some sort of meeting place.

name: House Karanthen
description:
You stand within the main hall of House Karanthen.  Several small chambers
head off of this one, probably to sleeping quarters of the drow who make up
this house.  A small altar to the Spider Queen sits in the middle of the room.

name: Sithyrr And Gear
description:
This small cavern seems to house some sort of weaponsmith.  Strange weapons
hang from the walls, from small daggers, easy to hide, to hand-held crossbows
and their poisoned darts.  A long counter runs the length of the eastern wall.

name: House Ssin'urn
description:
You stand within the hall of House Ssin'urn.  Several hallways branch
off, leading to sleeping quarters and other minor locations.  This house is
clean and has some expensive looking artwork hanging from the walls.

name: House Ssin'urn
description:
You stand within the hall of House Ssin'urn.  Several hallways branch
off, leading to sleeping quarters and other minor locations.  This house is
clean and has some expensive looking artwork hanging from the walls.

name: House Ssin'urn
description:
You stand within the main hall of House Ssin'urn.  A large altar to the Spider
Queen is placed in the northeast corner of the room.  From the blood stains on
the floor, it looks like it has been used recently.

name: House Ssin'urn
description:
You stand within the hall of House Ssin'urn.  Several hallways branch
off, leading to sleeping quarters and other minor locations.  This house is
clean and has some expensive looking artwork hanging from the walls.

name: House Ssin'urn
description:
You stand within the hall of House Ssin'urn.  Several hallways branch
off, leading to sleeping quarters and other minor locations.  This house is
clean and has some expensive looking artwork hanging from the walls.

name: Ky'ostal Kreations
description:
The gear of an armorsmith lays about this small cave.  A huge fire burns along
the western wall.  It must be magical, since you see no sign of wood or other
fuels.  The delicate instruments used to shape mithril are placed on a long
table along the south wall.

name: House Belaern
description:
The entrance hall of House Belaern is huge.  The ceiling stretches off into
the distance.  Magical lights float about the stalactites, giving the room a
strange, shifting glow.  Trophies of war stand on various pedestals about the
room.

name: House Belaern
description:

the distance.  Magical lights float about the stalactites, giving the room a
strange, shifting glow.  Trophies of war stand on various pedestals about the
room.

name: House Belaern
description:
The entrance hall of House Belaern is huge.  The ceiling stretches off into
the distance.  Magical lights float about the stalactites, giving the room a
strange, shifting glow.  Trophies of war stand on various pedestals about the
room.

name: House Belaern
description:
This is the altar room of House Belaern.  The altar to Lloth that is placed
against the western wall is carved from a giant piece of ebony.  Various
scenes of death and war are carved into its surface.  A strong incense burns
in the braziers surrounding the altar.

name: House Z'Ress
description:
From the look of this house, the drow who reside here must be the current
rulers of Tyrybblyn.  Although gruesome and horrifying, the art on the walls
is quite well crafted, and many valuable artifacts stand about, trophies from
some war or another.

name: House Z'Ress
description:

rulers of Tyrybblyn.  Although gruesome and horrifying, the art on the walls
is quite well crafted, and many valuable artifacts stand about, trophies from
some war or another.

description:

some war or another.

name: House Z'Ress
description:
You stand in the meeting room of the ruling house of Tyrybblyn.  A large ebony
table stands in the center of the room, and intricately carved stone chairs
sit about it at equal intervals.  The strange magical lights float about the
ceiling of this room.

name: House Z'Ress
description:
From the look of this house, the drow who reside here must be the current
rulers of Tyrybblyn.  Although gruesome and horrifying, the art on the walls
is quite well crafted, and many valuable artifacts stand about, trophies from
some war or another.

name: House Z'Ress
description:
Noticing all the beds and lockers here, you realize you must of wandered into
the barracks of the ruling house of Tyrybblyn.  You get a very bad feeling
when you realize that the most mighty warriors of the underworld make their
home in this room.

name: House Z'Ress
description:
The altar room of House Z'Ress is quite impressive.  A gold and ebony altar to
Lloth stands against the north wall, shaped like a giant spider.  Many candles
burn brightly around the sides of the room, but the darkness still seems to
envelop everything.  The smell of incense is very strong here.

name: A Path To The Grove
description:
This small dirt path leads north to small grove of sweet-smelling pine trees.
The sound of birds fills the air, and there is a feeling of happiness in the
air.  South of here is the main road through the plains.

name: A Gap In The Trees
description:
For some reason, the trees here have not grown as closely together as in the
rest of the grove.  Through the gap north of the grove, you spy the entrance
of a large cave.  The area is quite clean of the usual forest debris, as if
someone was deliberately keeping this area nice and neat.

name: The Cave Entrance
description:
You stand before the entrance to the large cave.  You sight the tracks of what
appears to be deer heading in and out of the cave.  Perhaps this is some sort
of den.

name: A Huge Cavern
description:
The tracks lead deeper into the cave, which you now realize is quite a bit
larger than you thought.  Although dark, the temperature is quite comfortable,
and the ground is nice and clean.

name: A Huge Cavern
description:
You reach the back of the huge cavern.  Looking about, you notice markings
that could only be left be sleeping creatures.  You guess that the deer of the
grove occasionally use the cave as shelter.

description:

village is neat and clean, with well-kept gardens everywhere you look.

A small dirt road circles the little village of Underhill.  Halflings smile
and wave at you as they travel about their business.  Every so often you hear
a bit of song or some laughter coming from the little hobbit holes.  The
village is neat and clean, with well-kept gardens everywhere you look.

name: The Golden Lily
description:
You step into a large, comfortable tavern.  A large fire burns in a fireplace
set into the northern wall, and a beautiful oak bar runs along the length of
the west wall.  Pictures of various hobbit "heroes", mostly cooks and
gardeners, hang about the place.   Several small tables sit in the middle of
the room, surrounding by wooden chairs, polished to a bright shine from use.

name: A Well-Tended Garden
description:
You stand in front of a small door that leads down into the earth, surrounding
by many wildflowers.  The owner of this hole has planted flowers whose colors
encompass every color of the rainbow, making the bright yellow door seem
fitting, instead of garish.

name: A Comfy Hobbit Hole
description:
With a ceiling obviously made for the shorter race, this hobbit hole is clean
and comfortably furnished.  The smell of fresh bread floats in from the
kitchen.  A large plush chair sits in front of the small fireplace, and
bookshelves lines the walls.  Most of the books seem to be about seeds and
growing seasons.

name: A Well-Tended Garden
description:
The entrance to a small hobbit hole is surrounded by a small flower bed.
While not as extravagant as some of the other gardens you've seen so far, this
one is still well-kept and pleasant.

name: A Comfy Hobbit Hole
description:
With a ceiling obviously made for the shorter race, this hobbit hole is clean
and comfortably furnished.  Many books are scattered about a table sitting in
the middle of the room.  Glancing over them, they seem to be mostly cookbooks
and stories of hobbit adventurers.

name: A Well-Tended Garden
description:
Neatly trimmed hedges form a circular design around the path and entranceway
to this hobbit hole.  Small white berries grow on the green bushes and provide
a pleasant piney scent to the surrounding area.

name: A Comfy Hobbit Hole
description:
With a ceiling obviously made for the shorter race, this hobbit hole is clean
and comfortably furnished.  A small fire crackles in the fireplace, and a
large rocking chair is pulled up close to it.  A comfy quilt lies on the floor
in front of the chair.

name: The Bakery
description:
A wave of heat hits you as you enter this building.  It must be coming from
the large oven leaning against the west wall.  A large stack of wood stands
nearby, obviously to fuel the fires that cook the wonderful breads you smell.
A small counter for placing orders stands in front of the ovens.

name: A Well-Tended Garden
description:
This garden looks a little disheveled when compared to the others, as if noone
has had time to take care of the weeds and vines that slowly move in.  A large
tree stands over the doorway of the hobbit hole.  The humming of bee's comes
from deep within the trunk.

name: A Comfy Hobbit Hole
description:
With a ceiling obviously made for the shorter race, this hobbit hole is clean
and comfortably furnished.  The smell of fresh bread floats in from the
kitchen.  A small couch sits against the wall, perfect for lying down, kicking
up your feet and taking a short nap.

name: Underhill Brewery
description:
A large brewing vat takes up most of this building, obviously a brewery.  The
smell of hops and aging wort fills the air.  Several scrubbed barrels are
stacked along the far wall, ready to be filled with the fine brew currently
aging in the large vat.

name: A Manicured Path
description:
Small rocks line the pathway leading to a large building to the north.  The
grass on either side of the path is carefully mowed, and a few of the hedges
are trimmed to look like bears and deer and other wild animals of the plains.

name: A Manicured Path
description:
Small rocks line the pathway leading to a large building to the north.  The
grass on either side of the path is carefully mowed, and a few of the hedges
are trimmed to look like bears and deer and other wild animals of the plains.
North of you stands the entrance to a large building.

name: Mayors Lobby
description:
A small receptionist desk is placed in the entranceway of this large building.
A tapestry hangs on the wall behind the desk, with the symbol of Underhill
embroidered into it with brightly colored yarn.  A small pot of flowers sits
on the corner of the desk.

name: The Meeting Room
description:
A large conference table sits in the middle of this large room.  Many small
chairs surround the table.  Placed along the wall at equal distances apart are
various painting of former Mayors and Shiriffs.

name: The Mayors Office
description:
A large desk takes up most of this room.  Many papers are scattered about in
disarray, giving the impression that the Mayor is disorganized and/or cares
not for the information they contain.  A small Underhill flag hangs behind the
desk.  A small keg of beer also stands behind the desk.

name: Storage Room
description:
A small storage room houses brooms and mops and other supplies used by the
Mayors employees.  Buckets are stacked in one corner, and a large barrel of
fresh water sits opposite.

name: The Dancing Cow
description:
From the looks of things, this tavern is a pure drinking establishment.  Long
tables with benches fill the room, and a large shelf covered in mugs lines the
western wall.  Several large kegs stand against the south side of the
building.  Many windows are placed about, allowing the cheery sunlight in
during the day, and views of the night sky during the evening.

name: Outside Of Bazabel
description:
You are standing outside of the monstrous walls of Bazabel.  The road stretches
down through the thin forest.  Several sentries are positioned behind the
trees, making them impossible to see if you were walking towards the city.
Numerous workers travel into and out of the gate and down the road.

name: On The Woodland Route
description:
The city fades from view behind the thick pale colored trees that surround the
path. The road itself is well cared for as large stones and other debris seems
constantly cleared, much to the enjoyment of the constant stream of travelers
and workers. The air is crisp and the trees provide excellent cover.

name: In Warm Waters
description:
The water of this sea is warmer than its sister seas up north.  Due to the
warmth, more algae seems to be growing here, giving the sea a dark green hue.
Occasionally, small bits of plant and wood float over the swells.  Cries of
seabirds can be heard faintly, from far overhead.

warmth, more algae seems to be growing here, giving the sea a dark green hue.
Occasionally, small bits of plant and wood float over the swells.  Cries of
seabirds can be heard faintly, from far overhead.  Waves crash against the
rocks to the south and west, making them impossible to climb up on.

name: Under Dark Waters
description:
The abundant algae making these seas home blocks any vision past a few feet.
The dark, warm water surrounds and comforts you.  If it wasn't for the fact
that breathing water is a hardship, its almost quite comfortable here.
Bubbles slowly float up from the ocean bottom, evidence of other creatures
swimming in your vicinity.
